title: Enzymatic activity-independent NANS stabilizes LATS2 to drive growth and therapeutic resistance in HR+/HER2- breast cancer
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Hormone receptor-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HR+ /HER2-) breast cancer is the most common subtype in females, frequently challenged by resistance to endocrine therapy and CDK4/6 inhibitors. Here we show that N-acetylneuraminate synthase (NANS) is significantly upregulated in female HR+ /HER2- breast cancer patients, inversely correlating with patient prognosis. Functionally, NANS promotes tumor growth and confers resistance to tamoxifen and CDK4/6 inhibitors independently of its canonical enzymatic activity. Mechanistically, NANS recruits ubiquitin-specific protease 7 (USP7) to deubiquitinate and stabilize large tumor suppressor kinase 2 (LATS2), leading to canonical Hippo pathway activation and upregulation of estrogen receptor α and CDK4. Reintroducing LATS2 into NANS-depleted cells partially rescues the impaired growth-promoting and drug-resistant phenotypes in vitro and in vivo. Furthermore, the clinical relevance of the NANS-USP7/LATS2 axis is confirmed in patient-derived female HR+ /HER2- breast cancer samples. Together, our findings unveil an enzymatic activity-independent role for NANS in driving therapy resistance, nominating it as a promising therapeutic target.
title_zh: 不依赖酶活性的 NANS 稳定 LATS2，以促进 HR+/HER2- 乳腺癌的生长和治疗耐药性
abstract_zh: 激素受体阳性、人表皮生长因子受体 2 阴性 (HR+ /HER2-) 乳腺癌是女性中最常见的亚型，经常受到内分泌治疗和 CDK4/6 抑制剂耐药的挑战。在这里，我们发现女性 HR+/HER2- 乳腺癌患者中 N-乙酰神经氨酸合酶 (NANS) 显着上调，与患者预后呈负相关。从功能上讲，NANS 促进肿瘤生长并赋予对他莫昔芬和 CDK4/6 抑制剂的抗性，与其典型的酶活性无关。从机制上讲，NANS 招募泛素特异性蛋白酶 7 (USP7) 去泛素化并稳定大肿瘤抑制激酶 2 (LATS2)，从而导致典型的 Hippo 通路激活以及雌激素受体 α 和 CDK4 的上调。将 LATS2 重新引入 NANS 耗尽的细胞中，可以在体外和体内部分挽救受损的生长促进和耐药表型。此外，NANS-USP7/LATS2 轴的临床相关性在患者来源的女性 HR+/HER2- 乳腺癌样本中得到证实。总之，我们的研究结果揭示了 NANS 在驱动治疗抵抗中的独立于酶活性的作用，将其提名为有前途的治疗靶点。

title: The critical challenges of energy diversification and environmental sustainability in the European Green Deal: Empirical evidence from European countries
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Energy Policy
abstract: The European Green Deal identifies energy diversification and environmental sustainability as two central pillars for achieving a secure, resilient, and climate-neutral energy system. Although previous studies have examined the determinants of environmental sustainability and the energy transition separately, limited evidence exists on how energy diversification, globalization, financial development, natural capital, and structural change jointly shape environmental sustainability within the European Green Deal framework. This study addresses this gap by investigating the macroeconomic determinants of environmental sustainability across 26 European countries during 1995-2023. The analysis employs dynamic System GMM as the primary estimation method, complemented by CS-ARDL to examine long-run relationships and machine-learning models with SHAP explainability to assess the relative importance of the explanatory variables. The results reveal strong persistence in environmental sustainability over time. Structural change is the only significant short-run determinant, while energy diversification and political globalization exhibit significant negative long-run effects, whereas financial development and natural capital show no robust long-run influence on environmental sustainability. These findings suggest that energy diversification alone does not guarantee environmental sustainability unless supported by renewable energy deployment, technological innovation, and effective environmental governance. By integrating dynamic econometric techniques with explainable machine learning, this study provides new evidence on the macroeconomic drivers of environmental sustainability and offers policy insights for implementing the European Green Deal more effectively.
title_zh: 欧洲绿色新政中能源多元化和环境可持续性的关键挑战：来自欧洲国家的经验证据
abstract_zh: 《欧洲绿色协议》将能源多样化和环境可持续性确定为实现安全、有弹性和气候中性的能源系统的两个核心支柱。尽管之前的研究分别考察了环境可持续性和能源转型的决定因素，但关于能源多样化、全球化、金融发展、自然资本和结构变革如何在欧洲绿色新政框架内共同塑造环境可持续性的证据有限。本研究通过调查 1995 年至 2023 年期间 26 个欧洲国家环境可持续性的宏观经济决定因素来弥补这一差距。该分析采用动态系统 GMM 作为主要估计方法，并辅以 CS-ARDL 来检查长期关系，并采用具有 SHAP 可解释性的机器学习模型来评估解释变量的相对重要性。结果表明，随着时间的推移，环境可持续性具有很强的持久性。结构变化是唯一重要的短期决定因素，而能源多样化和政治全球化则表现出显着的负面长期影响，而金融发展和自然资本对环境可持续性没有表现出强大的长期影响。这些发现表明，除非有可再生能源部署、技术创新和有效的环境治理的支持，否则单靠能源多样化并不能保证环境的可持续性。通过将动态计量经济学技术与可解释的机器学习相结合

title: The climate-electricity nexus in the GCC: How rising temperatures drive electricity demand across Gulf states
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Energy Policy
abstract: The GCC region is warming at 0.49°C per decade, nearly three times the global average, placing mounting pressure on electricity systems that already face extreme cooling demand. This study estimates country-specific income, price, and temperature elasticities of electricity demand for GCC countries over 1990-2022, using cointegration techniques. We find that a 1°C increase in annual average temperature would raise annual electricity consumption by 3.1% (Bahrain) to 5.8% (Saudi Arabia), translating into 32.2 TWh of additional regional demand, and 16.8 Mt of CO 2 emissions annually. The emission estimates are based on 2021 country-specific carbon intensities, reflecting each country's prevailing generation fuel mix (IEA, 2024; Ember, 2023). The additional generation would cost approximately $1.9 billion per year. Income elasticities range from 0.25 to 1.37, and price elasticities range from −0.08 to −0.61, revealing substantial cross-country heterogeneity driven by differences in appliance saturation, subsidy structures, and tariff reform histories. Decomposition analysis confirms that temperature, alongside population and income growth, is a first-order driver of electricity consumption, while the demand response to Saudi Arabia's 2016–2018 pricing reforms demonstrates that well-designed tariff adjustments can partially offset climate-driven demand growth. The findings highlight the urgency of improvements in the energy efficiency of buildings, advanced cooling technologies, and continued pricing reforms to decouple electricity demand from rising temperatures in support of GCC net-zero aspirations.
title_zh: 海湾合作委员会的气候与电力关系：气温上升如何推动海湾国家的电力需求
abstract_zh: 海湾合作委员会地区的升温速度为每十年 0.49°C，几乎是全球平均水平的三倍，这给已经面临极端冷却需求的电力系统带来了越来越大的压力。本研究利用协整技术估计了海湾合作委员会国家 1990 年至 2022 年期间特定国家电力需求的收入、价格和温度弹性。我们发现，年平均气温每升高 1°C，年用电量就会增加 3.1%（巴林）至 5.8%（沙特阿拉伯），相当于每年增加 32.2 TWh 的地区需求和 16.8 Mt CO 2 排放量。排放量估算基于 2021 年特定国家的碳强度，反映了每个国家当前的发电燃料结构（IEA，2024 年；Ember，2023 年）。额外发电每年将花费约 19 亿美元。收入弹性范围为 0.25 至 1.37，价格弹性范围为 -0.08 至 -0.61，揭示了由于家电饱和度、补贴结构和关税改革历史的差异而导致的巨大的跨国异质性。分解分析证实，气温以及人口和收入增长是电力消费的首要驱动因素，而对沙特阿拉伯 2016-2018 年定价改革的需求反应表明，精心设计的电价调整可以部分抵消气候驱动的需求增长。研究结果强调了提高建筑能效、先进冷却技术以及持续定价改革以将电力需求与气温上升脱钩以支持全球变暖的紧迫性。

title: Stress-relieving interface enabled by interlocking ionic polycarbolong for efficient and stable inverted perovskite solar cells
source: Joule
abstract: We report a corrugated polycarbolong interlocking strategy to address C60-related interface instability in inverted perovskite solar cells. Triphenylphosphine functions as a molecular interlocker that improves C60 film deposition, anchors C60 through triphenylphosphine-based “claw” motifs, and passivates unsaturated lead ions at the perovskite surface. This synergistic regulation stabilizes the top interface, suppresses C60 self-aggregation, and strengthens interfacial contact. Consequently, the resulting devices deliver a champion power conversion efficiency of 27.43% with exceptional operational stability under thermal stress, continuous illumination, and damp-heat conditions. The strategy establishes a robust and scalable pathway toward commercial perovskite photovoltaics.

title: Climate-driven spatial reorganization of cropland nitrogen pollution hotspots toward arid and semi-arid regions
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Cropland nitrogen (N) runoff contributes over 40% of riverine N loads globally, driving widespread aquatic eutrophication. The severity of this pollution is governed by the balance between N runoff and aquatic retention, yet how climate change will redistribute this risk across regions remains unclear. By integrating 1485 field observations into spatially explicit models across China, we show that climate change is creating new N pollution hotspots in arid and semi-arid regions. China’s humid South currently dominates riverine cropland N export (0.31 vs. 0.16 Tg in arid regions). However, under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5 scenarios, humid regions demonstrate hydrological resilience by 2050, with exports declining by approximately 5% due to warming-enhanced aquatic retention. In contrast, cropland N export from dryland-dominated North surges by 18.8–53.2%, driven by a nonlinear amplification of N runoff. These hydroclimatic shifts necessitate spatially adaptive strategies that prioritize cropland source reduction in the newly emerging arid and semi-arid hotspots.
title_zh: 气候驱动农田氮污染热点向干旱半干旱地区的空间重组
abstract_zh: 农田氮 (N) 径流占全球河流氮负荷的 40% 以上，导致广泛的水生富营养化。这种污染的严重程度取决于氮径流和水体滞留之间的平衡，但气候变化将如何在各地区重新分配这种风险仍不清楚。通过将 1485 个实地观测数据整合到中国各地的空间明确模型中，我们发现气候变化正在干旱和半干旱地区创造新的氮污染热点。中国湿润的南方目前主导着河流农田的氮输出（干旱地区为 0.31 Tg，而干旱地区为 0.16 Tg）。然而，在 SSP2-4.5 和 SSP5-8.5 情景下，潮湿地区到 2050 年将表现出水文恢复力，由于变暖增强了水体滞留，出口量下降约 5%。相比之下，在氮径流非线性放大的推动下，以旱地为主的北方农田氮输出激增 18.8-53.2%。这些水文气候变化需要空间适应性策略，优先考虑新兴干旱和半干旱热点地区农田资源的减少。

title: DS-MS-convformer: Ultra-short-term wind power prediction based on dual-stream multi-scale convolutional transformer and hierarchical dynamic fusion
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Against the backdrop of the global energy transition and the integration of large-scale wind power, ultra-short-term wind power forecasting is of great significance for ensuring the secure operation of power grids and the efficient dispatch of wind farms. However, wind power sequences are affected by complex meteorological factors and operating conditions, exhibiting pronounced non-stationarity. Their fluctuation characteristics primarily manifest as a continuous coupling between transient disturbances in the time domain and periodic variations in the frequency domain, posing challenges for multi-scale time-frequency structural representation and dynamic feature fusion. Existing methods often struggle to decouple and collaboratively fuse time-domain dynamic features and frequency-domain periodic structures while preserving the original temporal evolution information. To address this issue, this paper proposes an ultra-short-term wind power forecasting model based on dual-stream time-frequency decoupled modelling, a multi-scale convolutional Transformer, and a hierarchical dynamic fusion mechanism, namely DS-MS-Convformer. The proposed model first models the original time-domain dynamic features and the frequency-domain periodic features separately using a dual-stream time-frequency-decoupled framework. Then, a multi-scale convolution-enhanced Transformer encoder is constructed by integrating convolution kernels with different receptive fields and the self-attention mechanism, thereby jointly capturing local fluctuation features and long-range temporal dependencies. Finally, adaptive fusion of multi-source time-frequency features is achieved through low-, medium-, and high-frequency feature reconstruction, cross-attention interaction, and gated weight allocation. Experimental results on real wind farm datasets show that the proposed method achieves lower forecasting errors across single-step, multi-step, cross-seasonal validation, and generalizability testing. Ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of each key module. The results provide a reference for structured time-frequency modelling of non-stationary wind power sequences.
title_zh: DS-MS-conformer：基于双流多尺度卷积变压器和分层动态融合的超短期风电功率预测

title: Synthesis of ZIF-62 Glass and Solid-state Lithium Superconductor Composite Membranes for Electrodialytic Lithium Extraction
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Lithium superionic conductors such as Li3xLa2/3−xTiO3 (LLTO) enable rapid and selective lithium-ion transport through their crystalline frameworks and have been widely explored for lithium extraction. However, their implementation in membrane-based separations is hindered by the need for high-temperature sintering ( > 1000 °C), which leads to high energy consumption and potential lithium volatilization, thereby compromising structural integrity and scalability. Here, we report a structurally integrated composite membrane by embedding LLTO nanoparticles into a ZIF-62 glass matrix via a low-temperature melt-casting strategy, yielding a dense, defect-free membrane with intimate interfacial integration and improved mechanical robustness. Systematic investigations across a wide composition range reveal effective transport channels are highly restricted until a critical content is reached, after which an extensive interconnected LLTO network forms. The optimized membrane exhibits high lithium selectivity and delivers a Li/Mg selectivity of up to ~59,000 in Red Sea water under electrochemical operation, while maintaining stable lithium extraction performance across diverse natural brines. This study establishes a scalable membrane design strategy with good processability, offering broader opportunities for not only lithium extraction, but also ion-selective membranes in electrochemical separations and energy storage systems.
title_zh: 用于电渗析提锂的 ZIF-62 玻璃与固态锂超导复合膜的合成
abstract_zh: 锂超离子导体，如 Li3xLa2/3−xTiO3 (LLTO)，能够通过其晶体框架实现快速、选择性的锂离子传输，并已被广泛探索用于锂提取。然而，它们在基于膜的分离中的实施受到高温烧结（> 1000°C）的需要的阻碍，这导致高能耗和潜在的锂挥发，从而损害结构完整性和可扩展性。在这里，我们报告了一种结构集成的复合膜，通过低温熔铸策略将 LLTO 纳米粒子嵌入 ZIF-62 玻璃基体中，产生致密、无缺陷的膜，具有紧密的界面集成和改进的机械鲁棒性。对广泛组成范围的系统调查表明，有效的传输通道在达到关键内容之前受到高度限制，之后形成广泛互连的 LLTO 网络。优化的膜表现出高锂选择性，在电化学操作下在红海水中提供高达约 59,000 的 Li/Mg 选择性，同时在各种天然盐水中保持稳定的锂提取性能。这项研究建立了一种具有良好加工性能的可扩展膜设计策略，不仅为锂提取提供了更广泛的机会，还为电化学分离和储能系统中的离子选择性膜提供了更广泛的机会。

title: Dielectric stacking-engineered scalable reconfigurable transistor platform for adaptive logic circuits
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Although reconfigurable van der Waals devices featuring flexible logic transformation offer a promising strategy toward adaptable architectures to accommodate diverse computational demands, reliable polarity control and scalable integration remain challenging. Here, we demonstrate a reconfigurable field-effect transistor based on the scalable dielectric oxide-van der Waals quasi-floating-gate configuration, enabling nonvolatile polarity switching and multi-state programmability. Charge trapping engineering in an atomic-layer Al2O3/HfO2/Al2O3 dielectric stack achieves performance with nonvolatile conductance update (>6-bits for 1000 s), robust endurance (>3 × 105 cycles), and well-balanced electron/hole transport (current mismatch ratio ~ 1%). TCAD simulation and surface potential analysis reveal oxygen vacancies-dominated polarity switching dynamics. Using a silicon-compatible top-gate dielectric process and complementary design, diverse logic gates—including eight Boolean operations and seamless AND-OR-Invert/OR-AND-Invert transformations—are accommodated into compact reconfigurable logic-in-memory circuits. These transistors also simplify ternary content-addressable memory design, underscoring their potential for efficient logic-in-memory computing.
title_zh: 用于自适应逻辑电路的电介质堆叠设计的可扩展可重构晶体管平台
abstract_zh: 尽管具有灵活逻辑转换功能的可重构范德华器件为适应不同计算需求的适应性架构提供了一种有前途的策略，但可靠的极性控制和可扩展集成仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们展示了一种基于可扩展电介质氧化物范德华准浮栅配置的可重构场效应晶体管，可实现非易失性极性切换和多状态可编程性。原子层 Al2O3/HfO2/Al2O3 电介质堆栈中的电荷捕获工程实现了非易失性电导更新（> 6 位，持续 1000 秒）、强大的耐用性（> 3 × 105 次循环）和平衡良好的电子/空穴传输（电流失配率 ~ 1%）等性能。 TCAD 模拟和表面电势分析揭示了氧空位主导的极性转换动力学。使用硅兼容的顶栅介电工艺和互补设计，多种逻辑门（包括八个布尔运算和无缝与或反转/或与反转转换）被容纳到紧凑的可重配置内存逻辑电路中。这些晶体管还简化了三态内容寻址存储器设计，突显了它们高效内存逻辑计算的潜力。

title: Nickel catalysis enables chemoselectivity in radiation chemistry
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Radiation chemistry studies the chemical effects of ionizing radiation on matter. It has found broad applications across diverse scientific, medical and industrial fields. Recently, radiation-mediated transformations have emerged as valuable tools for activating inert molecules or enabling late-stage functionalization. Nevertheless, these applications are often limited by poor chemoselectivity arising from the diverse radical species generated by radiation. Inspired by advances in radical tuning within metallaphotoredox chemistry, here we show that a nickel catalytic system may precisely regulate these radical species, thereby enabling the chemoselectivity in radiation chemistry. When applied to C−H activation and arylation, this approach improves the yield of the desired product from less than 5% to up to 82%, suggesting the potential to overcome the long-standing challenge of poor chemoselectivity in radiation-driven transformations. Of note, this method enables selective C−H arylation without the need for photosensitizers and remains compatible with photoactive substrates. In addition, with the use of chiral ligands, we demonstrate enantioselective C(sp3)−H arylation under ionizing radiation, achieving enantiomeric excesses of up to 90%.
title_zh: 镍催化使辐射化学具有化学选择性
abstract_zh: 辐射化学研究电离辐射对物质的化学效应。它在科学、医学和工业领域都有广泛的应用。最近，辐射介导的转化已成为激活惰性分子或实现后期功能化的宝贵工具。然而，这些应用通常受到辐射产生的多种自由基种类所导致的较差的化学选择性的限制。受金属光氧化还原化学中自由基调节进展的启发，我们在此证明镍催化系统可以精确调节这些自由基种类，从而实现辐射化学中的化学选择性。当应用于 C−H 活化和芳基化时，这种方法将所需产物的产率从不到 5% 提高到高达 82%，这表明有可能克服辐射驱动转化中化学选择性差的长期挑战。值得注意的是，该方法无需光敏剂即可实现选择性 C−H 芳基化，并且与光活性底物保持兼容。此外，通过使用手性配体，我们证明了电离辐射下的对映选择性 C(sp3)−H 芳基化，实现了高达 90% 的对映体过量。

title: Counteranion-mediated dynamic kinetic asymmetric fluorination to access sulfur-stereogenic center
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Sulfonimidoyl fluorides serve as versatile click linkers and have demonstrated significant utility in the construction of S-stereogenic centers for drug discovery and organic synthesis. Although several established methods enable stereoselective access to these aza−sulfur compounds, achieving direct enantiocontrol in the formation of S(VI)–F bonds remains challenging. Herein, we present a highly efficient strategy to synthesize sulfonimidoyl fluorides through the dynamic kinetic asymmetric fluorination at mild reaction conditions. This one-pot process, involving sequential direct fluorination, hydrolysis and asymmetric fluorination, delivers a wide range of enantioenriched S(VI) compounds with high enantioselectivities. This protocol establishes an ideal platform for concise synthesis of structurally diverse array of S−chirogenic motifs via stereospecific transformations. Mechanistic studies suggest that the steric hindrance and hydrogen-bonding between substrate and phosphate anion are responsible for enantiocontrol.
title_zh: 抗衡阴离子介导的动态动力学不对称氟化以进入硫立体中心
abstract_zh: 磺酰亚胺酰氟可作为多功能点击链接剂，并在药物发现和有机合成的 S-立体中心构建中表现出显着的实用性。尽管几种已建立的方法能够立体选择性地获得这些氮杂硫化合物，但在 S(VI)-F 键的形成中实现直接对映控制仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了一种在温和反应条件下通过动态不对称氟化合成磺酰亚胺酰氟的高效策略。这种一锅法工艺包括连续的直接氟化、水解和不对称氟化，可产生多种具有高对映选择性的对映体富集的 S(VI) 化合物。该协议建立了一个理想的平台，用于通过立体特异性转化来简明合成结构多样的 S−手性基序阵列。机理研究表明，底物和磷酸根阴离子之间的空间位阻和氢键是对映体控制的原因。

title: Microwave-field quantum metrology with inherent robustness against detection losses enabled by Rydberg interactions
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Quantum sensing and metrology present one of the most promising near-term applications in the field of quantum technologies, with quantum sensors enabling unprecedented precision in measurements of electric, magnetic, or gravitational fields and displacements. Experimental loss at the detection stage remains one of the key obstacles to achieving a truly quantum advantage in many practical scenarios. Here, we combine the capabilities of Rydberg atoms to both sense external fields and be used for quantum information processing, thereby largely overcoming the issue of detection losses. While utilising the large dipole moments of Rydberg atoms in an ensemble to achieve single-shot precision of (217 ± 8) μV cm−1 for a very short 160-ns-long microwave pulse, we employ inter-atomic dipolar interactions to take advantage of an error-prevention protocol that protects information against conventional losses at the detection stage. Counterintuitively, the protocol’s idea is based on introducing an additional non-linear, lossy quantum channel, which results in a threefold enhancement of Fisher information. The presented results pave the way for broader adoption of quantum-information-inspired enhancements enabled by intrinsic interactions present in a sensor system, and more broadly in practical quantum metrology and communication, without the need for a general-purpose quantum computer.
title_zh: 微波场量子计量具有固有的鲁棒性，可抵抗里德伯相互作用带来的检测损失
abstract_zh: 量子传感和计量是量子技术领域最有前途的近期应用之一，量子传感器在电场、磁场或引力场和位移的测量中实现了前所未有的精度。检测阶段的实验损失仍然是在许多实际场景中实现真正量子优势的主要障碍之一。在这里，我们结合了里德伯原子的能力来感知外部场并用于量子信息处理，从而在很大程度上克服了检测损失的问题。在利用系综中里德伯原子的大偶极矩以在 160 ns 长的非常短的微波脉冲中实现 (217 ± 8) μV cm−1 的单次精度的同时，我们利用原子间偶极相互作用来利用防错协议，以保护信息免受检测阶段的传统损失。与直觉相反，该协议的想法是基于引入一个额外的非线性、有损量子通道，从而使费舍尔信息增强三倍。所提出的结果为更广泛地采用量子信息启发的增强功能铺平了道路，这些增强功能是通过传感器系统中存在的固有相互作用实现的，并且更广泛地应用于实际量子计量和通信，而无需通用量子计算机。

title: Finite-temperature toroidal moment amenable to direct observation in an Fe10Dy10 molecular ring
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Single-molecule toroics host closed magnetic vortices carrying toroidal moments τ, whose electric-dipole symmetry enables magnetoelectric spin control. Yet opposite toroidal chiralities are degenerate in conventional magnetic fields, making direct detection of τ challenging. Current approaches probe toroidal dynamics only indirectly through weak residual magnetism, while finite-temperature toroidal polarisation and realistic preparation/readout conditions remain unestablished. Here we show that the Fe10Dy10 molecule hosts a 62-billion-dimensional low-energy manifold pervaded by toroidal character, rendered tractable by an ab initio-informed transfer-matrix framework that reproduces experimental data. The model reveals a large toroidal response robust to thermal fluctuations, quantified by a finite-temperature toroidal susceptibility ξ. We then propose a preparation-and-readout protocol in which a train of temporally asymmetric near-infrared pulses accumulates toroidal polarisation, converted through magnetoelectric response into a measurable electric-field-induced magnetic signal. These results establish Fe10Dy10 as a molecular system where τ can be prepared, accumulated and read out under realistic conditions.
title_zh: 适合在 Fe10Dy10 分子环中直接观察的有限温度环形矩
abstract_zh: 单分子环形结构具有携带环形力矩τ的闭合磁涡流，其电偶极子对称性能够实现磁电自旋控制。然而，相反的环形手性在传统磁场中会退化，这使得直接检测 τ 具有挑战性。目前的方法仅通过弱剩磁间接探测环形动力学，而有限温度环形极化和实际的准备/读出条件仍未建立。在这里，我们展示了 Fe10Dy10 分子拥有一个 620 亿维的低能流形，其具有环形特征，通过再现实验数据的从头计算传递矩阵框架使其易于处理。该模型揭示了对热波动具有鲁棒性的大环形响应，通过有限温度环形磁化率 χ 进行量化。然后，我们提出了一种准备和读出协议，其中一系列时间不对称的近红外脉冲积累环形极化，通过磁电响应转换为可测量的电场感应磁信号。这些结果将 Fe10Dy10 确立为一个可以在现实条件下制备、积累和读出 τ 的分子系统。

title: Single-atom-engineered perovskite enables near-theoretical-rate hydroxyl radical electrogeneration
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Electrochemical advanced oxidation that directly activates O2 through the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) to generate hydroxyl radicals (•OH) offers a sustainable strategy for degrading persistent organic pollutants. However, prevailing approaches typically rely on a stepwise process involving the 2e⁻ ORR to produce H2O2 followed by 1e⁻ activation. High barriers associated with intermediate desorption and inter-site transfer consequently limit the •OH yield. Here, we construct a single-active-site architecture in the perovskite oxide Pr1.0Sr1.0Fe0.5Zn0.25Mo0.25O4-δ (PSFZM) that enables a direct three-electron ORR pathway for efficient •OH generation. The Znδ⁺ single active center selectively stabilizes *OOH and *H2O2 through weak orbital interactions, while an adjacent Mo atom polarizes the O atoms of adsorbed H2O2, promoting cleavage of the peroxide bond at the active site. This strategy avoids intermediate desorption and migration, enabling continuous proton-coupled electron transfer. The catalyst achieves a •OH production rate of 821 μmol h⁻1 and an O2 utilization of 37.7%, metrics competitive with previously reported systems. In a membrane-free flow cell that uses gaseous O2 directly, the •OH generation efficiency reaches 64.7%. By combining atomic-level catalyst design with reactor engineering, this work establishes a scalable platform for sustainable wastewater treatment.
title_zh: 单原子工程钙钛矿可实现接近理论速率的羟基自由基电产生
abstract_zh: 电化学高级氧化通过氧还原反应（ORR）直接激活O2产生羟基自由基（·OH），为降解持久性有机污染物提供了一种可持续的策略。然而，主流方法通常依赖于涉及 2e⁻ ORR 产生 H2O2，然后进行 1e⁻ 激活的逐步过程。与中间解吸和位点间转移相关的高势垒因此限制了·OH 产量。在这里，我们在钙钛矿氧化物 Pr1.0Sr1.0Fe0.5Zn0.25Mo0.25O4-δ (PSFZM) 中构建了单活性位点结构，该结构能够实现直接三电子 ORR 途径，从而有效生成·OH。 Znδ⁺单一活性中心通过弱轨道相互作用选择性地稳定*OOH和*H2O2，而相邻的Mo原子使吸附的H2O2的O原子极化，促进活性位点过氧化物键的裂解。该策略避免了中间解吸和迁移，从而实现连续的质子耦合电子转移。该催化剂的·OH 生产率为 821 μmol h⁻1，O2 利用率为 37.7%，这些指标与之前报道的系统具有竞争力。在直接使用气态O2的无膜流通池中，·OH的生成效率达到64.7%。通过将原子级催化剂设计与反应器工程相结合，这项工作建立了一个可扩展的可持续废水处理平台。

title: Field-to-forest fungal spillover is a biotic edge effect of coffee in Costa Rica
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Agricultural expansion creates mosaic landscapes where managed land borders natural ecosystems, facilitating the movement of organisms between habitats. Ecological spillover from natural systems to crops has been previously examined, but the extent to which populations amplified by agriculture move into adjacent forests remains largely unexplored. We investigated whether Costa Rican coffee fields act as reservoirs for foliar fungi that, because of high crop density and phylogenetic signal in plant-fungal associations, may particularly affect close relatives of coffee (Rubiaceae) in the forest understory. Field surveys, airborne propagule sampling, and metabarcoding along transects at the coffee-forest border revealed declining leaf spot incidence with distance into the forest for Rubiaceae but not non-Rubiaceae hosts, in parallel with declines in the dominant fungal order on coffee leaves, Pleosporales, and 19 coffee-associated taxa. Ninety-three coffee-associated taxa, including many potential plant pathogens, showed higher modeled abundance on forest Rubiaceae than forest non-Rubiaceae hosts. Our findings suggest that crops can act as reservoirs for fungi colonizing adjacent forest plants, disproportionately affecting hosts more closely related to the crop. These plants may face increased disease pressure, leading to changes in forest understory composition near the crop-forest border. Phylogenetically structured spillover represents an underappreciated edge effect in fragmented landscapes.
title_zh: 哥斯达黎加从田间到森林的真菌溢出是咖啡的生物边缘效应
abstract_zh: 农业扩张创造了马赛克景观，管理土地与自然生态系统接壤，促进生物在栖息地之间的移动。之前已经研究过从自然系统到农作物的生态溢出，但农业增加的人口迁移到邻近森林的程度在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们调查了哥斯达黎加咖啡田是否充当叶面真菌的储存库，由于作物密度高和植物-真菌关联中的系统发育信号，叶面真菌可能特别影响森林林下的咖啡（茜草科）的近亲。实地调查、空气繁殖体采样和沿着咖啡森林边界横断面的元条形码显示，随着进入森林的距离，茜草科寄主的叶斑发生率下降，但非茜草科寄主则不然，同时咖啡叶上的优势真菌目、侧孢菌目和 19 种与咖啡相关的类群也下降。 93 个与咖啡相关的类群，包括许多潜在的植物病原体，在森林茜草科宿主上显示出比森林非茜草科寄主更高的模拟丰度。我们的研究结果表明，作物可以作为真菌在邻近森林植物中定殖的储存库，对与作物关系更密切的宿主产生不成比例的影响。这些植物可能面临更大的疾病压力，导致农作物-森林边界附近的森林林下组成发生变化。系统发育结构的溢出代表了支离破碎的景观中未被充分认识的边缘效应。

title: Adaptive energy systems planning: A rolling horizon framework with AI-enabled scenario generation
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Energy systems face unprecedented challenges driven by deep uncertainty arising from evolving demand patterns, variable renewable integration, changing technology costs, and structural shifts. Building adaptive and flexible planning frameworks is becoming increasingly essential to hedge against these uncertainties, as traditional static optimization approaches that fix investment decisions in advance often struggle to adapt to rapidly evolving conditions. This paper presents an adaptive optimization framework that integrates Bayesian Neural Networks with Markov Chain Monte Carlo sampling (BNN-MCMC) for technology-specific probabilistic generation forecasting within a rolling-horizon stochastic programming formulation. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on static forecasts, the proposed methodology continuously updates scenario representations as new information becomes available, enabling investment decisions that respond more effectively to evolving system conditions. We formalize this integration through the α -BASIS framework, an adaptive extension of Bayesian Augmented Scenario Integration for Stochastic modeling, which transforms predictive distributions into probability-weighted scenarios and embeds them within a rolling-horizon stochastic programming formulation. Through an illustrative case study of the Texas energy network, we compare three planning strategies utilizing historical generation profiles of gas power plants, solar and wind farms: conventional stochastic optimization, adaptive rolling-horizon stochastic optimization, and deterministic optimization with perfect information. Results demonstrate that the adaptive rolling-horizon approach achieves total system costs only 9.7% above the perfect-information benchmark. The rolling-horizon strategy shows particular strength in incorporating updated scenario information, time-varying technology-cost trajectories, and investment timing. Overall, this work provides a practical methodology for energy planners facing deep uncertainty by bridging data-driven probabilistic forecasting with adaptive decision-making under uncertainty.
title_zh: 自适应能源系统规划：具有人工智能支持场景生成的滚动框架
abstract_zh: 不断变化的需求模式、可变的可再生能源整合、不断变化的技术成本和结构转变所带来的深度不确定性推动了能源系统面临前所未有的挑战。建立适应性和灵活的规划框架对于对冲这些不确定性变得越来越重要，因为提前确定投资决策的传统静态优化方法往往难以适应快速变化的条件。本文提出了一种自适应优化框架，它将贝叶斯神经网络与马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗采样 (BNN-MCMC) 相结合，用于滚动范围随机规划公式中特定技术的概率生成预测。与依赖静态预测的传统方法不同，所提出的方法随着新信息的出现而不断更新场景表示，从而使投资决策能够更有效地响应不断变化的系统条件。我们通过 α-BASIS 框架来形式化这种集成，这是随机建模的贝叶斯增强场景集成的自适应扩展，它将预测分布转换为概率加权场景，并将它们嵌入到滚动范围随机编程公式中。通过德克萨斯州能源网络的说明性案例研究，我们比较了利用燃气发电厂、太阳能和风电场的历史发电概况的三种规划策略：传统随机优化、自适应滚动水平随机优化和确定性优化

title: Real-world performance and module degradation impacts of robotic cleaning in PV systems
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Robotic cleaning is increasingly adopted worldwide to mitigate soiling losses in utility-scale photovoltaic (PV) systems. However, long-duration, side-by-side field evaluations of different robotic cleaning technologies under real field conditions remain scarce. This study presents the first comprehensive comparative assessment of multiple cleaning robots operating under identical field conditions in a dry and dusty desert environment. In addition to extensive outdoor and indoor experiments, a key methodological contribution of this work is the development of an irradiance-independent, short-circuit current ( Isc ) – based protocol for robust benchmarking of cleaning efficiency in outdoor environments. At the system level, the analysis considers the combined effects of robot design, module type (monofacial and bifacial), and cleaning frequency (daily, weekly, and no cleaning) to evaluate cleaning efficiency, operational reliability, electrical performance ( Pmax ), electroluminescence (EL) response, anti-reflective coating (ARC) characteristics, and module vibrations during cleaning. Results show that all robots achieved high cleaning efficiency with cleanliness restored to >99% under daily cleaning schedules, whereas extended intervals lead to residual soiling (cleanliness reduced to <95%). At module level, systematic cumulative Pmax degradation was observed in monofacial modules over time, while no consistent Pmax impact was identified across robot types. In contrast, bifacial glass–glass modules remained relatively stable. Although bifacial electrical signatures suggested reduced shunt resistance under highly penetrative robot brushes, EL, reflectivity, and surface roughness measurements were inconclusive. Module vibration under robot cleaning was minor, much less than wind-induced vibration. Overall, the results indicate that robotic cleaning could be highly effective for soiling mitigation in desert environments similar to this study site, but technology-specific validation and multi-modal diagnostics to ensure long-term module reliability prior to large-scale deployment is recommended.
title_zh: 光伏系统中机器人清洁的实际性能和模块退化影响
abstract_zh: 机器人清洁在全球范围内越来越多地采用，以减少公用事业规模光伏（PV）系统中的污垢损失。然而，在实际现场条件下对不同机器人清洁技术进行长期、并行的现场评估仍然很少。这项研究首次对干燥多尘的沙漠环境中相同现场条件下运行的多个清洁机器人进行了全面比较评估。除了广泛的室外和室内实验之外，这项工作的一个关键方法贡献是开发了一种与辐照度无关的、基于短路电流 (Isc) 的协议，用于对室外环境中的清洁效率进行稳健的基准测试。在系统层面，分析考虑了机器人设计、模块类型（单面和双面）和清洁频率（每天、每周和不清洁）的综合影响，以评估清洁效率、操作可靠性、电气性能（Pmax）、电致发光（EL）响应、抗反射涂层（ARC）特性以及清洁过程中的模块振动。结果表明，所有机器人都实现了较高的清洁效率，在日常清洁计划下，清洁度恢复到 >99%，而延长的间隔时间会导致残留污垢（清洁度降低到 <95%）。在模块层面，随着时间的推移，在单面模块中观察到系统累积的 Pmax 退化，而在不同类型的机器人中没有发现一致的 Pmax 影响。相比之下，双面玻璃-玻璃组件保持相对稳定。尽管双面电信号表明

title: A decomposition method for optimizing the operation of power-to-X energy systems with detailed process models
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: The growing reliance on renewable energy necessitates extending energy systems with complex processes such as power-to-X. Due to the diverse operational characteristics of these processes, the corresponding optimization problems are highly complex and result in models that are computationally difficult to solve. To address this computational challenge, this work proposes a decomposition method to solve operational optimization problems for complex energy systems with detailed process models. The method decomposes the original optimization problem into optimization problems with different levels of model granularity by incorporating a surrogate model for each process. Building on prior work focusing on a single continuous process system, this method is expanded to handle multiple and more complex process systems. To this end, we introduce a surrogate modeling approach for multistage process systems and develop three solution approaches for the operational optimization problems. The method is applied to minimize the daily operational cost of a power-to-X energy system with detailed process models of a PEM electrolyzer, a direct air capture plant and two methanation processes. All three solution approaches yield comparable operational costs, but differ in computational efficiency. The most efficient solution approach identifies an optimal operational strategy in under one hour. Additionally, a sensitivity study evaluates the impact of key parameters on the performance of the method, demonstrating its robustness and adaptability. The results highlight the potential of the proposed method to efficiently optimize the operations of complex energy systems with detailed process models.
title_zh: 一种利用详细过程模型优化 power-to-X 能源系统运行的分解方法
abstract_zh: 对可再生能源的日益依赖需要通过复杂的流程（例如 power-to-X）来扩展能源系统。由于这些过程的不同操作特性，相应的优化问题非常复杂，导致模型在计算上难以解决。为了解决这一计算挑战，这项工作提出了一种分解方法来解决具有详细过程模型的复杂能源系统的运行优化问题。该方法通过为每个过程合并一个代理模型，将原始优化问题分解为不同模型粒度级别的优化问题。该方法以以前专注于单个连续过程系统的工作为基础，扩展到处理多个和更复杂的过程系统。为此，我们引入了多阶段过程系统的代理建模方法，并针对操作优化问题开发了三种解决方法。该方法通过 PEM 电解槽、直接空气捕获装置和两个甲烷化过程的详细过程模型，用于最大限度地降低 power-to-X 能源系统的日常运营成本。所有三种解决方案的运营成本相当，但计算效率不同。最有效的解决方案可以在一小时内确定最佳运营策略。此外，敏感性研究评估了关键参数对方法性能的影响，证明了其稳健性和适应性。结果凸显了该提案的潜力

title: Subsidy rates, absolute pricing, and applied energy efficiency: evidence from energy-efficient appliance subsidies
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Tiered subsidies are widely employed in government programs globally, yet a key assumption in the energy efficiency domain, namely that a higher subsidy rate generates a correspondingly stronger market uptake, has received limited empirical scrutiny using high-frequency micro-level data. This paper exploits China's 2024 Energy-Efficient Appliance Subsidy policy as a quasi-natural experiment. Drawing on daily panel data from JD.com covering 12,936 products across eight appliance categories, and using product review counts as a sales proxy, we apply a difference-in-differences approach to assess the policy's effects. The findings are as follows. (1) The subsidy produced a marked aggregate sales increase, with subsidized products registering an approximating 263% gain in average daily unit sales. (2) Grade 2 products, receiving a 15% subsidy, exhibited a significantly larger sales increase than Grade 1 products eligible for 20%, indicating that a higher subsidy rate did not translate into a stronger market response. (3) Two mechanisms account for this mismatch. Consumers appear more responsive to the post-subsidy price level than to the ad valorem rate, with the strongest response concentrated among mid-priced products. The salience of energy efficiency attributes varies substantially across categories, with white goods eliciting the most pronounced response and kitchen appliances the weakest. The findings provide empirical evidence on the heterogeneous transmission of tiered subsidy incentives and offer implications for subsidy design, price-tier targeting, and informational strategies in future energy efficiency programs.
title_zh: 补贴率、绝对定价和应用能效：来自节能电器补贴的证据
abstract_zh: 分级补贴在全球政府计划中广泛采用，但能源效率领域的一个关键假设，即较高的补贴率会相应增强市场吸收能力，但使用高频微观数据的实证审查却很有限。本文将中国的 2024 年节能家电补贴政策作为一项准自然实验。我们利用京东涵盖八个家电类别 12,936 种产品的每日面板数据，并使用产品评论数作为销售代理，采用双重差分法来评估政策的效果。调查结果如下。 （1）补贴带动总销量大幅增长，补贴产品日均销量增长约263%。 （2）享受15%补贴的二级产品销量增幅显着高于享受20%补贴的一级产品，表明较高的补贴率并没有转化为更强烈的市场反应。 (3) 有两种机制可以解释这种不匹配。消费者似乎对补贴后价格水平的反应比对从价价格的反应更敏感，其中最强烈的反应集中在中等价格的产品上。不同类别的能源效率属性的显着性差异很大，白色家电引起的反应最明显，而厨房电器的反应最弱。研究结果为分级补贴激励的异质传导提供了经验证据，并对补贴设计、价格分级目标和信息化提供了启示。

title: Nanoconfined single-atom catalysis enables long-lived hydroxyl radicals for low-cost, versatile on-site water purification
source: One Earth
abstract: Chemically complex wastewater is increasingly costly and risky to treat off-site, creating an urgent need for on-site oxidation technologies. Fenton and Fenton-like chemistry is attractive for pollutant degradation, but its efficiency is constrained by the short lifetime and limited diffusion distance of hydroxyl radicals (·OH), causing excessive oxidant consumption. How to stabilize transient ·OH for sustained radical utilization remains unclear. Here, we construct isolated Fe–O 4 single-atom sites inside zeolite micropores through in-pore ferrocene cracking and atomic trapping. The nanoconfined tetrahedral oxygen microenvironment lowers hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2) activation barriers, enables reversible Fe redox cycling, and stabilizes adsorbed ·OH through orbital hybridization. This catalyst extends the effective ·OH lifetime by 30-fold and sustains radical production for 24 h. Integrated into a portable device, it achieves 98% contaminant removal over multiple operating cycles and purifies diverse wastewater, with an estimated 5-fold lower cost than conventional Fenton. The nanoconfined single-atom platforms offer a versatile and scalable strategy for on-site water purification.
title_zh: 纳米限制单原子催化可产生长寿命的羟基自由基，用于低成本、多功能的现场水净化
abstract_zh: 化学复杂的废水在场外处理的成本和风险越来越大，因此迫切需要现场氧化技术。芬顿和类芬顿化学对于污染物降解具有吸引力，但其效率受到羟基自由基（·OH）寿命短和扩散距离有限的限制，导致氧化剂消耗过多。如何稳定瞬态·OH以实现持续的自由基利用仍不清楚。在这里，我们通过孔内二茂铁裂解和原子捕获在沸石微孔内构建了孤立的 Fe-O 4 单原子位点。纳米四面体氧微环境降低了过氧化氢（H 2 O 2）活化势垒，实现可逆的Fe氧化还原循环，并通过轨道杂化稳定吸附的·OH。该催化剂将·OH 的有效寿命延长了 30 倍，并能维持自由基产生 24 小时。它集成到便携式设备中，可在多个操作周期内实现 98% 的污染物去除率，并净化多种废水，预计成本比传统 Fenton 低 5 倍。纳米单原子平台为现场水净化提供了一种多功能且可扩展的策略。

title: Place and behavioral modulation of hippocampal neurons during immobility
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Behavioral state fluctuations profoundly impact episodic memory processing. To explore the underlying mechanisms, we recorded CA1 place cells in head-fixed male mice and focused on awake immobility to capture spontaneous behavioral state fluctuations by facial motion, pupillometry, and local field potential (LFP) analysis. We found that during awake immobility, the duration of spontaneous whisker-pad motion events correlated with ongoing levels of arousal and modulated both the frequency and the power of theta oscillations. CA1 place cells continued to encode location during immobility, with the spatial code being primarily driven by a subset of behaviorally-modulated place cells which increased their firing upon behavioral state transitions. Single-cell stimulation during immobility was sufficient for the induction of place fields, indicating that plasticity mechanisms can be engaged even in the absence of locomotion. Altogether, these data indicate that behavioral state fluctuations might contribute to episodic memory processing by modulating theta oscillatory dynamics and hippocampal gain via the engagement of a discrete place-cell ensemble.
title_zh: 不动时海马神经元的位置和行为调节
abstract_zh: 行为状态波动深刻影响情景记忆处理。为了探索潜在的机制，我们记录了头部固定的雄性小鼠的 CA1 位置细胞，并专注于清醒不动，通过面部运动、瞳孔测量和局部场电位 (LFP) 分析来捕获自发的行为状态波动。我们发现，在清醒不动时，自发的胡须垫运动事件的持续时间与持续的唤醒水平相关，并调节 θ 振荡的频率和功率。 CA1位置细胞在不动期间继续编码位置，空间代码主要由行为调节位置细胞的子集驱动，这些位置细胞在行为状态转换时增加了它们的放电。静止期间的单细胞刺激足以诱导位置场，这表明即使在没有运动的情况下也可以发挥可塑性机制。总而言之，这些数据表明，行为状态波动可能通过离散位置细胞整体的参与来调节 θ 振荡动力学和海马增益，从而有助于情景记忆处理。

title: DirectContacts2: a wiring diagram of human physical protein interactions
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cellular function is driven by the activity of proteins in stable complexes. Protein complex assembly depends on the direct physical association of component proteins. Advances in macromolecular structure prediction with tools like AlphaFold and RoseTTAFold have greatly improved our ability to model these interactions in silico, but an all-by-all analysis of the human proteome’s ~200 M possible pairs remains computationally intractable. A comprehensive cellular map of direct protein interactions will therefore be an invaluable resource to direct screening efforts. Here, we present DirectContacts2, a machine learning model that distinguishes direct from indirect protein interactions using features derived from over 25,000 mass spectrometry experiments. Applied to ~25 million human protein pairs, our model outperforms previous resources in identifying direct physical interactions and enriches for accurate structural models including ~2500 AlphaFold3 models. Our framework enables structural modeling of disease-relevant complexes (e.g. orofacial digital syndrome (OFDS) complex) offering insights into the molecular consequences of pathogenic mutations (OFD1) and broadly, establishes a highly accurate protein wiring diagram of the cell.
title_zh: DirectContacts2：人类物理蛋白质相互作用的接线图
abstract_zh: 细胞功能由稳定复合物中蛋白质的活性驱动。蛋白质复合物的组装取决于组分蛋白质的直接物理结合。使用 AlphaFold 和 RoseTTAFold 等工具进行大分子结构预测的进展极大地提高了我们在计算机中模拟这些相互作用的能力，但对人类蛋白质组的约 2 亿个可能的对进行全面分析在计算上仍然很困难。因此，直接蛋白质相互作用的全面细胞图谱将成为指导筛选工作的宝贵资源。在这里，我们提出了 DirectContacts2，这是一种机器学习模型，它使用源自 25,000 多个质谱实验的特征来区分直接和间接的蛋白质相互作用。我们的模型应用于约 2500 万人类蛋白质对，在识别直接物理相互作用方面优于以前的资源，并丰富了精确的结构模型，包括约 2500 个 AlphaFold3 模型。我们的框架能够对疾病相关复合体（例如口面数字综合症（OFDS）复合体）进行结构建模，提供对致病突变（OFD1）的分子后果的见解，并广泛地建立细胞的高度准确的蛋白质接线图。

title: Two telomere-to-telomere Nelumbo genome assemblies reveal domestication history and empower precision breeding
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Lotus (Nelumbo) is an ancient aquatic plant of major ecological, economic, and cultural importance, yet its genomic architecture and domestication history remain incompletely resolved. Here, we generate telomere-to-telomere reference genomes for the two extant species, Asian lotus (N. nucifera) and American lotus (N. lutea). Comparative genomics analysis reveals divergence in centromeric regions and chromosomal structural variation between the two species. Population analysis of 832 globally distributed lotus accessions supports tropical Asia as the primary dispersal cradle of Asian lotus. We detect historical introgression events contributing to modern cultivated gene pools, and identify key loci regulating flower color variation and rhizome enlargement. To support research and breeding, we develop the Nelumbo Multi-omics Genome Platform (NMGP; http://182.92.235.125:18888/lotus/home/), integrating multi-omics data with a Pearson correlation-weighted Fusion of machine learning Models for Genomic Prediction (PFMGP) framework. These resources provide foundation for studying lotus evolution and genome-informed breeding.
title_zh: 两个端粒到端粒荷花基因组组装揭示了驯化历史并赋能精准育种
abstract_zh: 莲花（Nelumbo）是一种古老的水生植物，具有重要的生态、经济和文化重要性，但其基因组结构和驯化历史仍未完全解决。在这里，我们为亚洲莲花（N. nucifera）和美洲莲花（N. utea）这两个现存物种生成端粒到端粒参考基因组。比较基因组学分析揭示了两个物种之间着丝粒区域和染色体结构变异的差异。对 832 个全球分布的莲花品种的种群分析支持热带亚洲是亚洲莲花的主要传播摇篮。我们检测对现代栽培基因库有贡献的历史基因渗入事件，并确定调节花颜色变化和根茎增大的关键位点。为了支持研究和育种，我们开发了 Nelumbo 多组学基因组平台（NMGP；http://182.92.235.125:18888/lotus/home/），将多组学数据与 Pearson 相关加权基因组预测机器学习模型融合 (PFMGP) 框架集成。这些资源为研究莲花进化和基因组育种提供了基础。

title: Cryo-EM structures of biopsy-derived TTR fibrils in hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis (ATTRv) is a fatal autosomal dominant disease characterized by systemic deposition of transthyretin (TTR) amyloid fibrils, leading to progressive neuropathy and cardiomyopathy. More than 130 pathogenic mutations in the TTR gene have been identified, but their roles in TTR fibril formation and disease pathogenesis remain unclear. Here, using cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM), we present nineteen high-resolution TTR fibril structures (1.9-3.4 Å) from gastrocnemius muscle biopsies and vitreous humor of ten living ATTRv patients carrying nine distinct heterozygous mutations. Deep-learning-based analysis of cryo-EM densities enables semi-quantitative assessment of mutant or wild-type dominance within fibrils. These compositional profiles, combined with their structures, suggest an association between disease onset and the TTR species (wild-type or mutant) that primarily initiates amyloid formation. This biopsy-based workflow broadens access to patient tissue for amyloid structural studies, enabling systematic investigation of heterogeneous hereditary amyloidoses and the role of mutations in amyloid formation.
title_zh: 遗传性运甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性中活检来源的 TTR 原纤维的冷冻电镜结构
abstract_zh: 遗传性转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性（ATTRv）是一种致命的常染色体显性遗传疾病，其特征是转甲状腺素蛋白（TTR）淀粉样原纤维的全身沉积，导致进行性神经病和心肌病。已鉴定出 130 多种 TTR 基因致病突变，但它们在 TTR 原纤维形成和疾病发病机制中的作用仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM)，展示了来自 10 名携带 9 种不同杂合突变的活着的 ATTRv 患者的腓肠肌活检和玻璃体液的 19 种高分辨率 TTR 原纤维结构 (1.9-3.4 Å)。基于深度学习的冷冻电镜密度分析能够对原纤维内的突变型或野生型优势进行半定量评估。这些成分特征及其结构表明，疾病发作与主要引发淀粉样蛋白形成的 TTR 物种（野生型或突变型）之间存在关联。这种基于活检的工作流程拓宽了患者组织用于淀粉样蛋白结构研究的途径，从而能够系统地研究异质性遗传性淀粉样变性以及突变在淀粉样蛋白形成中的作用。

title: Evolving dynamics of H5Nx avian influenza in China revealed by long-term wild bird surveillance
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: H5Nx highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses pose persistent threats to poultry, wildlife, and public health. Over the past two decades, their geographic and host ranges have expanded across migratory networks whose epidemiological connectivity has become increasingly apparent through recent surveillance and genomic analyses. To elucidate these dynamics, we conduct long-term nationwide wild-bird surveillance in China, integrating active and passive monitoring. Our analyses reveal the maintenance, reassortment, and transmission of H5Nx viruses in wild birds, highlighting the value of sustained surveillance in capturing viral evolution. We identify distinct ecological patterns among major clades, with 2.3.4.4b showing the widest distribution and acting as the main lineage mediating intercontinental spread. Since 2020, most 2.3.4.4b viruses detected in wild birds in China have clustered with lineages originating outside China, consistent with repeated reintroduction rather than sustained local circulation. This shift underscores the growing role of migratory connectivity in shaping global viral exchange and the need for coordinated international active surveillance.
title_zh: 长期野生鸟类监测揭示中国H5Nx禽流感的演变动态
abstract_zh: H5Nx 高致病性禽流感病毒对家禽、野生动物和公众健康构成持续威胁。在过去的二十年中，它们的地理和宿主范围已经扩展到整个迁徙网络，通过最近的监测和基因组分析，其流行病学连通性变得越来越明显。为了阐明这些动态，我们在中国进行了长期的全国范围内的野生鸟类监测，结合了主动监测和被动监测。我们的分析揭示了 H5Nx 病毒在野生鸟类中的维持、重排和传播，凸显了持续监测在捕获病毒进化方面的价值。我们确定了主要分支之间不同的生态模式，其中 2.3.4.4b 显示了最广泛的分布，并且是介导洲际传播的主要谱系。自2020年以来，在中国野生鸟类中检测到的大多数2.3.4.4b病毒都与源自中国境外的谱系聚集，这与反复重新引入而不是持续的本地传播相一致。这一转变凸显了迁徙连通性在塑造全球病毒交换方面日益重要的作用，以及协调国际主动监测的必要性。

title: Transcript-aware rare genetic variant association analyses of cardiopulmonary traits in participants from the All of Us Research Program
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Gene-based rare variant analyses often lack statistical power and may overlook transcript-specific effects. Here, we present a transcript-aware aggregation framework. In simulation studies, the framework maintains appropriate false-positive rates and shows competitive power relative to standard single-transcript analyses, approaching the performance of the ideal case of knowing the most informative transcript in advance. We then apply the approach to 129 cardiopulmonary traits in over 240,000 whole-genome-sequenced All of Us participants. By leveraging transcript-specific annotations, we identify 11 novel associations and recover 47 reported associations, including potentially pleiotropic genes linked to plasma lipid traits (PPARG) and body habitus (TCF12). Notably, for TTN, a gene known for its transcript-specific effects in cardiomyopathy, our framework strengthens the association signal and pinpoints the N2B isoform, which shows a stronger association with cardiomyopathy than other transcripts. These findings highlight the value of a transcript-aware framework for improving rare variant association studies.
title_zh: 对“我们所有人研究计划”参与者的心肺特征进行转录感知的罕见遗传变异关联分析
abstract_zh: 基于基因的罕见变异分析通常缺乏统计能力，并且可能忽略转录本特异性效应。在这里，我们提出了一个转录感知聚合框架。在模拟研究中，该框架保持适当的假阳性率，并显示出相对于标准单转录本分析的竞争力，接近提前了解信息最丰富的转录本的理想情况的性能。然后，我们将该方法应用于超过 240,000 名经过全基因组测序的 All of Us 参与者的 129 项心肺特征。通过利用转录特异性注释，我们识别了 11 个新的关联并恢复了 47 个已报告的关联，包括与血浆脂质特征 (PPARG) 和身体习性 (TCF12) 相关的潜在多效性基因。值得注意的是，对于 TTN（一种因在心肌病中具有转录特异性作用而闻名的基因），我们的框架增强了关联信号并精确定位了 N2B 亚型，该亚型与其他转录本相比显示出与心肌病更强的关联。这些发现凸显了转录感知框架对于改进罕见变异关联研究的价值。

title: Thermogenic methane beneath the North Greenland Ice Sheet revealed by isotopic and geological evidence
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Glacial meltwater has been increasingly recognised as a potential source of atmospheric methane, yet its origin and variability in the High Arctic remain poorly constrained. In this study, we present measurements of methane concentration and carbon‑isotope composition in meltwater draining the northern Greenland Ice Sheet. Here we show that methane concentrations (12-20 nM) are significantly lower than those reported from other Greenland catchments, despite clear evidence of subglacial input. Isotopic signatures and regional geological context indicate that this methane is predominantly thermogenic, reflecting a geological source that is largely independent of subglacial microbial activity. These findings advance current understanding of methane sources beneath the Greenland Ice Sheet, revealing a thermogenic contribution alongside microbial methane in Arctic methane cycling. In this work we highlight the need to account for geological methane reservoirs when assessing present and future cryosphere–carbon feedbacks.
title_zh: 同位素和地质证据揭示了北格陵兰冰盖下方的热成因甲烷
abstract_zh: 人们越来越多地认识到冰川融水是大气甲烷的潜在来源，但其在高北极地区的起源和变化仍然很少受到限制。在这项研究中，我们测量了格陵兰冰盖北部排出的融水中的甲烷浓度和碳同位素组成。在这里，我们表明，尽管有明显的冰下输入证据，但甲烷浓度（12-20 nM）明显低于格陵兰岛其他流域报告的浓度。同位素特征和区域地质背景表明，这种甲烷主要是热成因的，反映了很大程度上独立于冰下微生物活动的地质来源。这些发现推进了目前对格陵兰冰盖下方甲烷来源的了解，揭示了北极甲烷循环中微生物甲烷的产热贡献。在这项工作中，我们强调在评估当前和未来的冰冻圈碳反馈时需要考虑地质甲烷库。

title: CDC7 and APC/CCdh1 gate distinct routes to initiate DNA replication
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Precise temporal control of DNA replication initiation is essential for faithful cell division, yet there are conflicting prevailing models for how cells trigger origin firing. Here, we demonstrate that human origins are not fired at fixed thresholds of cell cycle regulators E2F, APC/CCdh1, CDK2/1, and CDC7. Instead, origin firing is triggered at a tunable CDK2/1 threshold that is gated by either CDC7 or APC/CCdh1 activity. CDC7 phosphorylates MCM helicase, enabling Cyclin E-CDK2 to trigger origin firing at low CDK2/1 activity, independent of APC/CCdh1 inactivation. In contrast, APC/CCdh1 inactivation enables Cyclin A-CDK1 to phosphorylate MCM at distinct CDK2/1-specific sites and trigger origin firing, independent of CDC7 activity. Strikingly, this requires much higher CDK2/1 activity, which CDK2 cannot normally reach alone. Thus, having two distinct routes necessitates blocking both routes to prevent S phase: either by inhibiting CDC7 or CDK2 while also preventing APC/CCdh1 inactivation or inhibiting CDK1.
title_zh: CDC7 和 APC/CCdh1 控制启动 DNA 复制的不同途径
abstract_zh: DNA 复制起始的精确时间控制对于忠实的细胞分裂至关重要，但对于细胞如何触发起源激发，存在相互矛盾的流行模型。在这里，我们证明人类起源并不是在细胞周期调节因子 E2F、APC/CCdh1、CDK2/1 和 CDC7 的固定阈值下被激发。相反，起源激发是在可调节的 CDK2/1 阈值处触发的，该阈值由 CDC7 或 APC/CCdh1 活动进行门控。 CDC7 磷酸化 MCM 解旋酶，使 Cyclin E-CDK2 能够在低 CDK2/1 活性下触发起始放电，而与 APC/CCdh1 失活无关。相比之下，APC/CCdh1 失活使 Cyclin A-CDK1 能够在不同的 CDK2/1 特异性位点磷酸化 MCM 并触发起源放电，而与 CDC7 活性无关。引人注目的是，这需要更高的 CDK2/1 活性，而 CDK2 通常无法单独达到这一活性。因此，拥有两条不同的途径需要阻断两条途径以阻止 S 期：通过抑制 CDC7 或 CDK2，同时防止 APC/CCdh1 失活或抑制 CDK1。

title: A natural solution from caterpillar cuticles for flexible impact-resistant materials
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Flexible impact-resistant materials are essential for defense, transportation, and biomedical engineering due to their ability to combine strength, energy dissipation, and compliance. While nature offers robust solutions like beetle elytra or mantis shrimp hammers, designing materials that achieve these properties simultaneously remains a significant challenge. Here, we explore the cuticle of Ostrinia furnacalis (Asian corn borer) as a natural model. We identify two key structural proteins, FCSP-1 and FCSP-2, that form a β-sheet-rich matrix via liquid-liquid phase separation, adhering to chitin scaffolds. This matrix promotes lamellar structures that enhance energy dissipation through hydrogen bond disruption and secondary structure transformation under stress. NMR and molecular dynamics simulations further confirm that matrix formation relies on fine-tuned hydrogen bonding, electrostatic interactions, and π-π/cation-π interactions. Inspired by this mechanism, we developed a chitin-protein composite hydrogel with an energy dissipation capability of 8 MJ/m3, and its mechanical properties can be precisely tuned via in-vitro phosphorylation. This hydrogel demonstrates exceptional potential for protecting fragile objects.
title_zh: 毛毛虫角质层的天然解决方案，用于柔性耐冲击材料
abstract_zh: 柔性耐冲击材料由于能够兼具强度、能量耗散和合规性，因此对于国防、运输和生物医学工程至关重要。虽然大自然提供了甲虫鞘翅或螳螂虾锤等强大的解决方案，但设计同时实现这些特性的材料仍然是一项重大挑战。在这里，我们将亚洲玉米螟（Ostriniafurnacalis）的角质层作为自然模型进行探索。我们鉴定了两种关键结构蛋白 FCSP-1 和 FCSP-2，它们通过液-液相分离形成富含 β-折叠的基质，粘附到几丁质支架上。该基质促进层状结构，通过氢键破坏和应力下二级结构转变来增强能量耗散。核磁共振和分子动力学模拟进一步证实基质形成依赖于微调的氢键、静电相互作用和π-π/阳离子-π相互作用。受这一机制的启发，我们开发了一种能量耗散能力为8 MJ/m3的甲壳素-蛋白质复合水凝胶，其机械性能可以通过体外磷酸化精确调节。这种水凝胶在保护易碎物体方面表现出非凡的潜力。

title: Receptor allostery promotes context-specific Sonic Hedgehog signaling during embryonic development
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Sonic Hedgehog (SHH) signaling functions in temporal- and context-dependent manners to pattern diverse tissues during embryogenesis. The signal transducer Smoothened (SMO) is induced by sterols, oxysterols, and arachidonic acid (AA) through binding pockets in its extracellular cysteine-rich domain (CRD) and 7-transmembrane (7TM) bundle. In vitro analyses suggest SMO signaling is allosterically enhanced by combinatorial ligand binding to these pockets, but in vivo evidence of SMO allostery is lacking. Herein, we map an AA binding pocket at the top of the 7TM bundle and show that its disruption attenuates SHH- and sterol-stimulated SMO induction. A knock-in mouse model of compromised AA binding reveals that homozygous mutant mice are cyanotic, exhibit perinatal lethality, and display congenital heart disease. Surviving mutants demonstrate pulmonary maldevelopment and fail to thrive. Neurodevelopment is unaltered in these mice, suggesting that context-specific allosteric regulation of SMO signaling allows for precise tuning of pathway activity during cardiopulmonary development.
title_zh: 受体变构促进胚胎发育过程中特定环境的 Sonic Hedgehog 信号传导
abstract_zh: Sonic Hedgehog (SHH) 信号以时间和上下文相关的方式发挥作用，在胚胎发生过程中模拟不同的组织。信号转导器 Smoothened (SMO) 由甾醇、氧甾醇和花生四烯酸 (AA) 通过其胞外富含半胱氨酸结构域 (CRD) 和 7 次跨膜 (7TM) 束中的结合袋诱导。体外分析表明，SMO 信号传导通过与这些口袋结合的组合配体而变构增强，但缺乏 SMO 变构的体内证据。在此，我们在 7TM 束顶部绘制了 AA 结合口袋，并表明其破坏会减弱 SHH 和甾醇刺激的 SMO 诱导。 AA 结合受损的敲入小鼠模型表明，纯合突变小鼠出现紫绀、表现出围产期致死性，并表现出先天性心脏病。幸存的突变体表现出肺部发育不良并且无法生长。这些小鼠的神经发育没有改变，这表明 SMO 信号的上下文特异性变构调节可以在心肺发育过程中精确调节通路活性。

title: Patient-partnered multiomics reveals the molecular architecture of angiosarcoma
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Angiosarcoma is a poorly understood sarcoma due to its high heterogeneity and rarity. Here we show a comprehensive clinical and molecular analysis of a large cohort of 254 angiosarcoma patients through the patient-partnered Angiosarcoma Project. By integrating transcriptomic, somatic, and germline variant data, we find that subcutaneous angiosarcomas frequently exhibit TGF-β and receptor tyrosine kinase signaling upregulation, with driver mutations in KDR, PLCG1, and POT1. Meanwhile, cutaneous angiosarcomas are enriched for MYC-driven programs, UV mutational signatures, immune checkpoint gene expression, and TP53, FLT4, and BRAF mutations. Germline POT1 pathogenic variant carriers have a 92.7-fold higher risk of developing angiosarcoma, with ‘double-hit’ germline and somatic variant carriers developing disease decades earlier. Additionally, POT1-mutated tumors underexpress TERT and overexpress CHAMP1. Altogether, these findings elucidate the molecular framework of angiosarcoma, nominate therapeutic targets, and highlight the power of direct patient engagement in rare cancers.
title_zh: 患者合作的多组学揭示了血管肉瘤的分子结构
abstract_zh: 由于其高度异质性和罕见性，血管肉瘤是一种人们知之甚少的肉瘤。在这里，我们展示了通过患者合作的血管肉瘤项目对 254 名血管肉瘤患者进行的大型队列的全面临床和分子分析。通过整合转录组、体细胞和种系变异数据，我们发现皮下血管肉瘤经常表现出 TGF-β 和受体酪氨酸激酶信号传导上调，并伴有 KDR、PLCG1 和 POT1 的驱动突变。与此同时，皮肤血管肉瘤富含 MYC 驱动程序、UV 突变特征、免疫检查点基因表达以及 TP53、FLT4 和 BRAF 突变。种系 POT1 致病性变异携带者患血管肉瘤的风险高出 92.7 倍，“双重打击”种系和体细胞变异携带者患血管肉瘤的风险要早几十年。此外，POT1 突变的肿瘤 TERT 表达不足，CHAMP1 表达过度。总而言之，这些发现阐明了血管肉瘤的分子框架，指定了治疗靶点，并强调了患者直接参与治疗罕见癌症的力量。

title: Upwind terrestrial influences on soil moisture variability across South America
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Soil moisture across South America exhibits coherent spatial patterns shaped by upwind terrestrial conditions, yet their downwind propagation remains poorly quantified. We develop an observation-driven framework integrating atmospheric transport trajectories with deep learning to estimate vegetation’s contribution to downwind soil moisture. The transport-informed model outperforms a local-only baseline, with upwind information contributing 67% of predictive power, of which vegetation explains 15%. This vegetation-mediated influence is enhanced over agricultural zones, forming hotspots aligned with land-cover change and drought exposure. The cross-regional influence is organized along major transport corridors and varies non-linearly with climate. In humid forests, downwind moisture supply is highly sensitive to vegetation change, with canopy degradation associated with reduced soil moisture; in semi-arid regions, initial greening is associated with increases, but further greening weakens or reverses the effect. These results quantify vegetation–soil moisture teleconnections, with implications for land–atmosphere coupling in Earth system models and hydrological consequences of land-use and climate change.
title_zh: 逆风陆地对南美洲土壤湿度变化的影响
abstract_zh: 南美洲的土壤湿度表现出由逆风陆地条件塑造的连贯空间模式，但其顺风传播仍然很难量化。我们开发了一个观测驱动的框架，将大气传输轨迹与深度学习相结合，以估计植被对顺风土壤湿度的贡献。交通信息模型的表现优于仅本地基线，逆风信息贡献了 67% 的预测能力，其中植被解释了 15%。这种植被介导的影响在农业区得到增强，形成与土地覆盖变化和干旱暴露相关的热点。跨区域影响沿着主要交通走廊组织，并随气候呈非线性变化。在潮湿的森林中，顺风向的水分供应对植被变化高度敏感，冠层退化与土壤水分减少有关；在半干旱地区，最初的绿化与增加有关，但进一步的绿化会削弱或逆转这种影响。这些结果量化了植被-土壤湿度遥相关，对地球系统模型中的陆地-大气耦合以及土地利用和气候变化的水文后果具有影响。

title: Mitophagy mitigates mitochondrial DNA-induced activation of cGAS-STING in autoimmune thyroiditis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Autoimmune thyroiditis arises from disrupted homeostasis of thyroid follicular epithelial cells and coordinated immune cell activation within the microenvironment. However, its pathogenesis is not fully understood. Here, we identify a mitochondrial (mt) DNA-cGAS-STING inflammatory axis as a driver of autoimmune thyroiditis in mice. By contrast, ubiquitin-dependent mitophagy mediated by PINK1 and Parkin was found to protect mice from disease. Mechanistically, mitochondrial dysfunction elevates mitochondrial reactive oxygen species levels, activating the ATM-CHK2 DNA damage response pathway, which in turn phosphorylates the autophagy adapter TAX1BP1 at Ser722. This modification promotes the recruitment of mitochondria to autophagosomes, thereby facilitating mitophagy. Impairing the ATM-CHK2-TAX1BP1 mitophagy pathway causes mtDNA leakage into the cytosol and triggers cGAS-STING-dependent inflammation. Notably, pharmacological inhibition of STING with C176 effectively slows autoimmune thyroiditis progression. Together, these findings define an mtDNA-driven pathogenic mechanism in autoimmune thyroiditis and identify STING as a potential therapeutic target.
title_zh: 线粒体自噬减轻自身免疫性甲状腺炎中线粒体 DNA 诱导的 cGAS-STING 激活
abstract_zh: 自身免疫性甲状腺炎是由甲状腺滤泡上皮细胞的稳态破坏和微环境内协调的免疫细胞激活引起的。然而，其发病机制尚不完全清楚。在这里，我们确定线粒体 (mt) DNA-cGAS-STING 炎症轴是小鼠自身免疫性甲状腺炎的驱动因素。相比之下，PINK1 和 Parkin 介导的泛素依赖性线粒体自噬可以保护小鼠免受疾病侵害。从机制上讲，线粒体功能障碍会提高线粒体活性氧水平，激活 ATM-CHK2 DNA 损伤反应途径，进而磷酸化自噬接头 TAX1BP1 Ser722。这种修饰促进线粒体向自噬体的募集，从而促进线粒体自噬。损害 ATM-CHK2-TAX1BP1 线粒体自噬途径会导致 mtDNA 渗漏到细胞质中，并引发 cGAS-STING 依赖性炎症。值得注意的是，C176 对 STING 的药理抑制可有效减缓自身免疫性甲状腺炎的进展。总之，这些发现定义了自身免疫性甲状腺炎中 mtDNA 驱动的致病机制，并将 STING 确定为潜在的治疗靶点。

title: Cost-effective abatement of industrial sources of nitrous oxide with methane for urgent climate mitigation
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Abatement of industrial emissions of nitrous oxide (N2O), a potent greenhouse gas and stratospheric ozone-depleting substance, offers a viable approach to urgent climate mitigation. However, existing N2O abatement processes require rigorous conditions ( > 400 °C) due to its inertia and high costs. Here we present a cost-effective technology enabling 99.99% N2O conversion at 150 °C and a high reaction rate of 9629.55 kgN2O kgPt−1 h−1 using CH4 as a reductant on Pt/HZSM-5. Mechanism studies reveal the key to this success lies in the reaction-induced Pt nanoparticles, which host monoatomic adsorbed oxygen species and achieve a rapid O* formation/consumption cycle. Techno-economic analysis shows that it offers the potential to reduce N2O abatement costs by 62.3% for industrial adipic acid emissions in China. The study can incentivize further technical development and improve the sustainability of N2O abatement, as well as low-temperature CH4 activation.
title_zh: 用甲烷经济有效地减少工业来源的一氧化二氮，以紧急缓解气候变化
abstract_zh: 一氧化二氮（N2O）是一种强效温室气体和平流层臭氧消耗物质，减少工业排放为紧急缓解气候变化提供了可行的方法。然而，现有的 N2O 减排工艺由于其惰性和高成本，需要严格的条件（> 400 °C）。在这里，我们提出了一种经济有效的技术，使用 CH4 作为 Pt/HZSM-5 的还原剂，在 150 °C 下 N2O 转化率为 99.99%，反应速率高达 9629.55 kgN2O kgPt−1 h−1。机制研究表明，这一成功的关键在于反应诱导的 Pt 纳米颗粒，它含有单原子吸附的氧物质并实现快速的 O* 形成/消耗循环。技术经济分析表明，该方案可将中国工业己二酸排放的N2O减排成本降低62.3%。该研究可以激励进一步的技术开发并提高 N2O 减排以及低温 CH4 活化的可持续性。

title: Flexibility as a driver of regionalized power systems: A multi-regional optimization framework
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: In the context of the ongoing Energy Transition (ET), power system flexibility has emerged as a critical requirement for integrating increasing shares of Variable Renewable Energies (VREs) into electricity mixes. Because these resources are inherently location-specific, their large-scale deployment calls for a rethinking of how the balance between supply and demand is achieved. In this paper, we propose a multi-regional optimization framework to balance residual load using existing flexibility tools, including dispatchable generation, storage, demand response (DR), and inter-regional exchanges. Applying this framework to a cluster of four southern French regions for the full year 2023, we find that the residual load is met by an overwhelmingly low-carbon dispatchable mix dominated by nuclear baseload, and that inter-regional exchanges constitute the primary flexibility channel and generate substantial economic value through congestion rents ( ∼ 0.91 billion euros). We confirm the robustness of these findings through a dedicated sensitivity analysis spanning the hydro energy budget and the load recovery parameter. These results suggest that introducing an intermediate regional layer for the operation and coordination of power system flexibility could be beneficial from both a technical and an economic perspective.
title_zh: 灵活性作为区域电力系统的驱动力：多区域优化框架
abstract_zh: 在持续的能源转型 (ET) 背景下，电力系统灵活性已成为将越来越多的可变可再生能源 (VRE) 纳入电力结构的关键要求。由于这些资源本质上是特定地点的，它们的大规模部署需要重新思考如何实现供需平衡。在本文中，我们提出了一个多区域优化框架，利用现有的灵活性工具来平衡剩余负载，包括可调度发电、存储、需求响应（DR）和区域间交换。将此框架应用于 2023 年全年法国南部四个地区的集群，我们发现剩余负荷是通过以核基负荷为主的绝大多数低碳可调度组合来满足的，区域间交换构成主要的灵活性渠道，并通过拥堵租金（约 9.1 亿欧元）产生巨大的经济价值。我们通过涵盖水能预算和负荷恢复参数的专门敏感性分析确认了这些发现的稳健性。这些结果表明，从技术和经济角度来看，引入中间区域层来运行和协调电力系统灵活性可能都是有益的。

title: Carbohydrate-active enzymes of soil prophages enhance global carbon cycling potential
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Recent work suggests that soil-borne viruses play an important role in controlling carbon (C) cycling and stocks. However, the contribution of individual prophage (i.e., temperate phages residing within bacterial hosts during lysogenic cycle) to C degradation remains largely undocumented at global scale. Here, we generated a global gene catalog of prophage-encoded carbohydrate-active enzyme (pCAZymes), including 20,131 soil bacterial genomes, 3548 metagenomes, and 951 metatranscriptomes derived from pre-existing databases. The catalog includes 4708 pCAZymes associated with the degradation of lignocellulose, lignin, and pectin, with 21 lytic polysaccharide monooxygenase genes newly identified in phages. Our findings reveal that prophages have potential to accelerate labile soil C degradation by encoding pCAZymes that cooperate with their bacterial hosts. Using machine learning models, we predict a 13 ± 0.7% increase in the C metabolic potential driven by soil prophages by 2100 under a high-emission scenario (SSP585). In vitro experiments demonstrated that the transcriptional activity of pCAZyme genes is regulated by environmental temperature. Soil microcosm experiments further confirmed that pCAZymes can enhance host-mediated organic C mineralization by increasing degradative enzyme activity. This study reveals previously overlooked ecological functions of prophages in global soil C transformation, with important implications for the global climate and C cycling.
title_zh: 土壤原噬菌体的碳水化合物活性酶增强全球碳循环潜力
abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，土传病毒在控制碳 (C) 循环和库存方面发挥着重要作用。然而，单个原噬菌体（即溶原循环期间存在于细菌宿主内的温带噬菌体）对 C 降解的贡献在全球范围内基本上没有记录。在这里，我们生成了原噬菌体编码的碳水化合物活性酶 (pCAZymes) 的全球基因目录，包括源自现有数据库的 20,131 个土壤细菌基因组、3548 个宏基因组和 951 个宏转录组。该目录包括 4708 个与木质纤维素、木质素和果胶降解相关的 pCAZymes，以及在噬菌体中新鉴定的 21 个裂解多糖单加氧酶基因。我们的研究结果表明，原噬菌体有可能通过编码与其细菌宿主合作的 pCAZymes 来加速不稳定土壤碳的降解。使用机器学习模型，我们预测到 2100 年，在高排放情景下 (SSP585)，土壤原噬菌体驱动的碳代谢潜力将增加 13 ± 0.7%。体外实验表明pCAZyme基因的转录活性受环境温度调节。土壤微观世界实验进一步证实，pCAZymes 可以通过增加降解酶活性来增强宿主介导的有机碳矿化。这项研究揭示了先前被忽视的前噬菌体在全球土壤碳转化中的生态功能，对全球气候和碳循环具有重要意义。

title: Unit-level assessment of mitigation pathways for mercury emissions from the global coal power fleet
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Atmospheric mercury pollution remains a serious threat for human health and ecosystems, as recognized by the Minamata Convention on Mercury adopted in 2013. Coal-fired power units are major emitters of various environmental pollutants globally, including mercury. Here, we show the historical co-benefits of air pollution control measures and coal power retirement, identify coal-fired power units with disproportionately high mercury emissions, which we define as super emitters, and propose country-specific mitigation strategies. We find that super emitters were primarily concentrated in emerging countries by 2020. Our unit-level analysis highlights that substantial, near-term and cost-effective reductions can be achieved by prioritizing the retirement of super emitters and upgrading pollution control equipment, especially in countries with large coal fleets. In the long term, mercury-specific control technologies will be needed for deeper reductions. Our findings provide insights into customized and stage-based mitigation strategies for phasing down key sources of mercury emissions from coal-fired power units.
title_zh: 全球燃煤电厂汞排放缓解途径的单位级评估
abstract_zh: 2013 年通过的《汞问题水俣公约》承认，大气汞污染仍然对人类健康和生态系统构成严重威胁。燃煤发电机组是全球各种环境污染物（包括汞）的主要排放者。在这里，我们展示了空气污染控制措施和煤电退役的历史协同效益，确定了汞排放量过高的燃煤发电机组（我们将其定义为超级排放者），并提出了针对具体国家的缓解策略。我们发现，到 2020 年，超级排放国主要集中在新兴国家。我们的单位层面分析强调，通过优先淘汰超级排放国和升级污染控制设备，可以在短期内实现大幅、具有成本效益的减排，特别是在拥有大型燃煤船队的国家。从长远来看，需要针对汞的控制技术来进一步减少汞。我们的研究结果为逐步减少燃煤发电机组汞排放的主要来源的定制和分阶段缓解策略提供了见解。

title: JN.1-adapted vaccination is associated with readjustment of ancestral memory B cells toward neutralization within the JN.1 antigenic space
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The antigenic drift of SARS-CoV-2 toward the JN.1 lineage has prompted the development of variant-adapted COVID-19 booster vaccines. However, these boosters are thought to primarily recall pre-existing memory B cells (MBC), raising concerns about their ability to realign the immune response in highly pre-exposed populations. Here we analyze antibody and B cell responses in pre-exposed individuals (n = 42; median 4.5 prior COVID-19 vaccinations; 90% with at least one prior SARS-CoV-2 infection) following vaccination with a JN.1-adapted mRNA vaccine. Vaccination is associated with increased IgG binding and enhanced neutralization of JN.1 and related descendant variants. Longitudinal profiling of antigen-specific MBC shows that Wu01-only and Wu01/JN.1 cross-reactive cells remain dominant, while JN.1-only cells modestly increase by day 21. Single-cell RNA-sequencing of antigen-specific MBC in a representative sub-cohort (n = 7), combined with functional monoclonal antibody analyses, demonstrates that somatic hypermutation (SHM) drives intra-clonotype specialization toward improved JN.1 binding and neutralization. These findings indicate maturation of pre-existing, class-switched MBC rather than substantial de novo recruitment of naïve B cells. In conclusion, JN.1-adapted booster vaccination is associated with refinement of pre-existing MBC repertoires toward the JN.1 antigenic space and with enhanced neutralization of contemporary and antigenically proximate variants.
title_zh: JN.1 适应疫苗接种与祖先记忆 B 细胞在 JN.1 抗原空间内的中和作用的重新调整有关
abstract_zh: SARS-CoV-2 向 JN.1 谱系的抗原漂移促进了针对变体的 COVID-19 加强疫苗的开发。然而，这些增强剂被认为主要是召回预先存在的记忆 B 细胞 (MBC)，这引发了人们对其在高度预先暴露人群中重新调整免疫反应的能力的担忧。在这里，我们分析了预先暴露的个体（n = 42；中位数为 4.5 次之前接种过 COVID-19 疫苗；90% 的人之前至少感染过一次 SARS-CoV-2）在接种 JN.1 适应的 mRNA 疫苗后的抗体和 B 细胞反应。疫苗接种与 IgG 结合增加以及 JN.1 和相关后代变体的中和作用增强有关。抗原特异性 MBC 的纵向分析显示，仅 Wu01 和 Wu01/JN.1 交叉反应细胞仍占主导地位，而仅 JN.1 细胞在第 21 天时略有增加。对代表性亚组 (n = 7) 中抗原特异性 MBC 的单细胞 RNA 测序，结合功能性单克隆抗体分析，表明体细胞超突变 (SHM) 驱动克隆型内专业化，从而改善JN.1 结合和中和。这些发现表明先前存在的、类别转换的 MBC 已成熟，而不是大量从头招募初始 B 细胞。总之，适应 JN.1 的加强疫苗接种与针对 JN.1 抗原空间的预先存在的 MBC 库的完善以及对当代和抗原邻近变体的增强中和有关。

title: Ground-based radar unveils natural electron Bernstein waves in the ionosphere of Earth
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Electron Bernstein waves (EBWs) are electrostatic modes that propagate perpendicular to the magnetic field in magnetized plasmas, serving as a diagnostic tool for understanding plasma properties and the energetic particles that drive energy transport. However, their naturally occurring harmonic structures have long eluded ground-based radar detection due to their faint signals and the requirement for an observational geometry nearly perpendicular to the geomagnetic field. Here, we report high-resolution broadband spectral observations of naturally excited EBWs in Earth’s ionosphere using the Sanya Incoherent Scatter Radar. Our measurements reveal a series of discrete, well-defined spectral lines corresponding to the first seven electron gyroharmonics, a result consistent with theoretical predictions. Our analysis suggests that these EBW modes, enhanced by suprathermal photoelectrons, become observable under near-perpendicular geometry, where Landau damping is reduced. The frequency structure of these harmonics acts as a precise diagnostic ruler that enables the retrieval of electron density and perpendicular electron temperature, parameters that are difficult to retrieve with ion line techniques under such geometric constraints. This work provides ground-based radar observations of naturally excited EBWs and shows their use for diagnosing plasma parameters in magnetized plasmas.
title_zh: 地面雷达揭示了地球电离层中的自然电子伯恩斯坦波
abstract_zh: 电子伯恩斯坦波 (EBW) 是在磁化等离子体中垂直于磁场传播的静电模式，可作为了解等离子体特性和驱动能量传输的高能粒子的诊断工具。然而，由于它们的微弱信号以及几乎垂直于地磁场的观测几何形状的要求，它们自然产生的谐波结构长期以来一直无法被地面雷达探测到。在这里，我们报告了使用三亚非相干散射雷达对地球电离层中自然激发的电子束的高分辨率宽带光谱观测。我们的测量揭示了一系列离散的、明确的谱线，对应于前七个电子陀螺谐波，这一结果与理论预测一致。我们的分析表明，这些由超热光电子增强的 EBW 模式在近垂直的几何形状下变得可观察到，其中朗道阻尼减小。这些谐波的频率结构充当精确的诊断标尺，能够检索电子密度和垂直电子温度，这些参数在这种几何约束下很难用离子线技术检索。这项工作提供了对自然激发电子束的地面雷达观测，并展示了它们在诊断磁化等离子体中的等离子体参数中的用途。

title: The BRCT domain enhances DNA binding and catalytic efficiency of fungal PARPs
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Aspergillus fumigatus infections are a major yet often neglected global health challenge magnified by a growing at-risk population, limited treatment options, and the emergence of drug-resistant strains. Regulation of the DNA damage response (DDR) by ADP-ribosylation signalling has recently emerged as an important feature of fungal pathogenesis, but the underlying mechanisms remain largely elusive. Here we present a comprehensive phylogenetic and functional characterisation of Af-PARP1, the A. fumigatus PARP homologue. Our data reveal Af-PARP1 as a DNA-dependent poly(ADP-ribosyl)transferase with unique domain architecture, DNA damage selectivity, and activation dynamics distinct from its mammalian and plant homologues. We show that the fungal specific BRCT domain plays a crucial role in both damage recognition and ADP-ribosylation signal establishment. Collectively, our findings reveal a divergence in DDR-associated ADP-ribosylation specific to fungi, highlighting the potential of this signalling pathway as target for antifungal therapy.
title_zh: BRCT 结构域增强真菌 PARP 的 DNA 结合和催化效率
abstract_zh: 烟曲霉感染是一个主要但经常被忽视的全球健康挑战，由于高危人群不断增长、治疗选择有限以及耐药菌株的出现，这一挑战进一步加剧。 ADP-核糖基化信号传导对 DNA 损伤反应 (DDR) 的调节最近已成为真菌发病机制的一个重要特征，但其基本机制仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们提出了 Af-PARP1（烟曲霉 PARP 同源物）的全面系统发育和功能表征。我们的数据表明，Af-PARP1 是一种 DNA 依赖性聚（ADP-核糖基）转移酶，具有独特的结构域结构、DNA 损伤选择性和与其哺乳动物和植物同源物不同的激活动力学。我们发现真菌特异性 BRCT 结构域在损伤识别和 ADP-核糖基化信号建立中起着至关重要的作用。总的来说，我们的研究结果揭示了真菌特有的 DDR 相关 ADP 核糖基化的差异，突出了该信号通路作为抗真菌治疗靶点的潜力。

title: A benchmark study of vision and pathology foundation models for computational pathology
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: To advance precision medicine in pathology, artificial intelligence (AI)-driven foundation models must generalize across diverse datasets, tissues, and clinical tasks. However, their comparative performance and generalizability in computational pathology remain incompletely characterized. Here, we benchmark 32 AI foundation models across four categories, including general vision models (VM), general vision-language models (VLM), pathology-specific vision models (Path-VM), and pathology-specific vision-language models (Path-VLM), using slide- and patch-level tasks from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium (CPTAC), external benchmarking datasets, and out-of-domain datasets. Across TCGA tasks, Path-VMs consistently rank among the strongest performers. Evaluation across CPTAC and out-of-domain datasets reveals more nuanced generalization behavior, with model rankings showing modest but consistent shifts across datasets and task categories. Pairwise statistical comparisons indicate that differences among top-performing models are often small and task dependent. Path-VMs outperform Path-VLMs and remain competitive with VMs. Model size and pretraining dataset scale do not consistently predict downstream performance. Finally, late decision-level ensembling improves aggregate performance across external datasets and tissue types, highlighting complementary strengths across foundation models. PathBench: https://pathbench.stanford.edu/
title_zh: 计算病理学视觉和病理学基础模型的基准研究
abstract_zh: 为了推进病理学领域的精准医学，人工智能 (AI) 驱动的基础模型必须在不同的数据集、组织和临床任务中进行推广。然而，它们在计算病理学中的比较性能和普遍性仍未完全表征。在这里，我们使用来自癌症基因组图谱 (TCGA)、临床蛋白质组肿瘤分析联盟 (CPTAC)、外部基准测试数据集和域外数据集的幻灯片和补丁级任务，对四个类别的 32 个 AI 基础模型进行了基准测试，包括通用视觉模型 (VM)、通用视觉语言模型 (VLM)、病理特定视觉模型 (Path-VM) 和病理特定视觉语言模型 (Path-VLM)。在 TCGA 任务中，Path-VM 始终位居表现最强者之列。对 CPTAC 和域外数据集的评估揭示了更细微的泛化行为，模型排名显示数据集和任务类别之间适度但一致的变化。成对统计比较表明，表现最好的模型之间的差异通常很小并且依赖于任务。 Path-VM 的性能优于 Path-VLM，并与 VM 保持竞争力。模型大小和预训练数据集规模并不能一致地预测下游性能。最后，后期决策级集成提高了外部数据集和组织类型的总体性能，突出了基础模型之间的互补优势。 PathBench：https://pathbench.stanford.edu/
