title: Spontaneous and indefinite blinking in upconverting nanoparticles for ångström-precision multicolour super-resolution imaging
source: Nature Nanotechnology
abstract: Single-molecule localization microscopy enables high-resolution biological imaging, but its precision is limited by the rapid photobleaching of conventional fluorophores. Multicolour imaging is further constrained by the need for spectrally distinct dyes requiring separate excitations or sequential acquisition. Here we show that small (~10 nm) upconverting nanoparticles can be compositionally tuned to exhibit spontaneous, sustained blinking under single near-infrared excitation without optical or chemical modulation. By adjusting sensitizer (Yb3+)-emitter (Tm3+/Er3+) ratios, we identify a regime with intrinsic ON-OFF switching and low duty cycles (~0.9%) without photobleaching or statistical aging, enabling repeated localizations and sub-ångström precision (0.62 Å over 88,000 localizations) in upconversion-enabled stochastic optical reconstruction microscopy. By elucidating the underlying physical mechanism of this blinking, we engineered blue- and red-emitting probes for multicolour upconversion-enabled stochastic optical reconstruction microscopy. This technique enables the resolution of tightly packed UCNPs and the visualization of epidermal growth factor receptor dimers and multimers on cell membranes at single-protein resolution, all achieved with a simple optical setup without imaging buffers.
title_zh: 上转换纳米颗粒中的自发和无限期眨眼可实现埃级精度的多色超分辨率成像
abstract_zh: 单分子定位显微镜可实现高分辨率生物成像，但其精度受到传统荧光团快速光漂白的限制。多色成像进一步受到需要光谱不同的染料的限制，这些染料需要单独的激发或顺序采集。在这里，我们展示了小型（~10 nm）上转换纳米颗粒可以在成分上进行调整，以在单次近红外激发下表现出自发的、持续的闪烁，而无需光学或化学调制。通过调整敏化剂 (Yb3+)-发射极 (Tm3+/Er3+) 比率，我们确定了一种具有内在开关切换和低占空比 (~0.9%) 且无光漂白或统计老化的机制，从而在支持上转换的随机光学重建显微镜中实现重复定位和亚埃级精度（超过 88,000 个定位为 0.62 Å）。通过阐明这种闪烁的潜在物理机制，我们设计了用于多色上转换随机光学重建显微镜的蓝色和红色发射探针。该技术能够以单蛋白分辨率实现紧密堆积的 UCNP 的分辨率以及细胞膜上表皮生长因子受体二聚体和多聚体的可视化，所有这些都通过简单的光学设置实现，无需成像缓冲液。

title: Anionic Passivation Enables Reconstruction-Free Seawater Electrolysis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Nonoxide electrocatalysts hold great promise for high-efficiency seawater oxidation, yet their practical application is hindered by the inevitable surface reconstruction and pronounced corrosion under high anodic potentials. Herein, we solve this longstanding challenge by developing a rational anionic ligand passivation strategy that stabilizes phosphide lattices against oxidative degradation while preserving inherent electrocatalytic activity. Leveraging Lewis acid–base interactions, we grow an ultrathin, undercoordinated TiOx overlayer on a FeNiP (FNP) support. This overlayer withdraws electrons from lattice phosphorus, downshifts the P p-band center, and thermodynamically stabilizes the entire anionic sublattice against oxidative leaching. The oxidation-resistant scaffold further enables the anchoring of atomically ordered Ir arrays with a well-defined interatomic spacing of ∼2.8 Å, promoting direct O–O radical coupling via the oxide pathway mechanism and effectively circumventing the corrosive lattice oxygen route. Operando spectroscopy and 18O isotope tracing confirm fully reconstruction-free OER behavior with negligible lattice oxygen participation. The as-developed TiIr@FNP catalyst achieves ultralow overpotentials (only 310 mV at 1 A cm–2), operates stably for over 1200 h in alkaline seawater, and maintains near-unity Faradaic efficiency. The work demonstrates a generalizable strategy for designing durable, high-performance nonoxide anodic electrocatalysts under industrially relevant conditions.
title_zh: 阴离子钝化可实现免重建海水电解
abstract_zh: 摘要 非氧化物电催化剂在高效海水氧化方面具有广阔的前景，但其实际应用受到高阳极电位下不可避免的表面重构和明显腐蚀的阻碍。在此，我们通过开发合理的阴离子配体钝化策略来解决这一长期存在的挑战，该策略可以稳定磷化物晶格以防止氧化降解，同时保留固有的电催化活性。利用路易斯酸碱相互作用，我们在 FeNiP (FNP) 载体上生长了超薄、欠配位的 TiOx 覆盖层。该覆盖层从晶格磷中吸出电子，使 P p 带中心下移，并在热力学上稳定整个阴离子亚晶格以防止氧化浸出。抗氧化支架进一步能够以～2.8 Å的明确原子间间距锚定原子有序的Ir阵列，通过氧化物途径机制促进直接O-O自由基偶联，并有效地绕过腐蚀性晶格氧途径。原位光谱和 18O 同位素示踪证实了完全无重建的 OER 行为，且晶格氧的参与可以忽略不计。所开发的TiIr@FNP催化剂实现了超低过电势（1 A cm-2时仅为310 mV），在碱性海水中稳定运行超过1200小时，并保持接近一致的法拉第效率。这项工作展示了在工业相关条件下设计耐用、高性能非氧化物阳极电催化剂的通用策略。

title: Adaptive Fabrication of Porous Crystals through Multiple-Site Noncovalent Conjunction of [1,4]Diazocine-Embedded Three-Dimensionally Concave Nanographenes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Noncovalent porous crystals with superior processability have recently received intense attention due to their vast emerging applications. However, the construction of such materials is still extremely incidental and lacks a fine control. Herein, we develop a unique strategy using three-dimensional nanographenes with tunable bulky configurations to adaptively fabricate a series of noncovalent porous crystals. Stereospecific nanographenes with either unilateral or bilateral curved [1,4]diazocine domains are obtained by Scholl cyclization of tetracarbazole precursors bearing diverse substituents. Leveraging the multiple intrinsic concavities variably constructed by the rigid octagons and flexible carbazole groups, these nanographenes readily self-assemble into noncovalent porous crystals featuring straight one-dimensional, zigzag one-dimensional, or interconnected two-dimensional channels. Interestingly, coassembly with other aromatic derivatives such as pyrene further facilitates the construction of porous cocrystals from porosity-absent building blocks. Moreover, upon coassembly with fullerenes, the long-range charge-transfer interactions endow the resulting porous cocrystals with conducting properties.
title_zh: 通过[1,4]重氮辛嵌入三维凹纳米石墨烯的多位点非共价连接自适应制造多孔晶体
abstract_zh: 具有优异加工性能的非共价多孔晶体由于其广泛的新兴应用而最近受到了广泛的关注。但此类材料的施工仍然是极其偶然的，缺乏精细的控制。在此，我们开发了一种独特的策略，使用具有可调节大体积结构的三维纳米石墨烯来自适应地制造一系列非共价多孔晶体。通过带有不同取代基的四咔唑前体的 Scholl 环化获得具有单侧或双边弯曲的 [1,4]重氮辛结构域的立体特异性纳米石墨烯。利用刚性八边形和柔性咔唑基团不同地构造的多个固有凹面，这些纳米石墨烯很容易自组装成具有直一维、锯齿形一维或互连二维通道的非共价多孔晶体。有趣的是，与其他芳香族衍生物（例如芘）的共组装进一步促进了由无孔隙结构单元构建多孔共晶。此外，在与富勒烯共组装时，长程电荷转移相互作用赋予所得的多孔共晶以导电性能。

title: Personalized Phage Therapy in an ICU Patient with Polymicrobial Pulmonary Infections: a case from a single-arm trial
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Ventilator-associated infections (VAIs) caused by multidrug-resistant (MDR) pathogens poses a significant challenge in intensive care units (ICUs). Phage therapy has emerged as a promising alternative for VAIs, though its efficacy depends on multiple factors. We report a 40-year-old male ICU patient with sequential pulmonary infections of MDR Acinetobacter baumannii, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Stenotrophomonas maltophilia. Seven rounds of tailored phage therapy—targeting single or dual pathogens—were administered adjunctive to antibiotics. A. baumannii was complete eradication, but K. pneumoniae and S. maltophilia showed cyclical clearance and recurrence due to strain replacement and phage resistance. Phage therapy correlated with reduced bacterial load, fever, procalcitonin, and IL-6 levels, alongside improved pulmonary inflammation, while white blood cell counts and C-reactive protein showed limited response. No severe adverse events occurred. Dynamic shifts in dominant pathogens aligned with clinical progression, with phage therapy providing transient control, extending the window for intervention and reducing high-level antibiotic use. After six months, the patient was weaned from ventilation and discharged. This case underscores the complexity of VAI management and highlights the potential of personalized phage therapy to mitigate MDR infections and minimize antibiotic reliance. This case was enrolled in a single arm trial (ChiCTR2000036801).
title_zh: 对患有多种微生物肺部感染的 ICU 患者进行个性化噬菌体治疗：来自单臂试验的一个病例
abstract_zh: 由多重耐药 (MDR) 病原体引起的呼吸机相关感染 (VAI) 给重症监护病房 (ICU) 带来了重大挑战。噬菌体疗法已成为 VAI 的一种有前景的替代方案，尽管其疗效取决于多种因素。我们报告了一名 40 岁男性 ICU 患者，其肺部连续感染多重耐药鲍曼不动杆菌、肺炎克雷伯菌和嗜麦芽寡养单胞菌。七轮针对单一或双重病原体的定制噬菌体疗法与抗生素一起进行。鲍曼不动杆菌被完全根除，但肺炎克雷伯菌和嗜麦芽糖链球菌由于菌株更换和噬菌体抗性而表现出周期性清除和复发。噬菌体疗法与细菌负荷、发烧、降钙素原和 IL-6 水平的降低以及肺部炎症的改善相关，而白细胞计数和 C 反应蛋白的反应有限。没有发生严重不良事件。主要病原体的动态变化与临床进展一致，噬菌体疗法提供短暂的控制，延长干预窗口并减少高水平抗生素的使用。六个月后，患者脱离通气并出院。该案例强调了 VAI 管理的复杂性，并强调了个性化噬菌体疗法在减轻 MDR 感染和尽量减少抗生素依赖方面的潜力。该病例参加了单臂试验（ChiCTR2000036801）。

title: Interfacial Donnan Hydration Funnels in Lignin-Derived Carbon Orchestrate RuNi Synergy for Aldehyde-Assisted Dual-Hydrogen Electrosynthesis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Aldehyde oxidation-coupled hydrogen production can markedly reduce the energy demand of electrolysis while enabling hydrogen generation and collection from two compartments. However, high-current-density operation relies on catalysts that sustain fast kinetics and high selectivity under strong interfacial gradients. Electro-oxidized lignin is employed to construct a lignin-metal supramolecular framework composite, which upon carbonization yields RuNi@NOLC, a Ni-enriched RuNi alloy confined within an oxygen-enriched, nitrogen-doped lignin-derived carbon (NOLC) microenvironment. In a membrane-free flow electrolyzer using RuNi@NOLC as both cathode and anode catalysts, the coupled process achieves a specific energy consumption of 0.76 kWh Nm-3 H2, a formate Faradaic efficiency of 99.5%, and an apparent hydrogen Faradaic efficiency of 199.6% arising from dual-compartment hydrogen generation and collection. The NOLC microenvironment provides Donnan hydration with a hydration-funnel effect, enabling directional enrichment of H2O together with OH- at N-containing sites and stabilization of the transition configuration for water splitting, thereby markedly accelerating the Ni-centered Volmer step as the rate-determining process and establishing a 3-fold synergy of Ni-centered water activation, Ru-mediated hydrogen release, and NOLC-directed transport of water and hydroxide. Under formaldehyde oxidation bias, Ru-OH and RuOxH species dominate low-potential initiation. Assisted by neighboring Ni-OHads, these Ru-centered oxygenated species drive intermediates toward OCHO formation and formate production, while alloy electronic effects mitigate poisoning by strongly adsorbed intermediates before transport limitations prevail at higher potentials. This work converts the coordination-chemistry programmability of lignin into quantifiable interfacial-solvation advantages, providing a clear paradigm for understanding and designing microenvironment-dominated mechanisms in paired electrolysis.
title_zh: 木质素衍生碳中的界面唐南水合漏斗协调RuNi协同作用用于醛辅助双氢电合成
abstract_zh: 醛氧化耦合制氢可以显着降低电解的能量需求，同时能够从两个隔室产生和收集氢气。然而，高电流密度操作依赖于在强界面梯度下维持快速动力学和高选择性的催化剂。采用电氧化木质素构建木质素-金属超分子骨架复合材料，经碳化后生成 RuNi@NOLC，这是一种限制在富氧、氮掺杂木质素衍生碳 (NOLC) 微环境中的富镍 RuNi 合金。在使用RuNi@NOLC作为阴极和阳极催化剂的无膜流动电解槽中，耦合过程实现了0.76 kWh Nm-3 H2的单位能耗、99.5%的甲酸盐法拉第效率和199.6%的双室产氢和收集氢的表观氢法拉第效率。 NOLC微环境为唐南水合提供了水合漏斗效应，能够在含氮位点定向富集H2O和OH-，并稳定水分解的过渡构型，从而显着加速以Ni为中心的Volmer步骤作为速率决定过程，并建立以Ni为中心的水活化、Ru介导的氢释放以及NOLC定向的水和氢氧化物运输的3倍协同作用。在甲醛氧化偏压下，Ru-OH 和 RuOxH 物质在低电位引发中占主导地位。在邻近的 Ni-OHad 的协助下，这些以 Ru 为中心的含氧物质驱动中间体形成 OCHO 并最终形成

title: Structure–Property Relationships to Guide the Selection of Fluorinated Ethers for Li–S Batteries
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: A variety of fluorinated ethers have been used to improve key performance metrics in lithium-sulfur batteries, such as specific energy and cycle life. However, most previous articles employed only one fluorinated ether, and there is currently a lack of criteria or consensus about which fluorinated ether provides the largest performance improvement. This stems from a lack of fundamental understanding of the correlation between the chemical formula of the fluorinated ether and its effect on lithium-sulfur battery reactions. In this work, we systematically investigated nine fluorinated ethers and tested their effects in lithium-sulfur batteries representative of commercially relevant conditions. Electrochemical measurements were complemented by ex situ and operando NMR characterization of the lithium metal anode reactions, ex situ SEM and EDX imaging of cycled lithium and sulfur electrodes, and ab initio calculations and molecular dynamics simulations of the electrolytes, thus revealing the key motifs in the chemical structure of the fluorinated ethers that lead to performance improvements. The best-performing fluorinated ethers were those that interact with lithium ions with a strength similar to that of the other solvent(s) in the electrolyte, and as a result, fast solvent exchange reactions and high lithium-ion mobility are promoted. This benefited both the lithium and the sulfur electrode reactions, with the suppression of lithium dendrites, the formation of a more protective lithium SEI, and the promotion of polysulfide reactions that avoid the passivation of the carbon in the sulfur electrode. The best results were obtained with TFMP (1,1,2,2-tetrafluoro-3-methoxypropane), which had not been used before in lithium-sulfur batteries.
title_zh: 指导锂硫电池氟化醚选择的结构-性能关系
abstract_zh: 各种氟化醚已用于改善锂硫电池的关键性能指标，例如比能量和循环寿命。然而，以前的大多数文章仅采用一种氟化醚，目前缺乏关于哪种氟化醚提供最大性能改进的标准或共识。这是由于对氟化醚的化学式与其对锂硫电池反应的影响之间的相关性缺乏基本了解。在这项工作中，我们系统地研究了九种氟化醚，并测试了它们在代表商业相关条件的锂硫电池中的效果。电化学测量辅以锂金属阳极反应的非原位和原位核磁共振表征、循环锂和硫电极的非原位SEM和EDX成像以及电解质的从头计算和分子动力学模拟，从而揭示了氟化醚化学结构中的关键主题，从而提高了性能。性能最好的氟化醚是那些与锂离子相互作用的强度与电解质中其他溶剂相似的氟化醚，因此促进了快速溶剂交换反应和高锂离子迁移率。这有利于锂和硫电极的反应，抑制锂枝晶，形成更具保护性的锂SEI，并促进多硫化物反应，避免碳的钝化。

title: Food-related energy consumption can help reveal poverty in rural Chinese households
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Energy consumption for cooking is important for satisfying basic needs, complementing traditional poverty measurements. Here, we propose an energy consumption-based indicator (Energy Engel Coefficient) that measures the proportion of household energy dedicated to food preparation activities relative to the total. Using a nation-wide household survey in China, we find that this indicator exhibits consistent patterns with regional and household characteristics. In addition, it more accurately reflects Engel’s Law than traditional Engel Coefficient, which holds that households with lower incomes spend a larger proportion of their income on basic needs. Our proposed measure also shows stronger performance than traditional coefficient in comparing with non-monetary metrics like subjective experience and asset ownership. Our analysis reveals that the Energy Engel Coefficient identifies 13.9% of households experiencing poverty, with 85.8% of these households not identified by the traditional coefficient. These households are predominantly low-income, small-sized rural ones. Therefore, this indicator complements poverty identification and contributes to improving the distribution of welfare.
title_zh: 与食品相关的能源消耗有助于揭示中国农村家庭的贫困状况
abstract_zh: 烹饪能源消耗对于满足基本需求非常重要，是对传统贫困衡量的补充。在这里，我们提出了一个基于能源消耗的指标（能源恩格尔系数），衡量用于食品准备活动的家庭能源相对于总能源的比例。通过对中国全国范围的家庭调查，我们发现该指标表现出与地区和家庭特征一致的模式。此外，它比传统的恩格尔系数更准确地反映了恩格尔定律，传统的恩格尔系数认为收入较低的家庭将较大比例的收入用于基本需求。与主观经验和资产所有权等非货币指标相比，我们提出的衡量标准也显示出比传统系数更强的性能。我们的分析表明，能源恩格尔系数识别出了13.9%的贫困家庭，其中85.8%的家庭没有被传统系数识别。这些家庭主要是低收入、小规模的农村家庭。因此，该指标与贫困识别相辅相成，有助于改善福利分配。

title: Canopy-mediated climate feedbacks in the boreal continuous permafrost zone
source: Nature Climate Change
abstract:
Abstract
                  Boreal forests, covering approximately a quarter of the continuous permafrost zone, store relatively modest aboveground carbon, but thermally protect vast soil organic carbon (SOC) pools. Here, using a process-based model to compare seasonal thaw depths under forested and bare-ground scenarios, we quantify distinct canopy thermal insulation capacities of deciduous needleleaf, evergreen needleleaf and deciduous broadleaf canopies on permafrost thermal dynamics. Canopy buffering maintains approximately 59 Pg of carbon in a frozen state, which equals 32% of the total forested permafrost carbon pool and far exceeds boreal biomass stocks (7–19 Pg). Canopy changes could mobilize this frozen SOC through gradual thaw (40 Pg) and rapid thermokarst collapse (19 Pg). While forest loss sacrifices biomass carbon stocks, resulting thaw would expose orders of magnitude more SOC from previously frozen reservoirs, revealing a critical asymmetry. Forest conservation strategies in continuous permafrost zones must account for canopy-mediated thermal protection of frozen SOC, which far exceeds its biomass carbon sequestration capacity.
title_zh: 北方连续多年冻土区冠层介导的气候反馈
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  北方森林覆盖了大约四分之一的连续永久冻土带，储存的地上碳相对较少，但可以热保护大量的土壤有机碳（SOC）库。在这里，使用基于过程的模型来比较森林和裸地情景下的季节性融化深度，我们量化了落叶针叶、常绿针叶和落叶阔叶冠层在永久冻土热动力学上的不同冠层隔热能力。冠层缓冲在冻结状态下维持约 59 Pg 的碳，相当于森林永久冻土碳库总量的 32%，远远超过北方生物量储量 (7–19 Pg)。冠层变化可以通过逐渐解冻（40 Pg）和快速热喀斯特塌陷（19 Pg）来调动这种冻结的SOC。虽然森林损失牺牲了生物量碳储量，但由此产生的解冻将使先前冻结的水库中更多数量级的有机碳暴露出来，从而揭示出严重的不对称性。连续多年冻土区的森林保护策略必须考虑到冠层介导的冰冻有机碳的热保护，这远远超出了其生物质固碳能力。

abstract: The national synchrotron source, a laser facility and a particle accelerator are under threat of closure unless cash is found.

title: Phase-homogeneous mixed halide perovskites for stable tandem photovoltaics
source: Nature
abstract: Mixed-halide wide-bandgap (WBG) perovskites needed in tandem photovoltaics suffer from phase segregation, even at the time of initial film formation – the result of asymmetric nucleation of I-rich and Br-rich phases1-3. Known homogenization strategies tune Pb2+ coordination strength4-6; however, Pb2+-based modulation applies across all Pb2+ centers and does not preferentially address the problem that PbBrx nucleates faster than does PbIx. Here we introduce a selective coordination principle: we tune local Lewis-base hardness at the donor atom through a molecular dipole, an approach that constrains the polarizability of the O-donor’s outermost electrons. The harder O-donor preferentially coordinates the harder Pb2+ of PbBrx, selectively retarding Br-rich nucleation and synchronizing it with PbIx. This leads to compositionally homogeneous WBG films, enabling solar cells with bandgaps of 1.62 eV, 1.68 eV, and 1.88 eV, each achieving enhanced PCE and extended stability (1500 h, ≥T90, 1 sun and 65 °C). Perovskite/organic tandem cells fabricated with these WBG films and an infrared-active organic cell deliver certified 27.0% (steady-state 26.4%) efficiency, with T91 (ISOS-L2 at 65 °C) of 1000 h.
title_zh: 用于稳定串联光伏发电的相均质混合卤化物钙钛矿
abstract_zh: 串联光伏发电所需的混合卤化物宽带隙 (WBG) 钙钛矿即使在初始成膜时也会遭受相偏析，这是富 I 相和富 Br 相 1-3 不对称成核的结果。已知的均质化策略可调节 Pb2+ 配位强度4-6；然而，基于 Pb2+ 的调制适用于所有 Pb2+ 中心，并且不能优先解决 PbBrx 比 PbIx 成核更快的问题。在这里，我们引入了选择性配位原理：我们通过分子偶极子调节供体原子的局部路易斯碱硬度，这种方法限制了 O 供体最外层电子的极化率。较硬的 O 供体优先配位 PbBrx 中较硬的 Pb2+，选择性地延迟富 Br 成核并使其与 PbIx 同步。这导致了成分均匀的 WBG 薄膜，使太阳能电池的带隙为 1.62 eV、1.68 eV 和 1.88 eV，每种电池都实现了增强的 PCE 和延长的稳定性（1500 小时、≥T90、1 个太阳和 65 °C）。使用这些 WBG 薄膜和红外活性有机电池制造的钙钛矿/有机串联电池可提供经认证的 27.0%（稳态 26.4%）效率，T91（65 °C 下的 ISOS-L2）为 1000 小时。

title: Pyridoxal photoenzymes for asymmetric radical–radical cross-couplings
source: Nature
abstract: Non-native photoenzymes have enabled a myriad of asymmetric bond-forming events that are otherwise challenging or currently impossible with small molecule catalysis.1,2 These reactions require enzymes with cofactors that are strong absorbers in the visible region with reasonably long-lived excited states, such as flavin and nicotinamide. However, there exists a substantial chromophoric cofactor “dark space” where no known photoenzymatic activity has been characterized.1 Increased knowledge of the photophysics of the cofactors in the “dark space” would increase the types of bonds that photoenzymes can form by accessing new excited state intermediates in enzyme classes with divergent reactivities and selectivities. Here, we establish pyridoxal 5’-phosphate (PLP) as a photoenzymatic cofactor by leveraging the excited state quinonoid intermediate as a potent single-electron reductant. We overcome the poor photophysical properties of the native quinonoid intermediate by employing non-native benzyl amine substrates and exploiting Förster resonance energy transfer mechanism from an exogenous photosensitizer to access the quinonoid excited state. This redox neutral approach enables an asymmetric radical-radical cross-coupling between benzyl amines and reductive radical precursors through concomitant generation and localization of a radical pair in an enzyme active site—overcoming the typical challenges associated with this reaction by removing the necessity for radical sorting and the persistent radical effect. 33 The emergent photoexcited intermediates of PLP identified in this work greatly expands the potential avenues for valuable bond forming events by PLP-dependent enzymes.
title_zh: 用于不对称自由基-自由基交叉偶联的吡哆醛光酶
abstract_zh: 非天然光酶已经实现了无数不对称成键事件，而这些事件在小分子催化作用下是具有挑战性或目前不可能的。1,2这些反应需要具有辅因子的酶，这些辅因子在可见光区域是强吸收剂，具有相当长的激发态，例如黄素和烟酰胺。然而，存在大量的发色辅因子“暗空间”，其中没有已知的光酶活性被表征。1增加对“暗空间”中辅因子的光物理学的了解将增加光酶通过访问具有不同反应性和选择性的酶类中新的激发态中间体可以形成的键的类型。在这里，我们利用激发态醌类中间体作为有效的单电子还原剂，将吡哆醛 5’-磷酸 (PLP) 建立为光酶辅助因子。我们通过使用非天然苄胺底物并利用外源光敏剂的福斯特共振能量转移机制来获得醌类激发态，从而克服了天然醌类中间体较差的光物理性质。这种氧化还原中性方法通过在酶活性位点中同时生成和定位自由基对，实现了苄胺和还原性自由基前体之间的不对称自由基-自由基交叉偶联，通过消除自由基分选的必要性和持久的自由基效应，克服了与该反应相关的典型挑战。 33 本工作中发现的新出现的 PLP 光激发中间体

title: Hydrogen-induced damage in Ni-based superalloys at elevated temperatures
source: Nature Materials
abstract:
Abstract
                  The urgent need to decarbonize the energy and transport sectors motivates the use of hydrogen-containing fuels in gas turbines for power generation and aviation applications, exposing safety-critical components to hydrogen environments at elevated temperatures. Ambient-temperature hydrogen embrittlement has long been interpreted through the physical interactions between hydrogen and microstructural defects like interfaces and dislocations. Here we show that this understanding does not fully capture the behaviour at elevated temperatures, where vacancy-driven chemical reactions between hydrogen and specific microstructural constituents can markedly intensify embrittlement compared with ambient conditions. In a prototypical face-centred cubic Ni-based superalloy, our near-atomic-scale characterization and ab initio calculations reveal strong trapping of hydrogen atoms in carbon vacancies in carbides, driving their partial decomposition while simultaneously triggering localized methane formation at the carbide–matrix interface. As a result, the heterointerfaces are weakened, rendering them vulnerable to deformation-induced damage. Our work provides a physical foundation for mechanistic modelling of elevated-temperature hydrogen embrittlement in Ni-based alloys, an emerging area critical to hydrogen-fuelled turbines and related high-temperature technologies.
title_zh: 高温下镍基高温合金的氢致损伤
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  能源和运输行业脱碳的迫切需要促使发电和航空应用的燃气轮机使用含氢燃料，将安全关键部件暴露在高温的氢气环境中。长期以来，环境温度氢脆一直通过氢与界面和位错等微观结构缺陷之间的物理相互作用来解释。在这里，我们表明这种理解并不能完全捕捉高温下的行为，与环境条件相比，氢和特定微观结构成分之间的空位驱动的化学反应可以显着加剧脆化。在典型的面心立方镍基高温合金中，我们的近原子尺度表征和从头计算揭示了碳化物中碳空位中氢原子的强烈捕获，驱动其部分分解，同时触发碳化物-基体界面处的局部甲烷形成。结果，异质界面被削弱，使其容易受到变形引起的损坏。我们的工作为镍基合金高温氢脆的机械建模提供了物理基础，这是一个对氢燃料涡轮机和相关高温技术至关重要的新兴领域。

title: Force-responsive biomaterials drive tissue repair by harnessing endogenous growth factors
source: Nature Materials
abstract:
Abstract
                  Materials enabling the cell-responsive delivery of endogenous biologics, such as growth factors, have the potential to modulate wound repair cost-effectively and safely. Unlike passive drug delivery strategies that require supraphysiological doses of recombinant protein or stimuli-responsive systems that rely on external triggers, we demonstrate a strategy that harnesses cellular traction forces as an intrinsic delivery trigger. Traction-force-activated payloads are bioinspired aptamer constructs attached to biomaterial scaffolds that selectively harvest, concentrate and reactivate multiple endogenous growth factors from cells, injury sites and blood lysate in vivo (rat femur and mouse skin) and ex vivo (human skin), at doses orders of magnitude lower than current clinical standards. Unmodified oligonucleotide aptamers retain functionality in enzyme-rich wound environments, substantially expanding the translational potential of nucleic-acid-based therapeutics. The ability to harvest and redeliver endogenous growth factors without exogenous triggers, recombinant proteins or cold-chain logistics via mechanoresponsive biomaterials opens possibilities for accessible, cost-effective combinatorial biologic therapies.
title_zh: 力响应生物材料通过利用内源生长因子驱动组织修复
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  能够以细胞响应方式递送内源性生物制剂（例如生长因子）的材料有可能经济有效且安全地调节伤口修复。与需要超生理剂量的重组蛋白或依赖于外部触发的刺激响应系统的被动药物递送策略不同，我们展示了一种利用细胞牵引力作为内在递送触发的策略。牵引力激活的有效负载是附着在生物材料支架上的仿生适体结构，可选择性地从体内（大鼠股骨和小鼠皮肤）和离体（人类皮肤）的细胞、损伤部位和血液裂解物中收获、浓缩和重新激活多种内源性生长因子，其剂量低于当前临床标准的数量级。未修饰的寡核苷酸适体在富含酶的伤口环境中保留了功能，大大扩展了基于核酸的治疗的翻译潜力。通过机械响应生物材料收获和重新输送内源性生长因子而无需外源性触发物、重组蛋白或冷链物流的能力，为可获取、具有成本效益的组合生物疗法开辟了可能性。

title: Non-reciprocal linearly polarized light in simple media
source: Nature Materials
abstract: Reciprocity-the principle that a response is identical along the forward and backward paths-is a fundamental concept across physics. Non-reciprocity occurs when this symmetry is broken, resulting in direction-dependent behaviour. Achieving optical non-reciprocity typically requires complex metamaterials, exotic media or strong fields. Researchers have overlooked the possibility that conventional materials could support optical non-reciprocity. Here, through the Stokes-Mueller formalism, we predict a pathway to non-reciprocal absorption and emission of orthogonal linear polarizations. We test this idea using solution-processed films of CdS, CdSe and CdTe magic-size clusters with comparable circular and linear dichroism, and demonstrate non-reciprocal absorption and emission of linearly polarized light. Based on these findings, several design rules and practical applications are presented. Our work reveals that non-reciprocal linear dichroism and emission can be achieved in readily processable materials by harnessing chiral-linear optical interference, providing opportunities within polarization-based quantum optics and photonics such as direction-dependent optical routing or polarization-multiplexed encryption.
title_zh: 简单介质中的非互易线偏振光
abstract_zh: 互易性（即向前和向后路径上的响应相同的原理）是物理学的基本概念。当这种对称性被破坏时，就会出现非互易性，从而导致方向依赖的行为。实现光学非互易性通常需要复杂的超材料、奇异介质或强场。研究人员忽视了传统材料支持光学非互易性的可能性。在这里，通过 Stokes-Mueller 形式，我们预测了正交线性偏振的非互易吸收和发射的途径。我们使用具有可比圆形和线性二色性的 CdS、CdSe 和 CdTe 幻尺寸团簇的溶液处理薄膜测试了这一想法，并证明了线性偏振光的非互易吸收和发射。基于这些发现，提出了一些设计规则和实际应用。我们的工作表明，通过利用手性线性光学干涉，可以在易于加工的材料中实现非互易线性二色性和发射，从而在基于偏振的量子光学和光子学（例如方向相关的光学路由或偏振复用加密）中提供机会。

title: How hydrogen damages Ni-based superalloys in the heat
source: Nature Materials
abstract: Hydrogen compromises the mechanical performance of metallic materials, but hydrogen–material interactions at high temperatures remain poorly understood despite emerging applications in hydrogen-powered energy systems. Now, multiscale damage analysis of Ni-based superalloys tested in a high-temperature hydrogen atmosphere uncovers degradation mechanisms that differ from those operating at near-room temperature.
title_zh: 氢如何在高温下损坏镍基高温合金

title: Synthetic ion channel inhibitors enhance plant drought tolerance
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Drought stress significantly threatens global food security. According to the FAO2024, agriculture absorbs up to 80% of drought impacts. Stomata are vital pores for gas exchange and transpiration in plants. Stomatal closure, which is crucial for drought tolerance, is regulated by ion transport systems. Here, we identify two inhibitors of plasma membrane voltage-dependent potassium (K+) channels, NS5806 and UA49, that induce stomatal closure, reduce guard cell K+ levels, and increase drought resistance in Arabidopsis plants. This chemical-induced stomatal closure pathway is distinct from the abscisic acid (ABA). Notably, K+ channel inhibition led to increased cytosolic Ca2+, which was absent in K+ inward channel mutants, highlighting the link between K+ channel activity and cytosolic Ca2+ elevation. These findings suggest that the chemical regulation of K+ channels represents a strategy to induce stomatal closure, potentially improving plant drought tolerance through targeted interventions.
title_zh: 合成离子通道抑制剂增强植物耐旱性
abstract_zh: 干旱胁迫严重威胁全球粮食安全。根据FAO2024，农业吸收了高达80%的干旱影响。气孔是植物进行气体交换和蒸腾作用的重要孔隙。气孔关闭对于耐旱性至关重要，受到离子传输系统的调节。在这里，我们鉴定了两种质膜电压依赖性钾 (K+) 通道抑制剂 NS5806 和 UA49，它们可诱导拟南芥植物气孔关闭、降低保卫细胞 K+ 水平并增强抗旱性。这种化学诱导的气孔关闭途径与脱落酸 (ABA) 不同。值得注意的是，K+通道抑制导致胞质Ca2+增加，而K+内向通道突变体中不存在这种情况，突出了K+通道活性与胞质Ca2+升高之间的联系。这些发现表明 K+ 通道的化学调节代表了一种诱导气孔关闭的策略，可能通过有针对性的干预措施提高植物的耐旱性。

title: From takeout to takeoff
source: Nature Energy
abstract: Converting plastic waste into jet fuel could help decarbonize aviation, but upcycling routes often require high pressures and long reaction times. New research demonstrates that catalysts based on atomically-dispersed Ru atoms on oxide supports can rapidly convert waste plastics into jet fuel components under mild conditions.
title_zh: 从外卖到起飞
abstract_zh: 将塑料废物转化为喷气燃料可能有助于航空业脱碳，但升级改造路线通常需要高压和较长的反应时间。新的研究表明，基于氧化物载体上原子分散的钌原子的催化剂可以在温和的条件下将废塑料快速转化为喷气燃料成分。

title: Hidden spin-valley locking stabilizes nanosecond spin polarization in 2D perovskites
source: Nature Nanotechnology
abstract: Room-temperature spin control in semiconductors is fundamental to spin-optoelectronics. Although inversion symmetry breaking offers one path for spin control in semiconductors, strong spin dephasing at elevated temperatures remains a persistent limitation. Hidden spin polarization without global symmetry breaking provides another promising material design strategy, but robust spin stabilization from this effect has yet to be experimentally realized. Here we show spin stabilization at room temperature in two-dimensional hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites through hidden spin-valley locking. We use functional non-primary ammonium cations to induce symmetry-breaking distortions in the metal-halide layers, producing giant local spin splitting while preserving global inversion symmetry. Time-resolved circular dichroism measurements reveal optically generated spin-polarized carriers that persist for 686 ps in (AzOH)2PbI4 and 4.7 ns in the lead-free analogue (AzOH)2SnI4 at room temperature, without an external magnetic field. First-principles calculations suggest that these long lifetimes arise from hidden spin valleys, enhanced dielectric screening and reduced spin-orbit-induced scattering in the Sn-based compound. Our design paradigm unlocks inversion-symmetric semiconductors with ultralong spin lifetimes, broadening the materials options for light-driven spin control.
title_zh: 隐藏的自旋谷锁定稳定了二维钙钛矿中的纳秒自旋极化
abstract_zh: 半导体中的室温自旋控制是自旋光电子学的基础。尽管反演对称性破缺为半导体自旋控制提供了一种途径，但高温下的强自旋相移仍然是一个持久的限制。没有全局对称性破缺的隐藏自旋极化提供了另一种有前途的材料设计策略，但这种效应的强大自旋稳定性尚未通过实验实现。在这里，我们通过隐藏的自旋谷锁定展示了二维杂化有机-无机钙钛矿在室温下的自旋稳定性。我们使用功能性非伯铵阳离子在金属卤化物层中诱导对称性破缺扭曲，产生巨大的局部自旋分裂，同时保持全局反演对称性。时间分辨圆二色性测量揭示了光学产生的自旋偏振载流子，在室温下，在没有外部磁场的情况下，(AzOH)2PbI4 中的持续时间为 686 ps，无铅类似物 (AzOH)2SnI4 中的持续时间为 4.7 ns。第一原理计算表明，这些长寿命源于锡基化合物中隐藏的自旋谷、增强的介电屏蔽和减少的自旋轨道引起的散射。我们的设计范例解锁了具有超长自旋寿命的反演对称半导体，拓宽了光驱动自旋控制的材料选择。

title: Integrated blue ZnSe/ZnS quantum dot lasers on a silicon nitride platform
source: Nature Nanotechnology
abstract: On-chip blue lasers are essential for data storage, quantum photonics, optical communications and lab-on-chip sensing. Existing GaN-based devices deliver high performance but demand lattice-matched substrates, involve complex architectures and suffer from high optical losses in the visible range. Here we extend the CMOS-compatible fabrication methodology used to incorporate emitting colloidal quantum dots (QDs) with silicon nitride (SiNx) platforms from proven red and green to blue lasers. Implementing QD design rules for optimal gain performance, we obtain blue-emitting ZnSe/ZnS QDs with gain metrics on par with established red and green QDs. After encapsulating QD films with an organic/inorganic bilayer, we demonstrate stable lasing under femtosecond and nanosecond pumping using different cavity designs. Such films, coated on low-loss SiNx two-dimensional photonic crystal cavities, yield out-of-plane lasing between 425 and 445 nm, with quasi-continuous-wave thresholds of 7.5 kW cm-2. In addition, in-plane, waveguide-coupled lasing is demonstrated by depositing ZnSe/ZnS QD films on top of a one-dimensional distributed feedback cavity. Our work underscores the potential of non-toxic, solution-processable ZnSe-based QDs for integrated blue photonics.
title_zh: 氮化硅平台上的集成蓝色 ZnSe/ZnS 量子点激光器
abstract_zh: 片上蓝色激光器对于数据存储、量子光子学、光通信和片上实验室传感至关重要。现有的基于 GaN 的器件可提供高性能，但需要晶格匹配的衬底，涉及复杂的架构，并且在可见光范围内光学损耗较高。在这里，我们扩展了用于将发光胶体量子点 (QD) 与氮化硅 (SiNx) 平台相结合的 CMOS 兼容制造方法，从经过验证的红色和绿色激光器到蓝色激光器。实施 QD 设计规则以实现最佳增益性能，我们获得了发射蓝光的 ZnSe/ZnS QD，其增益指标与现有的红色和绿色 QD 相当。用有机/无机双层封装 QD 薄膜后，我们使用不同的腔设计在飞秒和纳秒泵浦下展示了稳定的激光发射。这种薄膜涂在低损耗的 SiNx 二维光子晶体腔上，可产生 425 至 445nm 之间的面外激光，准连续波阈值为 7.5kWcm-2。此外，通过在一维分布式反馈腔顶部沉积 ZnSe/ZnS QD 薄膜来演示面内波导耦合激光发射。我们的工作强调了无毒、可溶液加工的 ZnSe 基量子点在集成蓝色光子学方面的潜力。

title: Temperature-dependent replication and sensitivity to innate immunity of human coronavirus HKU1
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The human coronavirus HKU1, causing common colds and occasionally severe illness, remains largely uncharacterized because it has not been successfully grown on immortalized cells. Here, we identify Caco2 cells overexpressing TMPRSS2, the HKU1 receptor, as being highly permissive to infection. HKU1 replicates efficiently, forms syncytia and releases infectious progeny in these cells at 33 °C, the temperature of the nasal cavity, but is attenuated at 37 °C. Viral entry occurs similarly at both temperatures, but subsequent viral RNA synthesis is enhanced at 33 °C. Released virions display higher stability at 33 °C. In Caco2 and primary epithelial nasal cells, HKU1 is sensitive to interferons (IFN), but induction of IFN stimulated genes, such as IFN-Induced Transmembrane Proteins (IFITMs), is delayed at 33 °C. Once expressed, IFITMs comparably inhibit HKU1 fusion at both temperatures. In contrast, SARS-CoV-2 robustly replicates at 37 °C. Thus, cellular permissiveness, innate immunity and viral properties collectively explain why HKU1 replicates more efficiently at nasal temperature. Our results highlight temperature-sensitivity disparities between coronaviruses, likely associated to different pathogenic outcomes.
title_zh: 人类冠状病毒 HKU1 的温度依赖性复制和对先天免疫的敏感性
abstract_zh: 人类冠状病毒 HKU1 会引起普通感冒，偶尔还会导致严重疾病，但由于尚未在永生化细胞上成功生长，因此在很大程度上仍未得到表征。在这里，我们鉴定出过度表达 TMPRSS2（HKU1 受体）的 Caco2 细胞非常容易感染。 HKU1 在 33°C（鼻腔温度）下有效复制，形成合胞体并在这些细胞中释放感染性后代，但在 37°C 时减弱。两种温度下病毒进入的情况相似，但随后的病毒 RNA 合成在 33 °C 下增强。释放的病毒粒子在 33 °C 下表现出更高的稳定性。在 Caco2 和原代上皮鼻细胞中，HKU1 对干扰素 (IFN) 敏感，但 IFN 刺激基因（如 IFN 诱导的跨膜蛋白 (IFITM)）的诱导在 33 °C 时会延迟。一旦表达，IFITM 在两种温度下都会同等程度地抑制 HKU1 融合。相比之下，SARS-CoV-2 在 37°C 下可以强劲复制。因此，细胞许可性、先天免疫和病毒特性共同解释了为什么 HKU1 在鼻腔温度下复制效率更高。我们的结果强调了冠状病毒之间的温度敏感性差异，这可能与不同的致病结果有关。

title: Host-derived lactic acid disrupts IFN efficacy via antiviral inhibition and proinflammatory amplification
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Circulating emerging viruses endanger public health. Type I interferons (IFNs) confer robust preclinical antiviral efficacy yet face incompletely defined clinical hurdles: narrow therapeutic windows, suboptimal activity and severe adverse events. Herein, we show that IFNs confer antiviral protection exclusively upon pre-infection administration. Once infection is established, IFNs are ineffective yet induce prominent adverse effects, with host-derived lactic acid (LAC) as the key mediator: it promotes viral immune evasion, impairs IFN therapeutic efficacy, triggers inflammatory storms, and elicits adverse reactions. Mechanistically, LAC suppresses IFN activity via membrane receptor-mediated Silent Information Regulator 1 (SIRT1) upregulation and synergizes with IFNs to hyperactivate Nuclear Factor Kappa-Light-Chain-Enhancer of Activated B cells (NF-κB), initiating cytokine storms and forming an “antiviral failure-inflammatory amplification” feedback loop. Based on this mechanism, we develop a combinatorial therapy of IFNs plus an U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved lactate dehydrogenase inhibitor. This regimen reverses LAC-mediated IFN suppression, mitigates inflammation, and achieves dual “antiviral + anti-inflammatory” benefits. Notably, it retains robust efficacy even in late-stage infections, overcoming IFN monotherapy drawbacks and addressing the core bottleneck restricting IFN clinical application. Our study identifies LAC as a pivotal target for broad-spectrum antiviral development and provides a potential strategy to combat emerging viral pandemics.
title_zh: 宿主来源的乳酸通过抗病毒抑制和促炎放大破坏干扰素功效
abstract_zh: 正在传播的新病毒危及公众健康。 I 型干扰素 (IFN) 具有强大的临床前抗病毒功效，但面临不完全明确的临床障碍：治疗窗口狭窄、活性次优和严重不良事件。在此，我们证明干扰素仅在感染前给药时才具有抗病毒保护作用。一旦感染建立，干扰素不仅无效，而且会引起显着的不良反应，其中宿主源性乳酸（LAC）是关键介质：它促进病毒免疫逃避，损害干扰素治疗效果，引发炎症风暴，引发不良反应。从机制上讲，LAC 通过膜受体介导的沉默信息调节因子 1 (SIRT1) 上调抑制 IFN 活性，并与 IFN 协同作用，过度激活活化 B 细胞的核因子 Kappa 轻链增强子 (NF-κB)，引发细胞因子风暴并形成“抗病毒失败-炎症放大”反馈回路。基于这一机制，我们开发了一种 IFN 与美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 批准的乳酸脱氢酶抑制剂的组合疗法。该方案逆转LAC介导的IFN抑制，减轻炎症，实现“抗病毒+抗炎”双重功效。值得注意的是，它即使在晚期感染中也能保持强大的疗效，克服了IFN单药治疗的缺点，解决了限制IFN临床应用的核心瓶颈。我们的研究将 LAC 确定为广谱抗病毒药物开发的关键靶标，并提供了对抗新出现的病毒大流行的潜在策略。

title: CmDREBa regulates the perennial growth habit of chrysanthemum in response to prolonged chilling
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Seasonal growth modulation is a key adaptive trait in perennials that supports overwinter survival. During winter, many perennials adopt a rosette growth habit by suppressing both vegetative extension and flowering, but the mechanism that coordinates these two distinct developmental programs remains unclear. Here, we show that prolonged chilling primarily acts at the shoot apex to confer extension growth and flowering competence in chrysanthemum (Chrysanthemum morifolium). Long-term chilling is accompanied by marked changes in gene expression in the rib zone of the shoot apex. Notably, the expression of CmDREBa is associated with the transition from extension growth to rosette growth. Chilling induces CmDREBa expression, which suppresses both extension growth and flowering; when temperatures rise, CmDREBa expression declines, allowing both processes to resume. CmDREBa directly induces the expression of MADS AFFECTING FLOWERING (MAF) genes, which in turn promote rosette growth. Together, these findings identify CmDREBa as a key regulator of chilling-responsive seasonal growth.
title_zh: CmDREBa 调节菊花的多年生生长习性以应对长期寒冷
abstract_zh: 季节性生长调节是多年生植物支持越冬生存的关键适应性特征。在冬季，许多多年生植物通过抑制营养延伸和开花而采取莲座状生长习性，但协调这两种不同发育程序的机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明，长时间的寒冷主要作用于茎尖，以赋予菊花（Chrysanthemum morifolium）延伸生长和开花能力。长期寒冷伴随着茎尖肋区基因表达的显着变化。值得注意的是，CmDREBa 的表达与从延伸生长到玫瑰花结生长的转变相关。低温会诱导 CmDREBa 表达，从而抑制延伸生长和开花；当温度升高时，CmDREBa 表达下降，从而使两个过程得以恢复。 CmDREBa 直接诱导 MADS 影响开花 (MAF) 基因的表达，进而促进莲座丛的生长。总之，这些发现表明 CmDREBa 是寒冷响应季节性生长的关键调节因子。

title: High-diversity base mutagenesis via simultaneous adenine, cytosine and guanine editing
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Base editors hold great promise in endogenous mutagenesis for genetic screening. However, the development of base editors that induce saturated multi-base conversions with diverse mutation spectrum is challenging. Here, we develop triple base editors (smACGs) that simultaneously mutagenize adenine, cytosine, and guanine within the same allele. Through screening and embedding engineered deaminase and alkyladenine DNA glycosylase variants in Cas9 structure, smACGmax is generated to catalyze robust triple-base conversion efficiencies of up to 41% across varied sequence contexts while maintaining low RNA off-target effects compared to previous dual-base editors. We apply smACGmax to enable high coverage (94%) of targeted HBEGF mutagenesis that identified diphtheria toxin-resistant mutations and to dissect SF3B1 variants with alternative splicing specificity via complex single, double, and triple base conversion screening. smACGmax expands base conversion capability from single and double substrates to trinucleotide level, which facilitates the generation of high-diversity and complex genetic variants, providing a useful platform for mutagenesis-based application.
title_zh: 通过同时腺嘌呤、胞嘧啶和鸟嘌呤编辑进行高多样性碱基诱变
abstract_zh: 碱基编辑器在基因筛选的内源诱变方面具有广阔的前景。然而，开发诱导具有不同突变谱的饱和多碱基转换的碱基编辑器具有挑战性。在这里，我们开发了三碱基编辑器 (smACG)，可同时诱变同一等位基因内的腺嘌呤、胞嘧啶和鸟嘌呤。通过在 Cas9 结构中筛选和嵌入工程脱氨酶和烷基腺嘌呤 DNA 糖基化酶变体，生成 smACGmax，以在不同的序列背景下催化高达 41% 的稳健三碱基转换效率，同时与之前的双碱基编辑器相比，保持较低的 RNA 脱靶效应。我们应用 smACGmax 实现高覆盖率 (94%) 的靶向 HBEGF 诱变，识别白喉毒素抗性突变，并通过复杂的单碱基、双碱基和三碱基转换筛选，剖析具有选择性剪接特异性的 SF3B1 变体。 smACGmax将碱基转换能力从单底物和双底物扩展到三核苷酸水平，有利于高多样性和复杂遗传变异的产生，为基于诱变的应用提供了有用的平台。

title: Achieving enhanced and robust propane selective oxidative dehydrogenation via electrically-driven continuous chemical looping
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Oxidative propane dehydrogenation (OPDH) has emerged as a promising approach for direct propylene production. However, it still confronts great challenge of overoxidation of propane to COx, damaging the products selectivity. Herein, we report an electrically-driven continuous chemical looping process to efficiently produce propylene via an electrochemical CO2-OPDH system within solid oxide electrolysis cells (SOECs). At an optimal current density of 10 mA cm−2, the system with a Co3O4-modified La0.6Sr0.4Co0.2Fe0.8O3-δ (LSCF) anode achieves 92.6% olefin selectivity and 14.2% single-pass propane conversion. This current-driven configuration boosts the propylene yield (5.11 mmol gtotal−1 h−1) by a factor of 18.5 over the open-circuit baseline. The electrochemical CO2-ODHP system also exhibits good stability during a 120-hour durability test. In-situ characterization and theoretical calculations elucidate the electrically driven online replenishment mechanism of Co3O4 lattice oxygen by O2- derived from cathode CO2 reduction. This dynamic cycle maintains moderate anode surface oxygen activity, resulting in highly efficient and selective OPDH without significant over-oxidation or cracking of propane.
title_zh: 通过电驱动的连续化学循环实现增强且稳定的丙烷选择性氧化脱氢
abstract_zh: 氧化丙烷脱氢（OPDH）已成为直接生产丙烯的一种有前途的方法。然而，它仍然面临着丙烷过度氧化成COx的巨大挑战，损害了产品的选择性。在此，我们报告了一种电力驱动的连续化学循环工艺，可通过固体氧化物电解池（SOEC）内的电化学 CO2-OPDH 系统高效生产丙烯。在 10 mA cm−2 的最佳电流密度下，采用 Co3O4 改性的 La0.6Sr0.4Co0.2Fe0.8O3-δ (LSCF) 阳极的系统可实现 92.6% 的烯烃选择性和 14.2% 的单程丙烷转化率。这种电流驱动的配置使丙烯产量 (5.11 mmol gtotal−1 h−1) 比开路基线提高了 18.5 倍。电化学CO2-ODHP系统在120小时耐久性测试中也表现出良好的稳定性。原位表征和理论计算阐明了阴极 CO2 还原产生的 O2- 电驱动在线补充 Co3O4 晶格氧的机制。这种动态循环保持了适度的阳极表面氧活性，从而产生高效和选择性的 OPDH，而没有明显的丙烷过度氧化或裂解。

title: Reversible control of post-Golgi transport by brefeldin A reveals recycling endosome maturation during glycosylphosphatidylinositol-anchored protein transport
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Post-Golgi transport plays a crucial role in establishing and maintaining cellular function; however, its mechanism of action remains unclear. Therefore, a system to manipulate post-Golgi transport is highly desirable. In this study, we developed a brefeldin A (BFA)-controlled system to block and restart post-Golgi transport freely, allowing the detailed observation of cargo exit from Golgi stacks using live-cell imaging, electron microscopy, and biochemical analysis. Using this system, glycosylphosphatidylinositol-anchored protein (GPI-AP) transport from the trans-Golgi network (TGN) to Golgi-associated recycling endosomes (GA-REs) was visualized. GA-REs expanded during GPI-AP uptake, indicating maturation from the TGN into REs, which later detached as free REs released from the Golgi stacks. Tubular and pearled GPI-AP-positive structures formed on the TGN, which were likely GA-REs transporting GPI-AP from the TGN. REs matured in AP-1-deficient cells, whereas GA-RE detachment was impaired, and long-tubules were observed, thereby delaying GPI-AP delivery to the plasma membrane.
title_zh: 布雷菲德菌素 A 对高尔基体后转运的可逆控制揭示了糖基磷脂酰肌醇锚定蛋白转运过程中内体成熟的再循环
abstract_zh: 高尔基体后运输在建立和维持细胞功能中起着至关重要的作用；然而，其作用机制仍不清楚。因此，非常需要一种操纵高尔基体后运输的系统。在这项研究中，我们开发了一种布雷菲德菌素 A (BFA) 控制的系统，可以自由地阻断和重新启动高尔基体后运输，从而可以使用活细胞成像、电子显微镜和生化分析详细观察货物从高尔基体堆中退出的情况。使用该系统，可以可视化糖基磷脂酰肌醇锚定蛋白（GPI-AP）从反式高尔基体网络（TGN）到高尔基体相关回收内体（GA-RE）的转运。 GA-RE 在 GPI-AP 摄取过程中扩张，表明从 TGN 成熟为 RE，随后作为游离 RE 从高尔基体堆栈释放。 TGN 上形成管状和珠状 GPI-AP 阳性结构，这可能是从 TGN 转运 GPI-AP 的 GA-RE。 RE 在 AP-1 缺陷的细胞中成熟，而 GA-RE 脱离受损，并且观察到长管，从而延迟了 GPI-AP 向质膜的递送。

title: Cancer immunotherapy targeting murine myeloid cells requires endosomal pattern recognition
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Immunotherapy is now an established and efficient treatment option for many cancer patients. However, a proportion of patients still experience poor outcomes due to treatment resistance. Thus, a clear understanding of key mechanisms of resistance is needed for the development of new treatments. Here, we employ mouse models to explore an immunotherapeutic approach based on anti-MARCO (αMARCO) and anti-PD-L1 (αPD-L1) antibody-mediated targeting of tumor-associated macrophages (TAM). We demonstrate that effective immunotherapy relies on a functional endosomal pattern recognition machinery. We determine that endosomal Toll-like receptors (TLR), specifically TLR9, precondition macrophages to respond to αMARCO treatment by regulating the transcription of inflammasome components. Absence of TLRs renders TAMs unresponsive to treatment while retaining an immunosuppressive phenotype. Thus, we uncover the intracellular TLR signalling as a feature of immunotherapy efficacy, required to sensitise TAMs to treatment, and indicate that TLR targeting could be exploited to improve immunotherapeutic outcomes.
title_zh: 针对小鼠骨髓细胞的癌症免疫疗法需要内体模式识别
abstract_zh: 对于许多癌症患者来说，免疫疗法现已成为一种既定且有效的治疗选择。然而，由于治疗耐药，部分患者的治疗效果仍然不佳。因此，开发新疗法需要清楚地了解耐药性的关键机制。在这里，我们采用小鼠模型来探索基于抗 MARCO (αMARCO) 和抗 PD-L1 (αPD-L1) 抗体介导的肿瘤相关巨噬细胞 (TAM) 靶向的免疫治疗方法。我们证明有效的免疫疗法依赖于功能性内体模式识别机制。我们确定内体 Toll 样受体 (TLR)，特别是 TLR9，通过调节炎性体成分的转录，使巨噬细胞对 αMARCO 治疗做出反应。 TLR 的缺失导致 TAM 对治疗无反应，同时保留免疫抑制表型。因此，我们发现细胞内 TLR 信号传导是免疫治疗功效的一个特征，需要 TAM 对治疗敏感，并表明 TLR 靶向可用于改善免疫治疗结果。

title: Nematic and chiral superconductivity emerging within the loop-current phase in kagome metals
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The kagome metals AV3Sb5 (A = Cs, Rb, K) host multiple symmetry-breaking phases, including charge-density-wave and loop-current orders, and exhibit highly exotic superconductivity with pronounced nematicity and chirality. Remarkably, even dilute impurities transform this exotic superconducting state into an isotropic s-wave state. These observations pose a challenge to existing theoretical scenarios. We show that loop-current order induces nematic chiral d-wave superconductivity in kagome metals. The loop-current-induced orbital magnetization (OM) stabilizes one chiral superconducting channels. This OM-chirality coupling mechanism is generic and applies to pairing driven by either attractive or repulsive interactions. Furthermore, coexisting loop-current and bond orders give rise to pronounced nematic chiral superconductivity even for an almost C6-symmetric Fermi surface. For attractive pairing, dilute impurities suppress the chiral state and restore a conventional s-wave phase, as observed experimentally. The theory further predicts a robust 2 × 2 pair-density modulation. This study provides key insights into time-reversal-symmetry-breaking exotic superconductivity in kagome metals.
title_zh: Kagome 金属的环路电流相中出现向列相和手性超导
abstract_zh: Kagome 金属 AV3Sb5（A = Cs、Rb、K）具有多个对称破缺相，包括电荷密度波和环电流级，并表现出具有明显向列性和手性的高度奇异的超导性。值得注意的是，即使是稀释的杂质也会将这种奇异的超导态转变为各向同性的横波态。这些观察结果对现有的理论情景提出了挑战。我们证明环路电流顺序会在 kagome 金属中诱导向列手性 d 波超导性。环路电流引起的轨道磁化（OM）稳定了一个手性超导通道。这种 OM 手性耦合机制是通用的，适用于由吸引或排斥相互作用驱动的配对。此外，共存的环路电流和键序会产生明显的向列手性超导性，即使对于几乎 C6 对称的费米表面也是如此。为了实现有吸引力的配对，稀释的杂质会抑制手性状态并恢复传统的 s 波相，正如实验所观察到的。该理论进一步预测了稳健的 2 × 2 对密度调制。这项研究为戈薇金属中打破时间反转对称性的奇异超导性提供了重要见解。

title: Stiff interlocked nanoclay aerogels for synergistic detection and removal of organic contaminants in water
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Removing organic pollutants from water is essential for preserving global ecosystems. However, challenges related to recyclability and material stability hinder effective treatment. Inspired by the mortise-and-tenon structure, a series of Ca2+-enhanced amino acid-intercalated layered double hydroxide aerogels featuring an interlocked framework was developed via the structural memory effect and supercritical drying. The aerogels achieve a balance of compressive strength (40.1 − 45.5 MPa) and toughness, overcoming the brittleness of conventional inorganic aerogels. They can remove a broad range of water pollutants, including tetracycline, doxycycline hydrochloride, methyl orange, Congo red and malachite green, with efficiencies of 95.4 − 99.9%, while retaining 87% of their initial efficiency after five regeneration cycles and enabling pollutant detection with a detection limit of 710 nM. The aerogels also exhibit robust stability under liquid nitrogen and butane flame exposure, along with flame resistance (limiting oxygen index ≈ 100%). These findings highlight their potential for water purification under harsh environmental conditions.
title_zh: 刚性联锁纳米粘土气凝胶用于协同检测和去除水中的有机污染物
abstract_zh: 去除水中的有机污染物对于保护全球生态系统至关重要。然而，与可回收性和材料稳定性相关的挑战阻碍了有效的处理。受榫卯结构的启发，通过结构记忆效应和超临界干燥，开发了一系列具有互锁框架的Ca2+增强氨基酸插层层状双氢氧化物气凝胶。该气凝胶实现了抗压强度（40.1-45.5 MPa）和韧性的平衡，克服了传统无机气凝胶的脆性。它们可以去除多种水污染物，包括四环素、盐酸多西环素、甲基橙、刚果红和孔雀石绿，效率为 95.4 – 99.9%，同时在五个再生周期后保留其初始效率的 87%，并实现污染物检测，检测限为 710 nM。气凝胶在液氮和丁烷火焰暴露下还表现出强大的稳定性，以及阻燃性（极限氧指数约 100%）。这些发现凸显了它们在恶劣环境条件下净化水的潜力。

title: Direct electrosynthesis of acetamide from CO2 and nitrate via an atomically engineered dual-site catalyst
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The electrocatalytic synthesis of amides from abundant small molecules offers a sustainable route for green chemical production, yet faces fundamental challenges due to kinetic competition between C–C and C–N bond formation. Here we show an atomically engineered dual-site catalyst featuring nickel single atoms adjacent to copper nanoclusters (Ni-SA/Cu-NCs) on a nitrogen-doped carbon matrix for efficient CO2 and NO3− co-reduction to acetamide. This architecture enables complementary functions, with Ni sites selectively converting CO2 to CO and neighboring Cu nanoclusters promoting C–C coupling to form the *CCO intermediate while concurrently reducing NO3− to form the *NH2 intermediate. The resulting synergy facilitates rapid intermediate transfer and C–N coupling, delivering an acetamide yield rate of 257.3 mmol h−1 gcat.−1 at an industrial current density of 215.7 mA cm−2, with stable operation over 160 h. In situ spectroscopic studies and theoretical calculations suggest that strong Ni–Cu electronic coupling promotes reactant adsorption and reduces the activation barriers for critical steps, including *CO dimerization and *CCO–*NH2 coupling. This work provides an atomic-level design strategy for multi-site catalysts to steer complex electrocatalytic reactions toward value-added products.
title_zh: 通过原子设计的双中心催化剂从二氧化碳和硝酸盐直接电合成乙酰胺
abstract_zh: 利用丰富的小分子电催化合成酰胺为绿色化学生产提供了一条可持续的途径，但由于 C-C 和 C-N 键形成之间的动力学竞争而面临根本性挑战。在这里，我们展示了一种原子设计的双位点催化剂，其特征是在氮掺杂碳基质上与铜纳米簇 (Ni-SA/Cu-NC) 相邻的镍单原子，可有效地将 CO2 和 NO3− 共还原为乙酰胺。这种结构实现了互补功能，Ni 位点选择性地将 CO2 转化为 CO，而相邻的 Cu 纳米团簇促进 C-C 耦合形成*CCO 中间体，同时还原 NO3− 形成*NH2 中间体。由此产生的协同作用促进了快速中间体转移和 C-N 偶联，在 215.7 mA cm−2 的工业电流密度下提供 257.3 mmol h−1 gcat.−1 的乙酰胺产率，并稳定运行超过 160 小时。原位光谱研究和理论计算表明，强的 Ni-Cu 电子耦合可促进反应物吸附并减少关键步骤的活化势垒，包括 *CO 二聚和 *CCO-*NH2 耦合。这项工作为多位点催化剂提供了原子级设计策略，以引导复杂的电催化反应产生增值产品。

title: Phase-independent wireless data aggregation via optical in-sensor computing
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The data-intensive nature of the Internet of Things (IoT) significantly challenges conventional communication systems. While over-the-air computation integrates communication and computation to reduce data aggregation burdens, it requires strict synchronization of transmitted signals, increasing system overhead. Here, we report an optical in-sensor wireless data aggregation paradigm that exploits photocarrier trapping in defect-dominated persistent photoconductance sensors to reduce dependence on synchronization constraints. Within a single communication window, the system reliably aggregates incoherent optical signals with relative timing offsets exceeding the signal duration by up to 120%, while achieving computation errors below 1.5% normalized mean squared error. This process achieves unbiased integration with pulsed low-frequency readout, indicating its potential for ultra-low power operation. A distributed temperature prediction model based on this paradigm shows faster convergence and competitive accuracy with a simplified architecture, demonstrating effectiveness in distributed edge sensing scenarios. This work provides a promising hardware implementation for low-power data aggregation in large-scale IoT edge networks.
title_zh: 通过光学传感器内计算实现相位无关的无线数据聚合
abstract_zh: 物联网 (IoT) 的数据密集型特性对传统通信系统提出了重大挑战。虽然空中计算将通信和计算集成在一起以减少数据聚合负担，但它需要传输信号的严格同步，从而增加了系统开销。在这里，我们报告了一种光学传感器内无线数据聚合范例，该范例利用缺陷主导的持久光电导传感器中的光载流子捕获来减少对同步约束的依赖。在单个通信窗口内，系统可靠地聚合相对定时偏移超过信号持续时间高达 120% 的不相干光信号，同时实现低于 1.5% 归一化均方误差的计算误差。该过程实现了与脉冲低频读出的无偏集成，表明其超低功耗操作的潜力。基于此范式的分布式温度预测模型通过简化的架构表现出更快的收敛性和有竞争力的准确性，证明了分布式边缘传感场景的有效性。这项工作为大规模物联网边缘网络中的低功耗数据聚合提供了一种有前景的硬件实现。

title: Enantioselective synthesis of ring-constrained biaryls via a twist-expand-seal strategy
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Ring-constrained biaryls possess unique axial chirality, but methods to synthesize them with adjustable ring sizes remain limited. We report a “twist-expand-seal” strategy for preparing a unique class of cyclic biaryls that exhibit axial chirality and conformational constraint, with tunable ring sizes. This method enables the streamlined synthesis of 9- to 14-membered cyclic biaryls, achieving yields of up to 99% and enantioselectivities of up to 99% ee (49 examples). This approach begins with enantioselective ring-opening of a “flat” biaryl-embedded lactam mediated by a bifunctional chiral N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC) catalyst (twist). Chain expansion is achieved via introducing alcohols of varying chain lengths (expand), and the final ring closure is accomplished through diverse C–C or C–N bond-forming reactions (seal). Scalable synthesis and subsequent ring transformations are readily achieved. This work expands the chemical space of axial chirality by enabling the versatile synthesis of diverse biaryl-bridged ring scaffolds.
title_zh: 通过扭转-扩展-密封策略对映选择性合成环约束联芳基化合物
abstract_zh: 环约束联芳基化合物具有独特的轴向手性，但合成具有可调节环尺寸的方法仍然有限。我们报告了一种“扭曲-扩展-密封”策略，用于制备一类独特的环状联芳基化合物，该环状联芳基化合物表现出轴向手性和构象约束，且环尺寸可调。该方法能够简化 9 至 14 元环状联芳基的合成，收率高达 99%，对映选择性高达 99% ee（49 个实例）。该方法首先通过双功能手性 N-杂环卡宾 (NHC) 催化剂（扭曲）介导“扁平”联芳基嵌入内酰胺的对映选择性开环。扩链是通过引入不同链长的醇来实现的（扩展），最终的闭环是通过不同的 C-C 或 C-N 键形成反应（密封）来完成的。可轻松实现可扩展的合成和随后的环转化。这项工作通过实现多种联芳基桥环支架的多功能合成，扩大了轴向手性的化学空间。

title: A General Strategy for an Efficient Biointerface via Enhanced Capacitive Coupling
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Reliable sensing of bioelectronic signals is highly dependent on the efficient charge transfer at the biointerface, and the incorporation of biointerface materials would enhance it. Nevertheless, systematic investigations on interfacial electrochemical dynamics remain lacking, and universal fabrication criteria for such biointerface materials are yet to be established. Here, we propose a general strategy to promote interfacial charge transfer via enhancing capacitive coupling. We demonstrate this strategy by the design and synthesis of a hydrogel biointerface (HBI) that provides robust adhesion (adhesive strength up to ∼40 kPa) as well as conformal (Young's modulus < 50 kPa) and compliant (stretchability over 400%) contact with diverse bioelectronics and tissues. Importantly, the HBI enhances the capacitance three-fold and reduces the interfacial impedance over a wide frequency range. Bioelectrodes with HBI are capable of intraoperative neuromonitoring of motor evoked potentials (MEPs) during spinal surgery (lasting approximately 3 h). These results verify the effectiveness of our proposed strategy, which leverages enhanced capacitive coupling to establish an efficient and stable charge transfer interface for practical applications.
title_zh: 通过增强电容耦合实现高效生物界面的通用策略
abstract_zh: 生物电子信号的可靠传感高度依赖于生物界面上的有效电荷转移，生物界面材料的结合将增强它。然而，仍然缺乏对界面电化学动力学的系统研究，并且尚未建立此类生物界面材料的通用制造标准。在这里，我们提出了一种通过增强电容耦合来促进界面电荷转移的总体策略。我们通过设计和合成水凝胶生物界面（HBI）来证明这一策略，该生物界面可提供强大的粘附力（粘附强度高达〜40 kPa）以及与不同生物电子学和组织的保形（杨氏模量< 50 kPa）和顺应性（拉伸性超过400％）接触。重要的是，HBI 将电容提高了三倍，并在很宽的频率范围内降低了界面阻抗。具有 HBI 的生物电极能够在脊柱手术期间（持续约 3 小时）对运动诱发电位 (MEP) 进行术中神经监测。这些结果验证了我们提出的策略的有效性，该策略利用增强的电容耦合为实际应用建立高效稳定的电荷传输接口。

title: Oncogenic Kras targeting with MRTX1133 or Daraxonrasib specifically synergize with anti-CTLA4 to promote anti-tumor immunity in pancreatic cancer
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Lack of sustained response to oncogenic Kras (Kras*) inhibition in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) underscores the need to identify effective combination therapies. Here, we demonstrate that Kras* targeting using MRTX1133 or Daraxonrasib recruits diverse T-cell infiltrates, including regulatory (Tregs), effector and exhausted T cells into the PDAC microenvironment. Kras* inhibition induces T-cell influx and offers a therapeutic window to specifically prime PDAC to anti-CTLA4 immune checkpoint blockade efficacy, in contrast to anti-PD1, anti-Tim3, anti-Lag3, anti-Vista, and anti-4-1BB agonist combination therapy. Mechanistically, anti-CTLA4 combination therapy transcriptionally reprograms effector Tregs to a naive phenotype, reverses CD8+ T-cell exhaustion, and promotes recruitment of functional tertiary lymphoid structures to mediate anti-tumor immunity. Single-cell ATAC sequencing reveals that Treg reprogramming by anti-CTLA4 is epigenetically regulated by downregulation of AP-1 family transcription factors in the IL-35 promoter region. This study reveals an actionable vulnerability in the adaptive immune response in Kras* targeted PDAC with immediate clinical implications.
title_zh: MRTX1133 或 Daraxonrasib 靶向的致癌 Kras 与抗 CTLA4 特异性协同作用，促进胰腺癌的抗肿瘤免疫
abstract_zh: 胰腺导管腺癌 (PDAC) 中对致癌 Kras (Kras*) 抑制缺乏持续反应，这凸显了寻找有效联合疗法的必要性。在这里，我们证明使用 MRTX1133 或 Daraxonrasib 的 Kras* 靶向可招募不同的 T 细胞浸润，包括调节性 (Treg)、效应和耗尽的 T 细胞进入 PDAC 微环境。与抗 PD1、抗 Tim3、抗 Lag3、抗 Vista 和抗 4-1BB 激动剂联合疗法相比，Kras* 抑制可诱导 T 细胞流入，并提供一个治疗窗口，以特异性启动 PDAC 发挥抗 CTLA4 免疫检查点阻断功效。从机制上讲，抗 CTLA4 联合疗法通过转录将效应 Treg 重新编程为初始表型，逆转 CD8+ T 细胞耗竭，并促进功能性三级淋巴结构的募集以介导抗肿瘤免疫。单细胞 ATAC 测序表明，抗 CTLA4 引起的 Treg 重编程是通过 IL-35 启动子区域 AP-1 家族转录因子的下调来进行表观遗传调节的。这项研究揭示了 Kras* 靶向 PDAC 中适应性免疫反应的可操作漏洞，具有直接的临床意义。

title: Multimodal Operando Characterization of Layering and Wear at Concentrated Polymer Brush Interfaces
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: A multimodal operando measurement system integrating a surface force apparatus, optical interferometry, and Raman spectroscopy was developed to investigate layering, molecular-state evolution, and wear at concentrated polymer brush (CPB) interfaces in a good solvent. The system enables simultaneous monitoring of mechanical responses, interfacial gap, and molecular behavior at solid-liquid interfaces under both compression and sliding. Operando measurements during compression revealed that CPBs exhibit a hierarchical layered structure consisting of dilute, semidilute, middle, and concentrated layers, each characterized by distinct transition gaps in mechanical responses (Fz, ϕz) and molecular concentration profiles. Raman spectroscopic analysis further showed that the CPB-derived full width at half-maximum, ΓCPB, exhibits a nonmonotonic dependence on applied load. This behavior is interpreted as a Raman-detectable signature of compression-induced molecular-state changes in the confined CPB layer, reflecting changes in molecular mobility and local structural heterogeneity. The transition from a highly swollen, relatively mobile state to a deswollen, more constrained molecular state was closely associated with the onset and acceleration of CPB wear. Layer-resolved wear analysis, achieved by alternately performing contact and friction tests, demonstrated that CPB wear proceeds via a random chain-scission mode, in which the dilute layer is continuously regenerated while the concentrated layer gradually diminishes. Multimodal operando measurements during sliding revealed that this random scission is associated with localized tensile-strain-like deformation imposed on polymer chains under frictional shear in the glassy-like confined state. These results establish a unified operando framework linking hierarchical layering, compression-induced molecular-state changes, and wear mechanisms at polymer brush interfaces and provide design principles for achieving durable, superlow-friction polymer brush lubrication systems.
title_zh: 浓聚合物刷界面分层和磨损的多模态操作表征
abstract_zh: 开发了一种集成表面力装置、光学干涉测量和拉曼光谱的多模式操作测量系统，用于研究良溶剂中浓聚合物刷 (CPB) 界面的分层、分子态演化和磨损。该系统能够同时监测压缩和滑动下固液界面的机械响应、界面间隙和分子行为。压缩过程中的操作测量表明，CPB 表现出由稀释层、半稀释层、中间层和浓缩层组成的分层分层结构，每个层的特征在于机械响应（Fz、Φz）和分子浓度分布中存在明显的过渡间隙。拉曼光谱分析进一步表明，CPB 导出的半峰全宽 ΓCPB 对所施加的载荷表现出非单调依赖性。这种行为被解释为受限 CPB 层中压缩引起的分子状态变化的拉曼可检测特征，反映了分子迁移率和局部结构异质性的变化。从高度膨胀、相对活动的状态到消肿、更受约束的分子状态的转变与CPB磨损的发生和加速密切相关。通过交替执行接触和摩擦测试实现的层分辨磨损分析表明，CPB 磨损通过随机断链模式进行，其中稀层不断再生，而浓层逐渐减少。滑动过程中的多模态操作测量表明，

title: Large language model driven multicenter prediction and explainable risk attribution of acute kidney injury
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Acute kidney injury (AKI) represents a life-threatening condition among hospitalized patients, where early prediction enables prevention. Despite advances in existing models, clinical implementation remains hindered by excessive false positive rates (70%-94%) and lack of actionable clinical insights. We conduct a multi-center retrospective cohort study and develop a two-model large language model framework: AKI-PM (Prediction Model) for predicting AKI occurrence within 24 hours and AKI-RAM (Risk Attribution Model) for providing explainable risk attribution. Using a cohort of 140,637 hospital admissions across four geographically diverse Chinese hospitals, we demonstrate that AKI-PM achieves high predictive performance in internal validation (area under curve 0.95, positive predictive value 0.68) and maintains robust generalizability across external sites after few-shot (area under curve 0.92-0.96, positive predictive value 0.69-0.74). Crucially, AKI-RAM provides structured, clinically actionable risk explanations by distinguishing modifiable from non-modifiable factors and offering tailored recommendations. In a clinical evaluation of 200 cases from four independent hospitals by six nephrologists, AKI-RAM receives high scores across eight dimensions (Likert scale: 4.18-4.88) with moderate to good inter-rater reliability (intraclass correlation coefficients: 0.680-0.803). This integrated framework addresses critical limitations in AI-driven clinical prediction by combining accuracy with interpretability, offering a scalable solution for early AKI prevention in diverse healthcare settings.
title_zh: 大语言模型驱动的急性肾损伤多中心预测和可解释的风险归因
abstract_zh: 急性肾损伤 (AKI) 是住院患者中一种危及生命的疾病，早期预测可以预防。尽管现有模型取得了进步，但临床实施仍然受到假阳性率过高（70%-94%）和缺乏可操作的临床见解的阻碍。我们进行了多中心回顾性队列研究，开发了两个模型的大语言模型框架：用于预测24小时内AKI发生的AKI-PM（预测模型）和用于提供可解释的风险归因的AKI-RAM（风险归因模型）。通过使用中国四家不同地区医院的 140,637 例住院患者队列，我们​​证明 AKI-PM 在内部验证中实现了较高的预测性能（曲线下面积 0.95，阳性预测值 0.68），并且在几次测试后在外部站点保持了强大的普遍性（曲线下面积 0.92-0.96，阳性预测值 0.69-0.74）。至关重要的是，AKI-RAM 通过区分可修改因素和不可修改因素并提供量身定制的建议，提供结构化的、临床上可操作的风险解释。在六位肾病专家对来自四家独立医院的 200 例病例进行的临床评估中，AKI-RAM 在八个维度上获得了高分（李克特量表：4.18-4.88），评估者间信度为中等至良好（组内相关系数：0.680-0.803）。该集成框架通过将准确性与可解释性相结合，解决了人工智能驱动的临床预测的关键局限性，为不同健康状况的早期 AKI 预防提供了可扩展的解决方案

title: Single-fraction or multi-fraction stereotactic ablative body radiotherapy followed by atezolizumab in advanced triple-negative breast cancer: a randomized phase II trial
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Pre-clinical evidence suggests that stereotactic ablative body radiotherapy (SABR) can enhance systemic anti-tumor responses when combined with immune checkpoint inhibition, although optimal fractionation remains uncertain. Here we conducted a phase II multi-center randomized trial (AZTEC trial; ClinicalTrials.gov identifier NCT03464942) to investigate the efficacy and safety of single-fraction (SF: 20 Gy; n = 27) or multi-fraction (MF: 24 Gy in three fractions; n = 27) SABR followed by anti-PD-L1 atezolizumab in 54 women with advanced triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) as first or second-line treatment. The primary endpoint was progression free survival (PFS). Secondary endpoints included best overall response rate, clinical benefit rate, overall survival and safety. We observed that both treatment arms had similar efficacy: median PFS was 2.5 months (90% CI: 1.7-4.5) for SF and 3.1 months (90% CI: 1.8-3.9) for MF. The null hypothesis (PFS of 2 months) was not rejected in either arm. Clinical benefit (RECIST complete response/partial response or stable disease for ≥24 weeks) was achieved in 5 (20%) SF and 6 (25%) MF patients, all with oligometastatic disease, independent of PD-L1 expression. Adverse events were similar between arms. Prespecified exploratory analysis of peripheral blood found higher CD8 TPEX cells before and during treatment correlated with improved response duration. Combining SABR with atezolizumab is safe, however further testing is required to determine efficacy for advanced TNBC patients with oligometastatic disease.
title_zh: 单次或多次立体定向消融性全身放疗，随后使用 atezolizumab 治疗晚期三阴性乳腺癌：一项随机 II 期试验
abstract_zh: 临床前证据表明，立体定向消融体放射治疗（SABR）与免疫检查点抑制相结合可以增强全身抗肿瘤反应，尽管最佳分割仍不确定。在这里，我们进行了一项 II 期多中心随机试验（AZTEC 试验；ClinicalTrials.gov 标识符 NCT03464942），以调查单次分次（SF：20 Gy；n = 27）或多次分次（MF：三次分次 24 Gy；n = 27）SABR 后抗 PD-L1 atezolizumab 对 54 名晚期三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）女性的疗效和安全性。二线治疗。主要终点是无进展生存期（PFS）。次要终点包括最佳总体缓解率、临床获益率、总体生存率和安全性。我们观察到两个治疗组具有相似的疗效：SF 的中位 PFS 为 2.5 个月（90% CI：1.7-4.5），MF 为 3.1 个月（90% CI：1.8-3.9）。任一组均未拒绝原假设（2 个月的 PFS）。 5 名 SF 患者 (20%) 和 6 名 MF 患者 (25%) 实现了临床获益（RECIST 完全缓解/部分缓解或疾病稳定≥24 周），所有患者均患有寡转移疾病，与 PD-L1 表达无关。各组之间的不良事件相似。对外周血的预先设定的探索性分析发现，治疗前和治疗期间较高的 CD8 TPEX 细胞与改善的反应持续时间相关。 SABR 与 atezolizumab 联合使用是安全的，但需要进一步测试以确定对患有寡转移性疾病的晚期 TNBC 患者的疗效。

title: SLC26A11 is an atypical solute carrier with dual transport-channel function mediating lysosomal sulfate transport
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Membrane transporters and channels are generally assumed to be based on distinct structural and functional principles. SLC26A11, a solute carrier with high expression levels in the brain, has been proposed to function as either an anion transporter or a channel. Here, we resolve this apparent discrepancy by demonstrating that SLC26A11 is a dual-function protein capable of operating as both a sulfate transporter and a chloride channel. By resolving its structure and combining biochemical studies and molecular dynamics simulations, we show that SLC26A11 exhibits all the hallmarks of a secondary transporter. The mechanistic basis for its selective ion transport identifies the protein as the elusive lysosomal sulfate exporter. Additionally, we demonstrate that SLC26A11 exhibits an uncoupled, channel-like chloride conductance gated by proton:sulfate symport. Our finding that the chloride-conducting state arises from the transport cycle may contribute to the development of therapeutic strategies for treating brain edema, and the identification of its role in lysosome sulfate efflux may provide new approaches to study and treat lysosomal storage diseases.
title_zh: SLC26A11是一种非典型溶质载体，具有介导溶酶体硫酸盐转运的双通道功能
abstract_zh: 通常认为膜转运体和通道基于不同的结构和功能原理。 SLC26A11 是一种在大脑中高表达的溶质载体，被认为可以充当阴离子转运蛋白或通道。在这里，我们通过证明 SLC26A11 是一种双功能蛋白，能够同时充当硫酸盐转运蛋白和氯离子通道，解决了这种明显的差异。通过解析其结构并结合生化研究和分子动力学模拟，我们表明 SLC26A11 表现出二级转运蛋白的所有特征。其选择性离子转运的机制基础将该蛋白鉴定为难以捉摸的溶酶体硫酸盐输出蛋白。此外，我们证明 SLC26A11 表现出由质子：硫酸盐同向传递门控的非耦合通道状氯离子电导。我们发现氯离子传导状态由运输循环产生，可能有助于开发治疗脑水肿的治疗策略，并且鉴定其在溶酶体硫酸盐流出中的作用可能为研究和治疗溶酶体贮积病提供新方法。

title: Design, structure-based optimization and antiviral evaluation of potent inhibitors for the macrodomain Mac1 of SARS-CoV-2
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Enzymatically active macrodomains of (+)ss-RNA viruses mediate immune evasion by countering ADP-ribosylation and are therefore promising druggable targets. Here we report testing of ADP / ADP-ribose analogues for their ability to inhibit Mac1 of SARS-CoV-2, measurement of the affinity of active compounds and characterization of their binding mode by cocrystallization, uncovering critical molecular determinants of protein-ligand interaction. Key findings of the resulting structure-activity relationship (SAR) include that inhibitory potency is improved by either replacing the distal ribose of ADP-ribose by a small alkyl group or the adenine N7 by carbon. Based on insights from the SAR, we show β-methyl-GS-441524-diphosphate as nanomolar inhibitor that exhibits >1000-fold selectivity over human MacroD1 and MacroD2. Addition of C11-acyloxybenzyl (AB)-masking groups yields a membrane permeable, lipophilic prodrug that inhibits SARS-CoV-2 in cell culture (EC50 0.06 µM) while exhibiting low cytotoxicity (CC50 > 50 µM). Replacement of the terminal methyl phosphate with an ethyl phosphonate increases stability of the prodrug with little effect on toxicity and antiviral potency (EC50 = 0.03 µM), making it a membrane-permeable nucleotide-based prodrug against viral macrodomains.
title_zh: SARS-CoV-2 宏域 Mac1 有效抑制剂的设计、基于结构的优化和抗病毒评估
abstract_zh: (+)ss-RNA 病毒的酶活性大结构域通过对抗 ADP-核糖基化介导免疫逃避，因此是有前途的药物靶标。在这里，我们报告了 ADP / ADP-核糖类似物抑制 SARS-CoV-2 Mac1 的能力的测试，测量活性化合物的亲和力并通过共结晶表征其结合模式，揭示蛋白质-配体相互作用的关键分子决定因素。由此产生的构效关系 (SAR) 的主要发现包括，通过用小烷基取代 ADP-核糖的远端核糖或用碳取代腺嘌呤 N7 可以提高抑制效力。根据 SAR 的见解，我们证明 β-甲基-GS-441524-二磷酸作为纳摩尔抑制剂，其选择性比人类 MacroD1 和 MacroD2 高 1000 倍。添加 C11-酰氧基苄基 (AB) 掩蔽基团可产生一种膜渗透性亲脂性前药，可抑制细胞培养物中的 SARS-CoV-2 (EC50 0.06 µM)，同时表现出低细胞毒性 (CC50 > 50 µM)。用磷酸乙酯替换末端甲基磷酸酯可提高前药的稳定性，对毒性和抗病毒效力影响很小（EC50 = 0.03 µM），使其成为针对病毒大结构域的膜可渗透的基于核苷酸的前药。

title: Deferoxamine-B–Functionalized Silicon Nanowire Field-Effect Transistor Interfaces for Ultralow-Concentration Fe 3+ Detection in Semiconductor Process Chemicals
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Maintaining ultralow metal-ion purity in process chemicals is crucial in semiconductor fabrication, where trace Fe3+ contamination can lead to dielectric breakdown, yield loss, and unintended doping. Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) provides excellent qualitative and quantitative sensitivity; however, it requires specialized infrastructure, is time-consuming and costly, and is not well suited for rapid on-site screening. Herein, we present a deferoxamine-B (DFO-B)-functionalized silicon nanowire field-effect transistor (SiNW-FET) engineered for the ultrasensitive, label-free detection of Fe3+ in semiconductor-grade chemicals. Mixed PEG self-assembled monolayers were modified with DFO-B via aldehyde-amine coupling to form a stable, high-affinity chelation interface. In aqueous Fe3+ standards, the DFO-B-functionalized SiNW-FET exhibited a linear response from 10-15 to 10-11 M, with a practical LOD of 10-15 M and an above-Nernst sensitivity of -24 mV dec-1. In chemically complex matrices, the practical analytical boundary shifted upward, with reliable Fe3+ responses observed at approximately 10-12 M in a 23-element mixed-ion matrix and ∼10-13 M in a highly diluted IPA-derived multi-element matrix. Mechanistic analysis rationalizes the above-Nernst response using an equivalent-circuit framework involving chelation-associated chemical capacitance, coordination-induced interfacial polarization, and protonation-state effects. The sensor showed preferential Fe3+ response under tested interferent conditions and remained operational in mixed-ion and highly diluted IPA-containing matrices, while also revealing matrix-dependent shifts in analytical performance. This work introduces a rapid on-site Fe3+ screening approach based on a portable and potentially in situ-compatible SiNW-FET platform that can complement ICP-MS for contamination assessment, while establishing a modular sensing interface that can be extended to other transition metals through ligand substitution. With integration into microfluidic sample handling and CMOS-compatible readout, this technology offers a portable, point-of-use Fe3+ screening through a discrete incubation-rinse-electrical readout workflow.
title_zh: Deferoxamine-B——功能化硅纳米线场效应晶体管接口，用于半导体工艺化学品中超低浓度 Fe 3+ 检测
abstract_zh: 在工艺化学品中保持超低金属离子纯度对于半导体制造至关重要，其中微量 Fe3+ 污染可能导致介电击穿、良率损失和意外掺杂。电感耦合等离子体质谱 (ICP-MS) 提供出色的定性和定量灵敏度；然而，它需要专门的基础设施，耗时且成本高昂，并且不太适合快速现场筛查。在此，我们提出了一种去铁胺-B (DFO-B) 功能化硅纳米线场效应晶体管 (SiNW-FET)，专为超灵敏、无标记检测半导体级化学品中的 Fe3+ 而设计。通过醛-胺偶联，用 DFO-B 修饰混合 PEG 自组装单层，形成稳定、高亲和力的螯合界面。在水性 Fe3+ 标准品中，DFO-B 功能化 SiNW-FET 表现出 10-15 至 10-11 M 的线性响应，实际 LOD 为 10-15 M，高于能斯特的灵敏度为 -24 mV dec-1。在化学复杂的基质中，实际的分析边界向上移动，在 23 元素混合离子基质中大约 10-12 M 处观察到可靠的 Fe3+ 响应，在高度稀释的 IPA 衍生多元素基质中大约 10-13 M 处观察到可靠的 Fe3+ 响应。机理分析使用涉及螯合相关化学电容、配位诱导界面极化和质子化态效应的等效电路框架合理化上述能斯特响应。该传感器在测试的干扰条件下表现出优先的 Fe3+ 响应，并在混合离子和高度稀释的情况下保持运行

title: 3,4-Dihydropyrimidin-2-(1H)-one-Based Cationic Surfactants: Synthesis, Self-Assembly, and Antimicrobial Activity
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: 3,4-Dihydropyrimidin-2-(1H)-one (DHPM)-based cationic surfactants with alkyl tail lengths of 8, 12, and 16 carbons were synthesized from 4-dimethylaminobenzaldehyde by the green multicomponent reaction and characterized. The self-assembling behavior of the synthesized surfactants was determined by conductometry, tensiometry, and fluorimetry. Surface parameters, including the effectiveness of surface tension reduction, maximum surface excess concentration, minimum area per molecule, surfactant efficiency, and thermodynamic adsorption and micellization parameters, were also calculated. The surface activity of DHPM-based surfactants is found to increase with hydrophobicity, as evidenced by a reduction in critical micelle concentration from 0.067 to 0.040 mM at 298.15 K. Emulsion stability and interfacial tension were significantly influenced by the hydrophobic chain length of the surfactants. The Z-average, polydispersity index, and zeta potential of the micellar solutions were measured by dynamic light scattering, revealing an inverse correlation between the Z-average and surfactant hydrophobicity, which was further supported by transmission electron microscopy. The aggregation number was determined by fluorescence quenching. The antimicrobial efficacy of DHPM-based surfactants was evaluated against six pathogenic microbes, including both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria and fungi, to assess differences in antimicrobial potency. Molecular docking revealed interactions between surfactant head groups and bacterial cell wall components.
title_zh: 3,4-二氢嘧啶-2-(1H)-one基阳离子表面活性剂：合成、自组装和抗菌活性
abstract_zh: 以4-二甲氨基苯甲醛为原料，通过绿色多组分反应合成了烷基尾长为8、12和16个碳的3,4-二氢嘧啶-2-(1H)-酮(DHPM)基阳离子表面活性剂并进行了表征。通过电导测定法、张力测定法和荧光测定法测定合成表面活性剂的自组装行为。还计算了表面参数，包括表面张力降低的有效性、最大表面过量浓度、每个分子的最小面积、表面活性剂效率以及热力学吸附和胶束化参数。研究发现，DHPM 基表面活性剂的表面活性随着疏水性而增加，298.15 K 时临界胶束浓度从 0.067 降低至 0.040 mM 证明了这一点。乳液稳定性和界面张力受到表面活性剂疏水链长度的显着影响。通过动态光散射测量了胶束溶液的 Z 均值、多分散指数和 zeta 电位，揭示了 Z 均值和表面活性剂疏水性之间的负相关性，这一点得到了透射电子显微镜的进一步支持。通过荧光猝灭测定聚集数。基于 DHPM 的表面活性剂对六种病原微生物（包括革兰氏阳性和革兰氏阴性细菌和真菌）的抗菌功效进行了评估，以评估抗菌效力的差异。分子对接揭示了表面活性剂头基与细菌细胞壁成分之间的相互作用。

title: High-Performance Sky-Blue Hyperfluorescence Organic Light-Emitting Diodes Enabled by Efficient Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence Sensitizers with Suppressed Efficiency Roll-Off
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: High-performance blue emitters remain a major bottleneck for next-generation organic light-emitting diode (OLED) displays. Although multiresonance thermally activated delayed fluorescence (MR-TADF) materials offer exceptional color purity, their practical use is often limited by slow reverse intersystem crossing (RISC), leading to triplet accumulation, efficiency roll-off, and device degradation. Here, we report three aggregation-induced emission TADF emitters (23PalCBP, 23PclCBP, and 32PclCBP) constructed from indolocarbazole donors and a benzophenone acceptor. Among them, 32PclCBP exhibits a very small singlet-triplet energy gap (ΔEST = 0.01 eV) and a high photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) of 0.88 in doped films, affording OLEDs with a maximum external quantum efficiency (EQEmax) of 29.3%. When employed as sensitizers in hyperfluorescence (HF) devices with the MR-TADF emitter BNMIPAPh, both sensitized systems deliver narrowband blue emission with a full width at half-maximum of 27 nm. The 32PclCBP-sensitized device achieves a balanced performance with an EQEmax of 28.6% and a substantially reduced efficiency roll-off of 22.7% at 1000 cd m-2, together with modestly improved operational stability relative to the nonsensitized MR-TADF reference. In comparison, the 23PalCBP-sensitized device affords a higher EQEmax of 30.9%, albeit with a larger efficiency roll-off of 31.1%. These results demonstrate that the synergistic optimization of multiple photophysical parameters, including high PLQY, low nonradiative decay, small ΔEST, and moderate RISC kinetics, enables efficient, high-color-purity, and low-roll-off sky-blue HF OLEDs.
title_zh: 由高效热激活延迟荧光敏化剂实现的高性能天蓝色超荧光有机发光二极管，可抑制效率滚降
abstract_zh: 高性能蓝色发射器仍然是下一代有机发光二极管（OLED）显示器的主要瓶颈。尽管多共振热激活延迟荧光 (MR-TADF) 材料可提供出色的色纯度，但其实际使用通常受到缓慢的反向系间窜越 (RISC) 的限制，导致三线态累积、效率滚降和器件退化。在这里，我们报告了由吲哚并咔唑供体和二苯甲酮受体构建的三种聚集诱导发射TADF发射器（23PalCBP、23PclCBP和32PclCBP）。其中，32PclCBP在掺杂薄膜中表现出非常小的单线态-三线态能隙（ΔEST = 0.01 eV）和0.88的高光致发光量子产率（PLQY），使OLED的最大外量子效率（EQEmax）达到29.3％。当用作具有 MR-TADF 发射器 BNMIPAPh 的超荧光 (HF) 装置中的敏化剂时，两种敏化系统均可发出半峰全宽为 27 nm 的窄带蓝色发射。 32PclCBP 敏化器件实现了均衡的性能，EQEmax 为 28.6%，在 1000 cd m-2 时效率滚降大幅降低 22.7%，并且相对于非敏化 MR-TADF 参考器件，运行稳定性略有提高。相比之下，23PalCBP 敏化器件的 EQEmax 更高，为 30.9%，但效率滚降更大，为 31.1%。这些结果表明，多个光物理参数的协同优化，包括高 PLQY、低非辐射衰减、小 ΔEST 和适度的 RISC 动力学，可以实现高效

title: Immunological maladaptation preceding spontaneous preterm birth in human pregnancies
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The majority of spontaneous preterm births (sPTB) occurs without identifiable clinical indications or apparent risk factors. A dysregulated maternal immune adaptation at delivery has been associated with sPTB. Yet, a precise understanding of maternal immune dynamics preceding sPTB remains lacking. Here we show, in a nested case-control study within a low-risk, population-based pregnancy cohort, that an abnormal immune adaptation in mothers’ blood precedes sPTB by weeks to months and discriminates sPTB cases from term controls (AUROC: 0.7). Prominent features include enhanced immune cell responses to an adrenergic stimulus during the first and second trimesters, followed by increased production of pro-inflammatory cytokines in the third trimester in sPTB vs. term pregnancies. Transcriptome analysis of second trimester single-cell CD4+ T cells reveals a Th17-skewed, neuroactive-protein responsive phenotype in sPTB pregnancies. Our study provides a multi-omics resource and a conceptual framework for early identification of individuals at increased risk for sPTB with broad translational implications for advancing targeted preventive measures.
title_zh: 人类妊娠自发性早产前的免疫适应不良
