abstract_zh: 大多数自发性早产 (sPTB) 的发生没有可识别的临床指征或明显的危险因素。分娩时母体免疫适应失调与 sPTB 有关。然而，对于 sPTB 之前的母体免疫动态仍然缺乏准确的了解。在这里，我们在低风险、基于人群的妊娠队列中进行的一项巢式病例对照研究中表明，母亲血液中的异常免疫适应先于 sPTB 数周至数月，并将 sPTB 病例与足月对照病例区分开来（AUROC：0.7）。显着特征包括在妊娠早期和中期，免疫细胞对肾上腺素刺激的反应增强，随后与足月妊娠相比，sPTB 在妊娠晚期促炎细胞因子的产生增加。对妊娠中期单细胞 CD4+ T 细胞的转录组分析揭示了 sPTB 妊娠中 Th17 偏向的神经活性蛋白反应表型。我们的研究提供了多组学资源和概念框架，用于早期识别 sPTB 风险增加的个体，对推进有针对性的预防措施具有广泛的转化意义。

title: Obesity-driven microbial GABA depletion promotes metabolic rewiring and colorectal cancer progression
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Obesity is a major risk factor for colorectal cancer (CRC), yet the mechanisms linking obesity-associated gut dysbiosis to tumor progression remain unclear. Here, we show that a high-fat diet and fecal microbiota from patients with obesity-associated CRC deplete the GABA-producing commensal Bacteroides ovatus, resulting in reduced luminal GABA and accelerated tumorigenesis. Microbial GABA activates epithelial GABAB receptor signaling and induces TPI1 through the PI3K–HIF1α pathway. Increased TPI1-derived glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate inhibits PPP1CA, maintains YAP phosphorylation, restricts nuclear YAP activity, and suppresses pentose phosphate pathway flux, thereby limiting tumor growth. Consistently, obesity-associated CRC exhibits reduced fecal GABA, decreased TPI1 expression, and metabolic rewiring. A GABA-deficient B. ovatus mutant fails to restore GABA or suppress tumors despite normal colonization, whereas oral GABA supplementation or recolonization with wild-type B. ovatus markedly reduces tumor burden. These findings identify a microbiota–neurotransmitter–metabolism axis linking obesity to CRC and suggest microbiota-based GABA restoration as a potential preventive strategy.
title_zh: 肥胖导致的微生物 GABA 耗竭促进代谢重组和结直肠癌进展
abstract_zh: 肥胖是结直肠癌（CRC）的主要危险因素，但肥胖相关肠道菌群失调与肿瘤进展之间的联系机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们发现肥胖相关结直肠癌患者的高脂肪饮食和粪便微生物群会消耗产生 GABA 的共生卵形拟杆菌，导致管腔 GABA 减少并加速肿瘤发生。微生物 GABA 激活上皮 GABAB 受体信号传导并通过 PI3K-HIF1α 途径诱导 TPI1。 TPI1 衍生的 3-磷酸甘油醛的增加会抑制 PPP1CA，维持 YAP 磷酸化，限制核 YAP 活性，并抑制磷酸戊糖途径通量，从而限制肿瘤生长。与肥胖相关的 CRC 一致表现出粪便 GABA 减少、TPI1 表达减少和代谢重新布线。尽管正常定植，GABA 缺陷型 B. ovatus 突变体仍无法恢复 GABA 或抑制肿瘤，而口服 GABA 补充或用野生型 B. ovatus 重新定植可显着减轻肿瘤负荷。这些发现确定了将肥胖与结直肠癌联系起来的微生物群-神经递质-代谢轴，并表明基于微生物群的 GABA 恢复是一种潜在的预防策略。

title: The Dendritic Cell-based Vaccine PROTEXI leverages Antiviral CD4 T cell Memory to boost anti-tumor immune responses in mice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The efficacy of dendritic cell (DC) cancer vaccines is linked to poor immunogenicity of tumor-associated antigens and failure to elicit robust MHC class II-restricted CD4⁺ T-cell responses. Here, we introduce PROTEXI, a DC vaccine platform that optimizes tumor immunity by co-presenting tumor-specific CD8⁺ T-cell epitopes alongside CD4⁺ T helper epitopes from the SARS-CoV-2 Spike protein, leveraging widespread anti-viral immunity. In preclinical mouse models of melanoma and breast cancer, PROTEXI significantly reduces tumor growth and improves survival by promoting robust T cell infiltration into immune-cold tumors, increasing cytotoxic T cell responses via epitope spreading, and activating genes linked to optimal DC, NK cell, and T cell function. Furthermore, PROTEXI elicits superior responses when combined with other immunotherapy agents in models of therapy-resistant tumors. Finally, in a humanized mouse model of melanoma, PROTEXI vaccine co-presenting CD4⁺ T-specific Spike epitopes with CD8⁺ T cell-restricted PRAME and MAGE-A3 antigens, significantly reduces tumor burden. Thus, these data underscore the potential of harnessing pre-existing viral-specific immunity to enhance the efficacy of DC vaccines in immune-cold tumors.
title_zh: 基于树突状细胞的疫苗 PROTEXI 利用抗病毒 CD4 T 细胞记忆来增强小鼠的抗肿瘤免疫反应
abstract_zh: 树突状细胞 (DC) 癌症疫苗的功效与肿瘤相关抗原的免疫原性差以及无法引发强大的 MHC II 类限制性 CD4⁺ T 细胞反应有关。在这里，我们介绍了 PROTEXI，这是一种 DC 疫苗平台，通过将肿瘤特异性 CD8⁺ T 细胞表位与来自 SARS-CoV-2 刺突蛋白的 CD4⁺ T 辅助表位共同呈现来优化肿瘤免疫，从而利用广泛的抗病毒免疫。在黑色素瘤和乳腺癌的临床前小鼠模型中，PROTEXI 通过促进 T 细胞对免疫冷肿瘤的强大浸润、通过表位扩散增加细胞毒性 T 细胞反应以及激活与最佳 DC、NK 细胞和 T 细胞功能相关的基因，显着减少肿瘤生长并提高生存率。此外，当与其他免疫治疗药物联合治疗耐药性肿瘤模型时，PROTEXI 会产生优异的反应。最后，在黑色素瘤人源化小鼠模型中，同时呈现 CD4⁺ T 特异性 Spike 表位与 CD8⁺ T 细胞限制性 PRAME 和 MAGE-A3 抗原的 PROTEXI 疫苗可显着减轻肿瘤负荷。因此，这些数据强调了利用预先存在的病毒特异性免疫来增强 DC 疫苗在免疫冷肿瘤中的功效的潜力。

title: The influence of structural variants from 2445 pigs on gene expression and complex traits
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The impact of structural variants on gene regulation and complex traits in pigs remains poorly understood. Here, we present a resource comprising 60 long-read sequencing and 2445 high-quality short-read sequencing samples from 120 pig breeds/populations worldwide. These samples include 293 high-depth short-read sequencing samples and three long-read samples generated in this study. Integrating two graph-based genotyping approaches, we construct a structural variant map encompassing 158,288 deletions, 137,493 insertions, 660 inversions, and 10,063 duplications. We perform eQTL mapping in liver, skeletal muscle, backfat, and intramuscular fat tissues from an F6 hybrid pig family, finding that 49.01% of expressed genes are significantly associated with cis-region structural variants. We further explore the contribution of structural variants to domestication and population differentiation. We find a 53 bp insertion on chromosome 11 that significantly down-regulates GPC6 expression in liver tissue, potentially contributing to adaptive selection in northern Chinese pig populations. Additionally, FST analyses between miniature and commercial pig breeds identify candidate structural variant loci associated with body size. We next integrate results from structural variant-eQTL and GWAS to find a 50 bp deletion at chr4:75,613,295 that significantly reduces PLAG1 expression in skeletal muscle tissue and is associated with body weight at 240 days of age.
title_zh: 2445头猪的结构变异对基因表达和复杂性状的影响
abstract_zh: 结构变异对猪基因调控和复杂性状的影响仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们提供了一个资源，其中包含来自全球 120 个猪品种/群体的 60 个长读长测序样本和 2445 个高质量短读长测序样本。这些样本包括本研究中生成的 293 个深度短读长测序样本和 3 个长读长样本。整合两种基于图的基因分型方法，我们构建了一个结构变异图，其中包含 158,288 个缺失、137,493 个插入、660 个倒位和 10,063 个重复。我们对 F6 杂交猪家族的肝脏、骨骼肌、背膘和肌内脂肪组织进行了 eQTL 定位，发现 49.01% 的表达基因与顺式区域结构变异显着相关。我们进一步探讨结构变异对驯化和种群分化的贡献。我们发现 11 号染色体上的 53 bp 插入显着下调肝组织中的 GPC6 表达，可能有助于中国北方猪群的适应性选择。此外，小型猪品种和商品猪品种之间的 FST 分析确定了与体型相关的候选结构变异位点。接下来，我们整合结构变异 eQTL 和 GWAS 的结果，发现 chr4:75,613,295 处有一个 50 bp 的缺失，该缺失显着降低了骨骼肌组织中 PLAG1 的表达，并且与 240 日龄时的体重相关。

title: Measurement-Informed Deep Learning for Real-Time Monitoring of Hydrodynamic Drying Dynamics in Inkjet-Printed Display Pixels via Low-Resolution Imaging
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Real-time monitoring of drying dynamics is critical for ensuring high-quality thin-film fabrication in inkjet printing. Here, we present a classification framework for the drying stages of ZnO nanoparticle inks on 200-PPI patterned substrates using low-resolution optical images. By correlating 3D surface profiles with visual textures, we show how the volatility mismatch and viscosity contrast of binary solvents govern hydrodynamic evolution, generating distinct image textures for each stage. Based on this, we define three drying stages for binary mixed-solvent inks and two for single-solvent systems. A lightweight convolutional neural network, trained on grayscale images downsampled to 115 × 40 pixels, achieved a 99.4% test accuracy. Explainable AI analyses, utilizing input gradient saliency and gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM), revealed that the model autonomously learns to focus on the central pixel region-where physical variations are most pronounced-without any spatial supervision. Furthermore, the lightweight model requires only 0.64 ms per image for inference on a GPU, representing a 16.4-fold reduction in theoretical computational cost compared to the baseline. This image-only approach enables reliable, computationally efficient process monitoring, establishing a practical pathway for real-time quality control specifically for the tested ZnO nanoparticle inkjet printing configuration.
title_zh: 基于测量的深度学习通过低分辨率成像实时监控喷墨印刷显示像素中的水动力干燥动力学
abstract_zh: 干燥动态的实时监控对于确保喷墨打印中的高质量薄膜制造至关重要。在这里，我们使用低分辨率光学图像提出了 200-PPI 图案基材上 ZnO 纳米颗粒油墨干燥阶段的分类框架。通过将 3D 表面轮廓与视觉纹理相关联，我们展示了二元溶剂的挥发性失配和粘度对比度如何控制流体动力学演化，从而为每个阶段生成不同的图像纹理。基于此，我们为二元混合溶剂油墨定义了三个干燥阶段，为单溶剂系统定义了两个干燥阶段。轻量级卷积神经网络在降采样至 115 × 40 像素的灰度图像上进行训练，实现了 99.4% 的测试准确率。可解释的人工智能分析，利用输入梯度显着性和梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM），揭示了该模型自主学习关注中心像素区域（物理变化最明显），而无需任何空间监督。此外，轻量级模型在 GPU 上推理每张图像仅需 0.64 毫秒，与基线相比，理论计算成本减少了 16.4 倍。这种仅图像方法能够实现可靠、计算高效的过程监控，为专门针对测试的 ZnO 纳米颗粒喷墨打印配置的实时质量控制建立实用途径。

title: Structural and functional studies of inward rectifier Kir7.1 and its regulation by the Melanocortin-4 receptor
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Hereditary defects in the function of the inwardly rectifying potassium channel Kir7.1 in the retinal pigment epithelium are associated with the ocular diseases retinitis pigmentosa, Leber congenital amaurosis, and snowflake vitreoretinal degeneration. However, this ion channel is widely expressed, and studies also suggest that Kir7.1 may be directly regulated in a G protein-independent manner by a GPCR, the melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R), in specific hypothalamic neurons involved in energy homeostasis. To advance our understanding of this unusual direct regulation of an ion channel by a GPCR, it is important to characterize the structure and function of Kir7.1, and the Kir7.1-MC4R complex. Utilizing cryo-electron microscopy, we present structures of human Kir7.1 and demonstrate the structural basis for the blockade of the channel by a small molecule ML418. We show that channel blockade of Kir7.1 depolarizes MC4R neurons in a slice preparation of the paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (PVH), and activates PVH neurons in vivo, inhibiting food intake and inducing weight loss. We further show that Kir7.1 and MC4R are in close association on the plasma membrane and characterize a fusion construct of MC4R and Kir7.1 that provides an experimental tool for study of Kir7.1 regulation by the MC4R.
title_zh: 内向整流器 Kir7.1 的结构和功能研究及其 Melanocortin-4 受体的调节
abstract_zh: 视网膜色素上皮内向整流钾通道 Kir7.1 功能的遗传性缺陷与眼部疾病色素性视网膜炎、莱伯先天性黑蒙和雪花玻璃体视网膜变性有关。然而，这种离子通道广泛表达，研究还表明，在参与能量稳态的特定下丘脑神经元中，Kir7.1 可能以不依赖 G 蛋白的方式直接受到 GPCR、黑皮质素 4 受体 (MC4R) 的调节。为了加深我们对 GPCR 对离子通道这种不寻常的直接调节的理解，表征 Kir7.1 和 Kir7.1-MC4R 复合物的结构和功能非常重要。利用冷冻电子显微镜，我们展示了人类 Kir7.1 的结构，并证明了小分子 ML418 阻断通道的结构基础。我们发现，Kir7.1 通道阻断可使下丘脑室旁核 (PVH) 切片中的 MC4R 神经元去极化，并在体内激活 PVH 神经元，抑制食物摄入并诱导体重减轻。我们进一步表明，Kir7.1 和 MC4R 在质膜上密切相关，并表征了 MC4R 和 Kir7.1 的融合构建体，为研究 MC4R 对 Kir7.1 的调节提供了实验工具。

title: The sodium channel SCN2A regulates cortical excitatory and inhibitory neurogenesis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Voltage-gated sodium channels regulate neuronal excitability and synaptic transmission in the postnatal and adult brain. The gene SCN2A, encoding the sodium channel Nav1.2, regulates synaptic development and variants in SCN2A are associated with autism spectrum disorders (ASD) and a broad spectrum of epilepsy phenotypes, including early-onset developmental and epileptic encephalopathies. The expression pattern of SCN2A begins during prenatal cortical development, prior to the onset of synaptic transmission, but it is unknown whether SCN2A regulates early cortical development through mechanisms independent of synaptic transmission. Here we reveal that isogenic and ASD patient-derived human forebrain organoids modelling a loss of SCN2A function display impaired excitatory and inhibitory neurogenesis, leading to a developmental imbalance. Unexpectedly, we find precocious generation of cortical inhibitory neurons is driven by elevated Sonic hedgehog signaling and is reversible through pharmacological inhibition. Functionally, these developmental phenotypes arise due to Nav1.2-dependent sodium channel dysfunction and reduced action potential generation, leading to abnormal neuronal network activity. Our results identify a mechanism for cortical excitatory and inhibitory neurogenesis involving SCN2A, and reveal that early neurogenesis deficits precede postnatal neural circuit dysfunction in SCN2A-associated disorders.
title_zh: 钠通道 SCN2A 调节皮质兴奋性和抑制性神经发生
abstract_zh: 电压门控钠通道调节出生后和成人大脑中的神经元兴奋性和突触传递。编码钠通道 Nav1.2 的基因 SCN2A 调节突触发育，SCN2A 的变异与自闭症谱系障碍 (ASD) 和广泛的癫痫表型相关，包括早发性发育性脑病和癫痫性脑病。 SCN2A 的表达模式始于产前皮质发育期间，即突触传递开始之前，但尚不清楚 SCN2A 是否通过独立于突触传递的机制调节早期皮质发育。在这里，我们揭示了同基因和 ASD 患者来源的人类前脑类器官模拟 SCN2A 功能丧失，显示出兴奋性和抑制性神经发生受损，导致发育失衡。出乎意料的是，我们发现皮层抑制性神经元的早熟生成是由 Sonic hidehog 信号传导升高驱动的，并且通过药物抑制是可逆的。从功能上讲，这些发育表型是由于 Nav1.2 依赖性钠通道功能障碍和动作电位生成减少而产生的，导致神经元网络活动异常。我们的结果确定了涉及 SCN2A 的皮质兴奋性和抑制性神经发生的机制，并揭示了 SCN2A 相关疾病中早期神经发生缺陷先于出生后神经回路功能障碍。

title: Autonomous bioisosteric replacement for multi-property optimization in drug design
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Optimizing molecular properties while preserving biological activity is a central challenge in drug design. Bioisosteric replacement, which substitutes a molecular fragment with a chemically or biologically analogous moiety, offers a powerful strategy for fine-tuning properties without disrupting target binding. However, existing in silico approaches often rely on expert-defined modification sites or struggle to modulate multiple molecular properties simultaneously. Here, we present DeepBioisostere, a deep generative model that performs end-to-end bioisosteric replacement by autonomously selecting and substituting molecular fragments to satisfy multiple target properties. The model captures complex relationships across the molecular graph, enabling the optimization of sophisticated properties such as drug-likeness and synthetic accessibility. By learning from experimental bioassay data, DeepBioisostere proposes replacements that maintain biological activities, even generating potential bioisosteres beyond the training data. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the model in computational hit-to-lead optimization scenarios, highlighting its potential to accelerate rational molecular design without relying on expert heuristics or pre-established substitution rules.
title_zh: 用于药物设计中多特性优化的自主生物等排替代
abstract_zh: 优化分子特性同时保留生物活性是药物设计的核心挑战。生物电子等排替换，用化学或生物学类似部分替换分子片段，提供了一种强大的策略，可以在不破坏靶标结合的情况下微调特性。然而，现有的计算机方法通常依赖于专家定义的修饰位点或难以同时调节多个分子特性。在这里，我们提出了 DeepBioisostere，一种深度生成模型，通过自主选择和替换分子片段以满足多个目标特性来执行端到端生物电子等排替换。该模型捕获分子图上的复杂关系，从而能够优化复杂的特性，例如药物相似性和合成可及性。通过从实验生物测定数据中学习，DeepBioisostere 提出了维持生物活性的替代品，甚至产生了超出训练数据的潜在生物电子等排体。我们展示了该模型在计算命中到先导优化场景中的有效性，强调了其在不依赖专家启发法或预先建立的替换规则的情况下加速合理分子设计的潜力。

title: Microfluidic pulse oscillator enabled by a shapeshifting liquid metal capacitor
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Analogous to an inductor-capacitor oscillator circuit, the microfluidic oscillator employs a logic fluidic network to generate cascading and oscillatory flows, bringing the advanced function of flow control to the lab-on-chip platform. Despite notable advancements, current microfluidic oscillators are predominantly limited to fixed multilayer structures and cannot satisfy the requirements for flexibility, reconfigurability, and rapid-response characteristics. Herein, we developed a monolayer microfluidic pulse oscillator with a shapeshifting liquid metal (LM) capacitor for real-time control of oscillatory flows. This fluidic pulse oscillator exploits the interplay between LM capacitive energy storage and the surrounding Marangoni flow to convert stored interfacial energy into fluidic pulsed motion and realize fluid oscillation in alternating current fields. A theoretical model considering fluidic resistance, capacitance, and inductance is developed to decipher the fluid flow behavior. Furthermore, we employed both particle tracing to track transient flow field changes and numerical simulations to characterize the flow dynamics. The results reveal that vortex flow emerges in the near-field region adjacent to the LM capacitor, while pulse oscillatory flow prevails in the far-field region distant from the LM capacitor and occupies most of the microchannel. Axial oscillation and lateral lift-induced cumulative displacement are employed by oscillatory flow for frequency-tunable particle focusing and separation. By leveraging the principles of electronic circuits, the microfluidic pulse oscillator enables the advanced control of liquids and suspended particles for more lab-on-a-chip applications.
title_zh: 由变形液态金属电容器实现的微流体脉冲振荡器
abstract_zh: 与电感电容振荡器电路类似，微流控振荡器采用逻辑流体网络来生成级联和振荡流，将流控制的高级功能引入片上实验室平台。尽管取得了显着的进步，但当前的微流控振荡器主要局限于固定的多层结构，不能满足灵活性、可重构性和快速响应特性的要求。在此，我们开发了一种单层微流体脉冲振荡器，带有可变形液态金属（LM）电容器，用于实时控制振荡流。该流体脉冲振荡器利用LM电容储能与周围Marangoni流之间的相互作用，将存储的界面能量转换为流体脉冲运动，并在交流场中实现流体振荡。开发了考虑流体阻力、电容和电感的理论模型来解释流体流动行为。此外，我们采用粒子追踪来跟踪瞬态流场变化，并采用数值模拟来表征流动动力学。结果表明，靠近LM电容器的近场区域出现涡流，而远离LM电容器的远场区域则出现脉冲振荡流，并占据了大部分微通道。振荡流利用轴向振荡和横向升力引起的累积位移来实现频率可调的颗粒聚焦和分离。利用电子电路原理，微流体

title: Flexible organic thin-film transistors for all-in-one retinomorphic acceleration enabled by inorganic-organic heterogeneous dielectrics
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Organic neuromorphic visual sensors promise to overcome the limitations of conventional image sensors, but a trade-off between efficient charge transport and charge trapping has hindered the development of interfaces that combine efficient optical sensing and non-volatile memory. Here we show that an inorganic-organic heterogeneous dielectric (Al2O3/PAA), fabricated by low-temperature plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition and spin-coating, enables flexible thin-film transistors with integrated sensing-memory-processing functions. The devices exhibit an average mobility of 22.65 cm2 V−1 s−1, a 30 µs optical response to 450 nm light, charge retention exceeding ten years, write/erase endurance over 104 cycles, an electrical response down to 130 ns, and stable multilevel programming at 10 µs. They emulate synaptic plasticity and achieve recognition accuracies of 99.49% (gesture), 94.78% (digit) and 92.56% (face). When integrated with a convolutional neural network accelerator, the system demonstrates real-time, interference-resistant face detection, highlighting the potential of this dielectric architecture for flexible neuromorphic vision systems.
title_zh: 柔性有机薄膜晶体管，通过无机-有机异质电介质实现一体化视网膜加速
abstract_zh: 有机神经形态视觉传感器有望克服传统图像传感器的局限性，但高效电荷传输和电荷捕获之间的权衡阻碍了结合高效光学传感和非易失性存储器的接口的开发。在这里，我们展示了通过低温等离子体增强原子层沉积和旋涂制造的无机-有机异质电介质（Al2O3/PAA），可以实现具有集成传感存储处理功能的柔性薄膜晶体管。该器件的平均迁移率为 22.65 cm2 V−1 s−1，对 450 nm 光的光学响应为 30 µs，电荷保持时间超过 10 年，写入/擦除耐久性超过 104 个周期，电响应低至 130 ns，并可在 10 µs 内实现稳定的多级编程。它们模拟突触可塑性，识别准确率达到 99.49%（手势）、94.78%（数字）和 92.56%（面部）。当与卷积神经网络加速器集成时，该系统展示了实时、抗干扰的人脸检测，凸显了这种介电架构在灵活的神经形态视觉系统中的潜力。

title: Observing strong optical nonreciprocity from magnetically doped Dirac semimetals
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Many contemporary photonic and optoelectronic technologies rely on strong electromagnetic nonreciprocity at infrared frequencies. However, achieving a strong nonreciprocal effect in the infrared remains extremely challenging due to the lack of materials with inherently large nonreciprocal optical responses. Magnetic Weyl semimetals offer a promising solution, but the choice of materials has thus far been limited. Here, we present a different approach of accessing strong nonreciprocity by doping the Dirac semimetal Cadmium Arsenide (Cd3As2) with a magnetic dopant, Manganese (Mn). We attribute the strong optical nonreciprocity to the collective magnetic ordering of the Mn dopant that creates magnetic Weyl cones by lifting the degeneracy of Dirac cones via time-reversal symmetry breaking. The enabled nonreciprocity exhibits strong tunability through doping concentration and external magnetic fields, providing a new material platform and design rational for accessing strong electromagnetic nonreciprocity.
title_zh: 观察磁掺杂狄拉克半金属的强光学非互易性
abstract_zh: 许多当代光子和光电技术依赖于红外频率下的强电磁非互易性。然而，由于缺乏具有固有的大非互易光学响应的​​材料，在红外区域实现强非互易效应仍然极具挑战性。磁性韦尔半金属提供了一种有前景的解决方案，但迄今为止材料的选择受到限制。在这里，我们提出了一种通过用磁性掺杂剂锰 (Mn) 掺杂狄拉克半金属砷化镉 (Cd3As2) 来获得强非互易性的不同方法。我们将强光学非互易性归因于 Mn 掺杂剂的集体磁排序，通过时间反转对称性破缺提升狄拉克锥的简并性，从而产生磁外尔锥。所实现的非互易性通过掺杂浓度和外部磁场表现出很强的可调性，为获得强电磁非互易性提供了新的材料平台和设计原理。

title: Harnessing chloride to drive catalyst reconstruction for durable and efficient seawater electrolysis
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Direct seawater electrolysis offers an attractive route for sustainable hydrogen production, yet its practical implementation remains constrained by the corrosive nature of chlorion (Cl−). Here, we reveal that trace amounts of Cl−, rather than being detrimental, can play a constructive role in directing the structural evolution of transition-metal catalysts. Guided by this insight, NiS2 nanoparticles with controlled loading amounts on NiFe-MOF nanosheets (denoted as NiFe-MOF-S) are designed to enable fine regulation of Cl− proximity to the active metal sites. This design promotes the in situ reconstruction of catalyst into a dense γ-NiFeOOH phase with short Ni–Fe bond lengths, which triggers a mechanistic shift from the lattice-oxygen-mediated pathway to oxide path mechanism. NiFe-MOF-S achieves high oxygen evolution performance in alkaline seawater (1 M KOH + seawater), requiring a much lower overpotential of 213 mV to reach 500 mA cm−2 in alkaline seawater than that in alkaline water (1 M KOH) (268 mV). Furthermore, the electrocatalyst demonstrates high durability with a degradation rate of only 1.4 μV h−1 for over 7000 hours at 1.0 A cm−2 in alkaline seawater. A kilowatt-level alkaline seawater electrolyzer equipped with NiFe-MOF-S/NF operates reliably for over 1500 hours at industrially relevant conditions.
title_zh: 利用氯化物驱动催化剂重构，实现持久高效的海水电解
abstract_zh: 直接海水电解为可持续制氢提供了一条有吸引力的途径，但其实际实施仍然受到氯离子（Cl−）的腐蚀性的限制。在这里，我们发现痕量的 Cl− 非但不会有害，反而可以在指导过渡金属催化剂的结构演化方面发挥建设性作用。在这一见解的指导下，在 NiFe-MOF 纳米片（表示为 NiFe-MOF-S）上控制负载量的 NiS2 纳米粒子被设计为能够精细调节 Cl− 与活性金属位点的接近度。这种设计促进了催化剂原位重构为具有短Ni-Fe键长的致密γ-NiFeOOH相，从而引发了从晶格氧介导途径到氧化物途径机制的机械转变。 NiFe-MOF-S在碱性海水（1 M KOH +海水）中实现了高析氧性能，在碱性海水中达到500 mA cm−2所需的过电势比在碱性水（1 M KOH）（268 mV）低得多，为213 mV。此外，该电催化剂表现出高耐久性，在碱性海水中1.0 A cm-2下7000小时以上的降解率仅为1.4 μV h-1。配备 NiFe-MOF-S/NF 的千瓦级碱性海水电解槽在工业相关条件下可靠运行超过 1500 小时。

title: Hyperbolic adaptive spatial-aware multivariate time series anomaly detection
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Existing multivariate anomaly detection methods suffer from practical industrial limitations stemming from distribution assumptions, volatile data and scarce reliable anomaly labels. This study proposes a hyperbolic adaptive spatial-aware multivariate anomaly detection method aimed at enhancing accuracy, robustness and interpretability in real-world applications. It first constructs an adaptive hyperbolic pre-training framework to embed coupled spatio-temporal hierarchical time-series features and mine latent cross-variable correlations. Next, an adaptive graph structure discovery and dynamic sparsification module removes rigid topology restraints, autonomously learning inherent data structures and pinpointing the spatio-temporal locations of anomalies for causal interpretation. A multi-level attention module and small-sample dynamic threshold algorithm further improve model stability when handling complex signals. Built upon self-adaptive graph topology, the unified end-to-end framework integrates anomaly recognition, diagnosis and interpretation with dedicated discrimination and correction mechanisms. Experiments demonstrate 10%–30% performance improvements across diverse detection benchmarks, verifying the method’s effectiveness and advancing interpretable AI research for anomaly detection.
title_zh: 双曲自适应空间感知多元时间序列异常检测
abstract_zh: 现有的多变量异常检测方法受到分布假设、不稳定数据和稀缺可靠异常标签的实际工业限制。本研究提出了一种双曲自适应空间感知多元异常检测方法，旨在提高实际应用中的准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性。它首先构建一个自适应双曲预训练框架来嵌入耦合的时空分层时间序列特征并挖掘潜在的跨变量相关性。接下来，自适应图结构发现和动态稀疏模块消除了严格的拓扑限制，自主学习固有的数据结构并查明异常的时空位置以进行因果解释。多级注意力模块和小样本动态阈值算法进一步提高了处理复杂信号时的模型稳定性。统一的端到端框架建立在自适应图拓扑的基础上，将异常识别、诊断和解释与专用的辨别和纠正机制集成在一起。实验表明，在不同的检测基准中性能提高了 10%–30%，验证了该方法的有效性并推进了异常检测的可解释 AI 研究。

title: An agent-guided peptide hydrogel bio-stabilizer clamps pericellular viscoelastic drift
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Living tissues continually remodel the extracellular matrix, causing pericellular mechanics to drift over time. Chronic glycation amplifies this drift, destabilizing mechanoregulatory cues and compromising regenerative outcomes. Here we introduce Micro-Mechanical Homeostasis Reset, a material-based strategy that targets cell-to-pericellular viscoelastic homeostasis rather than static bulk stiffness. Using an agent-guided, rule-based enumeration-and-scoring workflow, we design ViscoClamp, an extracellular matrix-interpenetrating peptide hydrogel with affinity for calcium ions and advanced glycation end products. We show that ViscoClamp buffers chronic glycation loading and constrains glycation-driven viscoelastic drift, while remaining permissive to mesenchymal stem cell-mediated matrix remodeling and mineralization. We quantify stabilization using a dispersion-transfer ratio that measures how variable glycation inputs are compressed into stable micromechanical outputs. We demonstrate that in glycation-rich hyperglycemic craniofacial defects, ViscoClamp stabilizes cell-scale micromechanics, restores osteogenic activation, and improves bone repair and mineralization in rats, rabbits, beagle dogs, and rhesus macaques.
title_zh: 药剂引导的肽水凝胶生物稳定剂夹紧细胞周粘弹性漂移
abstract_zh: 活组织不断重塑细胞外基质，导致细胞周力学随着时间的推移而漂移。慢性糖化会放大这种漂移，破坏机械调节信号的稳定性并损害再生结果。在这里，我们介绍微机械稳态重置，这是一种基于材料的策略，其目标是细胞到细胞周的粘弹性稳态，而不是静态体积刚度。使用代理引导、基于规则的计数和评分工作流程，我们设计了 ViscoClamp，一种对钙离子和高级糖基化终产物具有亲和力的细胞外基质互穿肽水凝胶。我们发现 ViscoClamp 可以缓冲慢性糖基化负荷并限制糖基化驱动的粘弹性漂移，同时仍然允许间充质干细胞介导的基质重塑和矿化。我们使用分散转移比来量化稳定性，该分散转移比测量可变的糖基化输入如何被压缩为稳定的微机械输出。我们证明，在富含糖基化的高血糖颅面缺损中，ViscoClamp 可以稳定细胞尺度的微观力学，恢复成骨激活，并改善大鼠、兔子、比格犬和恒河猴的骨修复和矿化。

title: The VgrG2 effector of Acinetobacter baumannii mediates immune evasion by repressing Csu pilus assembly and triggering phagocyte methuosis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Acinetobacter baumannii is a formidable nosocomial pathogen whose multidrug resistance and immune evasion capabilities present a major therapeutic challenge. This study identifies the type VI secretion system (T6SS) effector VgrG2 as a critical virulence regulator in A. baumannii. VgrG2 employs a two-pronged strategy to undermine host innate immunity. First, it transcriptionally represses the major adhesin Csu pilus, reducing bacterial recognition, phagocytic uptake, and neutrophils recruitment. Second, VgrG2 directly targets and hyperactivates the small GTPase Rac1 within phagocytes. This leads to actin cytoskeletal disarray, which drives excessive macropinocytosis, resulting in compromised phagocytosis and methuosis—a non-apoptotic, vacuole-dependent death specific to phagocytes. Thus, VgrG2 selectively eliminates key immune sentinels and alters pulmonary inflammation, promoting bacterial persistence and dissemination. These findings extend the role of T6SS effectors beyond interbacterial competition to include sophisticated eukaryotic-directed attacks, and highlight the VgrG2-Rac1 axis as a promising therapeutic target.
title_zh: 鲍曼不动杆菌的 VgrG2 效应子通过抑制 Csu 菌毛组装并触发吞噬细胞代谢介导免疫逃避
abstract_zh: 鲍曼不动杆菌是一种可怕的医院病原体，其多重耐药性和免疫逃避能力提出了重大的治疗挑战。本研究将 VI 型分泌系统 (T6SS) 效应子 VgrG2 确定为鲍曼不动杆菌的关键毒力调节因子。 VgrG2 采用双管齐下的策略来破坏宿主先天免疫。首先，它在转录上抑制主要粘附素 Csu 菌毛，减少细菌识别、吞噬细胞摄取和中性粒细胞募集。其次，VgrG2 直接靶向并过度激活吞噬细胞内的小 GTPase Rac1。这会导致肌动蛋白细胞骨架紊乱，从而驱动过度的巨胞饮作用，导致吞噬作用和吞噬作用受损——一种吞噬细胞特有的非凋亡性、液泡依赖性死亡。因此，VgrG2 选择性地消除关键的免疫哨兵并改变肺部炎症，促进细菌的持续存在和传播。这些发现将 T6SS 效应器的作用扩展到细菌间竞争之外，包括复杂的真核定向攻击，并强调 VgrG2-Rac1 轴作为一个有前途的治疗靶点。

title: Experimental realization of a bidirectional quantum analog-to-digital converter between photonic wavefront and qubits
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Quantum systems can be fundamentally classified into discrete-variable (DV) and continuous-variable (CV) systems. The degree of quantum advantage achieved with a quantum system is often dictated by the scalability, robustness, and operational feasibility-factors that are closely tied to the nature of the variables employed. Notably, DV and CV systems are largely complementary in these factors. Consequently, integrating DV and CV variables holds significant promise for overcoming the inherent challenges associated with relying solely on one type of variable system. In this study, we build a bidirectional quantum analog-to-digital converter (QADC/QDAC), which facilitates deterministic and reversible quantum information transfer between CV and DV systems. This QADC/QDAC is hardware-efficient, and the error decreases exponentially with the number of qubits, thereby allowing high-fidelity information transfer with a few qubits. With this photonic QADC/QDAC, we demonstrate efficient CV mode tomography leveraging DV tomography techniques and achieve deterministic generation of non-Gaussian CV mode from qubits. Our findings address a critical barrier in constructing hybrid quantum processors and open up new avenues for scientific exploration previously inaccessible to single-variable quantum systems.
title_zh: 光子波前和量子位之间双向量子模数转换器的实验实现
abstract_zh: 量子系统从根本上可以分为离散变量（DV）和连续变量（CV）系统。量子系统实现的量子优势程度通常取决于可扩展性、鲁棒性和操作可行性等因素，这些因素与所使用的变量的性质密切相关。值得注意的是，DV 和 CV 系统在这些因素上基本上是互补的。因此，整合 DV 和 CV 变量对于克服仅依赖一种变量系统所带来的固有挑战具有重大前景。在这项研究中，我们构建了一个双向量子模数转换器（QADC/QDAC），它促进了 CV 和 DV 系统之间确定性和可逆的量子信息传输。该 QADC/QDAC 硬件效率高，误差随着量子位数量呈指数下降，从而允许使用少量量子位进行高保真信息传输。通过这种光子 QADC/QDAC，我们展示了利用 DV 断层扫描技术的高效 CV 模式断层扫描，并从量子位实现非高斯 CV 模式的确定性生成。我们的研究结果解决了构建混合量子处理器的关键障碍，并为以前单变量量子系统无法实现的科学探索开辟了新途径。

title: Luminescence meets physical unclonability in fracture engineered porous polymer skeletons for anticounterfeiting
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Counterfeiting remains a persistent global challenge, necessitating security technologies that combine robust unclonability with rapid, field-verifiable accessibility. Conventional optical labels with uniform designs are easily replicated, while most physical unclonable functions (PUFs) rely on complex fabrication processes or specialized readout systems, limiting their practical deployment, especially considering the broad accessibility of smartphone-based authentication. Here, we report a materials-driven strategy that unifies luminescence and physical unclonability through fracture-engineered polymer PUFs. Porous polymer skeletons bearing customized patterns are printed via maskless photolithography and subsequently functionalized by surface-initiated ATRP with Ir-based complexes and fluorescent dyes. This design yields Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET)-enabled, intensity-amplified, and spectrally multiplexed emissions under single-wavelength excitation, enabling optical information encryption and straightforward decoding. Crucially, the porous architecture supports fracture-engineered tape transfer that preserves macroscopic luminescent patterns while spontaneously generating stochastic microscale features at each pixel, producing intrinsically unclonable fingerprints. The resulting mechanically durable tags integrate bright, stable luminescence with reliable PUF characteristics and enable field-readable authentication using only a handheld flashlight and smartphone imaging, without the need for specialized instrumentation. By coupling luminescence with luminescence-enhanced intrinsic PUF security on easily readable tags, this work establishes a versatile and scalable platform for on-site customization and on-demand anti-counterfeiting authentication.
title_zh: 用于防伪的断裂工程多孔聚合物骨架中的发光满足物理不可克隆性
abstract_zh: 伪造仍然是一个持续存在的全球挑战，需要将强大的不可克隆性与快速、可现场验证的可访问性相结合的安全技术。具有统一设计的传统光学标签很容易复制，而大多数物理不可克隆功能（PUF）依赖于复杂的制造工艺或专门的读出系统，限制了它们的实际部署，特别是考虑到基于智能手机的身份验证的广泛可访问性。在这里，我们报告了一种材料驱动的策略，通过断裂工程聚合物 PUF 将发光和物理不可克隆性统一起来。带有定制图案的多孔聚合物骨架通过无掩模光刻技术印刷，随后通过表面引发的 ATRP 与 Ir 基络合物和荧光染料进行功能化。该设计在单波长激发下产生福斯特共振能量转移 (FRET)、强度放大和光谱复用发射，从而实现光学信息加密和直接解码。至关重要的是，多孔结构支持断裂工程磁带转移，保留宏观发光图案，同时在每个像素自发生成随机微观特征，产生本质上不可克隆的指纹。由此产生的机械耐用标签将明亮、稳定的发光与可靠的 PUF 特性相结合，只需手持手电筒和智能手机成像即可实现现场可读身份验证，无需专门的仪器。通过将发光与发光耦合

title: Probing entanglement scaling across a quantum phase transition on a quantum computer
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The investigation of strongly-correlated quantum matter is difficult due to the curse of dimensionality and intricate entanglement structures. These challenges are particularly pronounced in the vicinity of continuous quantum phase transitions, where quantum fluctuations manifest across all length scales. While quantum simulators give controlled access to a number of strongly correlated systems, the study of critical phenomena has been hampered by finite-size effects arising from diverging correlation lengths. Moreover, the experimental investigation of entanglement in many-body systems has been hindered by limitations in measurement protocols. To address these challenges, we employ the multiscale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA) and implement a holographic scheme for subsystem tomography on a fully-connected trapped-ion quantum computer. Our method accurately represents infinite systems and long-range correlations with few qubits, facilitating the efficient extraction of observables and entanglement properties, even at criticality. We observe a quantum phase transition with spontaneous symmetry breaking and reveal the evolution of entanglement properties across the critical point. For the first time, we demonstrate log-law scaling of subsystem entanglement entropies at criticality on a digital quantum computer. This achievement highlights the potential of MERA for the investigation of strongly-correlated many-body systems on quantum computers.
title_zh: 在量子计算机上探测量子相变中的纠缠尺度
abstract_zh: 由于维度灾难和复杂的纠缠结构，强相关量子物质的研究非常困难。这些挑战在连续量子相变附近尤其明显，其中量子涨落在所有长度尺度上都表现出来。虽然量子模拟器可以对许多强相关系统进行受控访问，但对关键现象的研究却受到相关长度发散产生的有限尺寸效应的阻碍。此外，多体系统中纠缠的实验研究受到测量协议限制的阻碍。为了应对这些挑战，我们采用多尺度纠缠重整化模拟（MERA），并在全连接的俘获离子量子计算机上实现子系统层析成像的全息方案。我们的方法用很少的量子位准确地表示无限系统和远程相关性，即使在临界状态下，也有助于有效提取可观察量和纠缠性质。我们观察到具有自发对称性破缺的量子相变，并揭示了跨越临界点的纠缠性质的演变。我们首次在数字量子计算机上演示了临界子系统纠缠熵的对数律标度。这一成就凸显了 MERA 在量子计算机上强相关多体系统研究方面的潜力。

title: β-cell FMO3-produced TMAO prevents NF-κB-mediated senescence and inflammation in ageing and diabetic conditions
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Human cells utilize gut microbiota-derived metabolites to control systemic metabolism. Trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO) is traditionally considered a hepatocyte-derived metabolite from microbial trimethylamine. Here we show that pancreatic β-cells also produce TMAO as an autocrine and intracellular metabolite to maintain β-cell function. β-cells synthesize TMAO via flavin-containing monooxygenase 3 (FMO3), but this machinery deteriorates in humans and rodents under diabetic and ageing conditions. β-cell-specific deletion of FMO3 depletes intracellular TMAO, leading to senescence, inflammation, and defective glucose-stimulated insulin secretion, causing age-dependent glucose intolerance in mice. Loss of FMO3 triggers nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-κB) activation, promoting senescent and inflammatory responses. Mechanistically, TMAO binds to inhibitor of kappa B alpha (IκBα), which inhibits IκBα degradation and NF-κB nuclear translocation, thereby blocking NF-κB-mediated transcription of senescent and inflammatory programs. Replenishment of FMO3 reduces NF-κB activation and senescence in aged human islets. Our findings reveal a protective role of β-cell-derived TMAO against ageing-related β-cell dysfunction.
title_zh: β 细胞 FMO3 产生的 TMAO 可预防衰老和糖尿病条件下 NF-κB 介导的衰老和炎症
abstract_zh: 人类细胞利用肠道微生物群衍生的代谢物来控制全身代谢。三甲胺 N-氧化物 (TMAO) 传统上被认为是微生物三甲胺的肝细胞衍生代谢物。在这里，我们证明胰腺 β 细胞也产生 TMAO 作为自分泌和细胞内代谢产物，以维持 β 细胞功能。 β 细胞通过含黄素的单加氧酶 3 (FMO3) 合成 TMAO，但在糖尿病和衰老条件下，人类和啮齿动物的这种机制会退化。 β细胞特异性删除FMO3会耗尽细胞内的TMAO，导致衰老、炎症和葡萄糖刺激的胰岛素分泌缺陷，从而导致小鼠出现年龄依赖性葡萄糖不耐受。 FMO3 的缺失会触发核因子 kappa-B (NF-κB) 激活，促进衰老和炎症反应。从机制上讲，TMAO 与 kappa B α (IκBα) 抑制剂结合，抑制 IκBα 降解和 NF-κB 核转位，从而阻断 NF-κB 介导的衰老和炎症程序的转录。补充 FMO3 可减少衰老人类胰岛的 NF-κB 激活和衰老。我们的研究结果揭示了 β 细胞衍生的 TMAO 对衰老相关 β 细胞功能障碍的保护作用。

title: Microbial drought resistance is achieved at the expense of soil carbon loss
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Life history strategies of soil microbiomes may determine their environmental adaptability and influence soil carbon-climate feedbacks. Here, we investigate trade-offs among microbial high yield (Y), resource acquisition (A), and stress tolerance (S) strategies and their consequences for soil carbon mineralization potential along an aridity gradient spanning 9.6 million square kilometers. Y-A-S strategies show nonlinear threshold responses to aridity, where a surge in S- and A-strategies and a sharp decline in Y-strategy occur once aridity exceeds critical levels. The aridity threshold for the Y-strategy occurs after those of S- and A-strategies, as increasing carbon allocation into stress tolerance and resource acquisition comes at the expense of growth. The Y-strategy negatively impacts, while A- and S-strategies positively impact soil carbon mineralization potential. Importantly, aridification intensifies these impacts. Overall, our findings suggest that variations in microbial Y-A-S strategies significantly influence soil carbon cycling and should be considered in microbial models.
title_zh: 微生物抗旱是以土壤碳损失为代价的
abstract_zh: 土壤微生物组的生活史策略可能决定其环境适应性并影响土壤碳-气候反馈。在这里，我们研究了微生物高产 (Y)、资源获取 (A) 和抗逆 (S) 策略之间的权衡及其对 960 万平方公里干旱梯度沿线土壤碳矿化潜力的影响。 Y-A-S 策略对干旱表现出非线性阈值响应，一旦干旱超过临界水平，S 和 A 策略就会激增，而 Y 策略则会急剧下降。 Y 策略的干旱阈值出现在 S 和 A 策略之后，因为增加对压力耐受性和资源获取的碳分配是以牺牲增长为代价的。 Y 策略产生负面影响，而 A 和 S 策略则对土壤碳矿化潜力产生积极影响。重要的是，干旱化加剧了这些影响。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，微生物 Y-A-S 策略的变化显着影响土壤碳循环，应在微生物模型中予以考虑。

title: The saline groundwater legacy of a large buried coastal paleo-estuary
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Elevated groundwater salinity in coastal regions threatens the beneficial use of fresh groundwater. Coastal groundwater management typically focuses on preventing intrusion from modern sources of seawater; however, past geological processes can also leave a legacy of saline groundwater now hidden in the subsurface. Here, multiple extensive airborne electromagnetic surveys provide detailed evidence of residual salinity from a paleo-estuary filling a late Pleistocene incised valley impacting more than 10,000 km2 that is now hidden beneath coastal Louisiana’s deltaic plain. Our results show that the three-dimensional pattern of saline groundwater beneath Louisiana mimics that of near-surface aquifers surrounding the modern Delaware Bay estuary, fingerprinting the signature of the past drowning of a large, incised valley of the Mississippi River following post-glacial sea-level rise. These findings demonstrate a new framework for understanding legacy sources of saltwater critical for managing stressed water resources along global coastlines.
title_zh: 大型埋藏沿海古河口的咸水地下水遗产
abstract_zh: 沿海地区地下水盐度升高威胁着淡水地下水的有益利用。沿海地下水管理通常侧重于防止现代海水源的入侵；然而，过去的地质过程也可能留下隐藏在地下的含盐地下水。在这里，多次广泛的机载电磁调查提供了古河口残留盐分的详细证据，该古河口填充了晚更新世切开的山谷，影响了超过 10,000 平方公里，目前隐藏在路易斯安那州沿海三角洲平原下方。我们的研究结果表明，路易斯安那州下方咸水地下水的三维模式模仿了现代特拉华湾河口周围近地表含水层的三维模式，记录了冰河后海平面上升后密西西比河一个大型切开河谷过去淹没的特征。这些发现展示了一个了解遗留咸水来源的新框架，这对于管理全球海岸线紧张的水资源至关重要。

title: Identification of scavenger receptor BI as a scavenger of free heme that is essential for protection against hemolysis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Severe hemolysis is a life-threatening condition with limited therapeutic options. Although haptoglobin and hemopexin sequester hemoglobin and heme, these protective systems are rapidly saturated during acute hemolysis, leading to the accumulation of cytotoxic free heme. In this study, we identify scavenger receptor BI (SR-BI) as a critical mediator of free heme clearance. SR-BI binds heme and facilitates its hepatic uptake under pathological conditions. Mice lacking hepatic SR-BI exhibit impaired heme clearance and increased susceptibility to heme- and hemolysis-induced lethality. Pharmacological upregulation of hepatic SR-BI via imatinib or adenoviral delivery confers protection against heme toxicity. Using a humanized model of sickle cell disease (SCD), we further demonstrate that sickle hepatopathy significantly reduces hepatic SR-BI expression compared to non-SCD HbAA littermates, potentially increasing vulnerability to heme-induced injury. Notably, adenoviral-mediated SR-BI upregulation rescues SCD mice from heme toxicity. These findings reveal a previously unrecognized mechanism of heme detoxification via hepatic SR-BI and identify a promising therapeutic target for hemolytic disorders.
title_zh: 鉴定清道夫受体 BI 作为游离血红素清道夫，对于防止溶血至关重要
abstract_zh: 严重溶血是一种危及生命的疾病，治疗选择有限。尽管触珠蛋白和血红素结合蛋白隔离血红蛋白和血红素，但这些保护系统在急性溶血期间迅速饱和，导致细胞毒性游离血红素的积累。在这项研究中，我们确定清道夫受体 BI (SR-BI) 是游离血红素清除的关键介质。 SR-BI 结合血红素并促进其在病理条件下的肝脏摄取。缺乏肝脏 SR-BI 的小鼠表现出血红素清除受损以及对血红素和溶血引起的致死的敏感性增加。通过伊马替尼或腺病毒递送对肝脏 SR-BI 进行药理学上调，可防止血红素毒性。使用镰状细胞病 (SCD) 人源化模型，我们进一步证明，与非 SCD HbAA 同窝仔鼠相比，镰状细胞性肝病显着降低肝脏 SR-BI 表达，可能增加对血红素诱导损伤的脆弱性。值得注意的是，腺病毒介导的 SR-BI 上调可拯救 SCD 小鼠免受血红素毒性。这些发现揭示了以前未被认识的通过肝脏 SR-BI 进行血红素解毒的机制，并确定了溶血性疾病的有希望的治疗靶点。

title: Balancing energy, water, and ecology through renewable energy transitions in the Yellow River Basin
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The transition to renewable energy for climate mitigation often involves trade-offs with regional priorities, owning to resource competition and potential ecological impacts. Addressing these challenges requires a holistic strategy. This study examines the potential of Hydropower–Photovoltaic–Wind–Pump renewable energy base (HPWP-base) in the Yellow River Basin in China—a region facing significant sustainability pressures, to balance energy, water, and ecology. Annually, the HPWP-base could replace 23.8% (249.4 tera watt hours) of coal-fired electricity generation. Such a basin-wide transition enables 28.0% reduction in energy-related emissions, 31.5% decline in electricity-sector water consumption, and 9.0% restoration of ecosystem carbon storage. These synergistic outcomes, attained through established technologies (pump and storage hydropower, basin-wide cooperation, and grid expansion), show the practicality of the HPWP-base. Therefore, it can serve as a solution to accelerate regional electricity transformation while advancing sustainable development, and enable policymakers to appreciate how to link renewable energy transition with multiple sustainable goals.
title_zh: 黄河流域通过可再生能源转型平衡能源、水和生态
abstract_zh: 由于资源竞争和潜在的生态影响，向可再生能源过渡以缓解气候变化往往需要与区域优先事项进行权衡。应对这些挑战需要整体战略。本研究探讨了中国黄河流域水电-光伏-风-泵可再生能源基地（HPWP-base）平衡能源、水和生态的潜力，该地区面临着巨大的可持续发展压力。每年，HPWP 基地可替代 23.8%（249.4 太瓦时）的燃煤发电。这样的全流域转型可以使能源相关排放减少28.0%，电力部门用水量减少31.5%，生态系统碳储存恢复9.0%。这些通过现有技术（抽水蓄能水电、全流域合作和电网扩建）取得的协同成果显示了高压水电基地的实用性。因此，它可以作为加速区域电力转型、促进可持续发展的解决方案，并使政策制定者了解如何将可再生能源转型与多个可持续目标联系起来。

title: Hydroxy acid conjugation to lipids increases structural and hydrolytic stability
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Contemporary life requires functional polymers and phospholipid-derived compartmentalization. Mutualistic relationships between compartmentalization and polymerization have never been demonstrated in an abiotic scenario. As both the polymerization of hydroxy acids and the primitive cell-like aggregation of short-chain fatty acids are well known, we study cooperative interactions between compartmentalization and polymerization using these two classes of molecules as a model system. To that end, we explore the formation of various hydroxy acid-fatty acid conjugates. All reactions produce two types of condensation products: hydroxy acid oligoesters and lipid-conjugated oligoesters. We find that conjugation of hydroxy acids to fatty acids leads to the reduction of fatty acid critical aggregation concentration by an order of magnitude. Furthermore, hydroxy acid oligomers are protected against hydrolysis only upon conjugation to fatty acids. Our work offers meaningful insights into the role of self-assembly and cooperative chemistry as selective driving forces in lipid-polymer co-evolution.
title_zh: 羟基酸与脂质缀合可提高结构和水解稳定性
abstract_zh: 现代生活需要功能性聚合物和磷脂衍生的区室化。分隔和聚合之间的互惠关系从未在非生物场景中得到证实。由于羟基酸的聚合和短链脂肪酸的原始细胞样聚集都是众所周知的，因此我们使用这两类分子作为模型系统来研究区室化和聚合之间的协同相互作用。为此，我们探索了各种羟基酸-脂肪酸缀合物的形成。所有反应都会产生两种类型的缩合产物：羟基酸低聚酯和脂质共轭低聚酯。我们发现羟基酸与脂肪酸的缀合导致脂肪酸临界聚集浓度降低一个数量级。此外，羟基酸低聚物只有在与脂肪酸缀合时才能免受水解。我们的工作为自组装和协同化学作为脂质-聚合物共同进化中选择性驱动力的作用提供了有意义的见解。

title: Tritium separation from gaseous 1,2,3H isotopologue mixtures by selective adsorption on Ag-exchanged zeolite type Y
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Efficient separation of hydrogen isotopologues is crucial for applications such as the recycling of exhaust streams in nuclear fusion reactors. We report on separation of a ternary 1,2,3H isotope mixture using thermal desorption spectroscopy (TDS), achieving an enrichment of 1:41:175 (H2:D2:T2) from an initially equimolar (1:1:1) gas mixture, based on selective adsorption using an Ag(I)-exchanged zeolite type Y. Further experiments on binary hydrogen isotope mixtures validated numerical predictions of the separation efficiency for T2. Specifically, the high selectivity for tritium over protium of 244 makes the Ag(I)-exchanged zeolite an excellent candidate for energy-efficient isotope separation at liquid-nitrogen temperature.
title_zh: 通过银交换 Y 型沸石选择性吸附从气态 1,2,3H 同位素混合物中分离氚
abstract_zh: 氢同位素异构体的有效分离对于核聚变反应堆废气流回收等应用至关重要。我们报告了使用热解吸光谱 (TDS) 分离三元 1,2,3H 同位素混合物，基于使用 Ag(I) 交换 Y 型沸石的选择性吸附，从最初等摩尔 (1:1:1) 的气体混合物中实现了 1:41:175 (H2:D2:T2) 的富集。对二元氢同位素混合物的进一步实验验证了 T2 分离效率的数值预测。具体而言，与氕相比，244 对氚的高选择性使得 Ag(I) 交换沸石成为液氮温度下节能同位素分离的绝佳候选者。

title: An ingestible origami-inspired metamaterial for prolonged oral delivery of therapeutics
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Poor adherence to oral drug regimens adversely affects treatment outcomes and contributes substantially to preventable healthcare costs, underscoring the need for long-acting drug delivery systems that sustain therapeutic levels over extended periods. To address this, we developed an origami-inspired, oral drug delivery dosage form capable of prolonged residence in the gastric cavity. This system achieves ease of administration and extended gastric residency through geometric design and shape optimization, allowing the dosage form to fold inside a standard ingestible capsule. Upon the capsule’s dissolution in the stomach, the dosage form rapidly transforms into its deployed configuration. Our formulation and manufacturing techniques enable the development of a long-acting dosage form with up to 40% weight loading capacity of sample drugs, such as moxifloxacin. The high surface-area-to-volume ratio of the origami design enables approximately linear release kinetics over the observed time window of candidate drugs. We incorporated pH-sensitive elements that dissolve in the neutral portions of the GI tract into the dosage form to promote its dissociation and safe transit in the intestine. In vitro and in vivo studies using swine models demonstrated extended gastric residency of up to three weeks (with a minimum of one week) and an approximately constant release rate for three days. Endoscopic and radiographic evaluations of the animal models confirmed that the dosage forms safely pass through the intestine without causing gastrointestinal obstruction or injury.
title_zh: 一种受折纸启发的可摄入超材料，用于延长口服治疗药物
abstract_zh: 口服药物治疗方案的依从性差会对治疗结果产生不利影响，并大大增加可预防的医疗费用，这凸显了对能够长期维持治疗水平的长效药物输送系统的需求。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种受折纸启发的口服药物递送剂型，能够在胃腔中长时间停留。该系统通过几何设计和形状优化实现了给药的简便性并延长了胃内的停留时间，使剂型能够折叠在标准的可摄入胶囊内。胶囊在胃中溶解后，剂型迅速转变为展开形态。我们的配方和制造技术能够开发出莫西沙星等样品药物重量负载能力高达 40% 的长效剂型。折纸设计的高表面积与体积比使得候选药物在观察到的时间窗口内能够实现近似线性的释放动力学。我们将溶解在胃肠道中性部分的 pH 敏感元素加入到剂型中，以促进其解离和在肠道中的安全转运。使用猪模型进行的体外和体内研究表明，胃内滞留时间长达三周（最少一周），并且释放速率大约持续三天。对动物模型的内窥镜和放射学评估证实，剂型安全地通过肠道，不会引起胃肠道梗阻或损伤。

title: Competitive resource allocation drives asynchronous and rapid nuclear multiplication in the malaria parasite
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The unicellular malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum proliferates within red blood cells of its human host, where it generates approximately 20 new parasites within a two-day developmental cycle. Before cellularization and release of the daughter cells, the nuclei multiply in a shared cytoplasm. In stark contrast to highly synchronized nuclear division cycles seen in other developing eukaryotes, Plasmodium nuclear cycles desynchronize rapidly. Combining live-cell imaging with biophysical modeling, we elucidate the mechanism of desynchronization and study its impact on parasite proliferation. We find that standard models of autonomous nuclear cycles cannot account for the experimental data, and therefore desynchronization requires nuclear coupling. Competition for a limiting pool of proteins needed for DNA replication explains the data, provided that they are allocated sequentially to individual nuclei. Sequential allocation can be achieved by reversible but stable association of the resources with DNA. Remarkably, the resultant asynchronous nuclear cycles accelerate parasite proliferation by minimizing idling times of the resource. This mechanism may be a general strategy to maximize proliferation in suboptimal growth conditions. Together, our findings identify nuclear cycle asynchrony as a resource-efficient means to achieve rapid proliferation.
title_zh: 竞争性资源分配驱动疟疾寄生虫的异步和快速核增殖
abstract_zh: 单细胞疟原虫恶性疟原虫在人类宿主的红细胞内增殖，在两天的发育周期内产生大约 20 种新的寄生虫。在细胞化和释放子细胞之前，细胞核在共享的细胞质中增殖。与其他发育中的真核生物中高度同步的核分裂周期形成鲜明对比的是，疟原虫核周期迅速去同步。将活细胞成像与生物物理模型相结合，我们阐明了去同步化的机制并研究了其对寄生虫增殖的影响。我们发现自主核循环的标准模型无法解释实验数据，因此去同步需要核耦合。 DNA 复制所需的有限蛋白质池的竞争解释了这些数据，前提是将它们按顺序分配到各个细胞核。顺序分配可以通过资源与DNA的可逆但稳定的关联来实现。值得注意的是，由此产生的异步核循环通过最大限度地减少资源的空闲时间来加速寄生虫的增殖。这种机制可能是在次优生长条件下最大化增殖的一般策略。总之，我们的研究结果表明核循环异步是实现快速扩散的资源有效手段。

title: A decoupled transcription platform enables tunable and predictable gene expression in yeast
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Predictable control of gene expression is essential for building genetic circuits and improving metabolic pathways, but conventional promoter libraries often behave unpredictably when genes are combined. Here we develop CRISPR-Activated Promoter-based Orthogonal expression (CAPO), a quantitative platform for controlling multiple genes in yeast. CAPO uses synthetic CRISPR-activated promoters that remain silent until matching guide RNAs recruit dCas9-VPR. We tune each gene by varying guide RNA abundance with defined T7 promoters, while keeping regulatory channels orthogonal. CAPO reaches expression levels comparable to strong native yeast promoters, maintains low background activity, and preserves promoter-strength order across different genes. We apply CAPO to program broad fluorescence color outputs and to rapidly optimize lycopene and 3-hydroxypropionic acid biosynthesis. These results establish CAPO as a scalable platform for predictable engineering of eukaryotic gene networks.
title_zh: 解耦转录平台能够在酵母中实现可调节和可预测的基因表达
abstract_zh: 基因表达的可预测控制对于构建遗传回路和改善代谢途径至关重要，但传统启动子文库在基因组合时通常表现不可预测。在这里，我们开发了基于 CRISPR 激活启动子的正交表达 (CAPO)，这是一种用于控制酵母中多个基因的定量平台。 CAPO 使用合成的 CRISPR 激活启动子，启动子保持沉默，直到匹配的引导 RNA 招募 dCas9-VPR。我们通过使用定义的 T7 启动子改变指导 RNA 丰度来调整每个基因，同时保持调控通道正交。 CAPO 达到与强天然酵母启动子相当的表达水平，保持低背景活性，并保持不同基因的启动子强度顺序。我们应用 CAPO 来编程广泛的荧光颜色输出并快速优化番茄红素和 3-羟基丙酸的生物合成。这些结果使 CAPO 成为可预测的真核基因网络工程的可扩展平台。

title: Dominant functional group explains global bird diversity responses to farmland abandonment
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Reversing biodiversity declines will require redesigning agricultural landscapes and their management. Farmland abandonment and intensification are emerging as major drivers of biodiversity changes, and their consequences vary widely from negative to positive among continents. Despite decades of research on agricultural biodiversity, no generalizable framework has been established to predict these variations globally, hindering the development of effective conservation strategies. Here, we combine broad-scale, multiseason avian field surveys across Japan with a global meta-analysis spanning four continents. In field surveys, we compared avian species richness among 2-ha plots in abandoned farmland (≤ 50 y since abandonment), traditional farmland, and intensive farmland, controlling for the surrounding land-use cover. We showed that the dominant functional group robustly explains the direction and strength of community-level responses to abandonment and intensification. When mature-habitat species comprise over 50% of communities, abandonment enhances species richness by over 240%, reaching levels comparable to natural wetlands. Abandoned farmlands hold the potential to offset past biodiversity declines and thus merit considerations for inclusion within the conservation area networks. Conversely, when disturbed-habitat species comprise more than 48% of communities, abandonment and intensification reduce species richness, underscoring the importance of biodiversity-friendly farming. This study provides a basis to understand how to address varied spatial variations in biodiversity responses to management and land-cover changes—a long-standing hurdle in conservation science. Complex bird diversity responses can be predicted globally by simply identifying the dominant functional group, thereby helping develop the most effective conservation strategies. Transferability beyond birds and across taxa should be evaluated empirically.
title_zh: 主要功能群体解释了全球鸟类多样性对农田废弃的反应
abstract_zh: 扭转生物多样性下降的趋势需要重新设计农业景观及其管理。农田撂荒和集约化正在成为生物多样性变化的主要驱动因素，其后果在各大洲之间有很大差异，从负面到正面。尽管对农业生物多样性进行了数十年的研究，但尚未建立通用的框架来预测全球范围内的这些变化，从而阻碍了有效保护战略的制定。在这里，我们将日本各地的大规模、多季节鸟类实地调查与跨越四大洲的全球荟萃分析结合起来。在实地调查中，我们比较了废弃农田（废弃后≤50年）、传统农田和集约农田中2公顷地块的鸟类物种丰富度，并控制了周围的土地利用覆盖。我们表明，主导功能群体有力地解释了社区层面对遗弃和集约化反应的方向和强度。当成熟栖息地物种占群落的 50% 以上时，遗弃会使物种丰富度提高 240% 以上，达到与自然湿地相当的水平。废弃农田有可能抵消过去生物多样性的下降，因此值得考虑将其纳入保护区网络。相反，当受干扰栖息地物种占群落的 48% 以上时，遗弃和集约化会降低物种丰富度，凸显了生物多样性友好型农业的重要性。这项研究为理解如何解决生物多样性的不同空间变化提供了基础

title: Sprint-like cardiac dynamics support repeated acrobatic lunges in foraging rorqual whales
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: The dive response decreases heart rate, regulates blood flow distribution, conserves oxygen, and extends dive duration. In diving animals, dive heart rate can be modulated to meet increased demands of exercise during foraging. However, lunge-feeding rorquals represent an extreme example of exercise under breath-hold conditions: Though most of their dive time is spent gliding and filtering, lunges require high-power, acrobatic sprints to engulf massive volumes of prey-laden water. Our biologging data show that heart rate repeatedly increases with lunging but only gradually declines during filtering, dissimilar from the heart rate-activity coupling observed in other divers. We suggest that the unique nature of rorqual exercise likely requires glycolytic metabolic substrates, rather than aerobic substrates, during short, powerful lunges. During slow filtering, high heart rates may help partially renew these energy sources via oxygen-dependent pathways. By temporarily buffering oxygen demand from supply, the flexible dive response appears to optimize oxygen use in lunging rorquals and support aerobically “cheap” foraging. The data also show that dive cycle heart rate scope increases with rorqual size. We propose that cardiovascular plasticity during high and low power phases of foraging dives underpins rorquals’ ability to achieve high foraging efficiencies and combine explosive predation with grazing-like efficiency in a single lineage.
title_zh: 冲刺般的心脏动力学支持在觅食的斑鲸中反复进行杂技式的弓步
abstract_zh: 潜水反应会降低心率、调节血流分布、保存氧气并延长潜水时间。对于潜水动物，可以调节潜水心率以满足觅食期间增加的运动需求。然而，弓步捕食的猫头鹰代表了屏气条件下运动的一个极端例子：尽管它们的大部分潜水时间都花在滑行和过滤上，但弓步需要高功率、杂技般的冲刺才能吞下大量猎物的水。我们的生物记录数据显示，心率随着冲刺而反复增加，但在过滤过程中仅逐渐下降，这与在其他潜水员中观察到的心率-活动耦合不同。我们认为，rorqual 运动的独特性质可能需要糖酵解代谢底物，而不是有氧底物，在短而有力的弓步过程中。在缓慢过滤过程中，高心率可能有助于通过依赖氧气的途径部分更新这些能量来源。通过暂时缓冲氧气供应的需求，灵活的潜水反应似乎可以优化刺猬的氧气使用，并支持有氧“廉价”觅食。数据还表明，潜水周期心率范围随着鱼体尺寸的增加而增加。我们认为，觅食潜水的高功率和低功率阶段的心血管可塑性支撑了短吻鳄实现高觅食效率并将爆炸性捕食与单一谱系中的放牧效率相结合的能力。

title: Reply to Topaz and Bahl: Interpreting a post-2022 lexical shift in academic prose

title: Palindrome in the sequence of the ribosomal peptidyl transferase center suggests a protoribosome emergence scheme
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: The emergence of a simple version of the modern ribosome represents an indispensable step in the evolution of life as we know it. Standalone dimeric protoribosome models, derived from the peptidyl transferase center of the modern ribosome, have been shown to perform the primary ribosomal function of catalyzing peptide bond formation. However, the likelihood of the random occurrence of a suitable 70-mer RNA strand capable of serving as the monomer sequence remains questionable. Here, what initially appeared to be a “hallucinatory” AlphaFold3 prediction of a putative protoribosome, was found to express the presence of a palindrome spanning most of the ribosome-derived monomer sequence. The framework of this sequence suggests a simple, experimentally testable molecular mechanism by which an analog of the ribosome-derived protoribosome could have self-assembled from a few copies and complementary strands of a single 10-mer RNA segment. This scenario significantly reduces the complexity attributed to the autonomous emergence of a protoribosome and provides a plausible starting point for a continuous evolutionary pathway, leading from inanimate matter to life as we know it.
title_zh: 核糖体肽基转移酶中心序列中的回文表明原核糖体出现方案
abstract_zh: 现代核糖体的简单版本的出现代表了我们所知的生命进化中不可或缺的一步。独立的二聚体原核糖体模型源自现代核糖体的肽基转移酶中心，已被证明执行催化肽键形成的主要核糖体功能。然而，随机出现能够充当单体序列的合适 70 聚体 RNA 链的可能性仍然值得怀疑。在这里，最初看似“幻觉”的 AlphaFold3 对假定的原核糖体的预测，被发现表达了跨越大部分核糖体衍生单体序列的回文结构的存在。该序列的框架表明了一种简单的、可通过实验测试的分子机制，通过该机制，核糖体衍生的原核糖体的类似物可以从单个 10 聚体 RNA 片段的几个拷贝和互补链进行自组装。这种情况显着降低了原核糖体自主出现的复杂性，并为连续进化途径提供了一个合理的起点，从无生命物质到我们所知的生命。

title: Abrupt transition to irreversible damage in the overdrafted Sacramento Valley aquifer system
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Groundwater extraction decreases water pressure in aquifer systems, causing reversible or irreversible deformation of the water-bearing layers that manifests as recoverable or permanent displacements of the land surface, respectively. Detecting and forecasting when and where an aquifer system transitions from a reversible, poroelastic regime, to an irreversible, inelastic regime remains a crucial challenge given the complex, heterogeneous nature of aquifer systems. Here we leverage high-resolution measurements of ground deformation and groundwater levels from 2016 to 2022 to characterize both regimes at the regional scale and show that a critical transition occurred in large areas of the Sacramento Valley during California’s 2020–2022 extreme drought. Our analysis reveals that, while deformation remained primarily poroelastic during the 2016–2020 interdrought period, land subsidence in areas of intense groundwater extraction accelerated abruptly in 2021, with subsidence rates exceeding the inferred poroelastic rates by several decimeters per year. Such rapid and extensive land subsidence indicates severe inelastic compaction and loss of storage capacity of the underlying aquifer system, which pose a serious threat to California’s water resources and infrastructure. A comparison of present-day deformation with historical groundwater levels reveals that this abrupt transition was not predictable based on the available groundwater records alone.
title_zh: 透支的萨克拉门托谷含水层系统突然转变为不可逆转的损害
abstract_zh: 地下水抽取降低了含水层系统中的水压，导致含水层发生可逆或不可逆变形，分别表现为地表的可恢复或永久位移。鉴于含水层系统的复杂性、异质性，检测和预测含水层系统何时何地从可逆的孔隙弹性状态转变为不可逆的非弹性状态仍然是一个至关重要的挑战。在这里，我们利用 2016 年至 2022 年地面变形和地下水位的高分辨率测量来描述区域尺度的两种状况，并表明在加州 2020 年至 2022 年极端干旱期间，萨克拉门托山谷的大片地区发生了关键转变。我们的分析表明，虽然在 2016 年至 2020 年间旱期，变形仍然主要是孔隙弹性的，但在 2021 年，地下水大量开采地区的地面沉降突然加速，沉降率每年超过推断的孔隙弹性率几分米。如此迅速而广泛的地面沉降表明底层含水层系统的严重非弹性压实和存储能力丧失，这对加州的水资源和基础设施构成严重威胁。当前变形与历史地下水位的比较表明，仅根据现有地下水记录无法预测这种突然转变。

title: Methionine oxidation alters both helical assembly and disordered contacts in human TDP-43 C-terminal domain phase separation
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: TAR DNA binding protein 43 (TDP-43), a key protein linked to ALS pathology, undergoes phase separation and forms functional assemblies via condensation within cells. The conserved region (CR) within its C-terminal domain (CTD) mediates self-assembly through helix–helix interactions, while the flanking intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) contribute to phase separation through transient interactions involving aromatic and hydrophobic residues. The CTD contains ten methionine residues distributed equally between these regions, making it particularly susceptible to oxidative modifications. While methionine oxidation is known to impair TDP-43 phase separation, neither the precise mechanism nor the specific contribution of methionines in the CR compared to the IDRs has been determined. Here, we combine NMR spectroscopy and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to reveal if and how methionine oxidation in each region differentially affects CTD structure and phase separation. To assess the change of secondary structure caused by oxidation, we measured NMR random coil chemical shift values for methionine sulfoxide. Oxidation of CR methionines disrupts helical structure and directly impairs intermolecular helical association, while oxidation of IDR methionines disrupts long-range contacts. Hence, oxidation of methionines in both regions contributes to impaired phase separation, albeit through different mechanisms. These findings establish methionines as critical redox-sensitive modulators in TDP-43 phase behavior and provide molecular insights into how oxidative stress may contribute to TDP-43 dysregulation in neurodegenerative diseases.
title_zh: 蛋氨酸氧化改变人 TDP-43 C 端结构域相分离中的螺旋组装和无序接触
abstract_zh: TAR DNA 结合蛋白 43 (TDP-43) 是一种与 ALS 病理学相关的关键蛋白，它经历相分离并通过细胞内凝聚形成功能性组装体。其 C 端结构域 (CTD) 内的保守区 (CR) 通过螺旋-螺旋相互作用介导自组装，而侧翼的本质无序区域 (IDR) 通过涉及芳香族和疏水性残基的瞬时相互作用有助于相分离。 CTD 包含十个蛋氨酸残基，均匀分布在这些区域之间，使其特别容易受到氧化修饰。虽然已知蛋氨酸氧化会损害 TDP-43 相分离，但与 IDR 相比，CR 中蛋氨酸的精确机制和具体贡献尚未确定。在这里，我们结合核磁共振波谱和分子动力学 (MD) 模拟来揭示每个区域的蛋氨酸氧化是否以及如何对 CTD 结构和相分离产生不同的影响。为了评估氧化引起的二级结构的变化，我们测量了蛋氨酸亚砜的 NMR 无规卷曲化学位移值。 CR 蛋氨酸的氧化会破坏螺旋结构并直接损害分子间螺旋缔合，而 IDR 蛋氨酸的氧化会破坏长程接触。因此，尽管机制不同，但两个区域中蛋氨酸的氧化都会导致相分离受损。这些发现确立了蛋氨酸作为 TDP-43 相行为中关键的氧化还原敏感调节剂，并提供了氧化应激如何影响的分子见解。

title: Heat tolerance decreases and cold tolerance increases with elevation for a species-rich insect family on a tropical volcano
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: The climate crisis is moving the high ambient temperatures common in lower elevation tropical forests upslope into areas where they would not have occurred historically. Tropical invertebrates may be particularly vulnerable to such changes. Here, our goal was to understand whether the distribution of heat and cold tolerances along an elevational gradient in northwestern Costa Rica predicted by theory were present for a leaf-litter inhabiting insect community of rove beetles (Staphylinidae: Coleoptera). We found that heat tolerance decreased, and cold tolerance increased with elevation, supporting the predictions. High elevation communities may not be capable of tolerating the rising temperatures that come with climate change, while low elevation communities are already experiencing environmental temperatures that may meet or exceed their thermal limits. While the forests in the low elevation more frequently exhibit temperatures that meet or exceed the heat tolerances for the beetle community, the soil will offer a buffered refuge for some time. The decline in thermal tolerance that we show here is predicted by theory yet is inconsistent with the values for insect species in the thermal tolerance literature. This reinforces the need for a better understanding of the thermal tolerances of diverse assemblages of tropical species that are likely to experience complicated and negative impacts of climate change.
title_zh: 热带火山上物种丰富的昆虫家族随着海拔的升高，耐热性降低，耐寒性增加
abstract_zh: 气候危机正在将低海拔热带森林中常见的高环境温度上升到历史上不会发生的地区。热带无脊椎动物可能特别容易受到这种变化的影响。在这里，我们的目标是了解理论预测的哥斯达黎加西北部沿海拔梯度的耐热性和耐冷性分布是否存在于落叶栖息的罗夫甲虫（葡萄球菌科：鞘翅目）昆虫群落中。我们发现随着海拔的升高，耐热性下降，而耐寒性增加，这支持了预测。高海拔社区可能无法承受气候变化带来的气温上升，而低海拔社区已经经历了可能达到或超过其热极限的环境温度。虽然低海拔森林的温度经常达到或超过甲虫群落的耐热性，但土壤将在一段时间内提供缓冲避难所。我们在此显示的耐热性下降是理论预测的，但与耐热性文献中昆虫物种的值不一致。这就更加需要更好地了解可能遭受气候变化复杂和负面影响的不同热带物种组合的热耐受性。

title: Global threat exposure of islands in a changing world
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Islands are at the forefront of global environmental change. Biological invasions, land-use change, and climate change are driving population declines and causing irreversible losses in island ecosystems. Although global threat exposure maps have been developed in recent years, they are mostly designed for coarse-grained, continental-extent analyses, often overlooking islands. Here, we assessed the cumulative exposure to biological invasion, land-use change, and climate change by 2050, for more than 16,000 islands worldwide using multiple threat markers. Climate change emerged as a ubiquitous threat, being the dominant threat for 65% of all islands, followed by land-use change (22%) and biological invasions (13%). Islands with the highest cumulative exposure were more likely to be isolated, without historical connection with the mainland. Small and low-elevation islands at low latitudes exhibited greater exposure to climate change, whereas larger, high-elevation islands tended to be more exposed to land-use change. Certain countries and subdivisions, such as Seychelles, Bangladesh, China, French Polynesia, and Micronesia, harbored statistically disproportionate numbers of highly exposed islands, highlighting geographic hotspots of cumulative exposure where conservation efforts might be particularly urgent. Our study indicates that by 2050, most islands will be simultaneously exposed to a triple threat arising from the combined impacts of land-use change, climate change, and biological invasions. This study provides robust quantification of island cumulative exposure to three key drivers of biodiversity loss, making a crucial step toward assessing global biodiversity vulnerability.
title_zh: 不断变化的世界中岛屿面临的全球威胁
abstract_zh: 岛屿处于全球环境变化的最前沿。生物入侵、土地利用变化和气候变化正在导致人口下降，并对岛屿生态系统造成不可逆转的损失。尽管全球威胁暴露地图是近年来开发出来的，但它们大多是为粗粒度、大陆范围的分析而设计的，通常会俯瞰岛屿。在这里，我们使用多种威胁标记评估了到 2050 年全球 16,000 多个岛屿遭受生物入侵、土地利用变化和气候变化的累积暴露程度。气候变化成为普遍存在的威胁，是 65% 岛屿的主要威胁，其次是土地利用变化 (22%) 和生物入侵 (13%)。累积暴露最高的岛屿更有可能是孤立的，与大陆没有历史联系。低纬度的小岛屿和低海拔岛屿更容易受到气候变化的影响，而较大的高海拔岛屿往往更容易受到土地利用变化的影响。某些国家和地区，如塞舌尔、孟加拉国、中国、法属波利尼西亚和密克罗尼西亚，拥有统计上不成比例的高度暴露岛屿数量，突出了累积暴露的地理热点，这些地区的保护工作可能特别紧迫。我们的研究表明，到 2050 年，大多数岛屿将同时面临土地利用变化、气候变化和生物入侵综合影响的三重威胁。这项研究提供了岛屿累积暴露于三种物质的可靠量化

title: Rapid microbial production of long-lived dissolved organic carbon in the global ocean
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Marine microbes have long been regarded as central to replenishing the ocean’s reservoir of recalcitrant dissolved organic matter (RDOM). However, molecular-level evidence for their role remains inconclusive because RDOM persists for years to millennia, far exceeding timescales accessible to laboratory experiments, and because conventional analytical approaches lack the resolution to discern structural isomers of RDOM that confer functionally important differences in persistence. Using polarity-based liquid chromatography coupled to ultrahigh-resolution mass spectrometry capable of discriminating RDOM isomer clusters, we reveal that marine microbial consortia rapidly (≤ 90 d) convert diverse organic substrates into RDOM with extensive structural isomerism that closely mirrors natural seawater RDOM. A subset of these microbially derived RDOM compounds exhibits near-ubiquitous occurrence (> 99%) in a global dataset and accumulates progressively in the ocean’s interior. Together, our findings substantiate the direct microbial contribution to the long-lived oceanic carbon reservoir through the rapid diversification of RDOM isomers, a mechanism that contributes to sustaining the complexity and long-term persistence of the planetary-scale carbon reservoir.
title_zh: 全球海洋中微生物快速生产长寿命溶解有机碳
abstract_zh: 长期以来，海洋微生物一直被认为是补充海洋顽固性溶解有机物（RDOM）库的核心。然而，其作用的分子水平证据仍然没有定论，因为 RDOM 可以持续数年至数千年，远远超过实验室实验所能达到的时间尺度，而且传统的分析方法缺乏辨别 RDOM 结构异构体的分辨率，这些异构体在持久性方面赋予了功能上重要的差异。使用基于极性的液相色谱与能够区分 RDOM 异构体簇的超高分辨率质谱联用，我们揭示了海洋微生物群落快速（≤ 90 d）将各种有机底物转化为具有广泛结构异构性的 RDOM，与天然海水 RDOM 密切相关。这些微生物衍生的 RDOM 化合物的一个子集在全球数据集中几乎无处不在（> 99%），并在海洋内部逐渐积累。总之，我们的研究结果证实了微生物通过 RDOM 异构体的快速多样化对长寿海洋碳库的直接贡献，这种机制有助于维持行星规模碳库的复杂性和长期持久性。

title: Can stimulating ownership increase fertility: Evidence from housing interventions in China
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Declining fertility and the emergence of very low TFR’s in the Asian economies has increased the focus on how to change the direction of the fertility trend. Several countries in Europe and Asia have explored a variety of stimulus packages to increase the overall TFR. In this research we review those policies and examine one of those interventions which has the potential to stimulate fertility—the role of access to housing. The core of housing approaches to stimulating fertility is to make housing more accessible and to use various forms of credit assistance with the aim of making ownership easier and more attractive to young families. The research asks how effective are these approaches to reversing the decline in fertility? And, are they a solution to very low fertility? The results provide some evidence that the focus on housing stimulus packages may increase fertility although most successfully for socioeconomically advantaged households.
title_zh: 刺激所有权能否提高生育率：来自中国住房干预措施的证据
abstract_zh: 亚洲经济体的生育率下降和生育率极低的出现，使人们更加关注如何改变生育率趋势的方向。欧洲和亚洲的一些国家已经探索了各种刺激方案来提高总生育率。在这项研究中，我们回顾了这些政策，并研究了其中一项可能刺激生育的干预措施——获得住房的作用。刺激生育的住房办法的核心是让住房更容易获得，并利用各种形式的信贷援助，使年轻家庭更容易拥有住房并更具吸引力。研究询问这些方法对于扭转生育率下降有多有效？而且，它们是解决生育率极低的办法吗？结果提供了一些证据，表明对住房刺激方案的关注可能会提高生育率，尽管对于社会经济优势家庭来说最为成功。

title: Dual control of PIP2 drives germline/soma segregation in Drosophila
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Embryonic cell fate decisions require precise spatial coordination between competing lineage determinants. In the syncytial
                    Drosophila
                    embryo, primordial germ cells (PGCs) and posterior endoderm are specified at the posterior pole in overlapping domains, creating a conflict between germline and somatic fates. PGC formation depends on germ granules, which locally promote production of the phospholipid PIP2 at the posterior plasma membrane. PIP2 regulates actin dynamics leading to membrane protrusions that generate PGCs. We find that the posterior endoderm determinant, the receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) Torso, antagonizes germ granule activity by activating phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K) which converts PIP2 to PIP3. PIP3 prevents PGC formation, ensuring endoderm specification. Loss of Torso or PI3K expands the posterior PIP2 domain, increasing both the number and spatial extent of PGCs. Germ granules counteract this activity through production of the E3 ubiquitin ligase Germ cell-less (Gcl), which locally eliminates Torso and prevents PI3K-mediated PIP2 depletion at the posterior pole. In
                    gcl
                    mutants, PIP3 accumulates at the posterior membrane and PGC formation fails, a defect that can be partially rescued by targeted posterior expression of the PIP3 phosphatase Pten. Together, these findings demonstrate that mutual antagonism between germ granules and Torso signaling generates a PIP2/PIP3 boundary in the plasma membrane that governs the earliest germline–soma fate decision. Our work reveals how opposing maternal cues can be integrated at the level of membrane phospholipids to pattern cell fate during the earliest stages of development.

title: Insights into hominin body size, locomotion, and behavior from Early Pleistocene trackways in northern Kenya
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
The Early Pleistocene fossils of the Koobi Fora Formation, northern Kenya, record two well-documented hominin genera,
                    Homo
                    and
                    Paranthropus
                    , preserved in the same deposits. Evidence for their ecological sympatry consists of co-occurring footprints of diverse morphologies, suggesting that
                    Homo erectus
                    and
                    Paranthropus boisei
                    were present in the same lake margin habitats over hundreds of thousands of years. Here, we report on a ~1.43 Ma fossil footprint assemblage that sheds light on Early Pleistocene hominin paleobiology and behavior. The internal morphologies of the hominin tracks align with others previously attributed to
                    P. boisei
                    , indicating patterns of foot morphology and locomotion different from modern
                    Homo
                    and more consistent with those seen in earlier
                    Australopithecus
                    species. However, the tracks indicate body sizes that exceed the largest skeletal estimates for
                    P. boisei
                    , raising the possibility that they may belong to
                    H. erectus
                    . Depending on their attribution, the tracks demonstrate a) larger body sizes and greater size variation in
                    P. boisei
                    than previously recognized, or b) levels of intraspecific anatomical and locomotor variation in
                    H. erectus
                    that far exceed those yet observed in modern humans or other fossil taxa. Regardless of their attribution, these tracks indicate larger than average body sizes. This supports the hypothesis that they capture a group that included multiple adult males and offers rare direct evidence for hominin social behavior. The ecological context of the tracks suggests that hominins were accessing resources in a deltaic lake margin habitat.

title: MORC2 controls HIF-1α stability via an HDAC4-dependent mechanism to regulate erythropoiesis
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
The hypoxia-inducible factor (HIF) signaling pathway is essential for cellular adaptation to low oxygen. Although the canonical PHD-pVHL pathway that mediates HIF-α degradation under normoxia is well established, alternative regulatory mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, we identify Microrchidia family CW-type zinc-finger 2 (MORC2) as a negative regulator of HIF-α. In zebrafish, CRISPR/Cas9-generated
                    morc2
                    mutants developed polycythemia, systemic hypoxia, and constitutive activation of the HIF pathway. Mechanistically, MORC2 counteracts histone deacetylase 4 (HDAC4) by competing for HIF-1α binding. Loss of MORC2 enhances HDAC4 recruitment to HIF-1α, reducing acetylation at lysine 629 and preventing proteasomal degradation of HIF-1α. These results define a regulatory mechanism in which MORC2 modulates HIF-1α stability via HDAC4 mediated deacetylation, shedding light on hematopoiesis and HIF-related disorders.

title: The free-living wellspring of symbiotic nitrogen fixation in Bradyrhizobium
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
The evolutionary origin of nitrogen-fixing symbiosis has been a long-standing question. To address this, we focused on
                    Bradyrhizobium
                    , a globally abundant bacterial genus that includes classic symbiotic lineages, which rely on the common Nod factor signaling pathway to form nodules, and close relatives capable of fixing nitrogen in a free-living state. We isolated 88 strains carrying the key genes for nitrogen fixation (
                    nif
                    ) from nonlegume environments and analyzed them alongside 586 public
                    Bradyrhizobium
                    genomes harboring these genes to reconstruct a robust phylogeny of
                    nif
                    genes. Analysis suggests that the earliest-diverging
                    nif
                    lineages are members capable of free-living nitrogen fixation, supporting the interpretation that this lifestyle is ancestral. The Nod factor-dependent symbiotic lineages are polyphyletic, with our data supporting at least three independent origins via horizontal acquisition of symbiosis islands. This evolutionary history is reflected in a genomic dichotomy: lineages capable of free-living nitrogen fixation possess a conserved
                    nif
                    island architecture that consistently includes the oxygen-protective gene
                    glbO
                    , whereas the symbiotic
                    nif
                    -associated regions are highly variable and universally lack
                    glbO
                    . Using both loss-of-function and gain-of-function genetic approaches, we show that
                    glbO
                    contributes significantly to nitrogenase activity under free-living conditions, whereas it is dispensable within the protected nodule environment. This work provides a framework for the evolution of nitrogen-fixing symbiosis, supporting the view that free-living nitrogen-fixing ancestors gave rise repeatedly and independently to symbiotic lineages in
                    Bradyrhizobium
                    .
