title: Simultaneous optimization of lignocellulosic sugar catabolism via systematic laboratory evolution under complex selection pressure
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Efficient co-utilization of hexose and pentose sugars from lignocellulose is essential for microbial bioconversion, yet engineered catabolic pathways can be unstable or suboptimal in complex resource environments. Here, we use a Pseudomonas putida strain engineered to catabolize xylose and arabinose to examine how resource abundance, temporal availability, and subculturing shape evolutionary outcomes. Using an automated adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE) platform, we evolve the strain under simple single-substrate and complex multi-substrate selection pressures. These environments drive divergence between catabolic specialists and generalists. Weak or absent selection for xylose frequently leads to loss of xylose catabolism, whereas carbon-limited mixed-sugar environments promote stable retention and coordinated optimization of multiple catabolic pathways, enhancing growth and substrate utilization. Genomic, proteomic, and biochemical analyses show that pathway-specific fitness costs determine evolutionary stability. A generalist clone also shows improved indigoidine production from mixed sugars relative to the parental strain. Together, these findings show how resource dynamics shape fitness landscapes that govern catabolic specialization, generalization, evolutionary trade-offs, and engineering of bioconversion.
title_zh: 在复杂选择压力下通过系统实验室进化同时优化木质纤维素糖分解代谢
abstract_zh: 来自木质纤维素的己糖和戊糖的有效共同利用对于微生物生物转化至关重要，但工程分解代谢途径在复杂的资源环境中可能不稳定或次优。在这里，我们使用设计用于分解木糖和阿拉伯糖的恶臭假单胞菌菌株来研究资源丰度、时间可用性和传代培养如何影响进化结果。使用自动自适应实验室进化（ALE）平台，我们在简单的单基质和复杂的多基质选择压力下进化菌株。这些环境导致了分解代谢专家和通才之间的分歧。对木糖的选择弱或不存在常常导致木糖分解代谢的丧失，而碳限制的混合糖环境促进多种分解代谢途径的稳定保留和协调优化，从而增强生长和底物利用率。基因组、蛋白质组和生化分析表明，路径特异性的适应成本决定了进化的稳定性。与亲本菌株相比，通才克隆还显示出混合糖的靛蓝啶产量有所提高。总之，这些发现表明资源动态如何塑造适应分解代谢专业化、泛化、进化权衡和生物转化工程的适应度景观。

title: Distinct differentiation trajectories leave lasting impacts on gene regulation and function of V2a neurons
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: V2a interneurons are excitatory neurons found throughout the hindbrain and spinal cord, two regions that arise from distinct progenitors during embryonic development. Whether this lineage difference shapes mature gene regulation and function is unknown. V2a neurons show plasticity after spinal cord injury and are candidates for cell therapy. We differentiated human stem cells into V2a neurons through hindbrain- and spinal cord-like progenitor routes and profiled them by single nucleus multiomic sequencing. The two lineages showed distinct transcription factor motif enrichment and differentially expressed genes governing axon growth and calcium handling. Inducing V2a transcription factors directly, bypassing developmental patterning, produced a population unlike either lineage, confirming progenitor history is not interchangeable. Using CellOracle and lentiviral knockdown, we identified CREB5 and TCF7L2 as regulators specific to the spinal-like lineage. These results show that progenitor origin shapes V2a identity and reveal new regulators of neural diversity along the anterior-posterior axis.
title_zh: 不同的分化轨迹对 V2a 神经元的基因调控和功能产生持久影响
abstract_zh: V2a 中间神经元是在后脑和脊髓中发现的兴奋性神经元，这两个区域在胚胎发育过程中由不同的祖细胞产生。这种谱系差异是否影响成熟的基因调控和功能尚不清楚。 V2a 神经元在脊髓损伤后表现出可塑性，是细胞治疗的候选者。我们通过后脑和脊髓样祖细胞途径将人类干细胞分化为 V2a 神经元，并通过单核多组学测序对其进行分析。这两个谱系显示出不同的转录因子基序富集和控制轴突生长和钙处理的差异表达基因。直接诱导 V2a 转录因子，绕过发育模式，产生了与任一谱系不同的群体，证实了祖细胞历史是不可互换的。使用 CellOracle 和慢病毒敲低，我们确定 CREB5 和 TCF7L2 是脊髓样谱系的特异性调节因子。这些结果表明，祖细胞起源塑造了 V2a 身份，并揭示了沿前后轴神经多样性的新调节因子。

title: Near-atomic in situ architecture and membrane-coupled dynamics of the Vibrio cholerae sheathed flagellum
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The sheathed flagellum of Vibrio cholerae is a self-assembling membranous organelle that coordinates flagellar assembly, sheath biogenesis, and rapid rotation. Here, we determine in-situ near-atomic structures of the sheathed flagellar motor within intact cells. The motor anchors to the outer membrane through lipidated HL-rings without forming a membrane pore, thereby enabling flagellar assembly to drive sheath formation. Conserved LP-rings function as slide-rotary bushings, permitting high-speed rotation within the bacterial envelope while retaining the ability to constrict and seal the lumen upon flagellar ejection. We further show that stator activation depends on a specific protein-protein interaction rather than peptidoglycan engagement. Together, these findings reveal how the distinctive architecture and dynamics of the sheathed flagellum support V. cholerae motility, environmental survival, and persistent colonization of the human gut.
title_zh: 霍乱弧菌鞘鞭毛的近原子原位结构和膜耦合动力学
abstract_zh: 霍乱弧菌的鞘鞭毛是一种自组装膜细胞器，协调鞭毛组装、鞘生物发生和快速旋转。在这里，我们确定了完整细胞内鞘鞭毛运动的原位近原子结构。马达通过脂化 HL 环锚定到外膜，而不形成膜孔，从而使鞭毛组装能够驱动鞘膜形成。保守的 LP 环起到滑动旋转衬套的作用，允许在细菌包膜内高速旋转，同时保留鞭毛喷射时收缩和密封管腔的能力。我们进一步表明，定子激活取决于特定的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，而不是肽聚糖的结合。总之，这些发现揭示了带鞘鞭毛的独特结构和动力学如何支持霍乱弧菌的运动、环境生存和人类肠道的持续定植。

title: Nanopore sequencing identifies parent-of-origin specific age-associated methylation changes at imprinted loci in the human genome
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Aging is accompanied by widespread DNA methylation changes, yet their full genomic scope and parent-of-origin dynamics remain poorly understood. Here, we apply nanopore long-read sequencing to 7,284 whole blood samples enabling methylation measurements of 17,959,684 high-quality CpG units. Over 20% of the measured high quality CpG units undergo age-associated changes, predominantly hypomethylation. From these data, we construct a methylation aging clock from 1,373 high-quality CpG units, with median absolute prediction error of 2.43 years. Importantly, phasing the methylation to parental haplotypes enables systematic analysis of age effects in parent-of-origin specific context, uncovering 702 high-quality CpG units with parent-of-origin specific age-association, most of which are located at imprinted genomic regions. At the DIRAS3 locus, we detect age-dependent hypermethylation on the active paternal allele, indicative of attenuation of parent-of-origin specific methylation with age. Together, these findings establish nanopore sequencing as a powerful tool for mapping both genome-wide and parent-of-origin specific signatures of methylation aging and provide evidence that methylation patterns at imprinted loci become progressively altered with age.
title_zh: 纳米孔测序识别人类基因组印记位点上亲本特定的年龄相关甲基化变化
abstract_zh: 衰老伴随着广泛的 DNA 甲基化变化，但其完整的基因组范围和亲本动态仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们对 7,284 个全血样本应用纳米孔长读长测序，从而对 17,959,684 个高质量 CpG 单位进行甲基化测量。超过 20% 的测量高质量 CpG 单位经历了与年龄相关的变化，主要是低甲基化。根据这些数据，我们从 1,373 个高质量 CpG 单元构建了甲基化衰老时钟，中位绝对预测误差为 2.43 年。重要的是，将甲基化定相到亲本单倍型可以系统地分析亲本特定背景下的年龄效应，发现 702 个具有亲本特定年龄关联的高质量 CpG 单位，其中大部分位于印记基因组区域。在 DIRAS3 位点，我们检测到活性父本等位基因上年龄依赖性的高甲基化，表明亲本特异性甲基化随着年龄的增长而减弱。总之，这些发现确立了纳米孔测序作为绘制全基因组和亲本甲基化老化特征的强大工具，并提供了印记位点的甲基化模式随着年龄逐渐改变的证据。

title: Single-cell profiling of natural killer/T-cell lymphoma reveals stratified immune features and potential therapeutic implications
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Tumor cell heterogeneity and interactions with the immune microenvironment play a key role in the progression and therapeutic efficacy of natural killer/T-cell lymphoma (NKTCL). We perform single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of 63 samples, integrating spatial transcriptomics, bulk transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics to dissect inter- and intra-tumoral heterogeneity. Four meta-programs (MP) are identified, including MP1 (immune-responsive), MP2 (proliferative), MP3 (inflammatory), and MP4 (metabolic), each linked to distinct molecular and immune features. MP1 exhibits an immune-exhausted tumor microenvironment and high programmed death-ligand 1 expression, suggesting a potential response to immune checkpoint blockade. MP2 shows an immune-desert phenotype with elevated HDAC2 and MKI67 expression, indicating epigenetic regulation in tumor proliferation. MP3 is characterized by a myeloid-dominant tumor microenvironment, JAK/STAT pathway activation, and an aggressive clinical course. MP4 exhibits a distinct amino acid metabolic profile and enriched tertiary lymphoid structures. Collectively, our study provides a high-resolution molecular atlas of NKTCL heterogeneity, offering insights into patient stratification and potential avenues for future therapeutic development.
title_zh: 自然杀伤/T 细胞淋巴瘤的单细胞分析揭示了分层免疫特征和潜在的治疗意义
abstract_zh: 肿瘤细胞异质性以及与免疫微环境的相互作用在自然杀伤/T细胞淋巴瘤（NKTCL）的进展和治疗效果中发挥着关键作用。我们对 63 个样本进行单细胞 RNA 测序分析，整合空间转录组学、批量转录组学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学，以剖析肿瘤间和肿瘤内的异质性。确定了四种元程序 (MP)，包括 MP1（免疫反应性）、MP2（增殖性）、MP3（炎症性）和 MP4（代谢性），每个元程序都与不同的分子和免疫特征相关。 MP1 表现出免疫衰竭的肿瘤微环境和高程序性死亡配体 1 表达，表明对免疫检查点阻断有潜在反应。 MP2 显示出免疫沙漠表型，HDAC2 和 MKI67 表达升高，表明肿瘤增殖中的表观遗传调控。 MP3 的特点是髓系肿瘤微环境、JAK/STAT 通路激活和侵袭性临床病程。 MP4 表现出独特的氨基酸代谢特征和丰富的三级淋巴结构。总的来说，我们的研究提供了 NKTCL 异质性的高分辨率分子图谱，为患者分层和未来治疗开发的潜在途径提供了见解。

title: An RNase domain-dependent microRNA detection with DNA-spiked nanocage for accurate cancer diagnosis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cancer-associated microRNAs are promising biomarkers for early cancer diagnosis. However, current microRNA detections – which are based on polymerase chain reaction, microarray analysis, Raman scattering, or various electrochemical assays – rely on multi-step analysis including amplification of microRNA and/or read-out signals, often causing inaccuracy despite using elaborate instruments, which remains a major challenge. Here, we describe an RNaseH1-dependent, amplification-free detection of microRNAs, which is based on Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) between donor (single-stranded DNA probe (ssDNA)-spiked, green fluorescent nanocage) and acceptor (RNaseH1-linked, orange fluorescent protein) and enables reliable cancer diagnosis with high accuracy for human lung and gastric cancer patients and healthy donors by directly quantifying serum microRNA targets. Notably, unlike traditional ensemble FRET, this FRET platform senses molecular interactions between ssDNA and miRNAs and conformational changes of their hybrid helices and thus differentiates even a single-base mismatch, which holds significant promise for reliable, clinical cancer diagnosis.
title_zh: 利用掺有 DNA 的纳米笼进行 RNase 结构域依赖性 microRNA 检测，以实现准确的癌症诊断
abstract_zh: 癌症相关的 microRNA 是用于早期癌症诊断的有前途的生物标志物。然而，当前的 microRNA 检测基于聚合酶链反应、微阵列分析、拉曼散射或各种电化学测定，依赖于多步骤分析，包括 microRNA 和/或读出信号的放大，尽管使用精密仪器，但通常会导致不准确，这仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们描述了一种依赖于 RNaseH1 的、无扩增的 microRNA 检测，该检测基于供体（单链 DNA 探针 (ssDNA) 尖峰的绿色荧光纳米笼）和受体（RNaseH1 连接的橙色荧光蛋白）之间的 Förster 共振能量转移（FRET），并通过直接定量血清 microRNA 靶标，为人类肺癌和胃癌患者以及健康供体提供可靠、高精度的癌症诊断。值得注意的是，与传统的整体 FRET 不同，该 FRET 平台可感知 ssDNA 和 miRNA 之间的分子相互作用以及其混合螺旋的构象变化，从而区分单碱基错配，这为可靠的临床癌症诊断带来了重要前景。

title: Health and economic impacts of improved air quality from transitioning global shipping energy to hydrogen
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Hydrogen energy is critical for decarbonizing the hard-to-electrify shipping sector and improving air quality. However, the associated health and economic co-benefits remain unclear. Here we assess the health and economic impacts of feasible hydrogen transition scenarios in global shipping using an integrated emission-air quality-health modeling framework. Our results show that hydrogen adoption could avert approximately 129,500 (95% confidence interval: 68,300–202,200) premature mortalities annually—75% attributable to ozone (O3) concentration reduction and 25% attributable to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) decline—with the greatest O3-attributable health gains in Southern Asia and PM2.5-attributable gains in Eastern Asia. These health benefits are estimated to save an economic cost of approximately US$306 billion (US$146–488 billion), with India, Japan and the United States of America receiving the largest economic benefit. The findings highlight the potential of hydrogen-based shipping decarbonization to deliver substantial public health and economic co-benefits.
title_zh: 全球航运能源转向氢能改善空气质量对健康和经济的影响
abstract_zh: 氢能对于难以实现电气化的航运业脱碳和改善空气质量至关重要。然而，相关的健康和经济协同效益仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用综合排放-空气质量-健康建模框架评估全球航运中可行的氢转型情景对健康和经济的影响。我们的研究结果表明，采用氢气每年可避免约 129,500 例（95% 置信区间：68,300-202,200）例过早死亡，其中 75% 归因于臭氧 (O3) 浓度降低，25% 归因于细颗粒物 (PM2.5) 下降，其中 O3 带来的健康收益最大的是南亚，PM2.5 带来的健康收益最大的是东亚。这些健康效益预计可节省约 3060 亿美元（146-4880 亿美元）的经济成本，其中印度、日本和美国获得的经济收益最大。研究结果强调了基于氢的航运脱碳在带来巨大的公共健康和经济协同效益方面的潜力。

title: Improving flood detection with large-scale dashboard camera data
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Flooding poses a significant and growing challenge globally, threatening infrastructure, livelihoods, and public safety. However, current methods for detecting floods are limited in their spatiotemporal granularity and inequitable in their coverage. Here, we propose BayFlood, a method for fine-grained urban flood detection that identifies flooded street scenes in large-scale dashboard camera datasets using a vision-language model. We leverage the ability of modern vision-language models to identify floods even without large labeled datasets, which are typically unavailable. We comprehensively validate our approach using 1,440,184 images, showing that our model provides strong signal for floods across multiple cities and time periods and that our flood detections correlate with known external predictors of flood risk. We show our approach can be used to improve flood detection in New York City: our analysis detects floods in neighborhoods overlooked by current methods, identifies demographic biases in existing methods, and suggests locations for new flood sensors. This work underscores the potential of leveraging dense street-level imagery to significantly improve the understanding, detection, and management of flooding, and is more broadly applicable to detecting other objects and incidents from street scene data even when no labeled data is available.
title_zh: 利用大规模行车记录仪数据改进洪水检测
abstract_zh: 洪水在全球范围内构成了日益严峻的挑战，威胁着基础设施、生计和公共安全。然而，当前的洪水检测方法在时空粒度上受到限制，并且覆盖范围不公平。在这里，我们提出了 BayFlood，一种细粒度的城市洪水检测方法，可使用视觉语言模型识别大规模仪表板摄像机数据集中被洪水淹没的街道场景。我们利用现代视觉语言模型的能力来识别洪水，即使没有大型标记数据集（通常不可用）。我们使用 1,440,184 张图像全面验证了我们的方法，表明我们的模型为多个城市和时间段的洪水提供了强烈的信号，并且我们的洪水检测与已知的洪水风险外部预测因素相关。我们展示了我们的方法可用于改善纽约市的洪水检测：我们的分析检测到当前方法忽视的社区中的洪水，识别现有方法中的人口统计偏差，并建议新洪水传感器的位置。这项工作强调了利用密集街道图像来显着提高对洪水的理解、检测和管理的潜力，并且更广泛地适用于从街道场景数据中检测其他物体和事件，即使没有可用的标记数据。

title: Hybrid bioelectrochemical process enables hierarchical C, N, and P utilization towards negative carbon emission wastewater treatment
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Bioelectrochemical system (BES) can provide sustainable solutions for wastewater treatment through lower energy consumption, reduced carbon emissions, and nutrient capture and reuse. Herein, we propose a hybrid bioelectrochemical assembly (HBA)-centered purification-power-cultivation process to achieve hierarchical C, N, and P metabolism, graded power generation, and reusable water production. The hybridization of abiotic and biotic cathode BESs in HBA enables hierarchical C metabolism, with effluent COD directly meeting the Class Ⅲ surface water standard. The customized water-permeable biofilm separators sequentially create anaerobic-anoxic-aerobic zones within HBA, enabling complete N removal. Subsequently, the P-rich tailwater of HBA is channelled into a hydroponic irrigation system for P utilization, ultimately producing reusable clean water. Notably, a high power density of 0.43 W m–2 is obtained, and this process achieves a net carbon emission of –0.413 kg-CO2 m–3. This study presents a prototype for sustainable wastewater purification, particularly in low-resource areas with carbon emission reduction and carbon neutrality targets.
title_zh: 混合生物电化学工艺可实现碳、氮、磷的分级利用，实现负碳排放废水处理
abstract_zh: 生物电化学系统（BES）可以通过降低能耗、减少碳排放以及营养物捕获和再利用，为废水处理提供可持续的解决方案。在此，我们提出了一种以混合生物电化学组装（HBA）为中心的净化-发电-培养过程，以实现分级C、N和P代谢、分级发电和可重复使用的水生产。 HBA中非生物和生物阴极BES的混合可实现分级C代谢，出水COD直接满足地表水Ⅲ类标准。定制的透水生物膜分离器在 HBA 内依次创建厌氧-缺氧-好氧区域，从而实现完全脱氮。随后，HBA富含磷的尾水被引入水培灌溉系统进行磷利用，最终产生可重复使用的清洁水。值得注意的是，获得了0.43 W m–2的高功率密度，并且该过程实现了–0.413 kg-CO2 m–3的净碳排放。这项研究提出了可持续废水净化的原型，特别是在具有碳减排和碳中和目标的资源匮乏地区。

title: Fast interlayer exciton drift driven by lattice reconstruction in a van der Waals heterobilayer
source: Nature Materials
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Modern short-scale information transmission mainly relies on dissipative charge transport, with electrons scattered by defects and phonons, leading to significant power losses. By contrast, excitons—charge-neutral quasiparticles—offer a playground for electro-optical energy-efficient information transduction and processing owing to their extended lifetimes, charge neutrality and efficient electrostatic control. In this work, we report the observation of fast exciton transport in a van der Waals heterostructure over distances exceeding 10 µm, constrained only by the heterostructure finite size. We observe the presence of excitonic potential ramps that leads to long-range rapid exciton drift and enables rapid dilution of the initial exciton population. Our measurements reveal fast exciton propagation, with interlayer exciton drift velocities of approximately 2.66 × 10
                    4
                     m s
                    −1
                    , within a transport regime that remains robust across a wide range of exciton densities and temperatures up to 150 K. Our work opens avenues for the development of high-speed, energy-efficient excitonic devices, such as field-effect switches and modulators.
title_zh: 范德华异双层中晶格重建驱动的快速层间激子漂移
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  
                    现代短尺度信息传输主要依赖于耗散电荷传输，电子因缺陷和声子而散射，导致显着的功率损耗。相比之下，激子（电荷中性准粒子）由于其延长的寿命、电荷中性和高效的静电控制，为电光节能信息转换和处理提供了一个平台。在这项工作中，我们报告了范德华异质结构中激子快速传输的观察结果，距离超过 10μm，仅受异质结构有限尺寸的限制。我们观察到激子势斜坡的存在导致长程快速激子漂移并能够快速稀释初始激子群体。我们的测量揭示了激子的快速传播，层间激子漂移速度约为 2.66 × 10
                    4
                     米 秒
                    −1
                    ，在一个广泛的激子密度和高达 150 K 的温度范围内保持稳健的输运机制。我们的工作为开发高速、节能的激子器件（例如场效应开关和调制器）开辟了道路。

title: Coupled and decoupled carbon-mercury dynamics across forest ecosystem continua
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Carbon sustains life, whereas mercury is a global toxin, yet their cycling in forests appears to be intimately linked. Here we show, using elemental stoichiometry, carbon and mercury isotopes and a global forest synthesis, that forests simultaneously couple and decouple mercury from carbon along contrasting ecosystem continua. Mercury/carbon ratios remain tightly conserved (0.5–0.9 × 10−6) along the aqueous-phase continuum, indicating proportional mercury transport with dissolved organic carbon. In comparison, mercury/carbon ratios increase by nearly three orders of magnitude from the atmosphere to soils (0.007–3.6 × 10−6) along the solid-phase continuum, reflecting progressive mercury enrichment during litter and soil organic matter decomposition. Standing litter acts concurrently as a net carbon source and mercury sink, whereas biomass regulates coupled carbon and mercury storage and litterfall deposition. These contrasting carbon-mercury trajectories reveal how forests both retain and redistribute atmospheric mercury and provide a conceptual framework for understanding terrestrial mercury cycling under environmental change.
title_zh: 整个森林生态系统连续体的耦合和解耦碳汞动态
abstract_zh: 碳维持生命，而汞是一种全球性毒素，但它们在森林中的循环似乎密切相关。在这里，我们利用元素化学计量、碳和汞同位素以及全球森林合成表明，森林沿着对比的生态系统连续体同时将汞与碳耦合和分离。汞/碳比率沿着水相连续体保持严格守恒（0.5–0.9 × 10−6），表明汞与溶解的有机碳成比例迁移。相比之下，沿着固相连续体，从大气到土壤的汞/碳比率增加了近三个数量级（0.007–3.6 × 10−6），反映了凋落物和土壤有机质分解过程中汞的逐渐富集。直立的枯枝落叶同时充当净碳源和汞汇，而生物质则调节耦合的碳和汞储存以及凋落物沉积。这些对比鲜明的碳-汞轨迹揭示了森林如何保留和重新分配大气汞，并为理解环境变化下的陆地汞循环提供了概念框架。

title: Active conformations of neuronal Na+, K+-ATPase isoforms and a disease-causing mutant
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Na+,K+-ATPases establish and maintain the vital electrochemical gradients for Na+ and K+ across animal cell membranes. The protein is a ternary complex composed of α, β and FXYD subunits, of which isoforms that fine-tune transport properties are expressed in a tissue-specific fashion. Here we report cryo-EM structures under active ATPase turn-over conditions of the ubiquitously expressed human α1β1FXYD1 and neuron-specific α3β1FXYD1 isoform complexes and probe their specific functional and biophysical properties. The data provides an extensive insight into Na+-transport of ATP-activated enzyme through four distinct conformational states, including a sodium-bound phosphoenzyme intermediate, denoted [Na3]E2P. This conformation reveals a crucial structural change that precedes Na+ release in the inward to outward (E1P-E2P) transition, within the general context of the sequential, active transport mechanism. We discuss the mechanism of the physiologically important differentiation in Na+ affinity of α3 compared to α1, the co-operative Na+ binding at the ion-binding sites, and the mechanistic aspects of cytoplasmic ion gating and extracellular Na+ release. Finally we present the structures of a disease-causing mutant form of α3, associated with Alternating Hemiplegia of Childhood (Q140L). The mutation compromises a specific phospholipid-binding pocket and impedes polyunsaturated phospholipid-mediated stimulation of Na+,K+-ATPase activity.
title_zh: 神经元 Na+、K+-ATP 酶亚型和致病突变体的活性构象
abstract_zh: Na+、K+-ATP 酶建立并维持跨动物细胞膜的重要的 Na+ 和 K+ 电化学梯度。该蛋白质是由 α、β 和 FXYD 亚基组成的三元复合物，其中微调转运特性的亚型以组织特异性方式表达。在这里，我们报告了普遍表达的人类α1β1FXYD1和神经元特异性α3β1FXYD1亚型复合物在活性ATP酶转换条件下的冷冻电镜结构，并探讨了它们的特定功能和生物物理特性。这些数据提供了对 ATP 激活酶通过四种不同构象状态的 Na+ 转运的广泛了解，包括钠结合的磷酸酶中间体，表示为 [Na3]E2P。这种构象揭示了在顺序主动转运机制的一般背景下，在从内到外（E1P-E2P）转变中Na+释放之前的关键结构变化。我们讨论了 α3 与 α1 相比，Na+ 亲和力在生理上的重要差异机制、离子结合位点的协同 Na+ 结合，以及细胞质离子门控和细胞外 Na+ 释放的机制。最后，我们提出了与儿童交替性偏瘫 (Q140L) 相关的致病突变形式 α3 的结构。该突变损害了特定的磷脂结合袋，并阻碍多不饱和磷脂介导的 Na+,K+-ATP 酶活性刺激。

title: Reservation policies and equity in national park access
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: National parks are experiencing unprecedented demand. High use strains infrastructure, damages ecosystems and reduces visitor enjoyment. To sustainably manage visitation, many parks now require reservations, raising concerns about equity. We quantify the effects of two reservation system features, advance purchase windows and competition for permits, on visitor income at seven national parks. Both effects disproportionately favor higher-income users. In the most competitive day-ahead and advance markets, reservation holders come from zip codes with 3–5% higher median household income. Extending the advance purchase window to six months shifts reservations toward users residing in zip codes with 5% higher income. Robustness checks imply individual effects of the same direction. This underscores a key challenge for park managers: designing reservation systems that protect resources while ensuring broad access. Without attention to distributional impacts, efforts to control crowding risk exacerbating income-based disparities in who can visit and enjoy the nation’s public lands.
title_zh: 国家公园准入的保留政策和公平性
abstract_zh: 国家公园正经历着前所未有的需求。高使用率会给基础设施带来压力，破坏生态系统并降低游客的享受。为了可持续地管理游客数量，许多公园现在都需要预订，这引发了人们对公平性的担忧。我们量化了两个预订系统功能（提前购买窗口和许可证竞争）对七个国家公园游客收入的影响。这两种效应都特别有利于高收入用户。在竞争最激烈的日前和提前市场中，预订持有者来自家庭收入中位数高出 3-5% 的邮政编码。将预购窗口延长至六个月，可将预订转移到居住在收入高出 5% 的邮政编码地区的用户。稳健性检查意味着同一方向的个体影响。这凸显了公园管理者面临的一个关键挑战：设计保护资源的预订系统，同时确保广泛的访问。如果不关注分配影响，控制拥挤的努力可能会加剧谁可以参观和享受国家公共土地的收入差距。

title: Miniaturizing and modifying natural proteins with Raygun
source: Nature
abstract: Proteins have evolved over billions of years through coordinated substitutions, insertions and deletions, yet computational protein design cannot fully replicate nature's ability to engineer new proteins from existing templates. Protein language models1-3 generate informative per-residue representations, but harnessing them for large-scale, function-preserving sequence modifications has remained beyond reach. Here we introduce Raygun, a generative artificial intelligence framework that enables miniaturization, modification and augmentation of proteins, using a probabilistic encoding of protein sequences constructed from language model embeddings. Our key conceptual advance is to encode each protein not as a sequence of variable length in high-dimensional space, but as a probability distribution in fixed dimensions, making proteins of any length directly commensurable. Controlled by just two parameters governing substitutions and length changes, Raygun can shrink proteins by 10-25% (sometimes more than 50%), expand them beyond their natural size, and introduce extensive sequence diversity, all while preserving predicted structural integrity and functional sites. In cell-based validation, Raygun miniaturized fluorescent proteins (2 shorter than 96% of fluorescent proteins in FPbase) and TurboID, a synthetic biotin ligase that has been widely adopted for proteomics. It also expanded epidermal growth factor (EGF), generating variants with higher EGFR-binding affinity than the wild type. These results show that protein function can be faithfully captured in a length-agnostic representation, enabling the kind of coordinated, large-scale sequence modifications that characterize natural protein evolution.
title_zh: 使用 Raygun 微型化和修饰天然蛋白质
abstract_zh: 蛋白质通过协调的替换、插入和删除已经进化了数十亿年，但计算蛋白质设计无法完全复制自然界从现有模板设计新蛋白质的能力。蛋白质语言模型1-3生成信息丰富的每个残基表示，但利用它们进行大规模、功能保留的序列修饰仍然遥不可及。在这里，我们介绍 Raygun，一种生成人工智能框架，它使用从语言模型嵌入构建的蛋白质序列的概率编码来实现蛋白质的小型化、修改和增强。我们的关键概念进展是将每个蛋白质编码为固定维度中的概率分布，而不是高维空间中可变长度的序列，从而使任何长度的蛋白质都可直接通约。 Raygun 仅受两个控制取代和长度变化的参数控制，可以将蛋白质缩小 10-25%（有时超过 50%），将其扩展至超出其自然大小，并引入广泛的序列多样性，同时保留预测的结构完整性和功能位点。在基于细胞的验证中，Raygun 小型化了荧光蛋白（2 比 FPbase 中 96% 的荧光蛋白短）和 TurboID（一种已广泛应用于蛋白质组学的合成生物素连接酶）。它还扩展了表皮生长因子 (EGF)，产生了比野生型具有更高 EGFR 结合亲和力的变体。这些结果表明，可以在与长度无关的重复中忠实地捕获蛋白质功能

title: High-entropy photocatalyst enabling collaborative cascade C–N coupling for converting benzyl alcohol to imine
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The selective conversion of biomass-derived alcohols to nitrogen-containing organic chemicals, such as the highly valuable imine, is a significant challenge due to the complex tandem process of C–N coupling and multiple reaction pathways. The photocatalytic coupling of biomass-derived alcohols with NH3 using renewable energy offers a sustainable way to produce imines, but requires the development of suitable photocatalysts. In this work, we present a promising high-entropy sulfide photocatalyst (NiSnCaZnInS) with integrated multifunctional sites. Using benzyl alcohol (BA) as an example, we achieved an imine yield of 1240 μmol gcat−1" role="presentation">gcat−1{{\mbox{g}}}_{{\mbox{cat}}}^{-1} for 5 hours, with a selectivity of 91.7%. The photocatalytic performance can be attributed to the special configuration of the high-entropy surface, which provides ideal catalytic sites for the cascade coupling reaction. This work highlights the great potential of high-entropy materials in photocatalytic reactions, providing a sustainable and effective approach to the photocatalytic conversion of biomass derivatives into valuable chemicals.
title_zh: 高熵光催化剂可实现协同级联 C-N 耦合，将苯甲醇转化为亚胺
abstract_zh: 由于 C-N 偶联的复杂串联过程和多种反应途径，将生物质衍生的醇选择性转化为含氮有机化学品（例如高价值的亚胺）是一项重大挑战。利用可再生能源将生物质衍生的醇与 NH3 进行光催化耦合提供了一种可持续的亚胺生产方法，但需要开发合适的光催化剂。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种具有集成多功能位点的有前途的高熵硫化物光催化剂（NiSnCaZnInS）。以苯甲醇（BA）为例，我们在5小时内实现了1240 μmol gcat−1" role="presentation">gcat−1{{\mbox{g}}}_{{\mbox{cat}}}^{-1}的亚胺收率，选择性为91.7%。光催化性能可归因于高熵表面的特殊构型，为级联偶联反应提供了理想的催化位点。突出了高熵材料在光催化反应中的巨大潜力，为将生物质衍生物光催化转化为有价值的化学品提供了一种可持续且有效的方法。

title: Casimir stabilization of fluctuating electronic nematic order
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The field of vacuum cavity control of quantum materials aims to engineer quantum materials through electromagnetic zero-point fluctuations. In this work we articulate and theoretically study a generic mechanism for vacuum control of electronic order: Casimir control, where a fluctuating phase is stabilized by minimizing the zero-point energy of the surrounding electromagnetic continuum. We focus on the Casimir stabilization of fluctuating nematic order, where local order develops but thermal fluctuations inhibit long-range order. As a concrete example, we stabilize fluctuating quantum Hall stripes by leveraging the anisotropic electromagnetic environment of a birefringent crystal. We show that for experimentally feasible setups, an orientation-dependent Casimir energy emerges which can be 103 times larger than other known stabilization mechanisms, implying that our setting may be realized with currently available technology. We close by discussing connections to recent quantum Hall stripes experiments, as well as broader applications of Casimir control.
title_zh: 波动电子向列序的卡西米尔稳定性
abstract_zh: 量子材料真空腔控制领域旨在通过电磁零点涨落来工程化量子材料。在这项工作中，我们阐明并从理论上研究了电子顺序真空控制的通用机制：卡西米尔控制，其中通过最小化周围电磁连续体的零点能量来稳定波动相位。我们关注波动向列序的卡西米尔稳定性，其中局部有序发展，但热波动抑制长程有序。作为一个具体的例子，我们通过利用双折射晶体的各向异性电磁环境来稳定波动的量子霍尔条纹。我们表明，对于实验上可行的设置，会出现一种与方向相关的卡西米尔能量，其比其他已知的稳定机制大 103 倍，这意味着我们的设置可以通过当前可用的技术来实现。我们最后讨论了与最近的量子霍尔条纹实验的联系，以及卡西米尔控制的更广泛的应用。

title: Broadband encoding and high-speed probabilistic bit generation with integrated microwave neurons
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Intelligence at high data rates depends on extracting meaning as information arrives. Although radio signals are analog, most systems digitize them before feature extraction, adding latency and power overhead while limiting processing speed to digital clock rates. Instead, we find that incoming data can itself reprogram coupling between frequency modes in an ensemble of microwave waveguides, encoding spectral features across several gigahertz. This milliwatt-scale Microwave Neural Network (MNN), manufactured in Complementary-Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) technology, expresses data tokens across a spread spectrum, making relationships between successive tokens easier to detect and enabling faster downstream decisions with lightweight digital processing. We also find that gigabit-per-second bitstreams, like 8-bit pixel data, drive the MNN to produce probabilistic bits whose bias reflects the input pattern. This analog dithering preserves detail in compressed data, potentially enabling richer satellite imaging at one-eighth the bit-rate under bandwidth constraints.
title_zh: 具有集成微波神经元的宽带编码和高速概率位生成
abstract_zh: 高数据速率下的智能取决于信息到达时提取含义。尽管无线电信号是模拟信号，但大多数系统在特征提取之前将其数字化，增加了延迟和功率开销，同时限制了数字时钟速率的处理速度。相反，我们发现输入数据本身可以重新编程微波波导集合中频率模式之间的耦合，编码跨几个千兆赫的光谱特征。这种毫瓦级微波神经网络 (MNN) 采用互补金属氧化物半导体 (CMOS) 技术制造，可在扩频范围内表达数据令牌，使连续令牌之间的关系更容易检测，并通过轻量级数字处理实现更快的下游决策。我们还发现每秒千兆位的比特流，如 8 位像素数据，驱动 MNN 产生概率位，其偏差反映了输入模式。这种模拟抖动保留了压缩数据中的细节，有可能在带宽限制下以八分之一的比特率实现更丰富的卫星成像。

title: Breaking the activity-stability trade-off via dual-mechanism induced by rare earths for lasting seawater electrolysis
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Triggering the adsorbate evolution and lattice oxygen mechanisms coupled path holds promise for overcoming the activity-stability trade-off of oxygen evolution reaction (OER). However, achieving precise regulation and activation of multiple OER pathways via 3d-metal modification strategy remains challenging due to the external effects of crystal fields and coordination environments. Herein, we propose an atomic-dispersed rare earth substitution strategy to construct a spatially partitioned reaction mechanism, and achieve dual activation between adsorbate evolution and lattice oxygen mechanisms. The strong shielding effect of 5 s/5p electrons in RE significantly reduces the influence of the external environment on the 4 f orbitals, thereby enhancing the controllability of the reaction pathway. The optimized Sm-NiMoO4 exhibits favorable OER performance. At an industrial temperature of 70 °C, the OER in simulated seawater exhibits an overpotential of only 214 mV at 0.5 A cm−2, while maintaining stability for 1500 h. Preliminary techno-economic analysis reveals that the cost of hydrogen produced from the Sm-NiMoO4 is US$2.56 kg−1. This synthetic strategy and mechanism analysis represent a valuable contribution towards achieving industrial-scale seawater hydrogen production.
title_zh: 通过稀土引起的持久海水电解的双重机制打破活性与稳定性的权衡
abstract_zh: 触发吸附质演化和晶格氧机制耦合路径有望克服析氧反应（OER）的活性与稳定性之间的权衡。然而，由于晶体场和配位环境的外部影响，通过3d金属修饰策略实现多个OER途径的精确调控和激活仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了一种原子分散的稀土替代策略来构建空间分区的反应机制，并实现吸附质演化和晶格氧机制的双重激活。 RE中5 s/5p电子的强屏蔽作用显着降低了外界环境对4 f轨道的影响，从而增强了反应途径的可控性。优化后的 Sm-NiMoO4 表现出良好的 OER 性能。在 70 °C 的工业温度下，模拟海水中的 OER 在 0.5 A cm−2 下的过电势仅为 214 mV，同时保持稳定性 1500 小时。初步技术经济分析表明，Sm-NiMoO4 生产氢气的成本为 2.56 kg−1 美元。这种合成策略和机制分析为实现工业规模海水氢生产做出了宝贵贡献。

title: Bolstered Interfacial Field Chemistry for Deep Fast-Charging Aqueous Zinc Metal Batteries
source: Nano-Micro Letters
abstract: Deep fast-charging capability has become the core pursuit for practical applications of aqueous zinc metal batteries, yet it is critically impeded by unfavorable interfacial field evolution at the electrode/electrolyte interface under high-current–density conditions. The coexistence of sluggish Zn2+ desolvation, competitive H2O reduction corrosion, uneven electric field, and concentration field collectively leads to poor rate performance. To tackle these issues, a bolstered interfacial field chemistry strategy was developed via sulfosuccinic acid to precisely regulate the physicochemical and electrochemical properties within the inner Helmholtz plane. The tuned interfacial field comprises a homogeneous distribution of interfacial ions and electric fields, promoting fast desolvation and interfacial electron transfer. Consequently, the modified Zn||Cu asymmetric cells deliver an outstanding average Coulombic efficiency of 99.48% over 1600 cycles at 2 mA cm−2 and 1 mAh cm−2. Furthermore, the modified Zn||Zn symmetric cells demonstrate exceptional stability under challenging conditions of 5 mA cm−2, 2 mAh cm−2 (over 1600 h), and 10 mA cm−2, 10 mAh cm−2 (over 675 h, depth of discharge = 17.08%). Impressively, a substantial cumulative capacity of 3500 mAh cm−2 is attained at 10 mAh cm−2 and a 56.93% Zn utilization rate. Besides, the enhanced Zn (10 µm) ||I2 (10.87 mg cm−2) full cell sustains over 1490 cycles at 1 A g−1 with 77.13% capacity retention and a harsh N/P ratio of 2.31. Remarkably, the Zn (10 µm) ||I2 pouch cell achieves over 680 cycles with an ultralow N/P ratio of 2.04. Highlights:1 A sulfosuccinic acid-enabled interfacial field chemistry strategy is developed to regulate the inner Helmholtz plane, which homogenized ion/electric distribution, thus accelerating Zn2+ desolvation and charge transfer under high current density.2 This strategy enables superior reversibility and ultralong stability in Zn||Zn cells, simultaneously meeting the requirements of high current density and deep discharge.3 The optimized Zn (10 µm) ||I2 full cells deliver over 1490 cycles (N/P = 2.31) and 680 cycles in pouch cells (N/P = 2.04), respectively.
title_zh: 支持深度快速充电水系锌金属电池的界面场化学
abstract_zh: 深度快速充电能力已成为水系锌金属电池实际应用的核心追求，但高电流密度条件下电极/电解质界面上不利的界面场演化严重阻碍了它的发展。缓慢的Zn2+去溶剂化、竞争性H2O还原腐蚀、不均匀电场和浓度场的共存共同导致了较差的倍率性能。为了解决这些问题，通过磺基琥珀酸开发了一种增强的界面场化学策略，以精确调节亥姆霍兹平面内的物理化学和电化学特性。调谐的界面场包括均匀分布的界面离子和电场，促进快速去溶剂化和界面电子转移。因此，改进的 Zn||Cu 不对称电池在 2 mA cm−2 和 1 mAh cm−2 下经过 1600 次循环后，平均库仑效率达到 99.48%。此外，改进的Zn||Zn对称电池在5 mA cm−2、2 mAh cm−2（超过1600小时）和10 mA cm−2、10 mAh cm−2（超过675小时，放电深度= 17.08%）的挑战性条件下表现出优异的稳定性。令人印象深刻的是，在 10 mAh cm-2 和 56.93% 的锌利用率下获得了 3500 mAh cm-2 的实际累积容量。此外，增强型 Zn (10 µm) ||I2 (10.87 mg cm−2) 全电池在 1 A g−1 下可维持超过 1490 个循环，容量保持率为 77.13%，N/P 比为 2.31。值得注意的是，Zn (10 µm) ||I2 软包电池以 2.0 的超低 N/P 比实现了超过 680 个循环

title: The dynamic response of Pine Island Glacier to two decades of intermittent ice shelf regrounding
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Over the last few decades, ice keels have intermittently bumped against the bedrock underneath Pine Island Ice Shelf. In general, it is thought that this process, termed regrounding, could enhance buttressing and potentially slow glacier flow or arrest retreat. Here, we test this hypothesis for Pine Island Glacier. Using offset tracking applied to satellite radar data, we reveal an extensive history of regrounding on the central shelf since 2009. Combining Earth observation and ice sheet modelling, we assess the direct effects this might have had on ice dynamics and indirect effects via its influencing on calving behaviour. Our results show that regrounding caused little additional drag on the base of the ice shelf. Furthermore, it plausibly contributed to the promotion of calving between 2015 and 2020 which is, in turn, held largely responsible for the increase in flow rate of the glacier over the last decade.
title_zh: 松岛冰川对二十年间歇性冰架重新接地的动态响应
abstract_zh: 在过去的几十年里，冰龙骨间歇性地撞击松岛冰架下方的基岩。总的来说，人们认为这个被称为重新接地的过程可以增强支撑作用，并可能减缓冰川流动或阻止冰川退缩。在这里，我们针对松岛冰川检验这一假设。利用应用于卫星雷达数据的偏移跟踪，我们揭示了自 2009 年以来中央大陆架重新搁浅的广泛历史。结合地球观测和冰盖建模，我们评估了这可能对冰动力学产生的直接影响以及通过其对崩解行为的影响产生的间接影响。我们的结果表明，重新接地对冰架底部几乎没有造成额外的阻力。此外，它似乎有助于促进 2015 年至 2020 年冰川崩解，而这又是过去十年冰川流量增加的主要原因。

title: Staple crops as a key hub of biogeochemical mercury cycle across China
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Mercury (Hg) contamination threatens human health and ecological security. Plants play a critical role in regulating the global Hg cycle, yet how agricultural crops influence Hg transport remains elusive. Here we show that staple crops (i.e., wheat, rice, and maize) assimilate 25.59 Mg Hg annually using a standardized field survey of 301 sites across China, with approximately 53% originating from the atmosphere and 47% from the soil based on Δ199Hg signatures. We further predict the North China Plain, Jiangnan Hills, and Northeast Plain as hotspots of crop Hg accumulation in China. Following harvest, 36.4% of the Hg accumulated by staple crops is returned to the soil as residues, while 43.4% is transferred to the food chain via grain consumption and straw-livestock feed. These findings demonstrate that staple crops act as a key hub in global Hg cycling, with implications for assessing the fate and risk of existing Hg on Earth.
title_zh: 大宗作物是中国生物地球化学汞循环的关键枢纽
abstract_zh: 汞（Hg）污染威胁人类健康和生态安全。植物在调节全球汞循环中发挥着关键作用，但农作物如何影响汞传输仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们通过对中国 301 个地点的标准化实地调查显示，主要作物（即小麦、水稻和玉米）每年吸收 25.59 毫克汞，根据 Δ199Hg 特征，其中约 53% 来自大气，47% 来自土壤。我们进一步预测华北平原、江南丘陵和东北平原是中国农作物汞积累的热点地区。收获后，主要作物积累的汞有36.4%作为残留物返回土壤，而43.4%则通过粮食消费和秸秆牲畜饲料转移到食物链。这些发现表明，主粮作物是全球汞循环的关键枢纽，对评估地球上现有汞的命运和风险具有重要意义。

title: Over 20,000 precolonial earthworks in the Southwest Amazonia
source: Nature
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Numerous geometric earthworks have been found in southwestern Amazonia, evidence of a monument-building precolonial civilization
                    1–3
                    . This knowledge has contributed to the discussion about the deep history and the precolonial urbanism of Amazonia, its sociocultural contexts and its environmental legacy
                    2,4–8
                    . Estimates of the geographical extent and population size of the forest civilization have remained weak, because the detection of earthworks has been almost exclusively limited to deforested areas where vegetation does not completely hide the structures. Here we used canopy-penetrating LiDAR data over 4,430 km of flight to define the geographical distribution and quantity of earthworks in this region better. On the basis of both existing data and our LiDAR documentation, we show that this cultural area alone contains as many earthworks as previously estimated for the whole of Amazonia. We also propose that the total human population of the area in 100–300
                    ad
                    was 1.25–3 million people. If similar results are found elsewhere in Amazonia, the total precolonial population density and its effect on the current Amazonian soil and forest structure, biodiversity and even some modelling of the global climate should be re-evaluated.
title_zh: 亚马逊流域西南部有 20,000 多个殖民前土方工程
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  
                    在亚马逊流域西南部发现了许多几何土方工程，这是前殖民文明的纪念碑建筑的证据
                    1–3
                    。这些知识有助于讨论亚马逊流域的深厚历史和前殖民城市主义、其社会文化背景和环境遗产
                    2,4–8
                    。对森林文明的地理范围和人口规模的估计仍然薄弱，因为土方工程的探测几乎完全局限于植被无法完全隐藏建筑物的森林砍伐地区。在这里，我们使用了超过 4,430 公里飞行的冠层穿透激光雷达数据来更好地确定该地区土方工程的地理分布和数量。根据现有数据和我们的激光雷达文档，我们表明，仅这个文化区域就包含了之前估计的整个亚马逊流域的土方工程数量。我们还建议该地区的总人口在 100-300 人之间
                    广告
                    是 1.25-300 万人。如果在亚马逊流域其他地方发现类似的结果，则应该重新评估前殖民时期的总人口密度及其对当前亚马逊土壤和森林结构、生物多样性甚至某些全球气候模型的影响。

title: The past and future impact of climate change on childhood malaria in Africa
source: Nature
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Despite recent advances in climate change attribution, many health impacts remain unmeasured
                    1
                    . Here we leverage over a century of clinical data
                    2
                    to investigate whether human-caused climate change has increased the burden of childhood malaria across sub-Saharan Africa. We find a robust effect of temperature and extreme precipitation on prevalence, consistent with previous findings at local scales and in laboratory experiments. We estimate that rising temperatures have probably increased malaria in East and southern Africa, but averted a comparable number of cases in West Africa, with a net impact of 1 excess case per 1,000 children (95% confidence interval (CI) −4 to 6) across the continent. Over the coming century, we project that climate change could marginally accelerate the elimination of malaria in West and central Africa, where the present-day burden is highest; across the continent, this could avert 1 (low greenhouse gas emissions: 95% CI −2 to 6) to 20 (high greenhouse gas emissions: 95% CI 0–52) cases per 1,000 children by the end of the century. However, reducing future global warming from 3 °C to under 2 °C could prevent an average of 5 excess cases per 1,000 in high-elevation (more than 1 km) East Africa and in southern Africa (95% CIs −3 to 13 and −4 to 14, respectively) by 2100. Our study resolves a decades-old debate about one of the first suspected health impacts of climate change, providing a template for future work measuring its true global burden.
title_zh: 气候变化对非洲儿童疟疾过去和未来的影响
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  
                    尽管最近在气候变化归因方面取得了进展，但许多健康影响仍然无法衡量
                    1
                    。在这里，我们利用一个多世纪的临床数据
                    2
                    调查人为造成的气候变化是否增加了撒哈拉以南非洲地区儿童疟疾的负担。我们发现温度和极端降水对患病率有强烈影响，这与之前在当地规模和实验室实验中的发现一致。我们估计，气温上升可能增加了东非和南部非洲的疟疾发病率，但避免了西非类似数量的病例，对整个非洲大陆每 1,000 名儿童中就有 1 例过量病例产生净影响（95% 置信区间 (CI) -4 至 6）。在下个世纪，我们预计气候变化可能会略微加速西非和中非疟疾的消除，这些地区目前疟疾负担最重；在整个非洲大陆，到本世纪末，这可以避免每 1,000 名儿童出现 1 例（低温室气体排放：95% CI -2 至 6）至 20 例（高温室气体排放：95% CI 0-52）病例。然而，到2100年，将未来全球变暖从3°C降低到2°C以下，可以防止东非高海拔地区（超过1公里）和南部非洲平均每1,000人中增加5例病例（95%置信区间分别为-3至13和-4至14）。我们的研究解决了长达数十年的关于气候变化的第一个疑似健康影响之一的争论，为未来的工作提供了模板测量它

title: Photocatalytic water splitting by 2D polymer with out-of-plane carrier flow
source: Nature
abstract: Solar-driven water splitting with semiconductor particulates offers a sustainable pathway for hydrogen production1,2. Two-dimensional (2D) π-conjugated polymers have emerged as promising photocatalysts owing to their cost effectiveness and optoelectronic tunability3,4. However, photoexcited states in polymers are largely confined within π-conjugated 2D planes, making charge carriers vulnerable to recombination. Despite widespread modification of the electronic structure to enhance in-plane charge separation, long-term experimental efforts continue to highlight a persistent bottleneck in quantum efficiency5. To maximize charge utilization efficiency, the main challenge lies in inducing out-of-plane carrier migration, namely, fostering carrier flow through van der Waals-bonded layers. Here, using polymeric carbon nitride crystals as model systems, we demonstrate that out-of-plane carrier transport can be activated over surprisingly long distances (about 200 nm) by applying lateral or vertical internal electric fields by means of encapsulating nanofilms on different polymer facets. The lateral and vertical electric fields boost apparent quantum efficiency for overall water splitting to 53.4% and 82.1%, respectively. Our study introduces a strategy for transitioning from intrinsic 2D-confined excited states into kinetic-driven 3D spatially separated states and paves the way for maximizing energy conversion by polymer photocatalysis.
title_zh: 二维聚合物平面外载流光催化水分解
abstract_zh: 太阳能驱动的半导体颗粒水分解为氢气生产提供了可持续的途径1,2。二维 (2D) π 共轭聚合物因其成本效益和光电可调性而成为有前途的光催化剂3,4。然而，聚合物中的光激发态很大程度上局限于π共轭的二维平面内，使得电荷载流子容易复合。尽管对电子结构进行了广泛的修改以增强面内电荷分离，但长期的实验努力仍然凸显了量子效率的持续瓶颈5。为了最大限度地提高电荷利用效率，主要挑战在于诱导面外载流子迁移，即促进载流子流过范德华键合层。在这里，使用聚合氮化碳晶体作为模型系统，我们证明了通过将纳米薄膜封装在不同的聚合物面上，施加横向或垂直内部电场，可以在令人惊讶的长距离（约200 nm）内激活面外载流子传输。横向和垂直电场将整体水分解的表观量子效率分别提高到 53.4% 和 82.1%。我们的研究引入了一种从固有的 2D 限制激发态转变为动力学驱动的 3D 空间分离态的策略，并为通过聚合物光催化最大化能量转换铺平了道路。

title: Alternating CO2 and bicycloalkane copolymerization to circular polyesters
source: Nature
abstract: Transforming abundant but inert CO2 into useful polymers has been pursued since the 1960s (ref. 1) and has typically been achieved by copolymerization with a reactive comonomer, aided by a catalyst, which can address both thermodynamic constraints and high kinetic barriers associated with CO2 fixation and incorporation2-5. However, making polyesters remains a challenge as alternating copolymerization of CO2 with alkenes is thermodynamically infeasible6. Here we introduce a closed-loop CO2-based polyester platform for producing high-performance yet recyclable polyesters by direct alternating copolymerization of CO2 with bicycloalkanes, bicyclic butane (BCB) and pentane (BCP) monomers. This copolymerization is initiated by a simple organic catalyst and proceeds in a perfectly alternating fashion to high-molar-mass polyesters with maximum (50 mol%) CO2 incorporation and architecturally defined backbones, in which the in-chain ring structure enables tailorable thermal and mechanical properties. These polyesters exhibit desired orthogonal performance and end-of-life outcomes. Although the BCB-CO2 polyesters exhibit exceptional thermal and hydrolytic stability across the full pH range, they can be selectively depolymerized in bulk and base-catalysed conditions to regenerate pure BCB monomers in >90% isolated yield. The BCP-CO2 polyesters can also be selectively depolymerized but to bicyclolactones. Sequential depolymerization-repolymerization cycles establish circular lifecycles for BCB/BCP-CO2 high-performance polyesters.
title_zh: CO2与双环烷烃交替共聚制备环状聚酯
abstract_zh: 自 20 世纪 60 年代以来，人们一直在追求将丰富但惰性的 CO2 转化为有用的聚合物（参考文献 1），通常通过在催化剂的辅助下与反应性共聚单体共聚来实现，这可以解决与 CO2 固定和掺入相关的热力学约束和高动力学障碍2-5。然而，制造聚酯仍然是一个挑战，因为二氧化碳与烯烃的交替共聚在热力学上是不可行的6。在这里，我们介绍了一种闭环CO2基聚酯平台，通过CO2与双环烷烃、双环丁烷（BCB）和戊烷（BCP）单体直接交替共聚来生产高性能且可回收的聚酯。这种共聚反应由简单的有机催化剂引发，并以完美交替的方式进行，形成具有最大（50mol％）CO2掺入量和结构明确的主链的高摩尔质量聚酯，其中链内环结构能够实现可调节的热性能和机械性能。这些聚酯表现出所需的正交性能和报废结果。尽管 BCB-CO2 聚酯在整个 pH 范围内表现出优异的热稳定性和水解稳定性，但它们可以在本体和碱催化条件下选择性解聚，以 >90% 的分离产率再生纯 BCB 单体。 BCP-CO2聚酯也可以选择性解聚，但解聚为双环内酯。连续的解聚-再聚合循环为 BCB/BCP-CO2 高性能聚酯建立了循环生命周期。

title: Weight-four parity checks in a spin-shuttling architecture
source: Nature
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Recent advances in coherent spin shuttling have made sparse semiconductor spin-qubit arrays an appealing solid-state platform to realize quantum processors
                    1–7
                    . The dynamic and long-range connectivity enabled by shuttling is also essential for many quantum error-correction schemes
                    8–10
                    . Here we demonstrate a silicon spin-qubit device comprising a shuttling bus for coherently transporting qubits that can interact at four isolated locations that we call bus stops. We dynamically populate the array and tune all single- and two-qubit operations using shuttling and quantum non-demolition spin measurements, without access to charge sensing in most of the device. We achieve universal control of the effective five-qubit processor and select the connectivity required to form a surface-code stabilizer plaquette that supports
                    X
                    - and
                    Z
                    -type parity checks up to weight four. We use the parity checks to generate multi-qubit entanglement between all qubit combinations in the array and report the genuine entanglement of a five-qubit Greenberger–Horne–Zeilinger state, constituting one of the largest such states constructed with gate-defined semiconductor spins. The protocols developed here lay the groundwork for modular calibration and operation of sparse spin-qubit arrays, and we highlight the feasibility of near-term quantum error-correction experiments with mobile spin qubits.
title_zh: 自旋穿梭架构中的权重四奇偶校验
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  
                    相干自旋穿梭的最新进展使稀疏半导体自旋量子位阵列成为实现量子处理器的有吸引力的固态平台
                    1–7
                    。穿梭实现的动态和远程连接对于许多量子纠错方案也至关重要
                    8–10
                    。在这里，我们演示了一种硅自旋量子位设备，包括用于连贯地传输量子位的穿梭总线，该总线可以在我们称为公交车站的四个隔离位置进行交互。我们动态地填充阵列并使用穿梭和量子非拆卸自旋测量来调整所有单量子位和两个量子位操作，而无需访问大多数设备中的电荷传感。我们实现了对有效五量子位处理器的通用控制，并选择形成表面代码稳定器板所需的连接，该表面代码稳定器板支持
                    X
                    - 和

                    -类型奇偶校验最多为权重四。我们使用奇偶校验在阵列中的所有量子位组合之间生成多量子位纠缠，并报告五量子位 Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger 状态的真正纠缠，该状态构成了用门定义的半导体自旋构造的最大此类状态之一。这里开发的协议为稀疏自旋量子位阵列的模块化校准和操作奠定了基础，我们强调了使用移动自旋量子位进行近期量子纠错实验的可行性。

title: Sequential reading of a stepwise-shortened peptide immobilized on nanopore
source: Nature
abstract: Accurate decoding of peptide sequences is crucial in proteomics. However, achieving this goal is a technical challenge, owing to the compositional and structural complexity of peptides1. Studies inspired by the success of nanopore nucleic acid sequencing have shown that nanopore-based techniques can also be applied to peptide sequencing2,3. The key is to generate narrowly distributed, consistent and sequence-dependent events during sequential nanopore readout. Here we introduce a nanopore-based strategy termed transient pore analyte looping (tPAL). We develop an engineered Mycobacterium smegmatis porin A (MspA) nanopore that is dual modified with a nickel-ion-bound nitrilotriacetic acid (NTA-Ni) adapter and the target peptide. This distinctive sensing configuration enables precise recognition of the N terminus of the immobilized peptide by multiple re-readings. With the aid of cholesterolized aminopeptidase, the immobilized peptide can be shortened sequentially in single-amino-acid increments, yielding sequence-dependent, stepwise and narrowly distributed signal alterations that provide clues to allow peptide sequence decoding. Our strategy achieves single-amino-acid resolution and effectively identifies single-amino-acid mutations, post-translational modifications and unnatural-amino-acid insertions-indicative of its versatility in nanopore proteomics and chiral peptide analyses.
title_zh: 固定在纳米孔上的逐步缩短的肽的顺序读取
abstract_zh: 肽序列的准确解码在蛋白质组学中至关重要。然而，由于肽的组成和结构复杂性，实现这一目标是一项技术挑战。受纳米孔核酸测序成功启发的研究表明，基于纳米孔的技术也可以应用于肽测序2、3。关键是在顺序纳米孔读出过程中生成分布狭窄、一致且序列依赖的事件。在这里，我们介绍了一种基于纳米孔的策略，称为瞬时孔分析物循环（tPAL）。我们开发了一种工程化的耻垢分枝杆菌孔蛋白 A (MspA) 纳米孔，该纳米孔经过镍离子结合次氮基三乙酸 (NTA-Ni) 接头和目标肽的双重修饰。这种独特的传感配置能够通过多次重读来精确识别固定肽的 N 末端。在胆固醇化氨肽酶的帮助下，固定肽可以以单个氨基酸增量顺序缩短，产生序列依赖性、逐步且窄分布的信号改变，为肽序列解码提供线索。我们的策略实现了单氨基酸分辨率，并有效识别单氨基酸突变、翻译后修饰和非天然氨基酸插入，表明其在纳米孔蛋白质组学和手性肽分析中的多功能性。

title: Perpendicular switching of polarization in layered ferroelectrics
source: Nature
abstract: Ferroelectric materials exhibit a spontaneous electric polarization that can be reversed by an electric field1, a property central to non-volatile memories2,3, sensors4 and actuators5,6. In most conventional ferroelectrics, the polarization originates from a softening of a polar mode7. The amplitude of the mode along a given direction couples with the applied field along the same direction8. Ferroelectrics with a predominant in-plane polarization are harder to use in standard device geometries and therefore the field has mostly focused on out-of-plane ferroelectrics. Developing approaches that enable manipulation of the in-plane polarization component with an out-of-plane field would therefore provide new opportunities for device design and functionality. Here we have discovered that a trilinear coupling between the in-plane and out-of-plane polarization, mediated by means of the octahedral tilts and rotations in the layered ferroelectric Bi4Ti3O12, naturally fulfils this challenge and enables perpendicular switching of the polarization state. In its bulk monoclinic phase, this material hosts a large in-plane polarization (about 50 μC cm-2) driven by a proper ferroelectric instability, together with smaller out-of-plane polarization (about 5 μC cm-2) of improper origin, induced by oxygen octahedral distortions. We demonstrate that, in c-axis-oriented epitaxial films, the in-plane polarization switches deterministically under an out-of-plane electric field. This cross-coupling between orthogonal polarization components provides a route to transverse manipulation of ferroic order parameters and establishes layered ferroelectrics as a platform for capacitive computing concepts.
title_zh: 层状铁电体中极化的垂直切换
abstract_zh: 铁电材料表现出可通过电场逆转的自发电极化1，这是非易失性存储器2、3、传感器4和执行器5、6的核心特性。在大多数传统铁电体中，极化源于极性模式的软化7。沿给定方向的模式振幅与沿同一方向施加的场耦合8。以面内极化为主的铁电体很难在标准器件几何形状中使用，因此该领域主要集中在面外铁电体。因此，开发能够利用面外场操纵面内偏振分量的方法将为设备设计和功能提供新的机会。在这里，我们发现，面内和面外偏振之间的三线性耦合，通过层状铁电 Bi4Ti3O12 中的八面体倾斜和旋转来介导，自然地解决了这一挑战，并实现了偏振态的垂直切换。在其块体单斜晶相中，该材料具有由适当的铁电不稳定性驱动的大面内极化（约 50 μC cm-2），以及由氧八面体畸变引起的来源不当的较小面外极化（约 5 μC cm-2）。我们证明，在 c 轴取向外延膜中，面内偏振在面外电场下确定性地切换。正交偏振分量之间的这种交叉耦合为铁氧体的横向操纵提供了一条途径。

title: Climate benefit and ecological cost trade-offs for ocean iron fertilization
source: Nature
abstract: Ocean iron fertilization (OIF) is being discussed as a potential carbon dioxide removal (CDR) strategy1. Yet the trade-offs between climate benefits and ecological costs remain poorly understood2-4. Here we use a process-rich ocean biogeochemical model with validated representations of marine biodiversity and biogeochemistry5 to quantify fertilization potential and ecosystem impact across ten ocean biomes over 60 years. We find regional disparities in climate ecosystem trade-offs: biomes with comparable CDR efficiency have contrasting ecological outcomes. The Southern Ocean and the equatorial Pacific achieve the highest efficiencies through distinct pathways: the former through non-local downstream carbon export, the latter through local export with downstream loss, as fertilized blooms deplete macronutrients in source water, suppressing non-local productivity. Consequently, equatorial fertilization reduces energy flows to higher trophic levels, expands oxygen-minimum zones (OMZs) and reduces macrozooplankton biomass. These ecosystem impacts are potentially avoidable by shifting deployment to higher latitudes. Post-fertilization recovery experiments reveal ecosystem resilience in the Southern Ocean but persistent perturbations in the equatorial Pacific owing to regional iron retention. Balancing climate benefits and ecological risks yields three tiers: the Southern Ocean (higher efficiency/lower risk); the equatorial Pacific and global fertilization (higher efficiency/higher risk); and the subtropics (lower efficiency/moderate risk). Sixty years of fertilization yield net CDR of 1.1-5.3 ppm, with more than half re-emitted within decades post-fertilization. The disconnect between local interventions and global outcomes complicates robust carbon crediting and raises equity and governance concerns.
title_zh: 海洋铁肥化的气候效益和生态成本权衡
abstract_zh: 海洋铁施肥（OIF）作为一种潜在的二氧化碳去除（CDR）策略正在被讨论1。然而，人们对气候效益与生态成本之间的权衡仍知之甚少2-4。在这里，我们使用一个过程丰富的海洋生物地球化学模型，该模型具有经过验证的海洋生物多样性和生物地球化学5表征，以量化 60 年来十个海洋生物群落的受精潜力和生态系统影响。我们发现气候生态系统权衡方面存在区域差异：具有可比 CDR 效率的生物群落具有截然不同的生态结果。南大洋和赤道太平洋通过不同的途径实现最高效率：前者通过非本地下游碳输出，后者通过本地输出并造成下游损失，因为受精的水华消耗了源水中的常量营养素，抑制了非本地生产力。因此，赤道施肥减少了能量流向更高的营养级，扩大了最低氧区（OMZ）并减少了大型浮游动物的生物量。通过将部署转移到高纬度地区，这些生态系统影响可能是可以避免的。受精后恢复实验揭示了南大洋的生态系统恢复力，但由于区域铁滞留而导致赤道太平洋的持续扰动。平衡气候效益和生态风险产生三个层次：南大洋（更高效率/更低风险）；赤道太平洋和全球受精（效率更高/风险更高）；和亚热带地区（效率较低/风险中等）。六十年施肥净产量C

title: Relatively few Black people benefited in the 1930s and 1940s from mortgages backed by the US government
source: Nature
abstract: Newly digitized mortgage records from 38 US states reveal the profound racial inequality of two mortgage programmes during the 1930s and 1940s. These loans, supported by the Federal Housing Administration and the Veterans Administration, were mainly responsible for the emergence of a US society that idealized home ownership. However, Black households were systematically excluded from receiving such loans. By contrast, immigrants received mortgages proportional to their number. Immigrants, who were mainly from Europe at the time, were proportionally represented among loan recipients in the United States.

title: The first known cephalopod was only a millimetre long and lived about 520 million years ago

abstract: The locomotion of modern cephalopods, such as squid and cuttlefish, relies on buoyancy control achieved mainly by a specialized structure called a siphuncle. The discovery of fossils of Eoceras — a millimetre-sized cephalopod with a siphuncle — suggests that the group had already emerged in the early Cambrian, around 520 million years ago. Small shelly fossils show that cephalopods with siphuncle structures lived in the early Cambrian period.

title: Enzymatic glycosylation and amidation reshapes polyene bioactivity
source: Nature
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Fungal diseases are an escalating threat to human health, driven by rising antimicrobial resistance and a lack of new antifungal treatments
                    1,2
                    . Polyenes, a class of complex natural products, have been widely used as antifungal agents due to their broad-spectrum activity
                    3
                    . However, their clinical use is limited by severe toxicity and poor solubility, making safer and more effective alternatives urgently needed
                    4
                    . Previous efforts to generate improved polyenes have relied on costly, step-inefficient and atom-inefficient chemical syntheses
                    5,6
                    . Here we describe the discovery and characterization of pathways to previously undescribed polyenes, including unusual glycosyltransferase enzymes that introduce sugars onto polyene scaffolds. We also show how the reaction scope of an amidotransferase enzyme can be expanded to transform the detrimental carboxylate substituent of polyenes to alternative functionality. Introduction of a second sugar combined with carboxylate modifications leads to more potent polyene antifungals, with reduced toxicity, that are accessible by clean and efficient fermentation or enzymatic routes.
title_zh: 酶促糖基化和酰胺化重塑多烯生物活性
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  
                    由于抗菌素耐药性上升和缺乏新的抗真菌治疗方法，真菌病对人类健康构成了日益严重的威胁

title: Assessing the deviation between policy and public attention in large-scale V2G deployment: evidence from multimodal data
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Vehicle-to-grid (V2G) is vital for achieving carbon neutrality, but its large-scale promotion faces a gap between strong policy support and low public participation, indicating a misalignment between government agendas and public attention. Based on V2G policy texts and multimodal user-generated content from Weibo, Douyin, and Xiaohongshu, this study applies BERTopic for topic modelling and develops an indicator system covering overall, structural, and content deviation to identify and quantify policy–public attention deviation in V2G deployment. The results show that: (1) Policy attention and public attention differ substantially, with an overall deviation index of 0.48. Policy attention focuses on macro-level governance and infrastructure development, whereas public attention centers on micro-level user experience, such as battery life and participation risks. (2) Structural deviation increases across the policy goal, tool, and pathway layers, with the largest deviation at the pathway layer, followed by the tool and goal layers. At each layer, the deviation between user posts and policy texts is higher than that between user comments and policy texts. (3) Substantial content deviation exists within the same policy themes, especially for the pathway theme of “top-level design and platform governance”, where the content deviation index reaches 0.457. This study systematically reveals the mismatch between policy supply and public cognition, providing empirical evidence for improving V2G policy design, user participation mechanisms, and policy responsiveness.
title_zh: 评估大规模V2G部署中政策与公众关注之间的偏差：来自多模态数据的证据
abstract_zh: 车到网（V2G）对于实现碳中和至关重要，但其大规模推广面临着政策支持力度大和公众参与度低的差距，反映出政府议程与公众关注度之间的脱节。基于V2G政策文本和来自微博、抖音和小红书的多模态用户生成内容，本研究应用BERTopic进行主题建模，并开发了涵盖整体、结构和内容偏差的指标体系，以识别和量化V2G部署中的政策-公众注意力偏差。结果表明：（1）政策关注度与公众关注度存在较大差异，总体偏差指数为0.48。政策关注集中在宏观层面的治理和基础设施发展，而公众关注则集中在微观层面的用户体验，例如电池寿命和参与风险。 （2）政策目标、工具、路径层的结构性偏差有所增加，其中路径层偏差最大，其次是工具层和目标层。在每一层，用户帖子与政策文本之间的偏差均高于用户评论与政策文本之间的偏差。 （3）同一政策主题存在较大内容偏差，特别是“顶层设计与平台治理”路径主题，内容偏差指数达到0.457。本研究系统揭示了政策供给与公众认知之间的错配，为完善V2G政策设计、用户参与机制和政策响应能力提供实证证据。

title: Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP
source: Nature
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Senescent cells promote tissue dysfunction in part through the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP)
                    1
                    . Cytosolic mitochondrial nucleic acids activate innate immune signalling to initiate this inflammatory programme
                    2,3
                    . Here we show that mitochondrial metabolism provides a second layer of control that enables execution of the inflammatory programme. In senescent cells, the mitochondrial pyruvate–citrate–acetyl-CoA axis is upregulated, increasing the availability of acetyl-CoA to support histone acetylation at SASP genes. Whereas mitochondrial DNA-driven signalling activates inflammatory transcription factors, acetyl-CoA availability is required for robust transcription of SASP genes. Accordingly, enhancing acetyl-CoA levels promotes SASP gene expression, whereas inhibition of SLC25A1, the mitochondrial citrate exporter, reduces histone acetylation at SASP loci, limiting activity of this programme. In vivo, inhibition of SLC25A1 reduces chromatin accessibility at SASP loci, dampens inflammation and improves healthspan in aged mice. Together, these findings identify a mitochondrial metabolic checkpoint that enables the epigenetic execution of innate immune signalling, revealing a mechanism that selectively controls the inflammatory output of senescent cells.
title_zh: 线粒体代谢和表观遗传串扰驱动 SASP

                    1

                    2,3
                    。在这里，我们表明线粒体代谢提供了第二层控制，可以执行炎症程序。在衰老细胞中，线粒体丙酮酸-柠檬酸-乙酰辅酶A轴上调，增加了乙酰辅酶A支持SASP基因组蛋白乙酰化的可用性。虽然线粒体 DNA 驱动的信号传导会激活炎症转录因子，但乙酰辅酶 A 的可用性对于 SASP 基因的稳健转录是必需的。因此，增强乙酰辅酶A水平会促进SASP基因表达，而抑制线粒体柠檬酸输出蛋白SLC25A1会减少SASP位点的组蛋白乙酰化，从而限制该程序的活性。在体内，抑制 SLC25A1 会降低 SASP 位点染色质的可及性，抑制炎症并延长老年小鼠的健康寿命。总之，这些发现确定了一个线粒体代谢检查点，该检查点能够实现先天免疫信号的表观遗传执行，揭示了一种选择性控制衰老细胞炎症输出的机制。

title: Diverse bacterial pattern recognition receptors sense the core phage proteome
source: Nature
abstract: Recognition of foreign molecules inside cells is critical for immunity across all domains of life. Proteins of the STAND NTPase superfamily1,2, including eukaryotic NOD-like receptors, play a central role in this process3,4. In bacteria and archaea, although several STAND families sense phage proteins5-9, their functional diversity remains largely unexplored. Here we conduct a systematic phylogenetic analysis of prokaryotic STAND NTPases and identify at least 90 structurally distinct families associated with antiviral defence. We first show that the uncharacterized Avs7 family recognizes the major capsid protein (MCP) of tailed phages. Three cryogenic electron microscopy structures of Salmonella enterica Avs7 reveal an asymmetric, butterfly-shaped tetramer that assembles stepwise through large, MCP-induced conformational changes, incorporating bacterial elongation factor Tu (EF-Tu) as a structural component that enhances defence. Using genetic screens with a library of 687 phage genes, we further show that 13 additional STAND families sense 13 conserved phage proteins, encompassing most of the core structural and replicative components of tailed phages. These include 2 distinct MCP-sensing families (Avs8 and Avs10) and 11 others (Avs11-21), which recognize the portal, portal adaptor, tail nozzle, head-tail connector, tail terminator, tail tube protein, tail assembly chaperone, tape measure protein, DNA polymerase, helicase/RecA-type ATPase and single-stranded DNA annealing protein, respectively. Together, our findings reveal a mechanism of host-factor repurposing and establish structure-based pattern recognition as a fundamental strategy of bacterial immunity.

title: New-deal mortgage programmes benefited white borrowers disproportionately
source: Nature
abstract: We show that the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) and Veterans' Administration (VA) mortgage programmes had few Black borrowers and proportionate foreign-born borrowers in their early years. Although scholars have long posited that the beneficiaries of these programmes were disproportionately white, evidence of the identities of these early borrowers was scant and lacking information on their nativity1-3. Here we fill this void by linking records from the Reconstruction Finance Corporation Mortgage Company (RFCMC), consisting of 29,921 FHA-insured and VA-guaranteed loans from 1935 to 1947, to Census data. Although the population of the USA was 9.9% Black in 1940, we find that only 2.1% of FHA-insured loans and 5.1% of VA-guaranteed loans went to Black borrowers. We also show that immigrants were proportionally represented in FHA lending (10.0% of loans) relative to their share of the population and in VA lending (2.2% of loans) relative to their share of Second World War veterans4. Our results indicate substantial racial inequality in the two foundational homeownership policies in the USA5,6. We anticipate our findings to be a starting point for nascent scholarship exploring the roles of FHA and VA lending in shaping racial disparities in access to homeownership and related outcomes, such as neighbourhood attainment and wealth7,8.
title_zh: 新政抵押贷款计划使白人借款人受益匪浅
abstract_zh: 我们发现，联邦住房管理局 (FHA) 和退伍军人管理局 (VA) 抵押贷款计划在早期几乎没有黑人借款人，而外国出生的借款人也占比例。尽管学者们长期以来一直认为这些计划的受益人中白人比例过高，但这些早期借款人身份的证据很少，而且缺乏有关其出生地的信息1-3。在这里，我们通过将重建金融公司抵押贷款公司 (RFCMC) 的记录（包括 1935 年至 1947 年间 29,921 笔 FHA 承保和 VA 担保的贷款）与人口普查数据联系起来来填补这一空白。尽管 1940 年美国人口中有 9.9% 是黑人，但我们发现只有 2.1% 的 FHA 担保贷款和 5.1% 的 VA 担保贷款流向了黑人借款人。我们还表明，移民在 FHA 贷款（占贷款的 10.0%）中所占的比例与其在人口中所占的比例有关，在 VA 贷款（占贷款的 2.2%）中所占比例则与他们在二战退伍军人中所占的比例相关4。我们的结果表明美国两项基本住房所有权政策中存在严重的种族不平等5,6。我们预计我们的研究结果将成为新兴学术研究的起点，探索 FHA 和 VA 贷款在塑造住房所有权和相关成果（例如邻里成就和财富）方面的种族差异方面的作用7,8。

title: Plasmonic metamaterial time crystal
source: Nature
abstract: Spatial photonic crystals (SPCs) are unique structures for light-matter interactions because they achieve a large and spatially periodic dielectric contrast on wavelength scales1-4. Their temporal analogues, photonic time crystals (PTCs), promise similar advances by periodically modulating optical properties in time5-11, but require strong, ultrafast modulation, which is challenging to obtain experimentally5,12-15. Driven metamaterials have been considered as a route to realize PTCs, yet all-optical implementations have remained unknown because of the challenge of achieving modulation on such short timescales. Here we demonstrate the all-optical realization of a photonic time crystal, achieved with a surface plasmon cavity metamaterial operating at terahertz frequencies. We demonstrate strong (near-unity) and coherent (sub-optical cycle) periodic driving of the plasmonic metamaterial enabled by field-induced dynamical modulation of the kinetic energy of the carriers and effective mass reaching up to 80% of their rest mass. Our spectroscopic measurements show a transition into the PTC regime mediated by an exceptional point, at which two Floquet-driven optical eigenmodes coalesce. In the PTC regime, emergent gain is shown to reduce plasmonic losses by more than 50% (refs. 16,17), and we predict plasmonic lasing to be within experimental reach. These results establish a robust platform for time-domain photonics in plasmonic systems.
title_zh: 等离激元超材料时间晶体
abstract_zh: 空间光子晶体 (SPC) 是光与物质相互作用的独特结构，因为它们在波长尺度 1-4 上实现了大的空间周期性介电对比度。它们的时间类似物，光子时间晶体（PTC），通过在时间中周期性调制光学特性来实现类似的进步5-11，但需要强大的超快调制，这在实验上获得具有挑战性5,12-15。驱动超材料已被认为是实现 PTC 的一种途径，但由于在如此短的时间尺度上实现调制的挑战，全光学实现仍然未知。在这里，我们演示了光子时间晶体的全光学实现，这是通过在太赫兹频率下工作的表面等离子体腔超材料实现的。我们展示了等离子体超材料的强（接近一致）和相干（亚光循环）周期性驱动，这是通过场致动态调制载流子的动能和有效质量达到其静止质量的 80% 来实现的。我们的光谱测量显示，由一个异常点介导向 PTC 状态的转变，在该异常点处两个 Floquet 驱动的光学本征模合并。在 PTC 体系中，涌现增益可将等离子体损失减少 50% 以上（参考文献 16,17），并且我们预测等离子体激射将在实验范围内。这些结果为等离子体系统中的时域光子学建立了一个强大的平台。

title: In situ structures of plant photosystem supercomplexes
source: Nature
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Photosynthesis sustains life on Earth by converting light to chemical energy through the coordinated action of photosystem I (PSI) and photosystem II (PSII) within thylakoid membranes
                    1–4
                    . Although structures of isolated photosystems are available, their native organization in chloroplasts remains unknown. Here, using in situ cryo-electron microscopy, we directly imaged
                    Oryza sativa
                    (rice) chloroplasts and determined structures of photosystem supercomplexes in their native membrane environment. We resolved a C
                    2

                    M
                    2
                    L
                    4
                    -type PSII–light harvesting complex II (LHCII) supercomplex, including four LHCII antenna trimers that were not retained in purified preparations. Excitation energy transfer calculations based on this architecture closely reproduce in vivo measurements, indicating its physiological relevance. We also resolved asymmetric PSII–LHCII dimers, including side-by-side, trans-lumenal and trans-stromal architectures, and higher-order assemblies of trimers and tetramers. On the basis of these observations, we propose that PSII forms a trans-lumenal and trans-stromal ‘skeleton’ that shapes thylakoid morphology and supports grana stacking. In addition, we obtained high-resolution structures of PSI–LHCI–LHCII and PSI–LHCI supercomplexes. Together, these structures reveal extensive networks of lipids, pigments and cofactors, providing the first molecular framework for understanding how the native architecture of plant photosystem supports the exceptional photon-to-electron efficiency of photosynthesis.

title: The piezochiral effect
source: Nature
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Chirality is a pervasive property of matter that underpins many important phenomena across physics
                    1
                    , chemistry
                    2
                    and biology
                    3
                    . Given its broad importance, the development of protocols for rational control of chirality in solid-state systems is highly desirable, especially if this effect can be tuned continuously and in two directions. Yet, this goal has remained elusive owing to the absence of a universal conjugate field that couples linearly to this structural order
                    4–6
                    . Here we introduce the piezochiral effect, which enables control of chirality through mechanical strain. We show by symmetry analysis that uniaxial strain induces chirality in a broad class of achiral crystals that host fragments of opposite chirality within each unit cell
                    7,8
                    , an effect that has so far remained unrecognized. The strain-induced handedness can be tuned either by changing the strain direction or by switching between compressive and tensile strain. We experimentally verify this effect in AgGaS
                    2
                    , using measurements of the optical activity under strain. Our discovery establishes a new scheme for chirality control, with potential applications that range from spintronics to asymmetric catalysis, and enantioselective interactions in biosystems.
title_zh: 压电手性效应
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  
                    手性是物质的普遍属性，是物理学中许多重要现象的基础
                    1
                    , 化学
                    2
                    和生物学
                    3
                    。鉴于其广泛的重要性，开发用于合理控制固态系统中手性的协议是非常可取的，特别是如果这种效应可以在两个方向上连续调节的话。然而，由于缺乏与这种结构顺序线性耦合的通用共轭场，这一目标仍然难以实现
                    4-6
                    。在这里，我们介绍压电手性效应，它可以通过机械应变控制手性。我们通过对称分析表明，单轴应变会在一大类非手性晶体中诱导手性，这些晶体在每个晶胞内含有相反手性的片段
                    7,8
                    ，迄今为止尚未认识到这一效应。应变引起的旋向性可以通过改变应变方向或通过在压缩应变和拉伸应变之间切换来调节。我们在 AgGaS 中实验验证了这种效应
                    2
                    ，使用应变下的光学活性测量。我们的发现建立了一种手性控制的新方案，其潜在应用范围包括自旋电子学、不对称催化以及生物系统中的对映选择性相互作用。

title: In situ structure of the poxvirus portal complex
source: Nature
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Poxviruses are a family of large, complex double-stranded DNA viruses that includes human pathogens such as variola—the cause of smallpox—and monkeypox. Recent outbreaks of mpox underscore the need for a better understanding of poxvirus biology
                    1,2
                    . Poxvirus assembly is a conserved process that involves the formation of a biconcave core inside the membrane of the maturing virus
                    3,4
                    . Here we use cryo-electron tomography combined with subtomogram averaging and structure prediction to determine the structure and composition of the portal complex—a pore that spans the core wall—in vaccinia virus, the prototypical poxvirus. The hexameric complex consists of the E8, E6 and L3 proteins, which are conserved across poxviruses and essential for mRNA release during the establishment of infection
                    5–7
                    . E6, which is also required for virus assembly
                    8–10

title: Cretaceous zhelestid mammals are zalambdalestoids
source: Nature
abstract: Placental mammals (the clade that includes bats, primates and whales) developed highly varied molars as they diversified in the Palaeogene, indicating derived diets such as carnivory and herbivory1. Cretaceous eutherian stem taxa to Placentalia had, however, more conservative dentitions-typically molars with high, sharp cusps for insectivory. The discovery 38 years ago of molars of Late Cretaceous zhelestid mammals2 with relatively low (bunodont) cusps, convergent with those of herbivorous placental ungulates, suggested a previously unknown Cretaceous radiation of more placental-like fossils3-5. However, as associated dental, cranial and skeletal material of a single individual zhelestid has never been found6, the hypothesis of what zhelestids are-physically and phylogenetically-has eluded rigorous testing. Here we describe Tamirkhan balcarceli, a new fossil from the Upper Cretaceous of Mongolia, whose type specimen represents a single individual with quadrangular, zhelestid-like molars in a skull and a cursorially adapted partial hind limb. Tamirkhan reveals that zhelestid molars co-occur with features that are historically diagnostic of the well-known Cretaceous clade Zalambdalestidae: elongate first lower incisors with restricted enamel and an open root extending under the cheek teeth; translacrimal canals; and fused distal hindlimbs with elongate metatarsals7-9. Zhelestids are therefore a dental variant within Zalambdalestoidea with skeletal features of that clade.
title_zh: 白垩纪 zhelestid 哺乳动物是 zalambdalestoids
abstract_zh: 胎盘哺乳动物（包括蝙蝠、灵长类动物和鲸鱼的进化枝）在古近纪多样化时发展出高度多样化的臼齿，这表明它们具有食肉性和草食性等派生饮食。然而，从白垩纪真兽类到胎盘类的茎类群具有更保守的齿列——通常是具有高而锋利的尖牙的臼齿，用于食虫。 38 年前，人们发现白垩纪晚期 zhelestid 哺乳动物的臼齿具有相对较低的齿尖（bunodont），与草食性胎盘有蹄类动物的齿尖趋同，这表明以前未知的白垩纪辐射存在更多类似胎盘的化石3-5。然而，由于从未发现单个 zhelestid 个体的相关牙齿、颅骨和骨骼材料，因此 zhelestid 的物理和系统发育假设未能经过严格的测试。在这里，我们描述了塔米尔汗·巴尔卡塞利（Tamirkhan balcarceli），这是一种来自蒙古上白垩纪的新化石，其模式标本代表了一个个体，头骨中有四边形的、类似zhelestid的臼齿和粗略改造的部分后肢。塔米尔汗揭示了 zhelestid 臼齿与历史上著名的白垩纪分支 Zalambdalestidae 的特征同时出现：细长的第一下门牙，牙釉质有限，牙根开放，延伸到颊齿下方；经泪道；并融合了远端后肢和细长的跖骨7-9。因此，Zhelestids 是 Zalambdalestoidea 中的一个牙齿变体，具有该分支的骨骼特征。

title: Avalanche-like intercalation and intraparticle correlations in graphite
source: Nature
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Although graphite is the most widely used negative electrode material in lithium-ion batteries
                    1
                    , its lithium insertion processes and associated dynamics, particularly those of the dilute stages, remain poorly understood. A fundamental understanding of how symmetry-breaking phase transitions occur continuously under operating conditions is lacking. Here, using operando optical microscopy, we provide a unified picture of ion intercalation dynamics during the dilute stages of graphite intercalation, showing that the graphitic particles undergo rapid, localized deintercalation–intercalation step events, leading to deintercalation–intercalation of micrometre-sized regions within seconds. These are reminiscent of a phase-transition phenomenon, ‘avalanches’, which occurs in disordered materials, involving step changes in the order parameter due to jumps between multiple metastable states
                    2,3
                    . Using a modified random field Ising model, the avalanches are related to static disorder, which disrupts intercalation dynamics. The model can also account for the apparently continuous transitions between stages and the experimental avalanche statistics. Finally, we develop a methodology to spatio-temporally analyse the sequences of avalanche events, revealing considerable heterogeneous connectivity. Our work highlights the role of local and static disorder in explaining unexpected phase-transition behaviour and provides new tools and concepts for studying layered battery materials.
