title: Metal-mediated weak adsorption enables the selective electrosynthesis of N-phenylhydroxylamine from nitrobenzene hydrogenation in water
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The electrocatalytic hydrogenation of nitrobenzene (Ph-NO2) to N-phenylhydroxylamine (Ph-NHOH) is of industrial importance as a high-value-added process but remains challenging because of the thermodynamically favorable overhydrogenation process. Here, metal-mediated weak adsorption is proposed to enable selective Ph-NO2-to-Ph-NHOH electrosynthesis in water. An activity volcano in the context of scaling relationships based on the adsorption energy of Ph-NO has identified metallic silver (Ag) as the optimal highly intrinsically active candidate for Ph-NHOH electrosynthesis. The results of in situ electrochemical infrared spectroscopy reveal the weak adsorption of Ph-NHOH on metallic Ag, which prevents its subsequent hydrogenation. Afterward, a nanosized Ag catalyst (CV-Ag) synthesized by electrodeposition is developed to rapidly and selectively synthesize Ph-NHOH under a large current. CV-Ag enhances the electrosynthesis reaction kinetics of Ph-NHOH. Therefore, an ampere-level current is realized during the electrosynthesis of Ph-NHOH, achieving a high selectivity of nearly 99.6% and continuous gram-scale synthesis of Ph-NHOH at 5.85 g per batch.
title_zh: 金属介导的弱吸附使得硝基苯在水中加氢选择性电合成N-苯基羟胺
abstract_zh: 硝基苯 (Ph-NO2) 电催化氢化为 N-苯基羟胺 (Ph-NHOH) 作为一种高附加值工艺具有工业重要性，但由于热力学上有利的过氢化过程，仍然具有挑战性。在这里，提出了金属介导的弱吸附，以实现水中选择性的 Ph-NO2-to-Ph-NHOH 电合成。基于 Ph-NO 吸附能的缩放关系背景下的活动火山已确定金属银 (Ag) 是 Ph-NHOH 电合成的最佳高本质活性候选者。原位电化学红外光谱的结果表明，Ph-NHOH在金属Ag上的弱吸附，阻碍了其后续的氢化。随后，开发了一种通过电沉积合成的纳米银催化剂（CV-Ag），可在大电流下快速选择性地合成Ph-NHOH。 CV-Ag 增强 Ph-NHOH 的电合成反应动力学。因此，在电合成Ph-NHOH过程中实现了安培级电流，实现了近99.6%的高选择性，并以每批次5.85 g连续克级规模合成Ph-NHOH。

title: Local stories in climate change communication
source: Nature Climate Change
abstract: Climate change communication differs across regions, shaped by unique political, economic, social and environmental conditions. These influence how climate messages are framed, received and acted upon by the local public. To explore this diversity, Nature Climate Change spoke to globally distributed scholars for their perspectives on the communication patterns, challenges and priorities in their regions.
title_zh: 气候变化传播中的当地故事
abstract_zh: 气候变化交流因地区而异，受到独特的政治、经济、社会和环境条件的影响。这些影响着当地公众如何构建、接收和采取气候信息。为了探索这种多样性，《自然·气候变化》采访了全球各地的学者，了解他们对各自地区的沟通模式、挑战和优先事项的看法。

title: Controlled parity of cooper pair tunneling in a hybrid superconducting qubit
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Superconducting quantum circuits derive their nonlinearity from the Josephson energy-phase relation. Besides the fundamental cos⁡ϕ" role="presentation">cos⁡ϕ\cos \phi term, this relation can also contain higher Fourier harmonics cos⁡(kϕ)" role="presentation">cos⁡(kϕ)\cos (k\phi ) corresponding to correlated tunneling of k Cooper pairs. The parity of the dominant tunneling process, i.e. whether an odd or even number of Cooper pairs tunnel, results in qualitatively different properties, and controlling this opens up a wide range of applications in superconducting technology. However, access to even-dominated regimes has remained challenging and has so far relied on complex multi-junction or all-hybrid architectures. Here, we demonstrate a simple “harmonic parity qubit”; an element that combines two aluminum-oxide tunnel junctions in parallel to a gate-tunable InAs/Al nanowire junction forming a SQUID, and use spectroscopy versus flux to reconstruct its energy-phase relation at 85 gate voltage points. At half flux quantum, the odd harmonics of the Josephson potential can be suppressed by up to two orders of magnitude relative to the even harmonics, producing a double-well potential dominated by even harmonics with minima near ± π/2. The ability to control harmonic parity enables supercurrent carried by pairs of Cooper pairs and provides a new building block for Fourier engineering in superconducting circuits.
title_zh: 混合超导量子位中铜对隧道效应的受控奇偶校验
abstract_zh: 超导量子电路的非线性源自约瑟夫森能量相位关系。除了基本的 cos⁡phi" role="presentation">cos⁡phi\cos \phi 项之外，该关系还可以包含对应于 k 个库珀对的相关隧道效应的高阶傅立叶谐波 cos⁡(kphi)" role="presentation">cos⁡(kphi)\cos (k\phi )。主要隧道过程的奇偶性，即无论是奇数还是偶数库珀对隧道，都会导致性质不同的性质，并且控制这一点在超导技术中开辟了广泛的应用。然而，进入偶数主导的体系仍然具有挑战性，并且迄今为止依赖于复杂的多结或全混合架构。在这里，我们演示了一个简单的“谐波奇偶校验量子位”；该元件将两个氧化铝隧道结与栅极可调的 InAs/Al 纳米线结并联，形成 SQUID，并使用光谱与通量来重建其在 85 个栅极电压点的能量相位关系。在半通量量子下，约瑟夫森势的奇次谐波相对于偶次谐波可以被抑制高达两个数量级，从而产生由偶次谐波主导的双阱势，最小值接近±π/2。控制谐波奇偶校验的能力使得库珀对能够承载超电流，并为超导电路中的傅立叶工程提供了新的构建模块。

title: A ring-jig additive friction stir deposition method for efficient additive manufacturing of metal laminates
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Metal additive manufacturing (AM) has attracted attention for producing high-mix, low-volume, meter-scale components, especially for industrial applications. However, conventional AM requires high-energy input, expensive powders, and long processing times, limiting scalability and cost-effectiveness. To overcome these challenges, solid-state AM methods are being explored for lower energy use and higher build rates. This study presents a solid-state AM technique derived from friction surfacing, in which uniform layers are formed by direct friction between a rotating metal bar and a substrate. The proposed method achieves a maximum build rate of 8,000 cm³ h−1, while fusion-based AM method achieves 800 cm3 h−1 and conventional solid-state AM method achieves 2400 cm3 h−1 in maximum. Compared with other processes, the proposed method offers significant gains in deposition speed. Combining high build rate with sound interfacial bonding, the proposed method provides a promising approach for scalable, cost-effective production of large structural metal components.
title_zh: 用于高效增材制造金属层压板的环形夹具增材搅拌摩擦沉积方法
abstract_zh: 金属增材制造 (AM) 因其生产高混合、小批量、米级部件而受到关注，特别是在工业应用中。然而，传统的增材制造需要高能量输入、昂贵的粉末和较长的处理时间，限制了可扩展性和成本效益。为了克服这些挑战，人们正在探索固态增材制造方法，以降低能耗和提高构建速度。这项研究提出了一种源自摩擦表面处理的固态增材制造技术，其中通过旋转金属棒和基材之间的直接摩擦形成均匀的层。该方法的最大构建速率为8,000 cm3 h−1，而基于融合的AM方法最大可实现800 cm3 h−1，而传统的固态AM方法最大可实现2400 cm3 h−1。与其他工艺相比，所提出的方法显着提高了沉积速度。该方法将高构建率与良好的界面结合相结合，为大型结构金属部件的可扩展、经济高效的生产提供了一种有前途的方法。

title: Greenhouse warming exacerbates El Niño-induced Indian monsoon droughts
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The inverse relationship between the El Niño‒Southern Oscillation (ENSO) and the Indian summer monsoon has weakened since the early 1980s. Here, we demonstrate that the historical weakening of the ENSO–monsoon relationship was caused by two unusual events (in 1983 and 1997), and greenhouse warming has actually strengthened rather than weakened this link between 1902 and 2023 and is projected to continue doing so. However, confidence in the projection of this enhancement remains relatively low. We attribute the model spread in ENSO–monsoon links to variations in ENSO-induced Walker circulation anomalies, primarily through zonal wind feedback processes. Through the use of multiple observations to constrain such atmospheric dynamic processes, we find that the observation-constrained sensitivity of monsoons to the ENSO by the end of this century will become almost 40% greater than that from 1963–2023. Such intensification occurs because, even if the degree of El Niño-induced sea surface warming remains unchanged, the response of tropical precipitation to sea surface warming will increase, causing further eastward displacement of Walker circulation anomalies and an increased subsidence over the Indian subcontinent, which will reduce monsoon precipitation further. Our findings suggest intensified hydrological extremes and increased risks for food security in India in a warmer future.
title_zh: 温室变暖加剧了厄尔尼诺现象引起的印度季风干旱
abstract_zh: 自 20 世纪 80 年代初以来，厄尔尼诺南方涛动 (ENSO) 与印度夏季风之间的负相关关系有所减弱。在这里，我们证明了ENSO与季风关系的历史性减弱是由两个不寻常的事件（1983年和1997年）引起的，而温室变暖实际上加强了而不是削弱了1902年至2023年之间的这种联系，并且预计将继续这种情况。然而，人们对这一增强预测的信心仍然相对较低。我们将 ENSO-季风联系中的模型传播归因于 ENSO 引起的沃克环流异常的变化，主要是通过纬向风反馈过程。通过利用多次观测来约束此类大气动力过程，我们发现，到本世纪末，季风对ENSO的观测约束敏感性将比1963年至2023年增加近40%。这种加剧的原因是，即使厄尔尼诺引起的海面变暖程度不变，热带降水对海面变暖的响应也会增强，导致沃克环流异常进一步东移，印度次大陆沉降加剧，从而进一步减少季风降水。我们的研究结果表明，在温暖的未来，印度的水文极端事件将会加剧，粮食安全风险也会增加。

title: ERH elicits cell lineage restriction in mammalian preimplantation development and differentiation from pluripotency via H3K9me3-heterochromatin
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Enhancer of Rudimentary Homolog (ERH) is an evolutionarily conserved protein originally characterized as promoting fission yeast heterochromatin and recently shown to maintain H3K9me3 heterochromatin in human fibroblasts. Here, we find that ERH depletion in fibroblasts reverts the somatic cell H3K9me3 landscape of broad megabase size domains to an embryonic stem cell (ESC) state composed of mainly H3K9me3 peaks and enables activation of naïve and pluripotency genes and transposable elements during induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) reprogramming. Concordantly, we find that ERH represses totipotent and alternative lineage programs during mouse preimplantation development and is required for proper segregation of the inner cell mass and trophectoderm cell lineages. During human ESC differentiation into germ layer lineages, ERH silences naïve and pluripotency genes, transposable elements, and alternative lineage somatic genes. As in fission yeast, we find that mammalian ERH interacts with RNA-binding proteins to engage and repress its chromatin targets. Our findings reveal a conserved, fundamental role for ERH in mammalian cell fate specification via the initiation and maintenance of early developmental gene repression.
title_zh: ERH 通过 H3K9me3-异染色质在哺乳动物植入前发育和多能性分化中引起细胞谱系限制
abstract_zh: 基本同源增强子 (ERH) 是一种进化上保守的蛋白质，最初的特征是促进裂殖酵母异染色质，最近显示可维持人成纤维细胞中的 H3K9me3 异染色质。在这里，我们发现成纤维细胞中的 ERH 耗竭将宽兆碱基大小的体细胞 H3K9me3 景观恢复为主要由 H3K9me3 峰组成的胚胎干细胞 (ESC) 状态，并在诱导多能干细胞 (iPSC) 重编程过程中激活幼稚和多能基因和转座元件。一致地，我们发现 ERH 在小鼠植入前发育过程中抑制全能和替代谱系程序，并且是内细胞团和滋养外胚层细胞谱系正确分离所必需的。在人类 ESC 分化为胚层谱系期间，ERH 沉默幼稚基因和多能性基因、转座元件和替代谱系体细胞基因。与裂殖酵母一样，我们发现哺乳动物 ERH 与 RNA 结合蛋白相互作用，以接合并抑制其染色质靶标。我们的研究结果揭示了 ERH 通过启动和维持早期发育基因抑制在哺乳动物细胞命运规范中发挥保守的基本作用。

title: A manufacturability-informed topology framework for AI-guided design of fibrous network materials
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Designing fibrous network materials that are simultaneously high-performance and manufacturable remains a fundamental challenge due to the complex coupling between topology, mechanics, and fabrication constraints. Here, we introduce the Regular Fibrous Network Framework, a manufacturability-informed and physics-consistent artificial intelligence framework that bridges digital topology, mechanical prediction, and physical realization. Within this framework, the Topology-Preserving Network Construction algorithm formalizes Eulerian circuit continuity for single-fiber fabrication and transforms digital topologies into knitting- and three-dimensional-printing-compatible architectures. An automated finite-element-analysis pipeline and a physics-inspired graph neural network accurately capture nonlinear J-type and C-type load-displacement behaviors, while a reinforcement learning module performs inverse design within minutes, achieving approximately 50% higher strength and approximately 20% lower mass compared with initial designs. Extending the framework with QuadriFlow-based surface mapping enables direct projection of optimized two-dimensional networks onto curved three-dimensional geometries. This approach is experimentally validated through stereolithography and fused deposition modeling. By integrating manufacturability constraints, physics-inspired learning, and artificial-intelligence-driven optimization into a unified pipeline, the proposed framework provides a generalizable paradigm for knittable, printable, and programmable fibrous network materials, offering a pathway toward autonomous and high-efficiency design of architected materials across length scales.
title_zh: 用于人工智能引导的纤维网络材料设计的可制造性拓扑框架
abstract_zh: 由于拓扑、力学和制造约束之间的复杂耦合，设计同时具有高性能和可制造性的纤维网络材料仍然是一个基本挑战。在这里，我们介绍常规纤维网络框架，这是一种可制造性知情且物理一致的人工智能框架，可连接数字拓扑、机械预测和物理实现。在此框架内，拓扑保持网络构建算法形式化了单光纤制造的欧拉电路连续性，并将数字拓扑转换为针织和三维打印兼容的架构。自动化有限元分析流程和受物理启发的图形神经网络准确捕获非线性 J 型和 C 型负载位移行为，而强化学习模块可在几分钟内执行逆向设计，与初始设计相比，强度提高约 50%，质量降低约 20%。使用基于 QuadriFlow 的表面映射扩展框架，可以将优化的二维网络直接投影到弯曲的三维几何形状上。该方法通过立体光刻和熔融沉积建模进行了实验验证。通过将可制造性约束、物理启发学习和人工智能驱动的优化集成到统一的管道中，所提出的框架为可针织、可打印和可编程纤维网络材料提供了一个通用范例，提供了一条途径

title: Northward expansion of high-stature vegetation reveals net surface-cooling feedbacks in the majority of Canadian Boreal-Tundra ecozones
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Climate warming has driven widespread shrub and tree expansion across the Canadian boreal-tundra. This is widely expected to amplify surface warming. However, whether this expectation is supported by observations remains unresolved. Here we show, using satellite observations of vegetation change alongside climate and surface-energy data from 1986 to 2023, that about 70% of central and northern Canadian ecozones exhibit net surface cooling tendencies, driven by interactions between vegetation change and the environment that reduce the energy available to warm the land surface ( −0.003 to −0.009W m−2 yr−1). Cooling is strongest in landscapes transitioning toward mixedwood forests, broadleaf vegetation and treed wetlands, reducing warming by approximately 0.015–0.028°C yr−1 relative to shrub- and conifer-dominated areas. These findings challenge the view that vegetation expansion at high latitudes uniformly drives warming, showing that its effects depend on vegetation type, moisture and environmental context. They further suggest that the continued spread of mixed vegetation communities may moderate surface warming previously associated with conifer-dominated landscapes.
title_zh: 高植被向北扩张揭示了加拿大北方苔原生态区大部分地区的净地表冷却反馈
abstract_zh: 气候变暖导致加拿大北方苔原上的灌木和树木大面积扩张。人们普遍预计这会加剧地表变暖。然而，这一预期是否得到观察结果的支持仍然悬而未决。在这里，我们利用1986年至2023年植被变化的卫星观测以及气候和地表能量数据表明，约70%的加拿大中部和北部生态区表现出净地表冷却趋势，这是由植被变化与环境之间的相互作用驱动的，减少了可用于温暖地表的能量（-0.003至-0.009W m−2 yr−1）。在向混合木森林、阔叶植被和树木湿地过渡的景观中降温最为强烈，相对于灌木和针叶树为主的地区，变暖速度减少约 0.015–0.028°C yr−1。这些发现挑战了高纬度地区植被扩张会导致变暖的观点，表明其影响取决于植被类型、湿度和环境背景。他们进一步表明，混合植被群落的持续蔓延可能会缓解以前与针叶树为主的景观相关的地表变暖。

title: Low-intensity pulsed ultrasound-mediated nose-to-brain co-delivery of β-blockers and aPD-L1 enhances glioblastoma immunotherapy
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Intranasal delivery offers a direct route to the brain, circumventing the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and minimizing systemic toxicity. However, its efficiency is mainly limited by the nasal mucosal barrier (NMB). Here, low-intensity pulsed ultrasound (LIPUS) without depending on the microbubbles (MBs) to amplify energy, is directly used to reversibly open the NMB by disrupting tight junction proteins. A bionic nanovesicle (iRGD-anti-programmed cell death ligand 1 (aPD-L1) & carvedilol (β-blocker) @ macrophage-derived extracellular vesicles, iMPC) is designed to co-deliver carvedilol for β-receptor blockade to reduce T-cell exhaustion, and aPD-L1 to enhance T-cell anti-tumor activity in orthotopic glioblastoma (GBM) mice during the two-hour window for NMB opening. Consequently, compared to free aPD-L1, up to a 33.38-fold increase of aPD-L1 in the GBM region is obtained with LIPUS-mediated intranasal delivery of iMPC. Reactivating T cells significantly enhances immunotherapy, leading to a 40% tumor reduction, extended survival, and long-term immune memory in orthotopic GBM mice. Overall, the LIPUS-mediated NMB opening strategy notably enhances nose-to-brain drug delivery efficiency, offering a promising platform for treating brain diseases.
title_zh: 低强度脉冲超声介导的 β 受体阻滞剂和 aPD-L1 鼻到脑共同递送可增强胶质母细胞瘤免疫治疗
abstract_zh: 鼻内给药提供了直接到达大脑的途径，绕过血脑屏障（BBB）并最大限度地减少全身毒性。然而，其效率主要受到鼻粘膜屏障（NMB）的限制。在这里，低强度脉冲超声（LIPUS）不依赖微泡（MB）来放大能量，直接用于通过破坏紧密连接蛋白来可逆地打开NMB。仿生纳米囊泡（iRGD-抗程序性细胞死亡配体 1 (aPD-L1) 和卡维地洛（β 受体阻滞剂）@ 巨噬细胞衍生的细胞外囊泡，iMPC）旨在共同递送卡维地洛以阻断 β 受体以减少 T 细胞耗竭，以及 aPD-L1 以增强原位胶质母细胞瘤 (GBM) 小鼠的 T 细胞抗肿瘤活性。 NMB 开放两小时窗口。因此，与游离的aPD-L1相比，通过LIPUS介导的iMPC鼻内递送，GBM区域中的aPD-L1增加了高达33.38倍。重新激活 T 细胞可显着增强免疫治疗，使原位 GBM 小鼠的肿瘤减少 40%、延长生存期并获得长期免疫记忆。总体而言，LIPUS介导的NMB开放策略显着提高了鼻到脑的药物输送效率，为治疗脑部疾病提供了一个有前途的平台。

title: Directional thermal emission enables efficient energy savings
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Thermal radiation, a fundamental heat transfer mechanism, is crucial for energy exchange across various applications. However, conventional radiative heat transfer systems rely on omnidirectional thermal radiation, causing energy dissipation in undesired directions and limiting radiative heat transfer efficiency. Here, we show that perfectly matched directional thermal emission between an emitter and absorber can reach a theoretical efficiency up to 100%. In a parallel-plate configuration, replacing a conventional system with a customized directional system raises efficiency from 29% to 100%. We further experimentally demonstrate directional radiative heat transfer realizes substantial energy savings of 67.8% in vacuum and 28.7% in non-vacuum conditions. Moreover, directional radiative heat transfer enables efficient heating in diverse scenarios, including vehicle heating, car paint drying, human body heating, and rail car thawing, achieving 17–46% energy savings. Our work highlights the broad applicability and energy-saving potential of directional radiative heat transfer, opening new avenues for efficient energy utilization.
title_zh: 定向热发射可实现高效节能
abstract_zh: 热辐射是一种基本的传热机制，对于各种应用中的能量交换至关重要。然而，传统的辐射传热系统依赖于全向热辐射，导致能量在不期望的方向上耗散并限制了辐射传热效率。在这里，我们证明发射器和吸收器之间完美匹配的定向热发射可以达到高达 100% 的理论效率。在平行板配置中，用定制定向系统替换传统系统可将效率从 29% 提高到 100%。我们进一步通过实验证明，定向辐射传热在真空条件下可实现 67.8% 的节能，在非真空条件下可实现 28.7% 的节能。此外，定向辐射传热可以在车辆加热、车漆干燥、人体加热、轨道车辆解冻等多种场景下实现高效加热，实现17-46%的节能。我们的工作凸显了定向辐射传热的广泛适用性和节能潜力，为高效能源利用开辟了新途径。

title: Tracking the catastrophic collapse of hybrid exciton-phonon order in a quantum material
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Revealing the hidden interactions that bind electronic and lattice components of cooperative quantum order is central to sculpting new states of matter. This challenge is epitomized by the charge density wave material 1T-TiSe2, where photoexcitation disrupts its presumed hybrid exciton-phonon order: the electronic component collapses within femtoseconds, while the periodic lattice distortion persists, challenging the definition of hybrid order. Here we resolve this paradox by uncovering a low-frequency mode (~0.13 THz) that emerges only in the ordered state and signals exciton-phonon coupling. This mode is consistent with a locked phason, a collective excitation arising when excitonic and lattice degrees of freedom share a coupled potential landscape. At a critical photoexcitation threshold, the collapse of the excitonic order flattens this potential, causing the locked phason to disappear, the charge density wave phonon to selectively overheat, and the surviving lattice distortion to become a trapped non-thermal remnant.
title_zh: 跟踪量子材料中混合激子-声子序的灾难性崩溃
abstract_zh: 揭示合作量子秩序的电子和晶格成分之间隐藏的相互作用是塑造新物质状态的核心。这一挑战的集中体现是电荷密度波材料 1T-TiSe2，其中光激发破坏了其假定的混合激子-声子序：电子元件在飞秒内崩溃，而周期性晶格畸变仍然存在，这对混合序的定义提出了挑战。在这里，我们通过揭示仅出现在有序状态和信号激子-声子耦合中的低频模式（~0.13 THz）来解决这个悖论。这种模式与锁定相子一致，锁定相子是当激子和晶格自由度共享耦合势能景观时产生的集体激发。在临界光激发阈值下，激子级的崩溃使该电势变平，导致锁定的相子消失，电荷密度波声子选择性过热，并且幸存的晶格畸变成为俘获的非热残余物。

title: Spatiotemporal patterns of lower-band whistler mode waves in the magnetosphere of Earth
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Electromagnetic emissions of lower-band chorus and exohiss waves are known to interact with electrons in the Earth’s outer radiation belt. Understanding statistical properties of these natural emissions is essential for modeling space weather hazards and protecting satellite infrastructure. Despite extensive previous studies, their spatiotemporal characteristics remain incompletely understood. Here, we analyze a large data set of spacecraft measurements, showing that distributions of wave amplitudes exhibit a wide log-normal core with an irregular heavy tail, changing with geomagnetic activity and location. The distribution of time intervals between wave detections follows a power law, suggestive of temporal bunching. Around local noon, we nearly always detect waves up to high latitudes, while intense waves occur for less than a few percent of the time, predominantly in the postmidnight equatorial region. Our findings indicate that the burstiness of whistler-mode waves may not be fully captured by long-term averages, which are commonly used in radiation belt modeling.
title_zh: 地球磁层低频带口哨模波的时空分布
abstract_zh: 众所周知，低频带合唱波和外展波的电磁发射会与地球外辐射带中的电子相互作用。了解这些自然排放的统计特性对于建模空间天气灾害和保护卫星基础设施至关重要。尽管之前进行了大量研究，但它们的时空特征仍然不完全清楚。在这里，我们分析了航天器测量的大型数据集，表明波幅的分布表现出宽对数正态核心和不规则的重尾，随着地磁活动和位置的变化而变化。波检测之间的时间间隔分布遵循幂律，暗示时间聚束。在当地正午前后，我们几乎总是检测到高纬度地区的波浪，而强烈波浪的出现时间不到百分之几，主要发生在午夜后的赤道地区。我们的研究结果表明，长期平均值可能无法完全捕获哨声模式波的突发性，而长期平均值通常用于辐射带建模。

title: An intelligent electronic-textile system with adaptive sweat-regulation for continuous exercise-induced fatigue monitoring
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Characterizing exercise-induced fatigue is challenging due to difficulties in monitoring biochemical and electrophysiological signals consistently. While wearable sensors able to monitor both signals are available, they struggle to maintain stable signal acquisition across exercise-rest scenarios because of significant sweat variation. Here we describe the development of a system, FatigueVisual, combining an adaptive sweat-regulating hybrid electronic textile (e-ASRHT) patch with artificial intelligence (AI) analytics to improve fatigue management. The key innovation lies in the precise regulation of the breakthrough pressure of micropores in fabric electrodes and sweat-excreting areas, allowing for accurate sweat management. This design enables efficient enrichment at an ultralow sweat rate (5.0×10−4 ml cm−2 min−1) while rapidly transporting excess sweat at a rate 2533 times the human physiological limit, ensuring stable chemical-electrophysiological sensing from exercise to rest. A cloud-connected AI model, trained on over 200,000 time-resolved observations collected from 10 participants, recognizes six fatigue-related states and provides personalized exercise management via a mobile app. Validation in three participants showed 87.3% agreement with clinical assessments. The system reduced exercise fatigue by 51.8% and accelerated recovery by 48 h compared with the control group. In practice, FatigueVisual may enable intelligent sports health management.
title_zh: 具有自适应出汗调节功能的智能电子纺织系统，用于连续监测运动引起的疲劳
abstract_zh: 由于难以持续监测生化和电生理信号，表征运动引起的疲劳具有挑战性。虽然能够监测这两种信号的可穿戴传感器是可用的，但由于汗液变化很大，它们很难在运动-休息场景下保持稳定的信号采集。在这里，我们描述了 FatigueVisual 系统的开发，该系统将自适应出汗调节混合电子纺织品 (e-ASRHT) 贴片与人工智能 (AI) 分析相结合，以改善疲劳管理。关键创新在于精确调节织物电极和排汗区域微孔的突破压力，从而实现精确的排汗管理。这种设计能够以超低出汗率（5.0×10−4 ml cm−2 min−1）实现高效富集，同时以人类生理极限的2533倍的速率快速输送多余的汗液，确保从运动到休息期间稳定的化学电生理传感。一个与云连接的人工智能模型经过从 10 名参与者收集的超过 200,000 个时间分辨观察数据的训练，可以识别六种与疲劳相关的状态，并通过移动应用程序提供个性化的锻炼管理。三名参与者的验证显示与临床评估的一致性为 87.3%。与对照组相比，该系统减少了51.8%的运动疲劳，并加速了48小时的恢复。在实践中，FatigueVisual 可以实现智能运动健康管理。

title: Tunable photofluorochromic switch driven by dynamic through-space conjugation
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Light is a powerful stimulus for regulating molecular functions, yet achieving precise and efficient photoswitching remains a significant challenge in organic materials, particularly in the aggregate state. Here we report a strategy based on dynamic through-space conjugation (TSC) to regulate photoswitching in Schiff-base crystals. Upon photoexcitation, the system undergoes an excited-state intramolecular proton transfer followed sequentially by cis-trans keto isomerization, a process in which electrons near the nitrogen atom dynamically couple with adjacent π-donors. This transient nitrogen-based TSC, captured by the femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy and corroborated by high-pressure experiments and calculations, modulates both the transition-state barrier and the stability of the metastable state, thereby markedly enhancing photoswitching efficiency. Beyond mechanistic insight, this study introduces a design paradigm that exploits dynamic nitrogen-based TSC to engineer light-driven logic devices, with broad implications extending from artificial vision sensors to molecular motors.
title_zh: 由动态空间共轭驱动的可调谐光荧光变色开关
abstract_zh: 光是调节分子功能的强大刺激，但实现精确有效的光开关仍然是有机材料中的一个重大挑战，特别是在聚集状态下。在这里，我们报告了一种基于动态空间共轭（TSC）的策略来调节席夫碱晶体中的光开关。光激发后，该系统经历激发态分子内质子转移，随后进行顺反酮异构化，这是氮原子附近的电子与相邻 π 供体动态耦合的过程。这种瞬态氮基TSC通过飞秒瞬态吸收光谱捕获并通过高压实验和计算证实，可以调节过渡态势垒和亚稳态的稳定性，从而显着提高光开关效率。除了机械洞察之外，这项研究还引入了一种设计范式，利用动态氮基 TSC 来设计光驱动逻辑器件，其广泛的影响范围从人工视觉传感器延伸到分子电机。

title: Synergistic Steric Hindrance and Chlorination Enable Efficient Binary Organic Solar Cells with Low Energy Loss
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: We report a series of small-molecule acceptors Z1–Z4 that reconcile low non-radiative energy loss with efficient charge transport by combining a nitrogen-containing core with out-of-plane steric-hindrance/chlorination-regulated packing. The dibenzo[b,f]azepine unit enables low non-radiative energy losses below 0.20 eV, while progressive backbone unlocking and targeted chlorination reshape intermolecular packing by suppressing unfavorable core-centered aggregation and promoting multidimensional electronic coupling. Single-crystal analysis, GIWAXS, and electronic-structure calculations reveal enhanced packing coherence and stronger coupling pathways from Z1 to Z4. Transient absorption spectroscopy and kinetic analysis further show that improved exciton delocalization accelerates interfacial exciton dissociation and suppresses monomolecular recombination. Photo-induced force microscopy confirms more continuous acceptor-rich fibrils in Z3- and Z4-based blends. Consequently, the optimized Z4-based binary device achieves a PCE of 20.28% with a high open-circuit voltage of 0.95 V, demonstrating an effective molecular strategy for low energy-loss high-performance organic solar cells.
title_zh: 协同空间位阻和氯化可实现低能量损失的高效二元有机太阳能电池
abstract_zh: 我们报告了一系列小分子受体 Z1-Z4，通过将含氮核心与面外空间位阻/氯化调节填料相结合，将低非辐射能量损失与高效电荷传输相结合。二苯并[b,f]氮杂苯单元可实现低于 0.20 eV 的低非辐射能量损失，同时通过抑制不利的以核为中心的聚集和促进多维电子耦合，逐步主链解锁和定向氯化重塑分子间堆积。单晶分析、GIWAXS 和电子结构计算揭示了增强的堆积相干性和更强的从 Z1 到 Z4 的耦合路径。瞬态吸收光谱和动力学分析进一步表明，改善的激子离域加速了界面激子解离并抑制单分子重组。光诱导力显微镜证实了基于 Z3 和 Z4 的混合物中存在更连续的富含受体的原纤维。因此，优化的基于 Z4 的二元器件的 PCE 达到 20.28%，开路电压为 0.95 V，展示了低能量损耗高性能有机太阳能电池的有效分子策略。

title: Longitudinal analysis reveals myeloid cell contributions to murine neuroPASC pathogenesis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Neurological and neuropsychiatric symptoms, collectively termed neuroPASC, are among the most prevalent Post-Acute Sequelae of COVID-19 (PASC). Neuroinflammation – particularly microglia reactivity – has been implicated in neuroPASC. We previously established a PASC model in which SARS-CoV-2-infected mice developed persistent behavior alterations and prolonged neuroinflammation for up to 120 days post-infection (dpi). Here, we extend these results to a longitudinal single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of brain immune cells collected at 0, 6, 30, and 100 dpi. We identify a coordinated contribution of infiltrating and resident myeloid cells to the initiation and persistence of neuroinflammation. In specific, microglia display sustained expansion of subclusters characterized by inflammatory, stress response, and metabolic signatures. Border-associated macrophages upregulate monocyte attractants during acute infection. Concurrently, peripherally derived monocytes and neutrophils mount transient inflammatory responses, potentially triggering long-term microglial reactivity. Together, these findings provide a high-resolution atlas of brain myeloid immune dynamics during neuroPASC and highlight a central role for microglia in sustaining chronic neuroinflammation.
title_zh: 纵向分析揭示骨髓细胞对小鼠 NeuroPASC 发病机制的贡献
abstract_zh: 神经系统和神经精神症状统称为 NeuroPASC，是 COVID-19 (PASC) 最常见的急性后遗症之一。神经炎症——尤其是小胶质细胞反应性——与neuroPASC有关。我们之前建立了一个 PASC 模型，其中 SARS-CoV-2 感染的小鼠在感染后长达 120 天（dpi）内出现持续的行为改变和长期的神经炎症。在这里，我们将这些结果扩展到对 0、6、30 和 100 dpi 收集的脑免疫细胞进行纵向单细胞 RNA 测序分析。我们确定了浸润和驻留的骨髓细胞对神经炎症的发生和持续的协调作用。具体而言，小胶质细胞表现出以炎症、应激反应和代谢特征为特征的亚簇的持续扩张。边缘相关巨噬细胞在急性感染期间上调单核细胞引诱剂。同时，外周来源的单核细胞和中性粒细胞会产生短暂的炎症反应，可能引发长期的小胶质细胞反应。总之，这些发现提供了 NeuroPASC 期间脑髓系免疫动态的高分辨率图谱，并强调了小胶质细胞在维持慢性神经炎症中的核心作用。

title: Ultrafast bimolecular reaction catalysis via engineered nuclear quantum effects in helium nanodroplets
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Nuclear quantum effects (NQEs) fundamentally alter chemical reactivities, particularly those occurring at low temperatures or involving light nuclei. Yet, directly resolving how NQEs influence the ultrafast dynamics of bond formation remains a central challenge. Here we report the time-resolved observation of NQEs catalyzing a light-induced bimolecular reaction within a quantum-phase environment. Using femtosecond pump-probe spectroscopy on H2-H2 and D2-D2 dimers confined in helium nanodroplets at 0.37 K, we find that the low-temperature conditions engineered by the host environment drive a pronounced acceleration of reaction dynamics. The formation of \({{{{\rm{H}}}}}_{3}^{+}\) is accelerated to 59 ± 10 fs in the droplet compared to 152 ± 17 fs in the gas phase. This catalytic effect is strongly isotope-dependent, with the heavier \({{{{\rm{D}}}}}_{3}^{+}\) exhibiting only a slight reduction in formation time from 153 ± 8 fs to 111 ± 9 fs. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal that the acceleration is catalyzed by pronounced NQEs under cryogenic confinement, with lighter hydrogen isotopes exhibiting greater quantum delocalization and consequently faster reaction rates. These findings provide a time-resolved perspective on quantum effects in ultracold chemistry, demonstrating how the unique environment of nano-cryo-reactors can harness temperature-driven NQEs to steer the ultrafast dynamics of chemical reactions.
title_zh: 通过氦纳米液滴中的工程核量子效应进行超快双分子反应催化
abstract_zh: 核量子效应 (NQE) 从根本上改变化学反应性，特别是在低温下或涉及轻核时发生的化学反应性。然而，直接解决 NQE 如何影响债券形成的超快动态仍然是一个核心挑战。在这里，我们报告了 NQE 在量子相环境中催化光诱导双分子反应的时间分辨观察。使用飞秒泵浦探针光谱对 0.37 K 限制在氦纳米液滴中的 H2-H2 和 D2-D2 二聚体进行分析，我们发现宿主环境设计的低温条件显着加速了反应动力学。 \({{{{\rm{H}}}}}_{3}^{+}\) 的形成在液滴中加速至 59 ± 10 fs，而在气相中为 152 ± 17 fs。这种催化效应强烈依赖于同位素，较重的 \({{{{\rm{D}}}}}_{3}^{+}\) 的形成时间仅略有减少，从 153 ± 8 fs 到 111 ± 9 fs。分子动力学模拟表明，低温约束下显着的 NQE 催化了加速，较轻的氢同位素表现出更大的量子离域性，因此反应速率更快。这些发现为超冷化学中的量子效应提供了时间分辨的视角，展示了纳米低温反应器的独特环境如何利用温度驱动的 NQE 来引导化学反应的超快动力学。

title: Rapid and quantitative measurement of bacteriophage infectivity via fully automated droplet digital PCR
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The clinical translation of phage therapy for multidrug-resistant infections is constrained by the lack of rapid, standardized therapeutic phage selection. Here, we introduce digital phage susceptibility testing (dPhaST), an automated droplet digital PCR workflow that quantifies phage-induced DNA release as a molecular signature of lysis. By targeting conserved 16S rRNA regions, dPhaST measures lytic activity across diverse bacterial pathogens within 3 h. Across 122 phage–host combinations involving 19 bacterial strains from six species, dPhaST shows 95.9% concordance with spot tests while resolving weak and heterogeneous lytic activities that are not readily distinguished phenotypically. It remains robust during the early infection window despite phage-encoded nuclease activity and tolerates phage cross-contamination better than spot tests. The method captures defense-mediated interactions involving CRISPR–Cas and Sir2-HerA systems. In this work, we show that automated digital quantification enables rapid and mechanistically informative profiling of early phage lytic efficacy across Gram-positive and Gram-negative pathogens.
title_zh: 通过全自动液滴数字 PCR 快速定量测量噬菌体感染性
abstract_zh: 由于缺乏快速、标准化的治疗性噬菌体选择，噬菌体疗法治疗多重耐药感染的临床转化受到限制。在这里，我们介绍数字噬菌体敏感性测试 (dPhaST)，这是一种自动化液滴数字 PCR 工作流程，可将噬菌体诱导的 DNA 释放量化为裂解的分子特征。通过靶向保守的 16S rRNA 区域，dPhaST 可在 3 小时内测量多种细菌病原体的裂解活性。在涉及来自 6 个物种的 19 种细菌菌株的 122 个噬菌体-宿主组合中，dPhaST 显示与斑点测试的一致性为 95.9%，同时解决了表型上不易区分的微弱且异质的裂解活性。尽管存在噬菌体编码的核酸酶活性，但它在早期感染窗口期间仍然保持稳健，并且比斑点测试更好地耐受噬菌体交叉污染。该方法捕获涉及 CRISPR-Cas 和 Sir2-HerA 系统的防御介导的相互作用。在这项工作中，我们表明，自动数字量化能够快速、机械地对革兰氏阳性和革兰氏阴性病原体的早期噬菌体裂解功效进行分析。

title: Effect of a complementary feeding intervention based on iron- and zinc-biofortified pearl millet on the gut microbiota in 12–18-month-old children: a randomized trial
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Iron supplementation studies in children under five suggest potentially adverse gut microbiota shifts. Given iron’s importance during early childhood, food-based approaches may offer a more viable supplementation strategy. Using shotgun metagenomics, we examined the effects of 9 months’ daily consumption of iron/zinc-biofortified pearl millet (FeZnPM; 8.70 mg/100 g iron) versus control pearl millet (CPM; 3 mg/100 g iron) on the gut microbiome in 12–18-month-old children without severe anemia (hemoglobin ≥9.0 g/dL) from Mumbai urban slums through a randomized controlled trial, the primary outcomes of which were iron status biomarkers and infant growth (ClinicalTrials.gov ID: NCT02233764). In paired (n = 81) and endpoint (n = 108) analyses, FeZnPM consumption was not associated with detectable adverse effects on developing microbiomes and exploratory analyses suggest that it may support beneficial metabolic adaptations via direct modulation of antibiotic, antioxidant, and pollutant degradation pathways. This suggests biofortified crops could provide a sustainable approach to addressing iron deficiency while maintaining healthy microbiome development in early life.
title_zh: 基于铁和锌生物强化珍珠粟的补充喂养干预对 12-18 个月大儿童肠道微生物群的影响：一项随机试验
abstract_zh: 五岁以下儿童的铁补充剂研究表明，肠道微生物群可能会发生不利的变化。鉴于铁在儿童早期的重要性，以食物为基础的方法可能提供更可行的补充策略。使用鸟枪法宏基因组学，我们通过随机对照研究，研究了孟买城市贫民窟的无严重贫血（血红蛋白≥9.0 g/dL）的 12-18 个月大儿童在 9 个月内每天食用铁/锌生物强化珍珠小米（FeZnPM；8.70 毫克/100 克铁）与对照珍珠小米（CPM；3 毫克/100 克铁）对肠道微生物组的影响。试验，其主要结果是铁状态生物标志物和婴儿生长（ClinicalTrials.gov ID：NCT02233764）。在配对 (n = 81) 和终点 (n = 108) 分析中，FeZnPM 消耗与发育中微生物组的可检测到的不利影响无关，探索性分析表明，它可能通过直接调节抗生素、抗氧化剂和污染物降解途径来支持有益的代谢适应。这表明生物强化作物可以提供一种可持续的方法来解决缺铁问题，同时保持生命早期健康的微生物组发育。

title: Circularly polarized electroluminescence from topologically chiral [2]catenane-based neutral radicals with tunable deep-red emission
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Stable organic radicals with unique luminescence have demonstrated great importance in photoelectromagnetic materials and have found broad applicability in the field of organic light-emitting diode (OLEDs). Aiming to further extend their application into chiral optoelectronic devices, by employing topologically chiral [2]catenane as the key chiral skeleton, this work presents the first successful construction of circularly polarized OLEDs (CP-OLEDs) based on donor–acceptor (D–A•) type neutral tris(2,4,6-trichlorophenyl)methyl (TTM) radicals. Remarkably, the topologically chiral skeleton, in combination with its controllable dynamic features, enables the system to exhibit a luminescence dissymmetry factor (|gPL|) value as high as 7.1 × 10-3, as well as reversible circularly polarized luminescence (CPL) on/off switching in film state. Importantly, the resulting CP-OLEDs exhibit deep red emission, a maximum external quantum efficiency (EQEmax) of 3.92%, and a |gEL| value of 7.2 × 10-3. These findings demonstrate the successful development of not only luminescent radicals with unique switchable CPL performances, but also the first CP-OLEDs with promising device performance based on topologically chiral radical emitter, providing a distinctive design principle and a versatile platform for the creation of next-generation smart CP-OLEDs.
title_zh: 具有可调深红色发射的拓扑手性[2]链烷中性自由基的圆偏振电致发光
abstract_zh: 具有独特发光性能的稳定有机自由基在光电磁材料中表现出非常重要的作用，并在有机发光二极管（OLED）领域具有广泛的应用性。为了进一步将其应用扩展到手性光电器件中，本工作采用拓扑手性[2]链烯作为关键手性骨架，首次成功构建了基于供体-受体（D–A•）型中性三（2,4,6-三氯苯基）甲基（TTM）自由基的圆偏振OLED（CP-OLED）。值得注意的是，拓扑手性骨架与其可控的动态特性相结合，使该系统能够表现出高达7.1×10-3的发光不对称因子（|gPL|）值，以及薄膜状态下的可逆圆偏振发光（CPL）开/关切换。重要的是，所得的 CP-OLED 表现出深红色发射，最大外量子效率 (EQEmax) 为 3.92%，|gEL|值为7.2×10-3。这些发现不仅证明了具有独特可切换CPL性能的发光自由基的成功开发，而且还证明了第一个基于拓扑手性自由基发射体的具有良好器件性能的CP-OLED，为创建下一代智能CP-OLED提供了独特的设计原理和多功能平台。

title: The basolateral amygdala decodes visceral pain and itch via distinct circuits and molecules
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: As aversive sensations, visceral pain and itch are highly refractory to conventional treatments. Accumulating evidence suggests that the basolateral amygdala (BLA) is involved in pain and itch; however, how the BLA segregates visceral pain and itch remains unclear. Here, we identify two distinct neuronal populations within the BLA that selectively respond to visceral pain and itch in mice. These populations project to distinct downstream brain regions-the ventromedial hypothalamus (VMH) and dorsomedial striatum (DMS)-forming separate circuits that specifically regulate visceral pain and itch. Furthermore, function-labeled single cell sequencing demonstrates that Fgf2 and Notch2 are highly and selectively expressed in visceral pain- and itch-labeled neurons, respectively. Knockdown of these genes selectively attenuates visceral pain and itch. These findings emphasize the critical role of the BLA in sorting the processes of visceral pain and itch, providing insights into the neural mechanisms underlying different sensory processing and identifying potential therapeutic targets.
title_zh: 基底外侧杏仁核通过不同的电路和分子解码内脏疼痛和瘙痒
abstract_zh: 作为厌恶的感觉，内脏疼痛和瘙痒对于传统治疗来说是非常难治的。越来越多的证据表明基底外侧杏仁核 (BLA) 与疼痛和瘙痒有关。然而，BLA 如何区分内脏疼痛和瘙痒仍不清楚。在这里，我们确定了 BLA 内的两个不同的神经元群，它们选择性地响应小鼠的内脏疼痛和瘙痒。这些群体投射到不同的下游大脑区域——下丘脑腹内侧（VMH）和背内侧纹状体（DMS）——形成专门调节内脏疼痛和瘙痒的独立回路。此外，功能标记的单细胞测序表明，Fgf2 和 Notch2 分别在内脏疼痛和瘙痒标记的神经元中高度选择性表达。这些基因的敲除可以选择性地减轻内脏疼痛和瘙痒。这些发现强调了 BLA 在分类内脏疼痛和瘙痒过程中的关键作用，提供了对不同感觉处理背后的神经机制的见解，并确定了潜在的治疗靶点。

title: Hypoxia-induced metastatic heterogeneity in pancreatic cancer
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: In solid tumors, hypoxia is a key driver of metastasis by promoting cellular plasticity and chromosomal instability (CIN). Despite this, the mechanisms by which malignant cells concurrently co-opt these elements of hypoxic adaptation to promote metastasis remains unclear. Here we report that hypoxia promotes metastasis by suppressing the JmjC-containing histone lysine demethylase KDM8. Kdm8 targeting in a Kras;Trp53-driven mouse model of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma induces a profound loss of the epithelial morphology and widespread metastatic disease. Mechanistically, Kdm8 suppression in normoxia recapitulates major aspects of the global epigenetic changes, transcriptomic rewiring, and mitotic spindle defects induced by hypoxia. Of note, disruption of Kdm8’s demethylase function phenocopies the effects of Kdm8 loss, whereas expression of hypermorphic Kdm8 variants that are resistant to hypoxic suppression reduces metastasis beyond the levels achieved by the wildtype counterpart. Through the suppression of Kdm8 demethylase activity, hypoxia unleashes a potent metastatic program by simultaneously advancing cellular plasticity and CIN.
title_zh: 缺氧诱导的胰腺癌转移异质性
abstract_zh: 在实体瘤中，缺氧通过促进细胞可塑性和染色体不稳定性（CIN）而成为转移的关键驱动因素。尽管如此，恶性细胞同时利用这些缺氧适应要素来促进转移的机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们报道缺氧通过抑制含有 JmjC 的组蛋白赖氨酸去甲基化酶 KDM8 来促进转移。在 Kras;Trp53 驱动的胰腺导管腺癌小鼠模型中，Kdm8 靶向诱导上皮形态的严重丧失和广泛的转移性疾病。从机制上讲，常氧条件下 Kdm8 的抑制概括了缺氧引起的整体表观遗传变化、转录组重新布线和有丝分裂纺锤体缺陷的主要方面。值得注意的是，Kdm8 去甲基化酶功能的破坏反映了 Kdm8 缺失的影响，而对缺氧抑制具有抵抗力的超态 Kdm8 变体的表达可将转移减少到超过野生型对应物所达到的水平。通过抑制 Kdm8 去甲基酶活性，缺氧可同时促进细胞可塑性和 CIN，从而释放有效的转移程序。

title: The m⁶A reader YTHDF2 regulates mRNA transport and axon outgrowth in developing neurons
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Proper nervous system development is critical for brain function, and deficits in neural development are implicated in many brain disorders. Neurons are distinctly polarized cells where mRNA can be transported to distal structures like axons and dendrites. Recent discoveries of widespread mRNA chemical modifications raise the question of their post-transcriptional regulatory role in brain development and function. N6-methyladenosine (m6A), installed by the METTL3/METTL14 methyltransferase complex, is the most prevalent internal mRNA modification, influencing stability, translation, splicing, and localization. However, the impact of m6A modification on RNA transport in developing neurons is not well understood. In this study, we find that the ablation of Mettl14 in postmitotic neurons leads to impaired axonal projection during corticogenesis. RNA-seq and single-molecule in situ hybridization reveal mislocalization of mRNAs in neurites of neurons with m6A loss-of-function. Furthermore, m6A-SAC-seq to identify a single nucleotide resolution m6A maps in the perinatal brain uncovers m6A-tagged transcripts associated with synapse organization, mRNA processing, and axonogenesis. We also identify YTHDF2 as the reader protein responsible for mRNA transport in callosal projection axons. YTHDF2 interacts with motor proteins, translational regulators, and microtubules to facilitate distal transport of m6A-tagged mRNA. Our data suggest that FMRP may serve as a context-guiding interactor that reshapes the YTHDF2 complex by recruiting specific cofactors and motor proteins, thereby promoting transport rather than degradation of m⁶A-tagged transcripts. Together, these findings provide insight into the epitranscriptomic mechanisms governing axon projection and guidance during mammalian cortical neurogenesis.
title_zh: m⁶A 阅读器 YTHDF2 调节发育神经元中的 mRNA 运输和轴突生长
abstract_zh: 适当的神经系统发育对于大脑功能至关重要，神经发育缺陷与许多大脑疾病有关。神经元是明显极化的细胞，其中 mRNA 可以被转运到轴突和树突等远端结构。最近发现的广泛 mRNA 化学修饰提出了它们在大脑发育和功能中的转录后调节作用的问题。 N6-甲基腺苷 (m6A) 由 METTL3/METTL14 甲基转移酶复合物安装，是最常见的内部 mRNA 修饰，影响稳定性、翻译、剪接和定位。然而，m6A 修饰对发育中神经元 RNA 转运的影响尚不清楚。在这项研究中，我们发现有丝分裂后神经元中 Mettl14 的消融导致皮质生成过程中轴突投射受损。 RNA-seq 和单分子原位杂交揭示了 m6A 功能丧失的神经元神经突中 mRNA 的错误定位。此外，m6A-SAC-seq 用于识别围产期大脑中的单核苷酸分辨率 m6A 图谱，揭示了与突触组织、mRNA 加工和轴突发生相关的 m6A 标记转录本。我们还确定 YTHDF2 是负责胼胝体投射轴突中 mRNA 运输的读取蛋白。 YTHDF2 与运动蛋白、翻译调节因子和微管相互作用，以促进 m6A 标记 mRNA 的远端运输。我们的数据表明，FMRP 可能作为上下文引导相互作用因子，通过招募特定的辅助因子和运动蛋白来重塑 YTHDF2 复合物，从而促进

title: ERAD-level gene switches for on-demand protein secretion and rapidly controlled gene therapies
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: On-demand regulation of therapeutic activities is critical to broaden the clinical utility of gene therapies. Here, we employ an Endoplasmic Reticulum-Associated Degradation (ERAD)-centered strategy to develop trigger-inducible gene switches tailor-designed for rapid protein secretion. By temporarily attaching conditional degron motifs to various therapeutic proteins of interest (POIs), inducible, tunable and reversible control of native POI secretion into the bloodstream was achieved through oral administration of specific clinically licensed small-molecule drugs. This simple and generalizable design principle is highly compatible with adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated gene delivery, enabling long-term and remote-controlled transgene expression in male mice in vivo. To showcase potential therapeutic benefits of ERAD-level gene switches, we describe gene therapy approaches for cardiovascular diseases and chronic pain - two classes of disease treatments that may most urgently require on-demand drug actions. This study achieves dose- and time-dependent control of transgene activities without requiring the design of overly complex gene circuits, and may form important basis to move synthetic biology-based regulation systems towards therapeutic usage.
title_zh: 用于按需蛋白质分泌和快速控制基因治疗的 ERAD 水平基因开关
abstract_zh: 治疗活动的按需调节对于扩大基因疗法的临床应用至关重要。在这里，我们采用以内质网相关降解（ERAD）为中心的策略来开发专为快速蛋白质分泌而设计的触发诱导基因开关。通过将条件降解决定子基序暂时附加到各种治疗性目的蛋白 (POI) 上，通过口服特定的临床许可的小分子药物，实现了对天然 POI 分泌到血流中的可诱导、可调节和可逆的控制。这种简单且可推广的设计原理与腺相关病毒（AAV）介导的基因传递高度兼容，从而能够在雄性小鼠体内进行长期和远程控制的转基因表达。为了展示 ERAD 水平基因开关的潜在治疗益处，我们描述了心血管疾病和慢性疼痛的基因治疗方法——这两类疾病治疗可能最迫切需要按需药物作用。这项研究实现了转基因活性的剂量和时间依赖性控制，而不需要设计过于复杂的基因电路，并且可能为将基于合成生物学的调节系统转向治疗用途奠定重要基础。

title: Uranium in cobalt-hydroxide exports from the Democratic Republic of the Congo
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)’s Copperbelt is the world’s leading source of cobalt, a metal essential to the energy transition. In this region, uranium co-occurs with oxidized cobalt ores. Despite no officially reported uranium production, we show that uranium is extracted, concentrated, and exported via the DRC cobalt supply chain. This conclusion follows from co-mineralization, similar behavior of cobalt and uranium in hydrometallurgical circuits, and the partitioning of uranium into crude cobalt hydroxide, the export form for over 95% of DRC production. We combine a first-order carryover model with geological mapping, mineralization and geochemical data, as well as mine-level trade records (2000–2024) to quantify these flows. We estimate 2,000–5,000 tonnes of natural uranium were exported embedded in cobalt-hydroxide shipments. Less than 10% of this material has been publicly declared and placed under international safeguards. In addition, 1,000–4,000 tonnes were likely discarded to tailings in easily-mobilized forms, posing environmental and health risks. Together, these findings identify a substantial gap in nuclear accountancy and environmental oversight within a critical mineral supply chain.
title_zh: 刚果民主共和国出口的氢氧化钴中的铀
abstract_zh: 刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 的铜带矿区是世界上主要的钴产地，而钴是能源转型必不可少的金属。在该地区，铀与氧化钴矿石共生。尽管没有官方报告的铀产量，但我们表明铀是通过刚果民主共和国的钴供应链提取、浓缩和出口的。这一结论是根据钴和铀在湿法冶金回路中的共矿化、相似行为以及将铀划分为粗氢氧化钴（刚果民主共和国 95% 以上的产量的出口形式）得出的。我们将一阶结转模型与地质测绘、矿化和地球化学数据以及矿山级贸易记录（2000-2024）相结合来量化这些流量。我们估计有 2,000-5,000 吨天然铀以氢氧化钴的形式出口。这些材料中只有不到 10% 已公开声明并置于国际保障之下。此外，有 1,000-4,000 吨可能以易于移动的形式被丢弃到尾矿中，造成环境和健康风险。总之，这些发现确定了关键矿产供应链内核会计和环境监督方面存在巨大差距。

title: An embedding-based framework enables statistical testing of gene-set function hypotheses inferred by large language models
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Emerging large language models (LLMs) can infer gene functions directly from gene lists, enabling hypothesis generation without predefined gene sets. However, these LLM-derived predictions are qualitative, and principled statistical validation is lacking. Here, we develop an embedding-based statistical framework that transforms gene and function descriptions into vector representations, enabling statistical testing of gene-gene and gene-function relationships and quantitative prioritization of de novo functional hypotheses inferred by LLMs. We benchmark seven state-of-the-art embedding models using curated and retrieval-augmented literature-derived gene descriptions across diverse biological contexts. OpenAI’s text-embedding-3-large and Google’s gemini-embedding-001 perform best, capturing gene-gene functional relationships in 88.7-92.5% of Gene Ontology biological processes and approximately 98.6% of canonical pathways. In gene-function association analyses, these models achieve high sensitivity (95.2-98.4%) and specificity (72.7-84.3%). Through contamination analysis and evaluation using experimentally informed protein assembly gene sets, our framework distinguishes biologically meaningful LLM-inferred hypotheses from noise, outperforming confidence-based inference and conventional enrichment analysis. We further develop the open-source R package DEGEmbedR and demonstrate its utility for interpreting a drug perturbation-derived differentially expressed gene (DEG) signature lacking significant conventional enrichment results. Together, these results establish LLM-derived embeddings as a quantitative foundation for functional genomics and the statistical validation of LLM-based gene function inference.
title_zh: 基于嵌入的框架可以对大型语言模型推断的基因集功能假设进行统计测试
abstract_zh: 新兴的大型语言模型（LLM）可以直接从基因列表推断基因功能，无需预定义基因集即可生成假设。然而，这些由法学硕士得出的预测是定性的，缺乏原则性的统计验证。在这里，我们开发了一个基于嵌入的统计框架，将基因和功能描述转换为向量表示，从而能够对基因-基因和基因-功能关系进行统计测试，并对法学硕士推断的从头功能假设进行定量优先级排序。我们使用跨不同生物背景的精选和检索增强的文献衍生基因描述来对七个最先进的嵌入模型进行基准测试。 OpenAI 的 text-embedding-3-large 和 Google 的 gemini-embedding-001 表现最好，捕获了 88.7-92.5% 的基因本体生物过程和大约 98.6% 的规范路径中的基因间功能关系。在基因功能关联分析中，这些模型实现了高灵敏度 (95.2-98.4%) 和特异性 (72.7-84.3%)。通过使用实验知情的蛋白质组装基因集进行污染分析和评估，我们的框架将具有生物学意义的 LLM 推断假设与噪音区分开来，优于基于置信度的推断和传统的富集分析。我们进一步开发了开源 R 包 DEGEmbedR，并证明了其在解释缺乏显着的常规富集结果的药物扰动衍生的差异表达基因 (DEG) 特征方面的实用性。总之，这些结果建立了法学硕士衍生的 e

title: A GABARAP−PtdIns3K-C1 positive feedback loop at the heart of the phagophore nucleation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: In mammalian cells, autophagosomes can reach diameters of over 1000 nm within 30 min after triggering starvation, but how such substantial amounts of membranes can be synthesized remains elusive. The phagophore initiation needs the lipid kinase PIK3C3-Complex 1 (PtdIns3K-C1), which produces phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate (PtdIns3P). PtdIns3P recruits WIPI2 that facilitates lipidation of mammalian ATG8 (mATG8) family proteins on phagophores. Here we show that recombinant membrane-coupled GABARAP binds to and potently activates PtdIns3K-C1. By a combination of cryo-electron microscopy, structural mass spectrometry, activity assays and mutagenesis, we show that GABARAP activates PtdIns3K-C1 through two binding sites. We propose that once GABARAP is indirectly recruited by PtdIns3P generated by basal activity of PtdIns3K-C1, a positive feedback loop is formed where PtdIns3K-C1 interacts with GABARAP and becomes activated to produce more PtdIns3P, thereby further stimulating GABARAP lipidation. This mechanism would be central for autophagosome biogenesis, where enlarged membranes need to be rapidly synthesized.
title_zh: 吞噬细胞成核核心的 GABARAP−PtdIns3K-C1 正反馈环
abstract_zh: 在哺乳动物细胞中，自噬体在引发饥饿后 30 分钟内直径可以达到超过 1000 nm，但如何合成如此大量的膜仍然难以捉摸。吞噬细胞的启动需要脂质激酶 PIK3C3-Complex 1 (PtdIns3K-C1)，它会产生 3-磷酸磷脂酰肌醇 (PtdIns3P)。 PtdIns3P 招募 WIPI2，促进吞噬细胞上哺乳动物 ATG8 (mATG8) 家族蛋白的脂化。在这里，我们证明重组膜偶联 GABARAP 结合并有效激活 PtdIns3K-C1。通过结合冷冻电子显微镜、结构质谱、活性测定和诱变，我们证明 GABARAP 通过两个结合位点激活 PtdIns3K-C1。我们提出，一旦 GABARAP 被 PtdIns3K-C1 基础活性产生的 PtdIns3P 间接招募，就会形成正反馈回路，其中 PtdIns3K-C1 与 GABARAP 相互作用并被激活以产生更多的 PtdIns3P，从而进一步刺激 GABARAP 脂化。这种机制对于自噬体生物发生至关重要，其中需要快速合成扩大的膜。

title: Condensation of MATCAP promotes CENP-E-dependent chromosome congression in mitosis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Accurate segregation of mitotic chromosomes requires pre-anaphase alignment driven by microtubule-based motor proteins. Tubulin detyrosination is essential to guide CENP-E-driven chromosome congression in mitosis. However, the mechanisms of action and physiochemical properties of the detyrosinases for decoding CENP-E motility remain elusive. Here we show that microtubule-associated tyrosine carboxypeptidase (MATCAP) undergoes intrinsically disordered region (IDR)-dependent liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) on microtubules to constitute the tubulin detyrosination machinery. These biomolecular condensates selectively enrich tubulin and CENP-E, thereby stabilizing kinetochore-microtubule attachments. Real-time imaging of cells expressing LLPS-deficient MATCAP mutants reveals the importance of MATCAP LLPS dynamics in mitotic chromosome alignment. Mechanistically, phase separation of MATCAP spatiotemporally couples tubulin detyrosination with CENP-E motility to ensure a robust chromosome alignment during mitosis. These findings delineate a signaling cascade that integrates phase separation and tubulin detyrosination with mitotic progression for the maintenance of genomic stability.
title_zh: MATCAP 的缩合促进有丝分裂中 CENP-E 依赖性染色体的收缩
abstract_zh: 有丝分裂染色体的准确分离需要由基于微管的运动蛋白驱动的后期前对齐。微管蛋白脱酪氨酸对于引导有丝分裂中 CENP-E 驱动的染色体折叠至关重要。然而，用于解码 CENP-E 运动的脱酪氨酸酶的作用机制和理化性质仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们表明微管相关酪氨酸羧肽酶（MATCAP）在微管上经历本质无序区域（IDR）依赖性液-液相分离（LLPS）以构成微管蛋白去酪氨酸机制。这些生物分子缩合物选择性地富集微管蛋白和 CENP-E，从而稳定动粒-微管附着。表达 LLPS 缺陷的 MATCAP 突变体的细胞的实时成像揭示了 MATCAP LLPS 动力学在有丝分裂染色体排列中的重要性。从机制上讲，MATCAP 的相分离在时空上将微管蛋白脱酪氨酸与 CENP-E 运动耦合，以确保有丝分裂过程中稳健的染色体排列。这些发现描绘了一个信号级联，它将相分离和微管蛋白脱酪氨酸与有丝分裂进展结合起来，以维持基因组稳定性。

title: Public responses about air quality in the world’s ten most populous countries
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Understanding how people view and react to outdoor air quality is crucial to effectively managing and responding to air pollution, which is a major threat to global public health. Using a quota sample of 10,618 respondents from 1,372 localities across the world’s ten most populous countries (Bangladesh, Brazil, China, Indonesia, India, Mexico, Nigeria, Pakistan, Russia, and the United States), we assessed the association between exposure to fine particulate matter with diameter ≤ 2.5 micrometers (PM2.5) and people’s knowledge, attitudes, perceptions, practices, and concern about air quality. Overall, we find an inverse association between air pollution exposure and knowledge about air quality, and a positive association between air pollution exposure, practices, attitudes, and concern about air quality. We also identified significant interactions with demographic characteristics such as age, sex, education, place of residence, political ideology, and marital, employment, or smoking status, which can inform targeted interventions among vulnerable populations.
title_zh: 公众对世界十大人口最多国家空气质量的反应
abstract_zh: 了解人们对室外空气质量的看法和反应对于有效管理和应对空气污染至关重要，空气污染是全球公共卫生的主要威胁。我们使用来自全球人口最多的十个国家（孟加拉国、巴西、中国、印度尼西亚、印度、墨西哥、尼日利亚、巴基斯坦、俄罗斯和美国）1,372 个地区的 10,618 名受访者的配额样本，评估了暴露于直径 ≤ 2.5 微米细颗粒物 (PM2.5) 与人们对空气质量的知识、态度、看法、实践和关注之间的关联。总体而言，我们发现空气污染暴露与空气质量知识之间呈负相关，而空气污染暴露、实践、态度和对空气质量的关注之间呈正相关。我们还发现了与年龄、性别、教育、居住地、政治意识形态、婚姻、就业或吸烟状况等人口特征的显着相互作用，这可以为针对弱势群体的有针对性的干预措施提供信息。

title: Engineering viral protease-operated nanobodies for programmable and orthogonal control of protein function
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Precise control of protein function in living cells is essential for engineering programmable biological systems and therapeutic applications. However, most current strategies act indirectly by altering protein stability, localization, or proximity rather than directly modulating binding activity. Here we present VIPbodies, nanobodies engineered with self-cleaving viral proteases that convert protease inhibition into drug-dependent antigen recognition. Using anti-mCherry nanobodies as prototypes, we create variants responsive to orthogonal viral protease–inhibitor pairs and extend the design to diverse nanobody scaffolds. Each VIPbody functions independently within the same cell, enabling multiplexed regulation of distinct targets. When incorporated into transcriptional circuits, VIPbodies mediate drug-tunable gene expression and execute all six canonical Boolean logic operations, providing a compact framework for programmable cellular computation. Beyond gene regulation, VIPbody circuits mediate bidirectional control of pyroptosis and selectively activate apoptotic or pyroptotic programs via caspase coupling, thereby enabling chemogenetic control of protein function and cell fate.
title_zh: 工程病毒蛋白酶操作的纳米抗体用于蛋白质功能的可编程和正交控制
abstract_zh: 精确控制活细胞中的蛋白质功能对于工程可编程生物系统和治疗应用至关重要。然而，大多数当前策略通过改变蛋白质稳定性、定位或邻近性而不是直接调节结合活性来间接起作用。在这里，我们展示了 VIPbodies，这是一种用自切割病毒蛋白酶设计的纳米抗体，可将蛋白酶抑制转化为药物依赖性抗原识别。使用抗 mCherry 纳米抗体作为原型，我们创建了对正交病毒蛋白酶-抑制剂对敏感的变体，并将设计扩展到不同的纳米抗体支架。每个 VIPbody 在同一细胞内独立发挥作用，从而实现不同靶标的多重调节。当纳入转录电路时，VIPbodies 介导药物可调基因表达并执行所有六种规范布尔逻辑运算，为可编程细胞计算提供紧凑的框架。除了基因调控之外，VIPbody 电路还介导焦亡的双向控制，并通过 caspase 偶联选择性激活细胞凋亡或焦亡程序，从而实现蛋白质功能和细胞命运的化学遗传学控制。

title: Screening of amphipathic helices identifies features linked to inner nuclear membrane properties
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Inner nuclear membrane (INM) proteins control numerous nuclear functions, yet properties governing peripheral INM-association remain poorly defined. Here, we perform an image-based screen to identify features in candidate and established amphipathic helices (AHs) that mediate INM association. AHs that localize to ER/Golgi membranes become INM-associated when directed to the nucleus, whereas mitochondrial-localized AHs become largely nucleoplasmic. Mutating a mitochondrial-localized AH to increase its preference for membranes with lipid packing defects enables INM-association upon nuclear targeting. Structural studies of an INM-associated AH in TMEM214 show folding upon binding to lipid packing defects, and full-length TMEM214 localizes to nuclear pores. Consistently across multiple AHs, INM binding depends primarily on sensitivity to lipid packing defects, with a minor electrostatic contribution. Highlighting distinct effects of different mechanical inputs, nuclear swelling, but not cell stretching, enhances INM association of select AHs. These findings define AH features that promote INM association, with implications for nucleo-mechanical responses.
title_zh: 两亲性螺旋的筛选鉴定了与内核膜特性相关的特征
abstract_zh: 内核膜 (INM) 蛋白控制着许多核功能，但控制外周 INM 关联的特性仍不清楚。在这里，我们进行基于图像的筛选来识别候选者和已建立的介导 INM 关联的两亲性螺旋 (AH) 的特征。当定向到细胞核时，定位于 ER/高尔基体膜的 AH 会变得与 INM 相关，而定位于线粒体的 AH 则主要变得与核质相关。突变线粒体定位的 AH 以增加其对具有脂质堆积缺陷的膜的偏好，从而实现核靶向时的 INM 关联。对 TMEM214 中 INM 相关 AH 的结构研究表明，与脂质堆积缺陷结合后会折叠，并且全长 TMEM214 定位于核孔。在多个 AH 中，INM 结合一致主要取决于对脂质堆积缺陷的敏感性，静电贡献较小。强调不同机械输入、核肿胀而不是细胞拉伸的不同影响，增强了选定 AH 的 INM 关联。这些发现定义了促进 INM 关联的 AH 特征，并对核机械反应具有影响。

title: Decadal sink-source shifts of forest aboveground carbon since 1988
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Forest ecosystems are vital to the global carbon cycle, yet their long-term aboveground carbon (AGC) dynamics remain uncertain. Here, we integrate multi-source satellite observations with probabilistic deep learning models to reconstruct a harmonized, uncertainty-aware global forest AGC record from 1988 to 2021 at 0.25∘. We find that, although global forests sequestered 6.2 PgC, moist tropical and boreal forests have progressively transitioned toward carbon sources since the early 2000s. Tropical AGC variability became increasingly negatively correlated with atmospheric CO2 growth rates (r = – 0.63 in 2011–2021), suggesting tropical forests increasingly modulate the global carbon cycle. In the Brazilian Amazon, the contribution of intact forests to the year-to-year variations in AGC losses increased from 33% in the 1990s to 76% in the 2010s. Our findings highlight the vulnerability of carbon stocks in key biomes and provide a benchmark to track emerging sink-source shifts under anthropogenic climate change.
title_zh: 1988年以来森林地上碳的十年汇源变化
abstract_zh: 森林生态系统对全球碳循环至关重要，但其长期地上碳（AGC）动态仍然不确定。在这里，我们将多源卫星观测与概率深度学习模型相结合，以 0.25∘ 重建 1988 年至 2021 年协调的、具有不确定性的全球森林 AGC 记录。我们发现，尽管全球森林封存了 6.2 PgC，但自 2000 年代初以来，潮湿的热带和北方森林已逐渐转向碳源。热带 AGC 变异性与大气 CO2 增长率的负相关性越来越大（2011 年至 2021 年 r = – 0.63），这表明热带森林越来越多地调节全球碳循环。在巴西亚马逊地区，完整森林对 AGC 损失逐年变化的贡献从 1990 年代的 33% 增加到 2010 年代的 76%。我们的研究结果强调了关键生物群落中碳储量的脆弱性，并为跟踪人为气候变化下新兴的汇-源变化提供了基准。

title: Impact attribution of anthropogenic forcing on lake surface temperature
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Global lakes are important sources of freshwater, supporting biodiversity and providing vital ecosystem services. While widespread lake surface warming has been well-documented, formal attribution of this trend to specific anthropogenic drivers has remained out of reach. Here, we provide the attribution of global lake surface warming to human activities using a dataset that integrates satellite-constrained lake temperature estimates with climate model simulations. From 1950 to 2020, we find that the observed 0.47 °C increase in lake surface temperature is primarily driven by greenhouse gas emissions, which contributed a warming trend of 0.95 °C, partially offset by aerosol-induced cooling of −0.28 °C. A dominant greenhouse-gas fingerprint is consistently detected across 23 of 44 studied regions, with regional variations reflecting the influence of other anthropogenic and natural forcings. Our findings provide the direct evidence of global lake surface warming induced by greenhouse-gas emissions, offering scientific foundations for climate accountability and future adaptation in a warming world.
title_zh: 人为强迫对湖面温度的影响归因
abstract_zh: 全球湖泊是重要的淡水来源，支持生物多样性并提供重要的生态系统服务。尽管广泛的湖面变暖已得到充分记录，但将这种趋势正式归因于特定的人为驱动因素仍然遥不可及。在这里，我们使用一个数据集将全球湖泊表面变暖归因于人类活动，该数据集将卫星约束的湖泊温度估计与气候模型模拟相结合。我们发现，从1950年到2020年，观察到的湖面温度上升了0.47°C，主要是由温室气体排放驱动的，温室气体排放导致了0.95°C的变暖趋势，部分被气溶胶引起的-0.28°C的降温所抵消。在 44 个研究区域中的 23 个区域中一致检测到了主要温室气体指纹，区域差异反映了其他人为和自然强迫的影响。我们的研究结果提供了温室气体排放引起的全球湖面变暖的直接证据，为气候变暖的世界的气候责任和未来适应提供了科学基础。

title: Gene regulatory innovations from transposable elements in primate cerebellum development
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Transposable elements are hypothesized to have driven gene regulatory innovation, yet their contributions to primate brain development at the cell type level remain underexplored. Here, we use single-cell multiomics data from human, macaque, marmoset, and mouse cerebella to show that transposable element contributions to different cell types are shaped by varying degrees of constraints across cell types, as well as the preferential co-option of certain transposable elements in specific cell states. Using a sequence-based deep-learning model that predicts cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility, we systematically assess the co-option potential of transposable elements into cerebellar gene regulatory networks, identifying twelve transposable element subfamilies with complex regulatory sequences in their ancestral states that facilitate their co-option as cell-type-specific cis-regulatory elements. Preservation of these ancestral regulatory sequences, as well as the active chromatin environment surrounding the insertion site, is the major determinant of the accessibility of extant copies. Lineage-specific accessible copies contribute to human-specific gene expression. Broadly, we demonstrate how transposable elements can be flexibly co-opted into cell-type-specific gene regulatory networks, and introduce a generalizable analytical framework for dissecting their contribution to mammalian regulatory evolution.
title_zh: 灵长类小脑发育中转座元件的基因调控创新
abstract_zh: 据推测，转座元件推动了基因调控创新，但它们在细胞类型水平上对灵长类大脑发育的贡献仍未得到充分探索。在这里，我们使用来自人类、猕猴、狨猴和小鼠小脑的单细胞多组学数据来表明，转座元件对不同细胞类型的贡献是由不同程度的跨细胞类型的约束以及特定细胞状态下某些转座元件的优先共同选择决定的。使用基于序列的深度学习模型来预测细胞类型特异性染色质可及性，我们系统地评估了转座元件在小脑基因调控网络中的共选潜力，识别了十二个转座元件亚家族，其祖先状态下具有复杂的调控序列，有助于它们作为细胞类型特异性顺式调控元件的共选。这些祖先调控序列的保存以及插入位点周围的活性染色质环境是现有拷贝可及性的主要决定因素。谱系特异性可访问拷贝有助于人类特异性基因表达。从广义上讲，我们展示了转座元件如何灵活地纳入细胞类型特异性基因调控网络，并引入一个通用的分析框架来剖析它们对哺乳动物调控进化的贡献。

source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract:
When Andy Burnham became the United Kingdom’s prime minister last week, among his first acts was to abolish the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT), folding it into a new superministry for
                    Business, Innovation, Science and Trade
                    . The science minister,
                    Patrick Vallance
                    , stepped down the same day. Viewed from the United States, where the federal research system is under pressure, it may be tempting to see Britain’s reshuffle as kindred turmoil and proof that political instability is corroding science on both sides of the Atlantic. That reading would be wrong. Britain has rearranged the machinery of its science policy, not undermined its foundations. The change could sharpen the contribution of UK research to the economic renewal that Burnham has made his defining mission.

title: The molecular architecture of mammalian vitreous body collagen fibrils
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Collagen, a fundamental constituent of the extracellular matrix, has long remained elusive to high-resolution structural characterization. Using a tailored system and optimized cryo–electron microscopy processing for long-period filaments, we determined the structure of native collagen fibrils from the porcine vitreous body, with local resolutions extending from 2.6 to 7 angstroms. Each 67-nanometer periodic unit contains type II, V/XI, and IX collagen triple helices together with opticin, at a stoichiometry of 8:4:4:4, which reveals their detailed higher-order molecular packing. Abundant galactose-glucose disaccharides modify hydroxylysine residues in conserved -glycine-X-hydroxylysine- motifs, mediating fibril packing and structural stability. Our structure uncovers the glycan-mediated assembly principle of collagen fibrils and clarifies the structure-function basis of collagens in the vitreous body.

title: Toward an exact quantum many-body treatment of Kondo correlation in magnetic impurities
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: The Kondo effect is a prototypical quantum phenomenon arising from the interaction between localized electrons in a magnetic impurity and itinerant electrons in a metallic host. Although this phenomenon has served as the testing ground for quantum many-body methods for decades, the precise description of Kondo physics with material specificity remains challenging. Here, we present a systematic ab initio approach to converge toward an exact zero-temperature electronic treatment of Kondo correlations. Across a series of 3d transition metals, we extracted Kondo temperatures matching subtle experimental trends, with accuracy exceeding that of standard models. We further obtained microscopic insight into the origin of these trends. More broadly, we demonstrate the possibility to start from fully ab initio many-body simulations and push toward the realm of converged predictions.
title_zh: 磁性杂质中近藤相关性的精确量子多体处理
abstract_zh: 近藤效应是一种典型的量子现象，由磁性杂质中的局域电子与金属主体中的流动电子之间的相互作用产生。尽管这种现象几十年来一直作为量子多体方法的试验场，但对具有材料特异性的近藤物理学的精确描述仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了一种系统的从头算方法，以收敛于近藤相关性的精确零温度电子处理。在一系列 3d 过渡金属中，我们提取了与微妙的实验趋势相匹配的近藤温度，其精度超过了标准模型。我们进一步对这些趋势的起源进行了微观洞察。更广泛地说，我们展示了从完全从头开始的多体模拟并推动融合预测领域的可能性。

title: Beyond the scales: Marine archaeogenomics for the conservation and restoration of fisheries
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Protection and restoration of marine environments are essential for food security and climate change mitigation. Yet historical and archaeological research have shown that conservation and management often rely on arbitrary ecological baselines in ecosystems already shaped by long-term human impacts. Archaeogenomics, the combination of ancient DNA (aDNA) and whole-genome sequencing, provides invaluable insights into these impacts. Recent improvements in laboratory and computational techniques enable the assessment of past fish population dynamics, migration patterns, historical trade routes, long-term anthropogenic pressures, and responses to environmental change. This Review compiles aDNA research on archaeological fish remains, emphasizing studies from 2020 to 2025 that used whole-genome analysis to investigate historical fisheries and marine ecosystem change. We highlight the growing potential of archaeogenomics to inform restoration, conservation, sustainable fisheries management, and climate adaptation strategies worldwide.
title_zh: 超越尺度：用于渔业保护和恢复的海洋考古基因组学
abstract_zh: 保护和恢复海洋环境对于粮食安全和减缓气候变化至关重要。然而历史和考古研究表明，保护和管理往往依赖于已经受到长期人类影响形成的生态系统中的任意生态基线。考古基因组学是古代 DNA (aDNA) 和全基因组测序的结合，为了解这些影响提供了宝贵的见解。实验室和计算技术的最新改进使得能够评估过去的鱼类种群动态、迁徙模式、历史贸易路线、长期人为压力以及对环境变化的反应。本综述汇编了考古鱼类遗骸的aDNA研究，重点关注2020年至2025年利用全基因组分析来调查历史渔业和海洋生态系统变化的研究。我们强调考古基因组学在为全球恢复、保护、可持续渔业管理和气候适应战略提供信息方面日益增长的潜力。

title: The genomic identity of early smallpox in South America
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Smallpox was a major driver of population collapse in the Americas after European contact, yet the genetic identity of the causal strains remains unknown. Here, we report the first ancient smallpox genomes in the Americas, dating to approximately 1492–1631 common era (CE), recovered from two Inca-Colonial individuals in northern Chile. These genomes form a now-extinct lineage that diverged around 1296 CE, after the splitting of early medieval European strains but before the emergence of modern variola lineages, providing direct molecular evidence for smallpox introduction through European colonization. We further identify a constant tempo of gene inactivation until the late 16th century, followed by a phase of constraint and a subsequent rebound in substitution rates, linking variola virus evolution to major shifts in human demography and epidemiology.
title_zh: 南美洲早期天花的基因组特征
abstract_zh: 天花是欧洲接触后美洲人口锐减的主要原因，但致病菌株的遗传身份仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了美洲第一个古代天花基因组，可追溯到大约公元 1492 年至 1631 年，从智利北部的两个印加殖民地个体中发现。这些基因组形成了一个现已灭绝的谱系，该谱系在公元 1296 年左右分化，在中世纪早期欧洲菌株分裂之后但在现代天花谱系出现之前，为天花通过欧洲殖民传入提供了直接的分子证据。我们进一步确定了直到 16 世纪末基因失活的恒定节奏，随后是一个限制阶段和随后的替代率反弹，将天花病毒的进化与人类人口学和流行病学的重大转变联系起来。

title: Catalytic Appel fluorination of alcohols with potassium fluoride
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Appel halogenation reactions are widely used to convert alcohols to alkyl halides but are not suitable to prepare alkyl fluorides because fluoride is sequestered as a difluorophosphorane. In this work, we introduce bench-stable neopentoxyphosphonium salts to solve this enduring challenge. With these reagents, various alcohols undergo fluorination with potassium fluoride under hydrogen bonding phase-transfer catalysis, a manifold offering a pathway to enantioselective fluorination of alcohols. Mechanistically, a neopentoxyfluorophosphorane is formed, which undergoes reversible exchange with the alcohol substrate in preference to difluorophosphorane formation. The catalyst assists with potassium fluoride solubilization and with phosphorus–fluorine bond dissociation, leading to the alkoxyphosphonium fluoride ion pair undergoing stereoinvertive fluorination. Turnover results from stronger binding of the catalyst to fluoride than phosphine oxide, the by-product of the reaction, which is recyclable as starting material for the synthesis of the phosphonium reagents.
title_zh: 氟化钾催化 Appel 氟化醇
abstract_zh: 阿佩尔卤化反应广泛用于将醇转化为烷基卤，但不适合制备烷基氟，因为氟化物以二氟正膦的形式被螯合。在这项工作中，我们引入了实验室稳定的新戊氧基鏻盐来解决这一持久的挑战。使用这些试剂，各种醇在氢键相转移催化下用氟化钾进行氟化，这为醇的对映选择性氟化提供了一条途径。从机理上讲，形成新戊氧基氟正膦，其优先于二氟正膦形成而与醇底物发生可逆交换。该催化剂有助于氟化钾溶解和磷-氟键解离，导致烷氧基鏻氟离子对进行立体反转氟化。转化率是由于催化剂与氟化物的结合力强于反应副产物氧化膦，氧化膦可作为合成鏻试剂的起始材料进行回收。

title: Plasma surface engineering for efficient and stable perovskite solar cells and modules
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract:
The instability of perovskite solar cells (PSCs) stems largely from the formation and evolution of interfacial defects associated with the soft, multicomponent perovskite lattice. We report a scalable, plasma-based passivation strategy that forms conformal, uniform, and strong-bonded heterostructure through in situ chemical reactions on large-area perovskite films. This approach also mitigates defect accumulation within the laser-scribed interconnection regions, where localized damage often dominates module-level performance losses. We achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 27.2% in small-area devices (active area 8.313 square millimeters) and 24.0% (certified efficiency of 23.5%) in 100-square-centimeter (cm
                    2
                    ) modules (aperture area 65.05 cm
                    2

                    2
                    module retained 99.3% of its initial PCE after 1600 hours at 65°C under 1-sun illumination.

title: A 10-million-year biogeographic holding pen primed the Great American Biotic Interchange
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: The movement of taxa between North and South America across the Panamanian land bridge, known as the Great American Biotic Interchange (GABI), established modern-day mammal assemblages in the Americas, heralding the decisive end of what has been called the “splendid isolation” of the South American fauna. Lacking substantive low-latitude records, previous work on this pattern relied on South American and temperate North American fossils to conclude that pulsed interchanges began about 2.8 million years ago (mya). Based on new low-latitude fossil data from México, we found evidence for a prolonged, triphasic interchange. Phase 1 consisted of the initial accumulation of northern higher-latitude mammals in a Mexican “holding pen” beginning 10 mya. Dispersal began in phase 2, with a strong north-south gradient and increasing biogeographic connections (7 to 3 mya). The final phase consisted of the already well-described taxonomic pulses (from ~2.8 mya).
title_zh: 一千万年的生物地理围栏为大美国生物交汇处做好了准备
abstract_zh: 类群在北美和南美洲之间跨越巴拿马陆桥（被称为大美洲生物交汇处（GABI））的移动，在美洲建立了现代哺乳动物群落，预示着所谓的南美动物群“绝妙隔离”的决定性结束。由于缺乏实质性的低纬度记录，之前对这种模式的研究依赖于南美洲和北美温带的化石，得出脉冲交换开始于大约 280 万年前 (mya) 的结论。根据墨西哥新的低纬度化石数据，我们发现了长期三相交换的证据。第一阶段包括北部高纬度哺乳动物在 10 米开始在墨西哥“围栏”中的初步积累。扩散开始于第二阶段，具有较强的南北梯度和不断增加的生物地理联系（7 至 3 mya）。最后阶段包括已经详细描述的分类脉冲（从~2.8 mya）。

title: Calcium isotopes link ocean acidification to Aptian–Albian foraminiferal extinctions
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract:
The second-largest extinction event in the evolutionary history of planktic foraminifera occurred at the Aptian–Albian boundary. This extinction may reflect ocean acidification (OA) associated with Oceanic Anoxic Event 1b. As calcium isotope ratios (δ
                    44/40
                    Ca) can track how biocalcification rates respond to OA, we measured δ
                    44/40
                    Ca records for planktic and benthic foraminifera, bulk carbonates, and authigenic calcite across the Aptian–Albian boundary in the South Atlantic. Benthic and bulk δ
                    44/40
                    Ca data display a distinct sequence of negative and positive excursions, similar to δ
                    44/40
                    Ca variations across other OA events. Planktic δ
                    44/40
                    Ca values increase markedly, tracking a reduction in calcification rates coincident with decreases in the size, diversity, and shell thickness of planktic foraminifera. These results suggest that OA drove extinctions of planktic foraminifera at the Aptian–Albian boundary.

title: n-Type polymer layers enable efficient, scalable, and thermally stable perovskite solar modules
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Fullerene-based electron transport layers (ETLs) used in inverted (p-i-n) perovskite solar cells face issues regarding cost, scalability, and instability, whereas highly stable inorganic oxides feature unfavorable energy alignment and enhance hysteresis, which reduce power conversion efficiency (PCE). We report a nonfullerene conjugated polymer, 2PB-T, that incorporates coplanar and electron-withdrawing perylene bisimide (PBI) units into its backbone. The PBI polymeric backbone and side-chain engineering address the instability of small-molecule ETLs by optimizing electron transport properties, film uniformity, and interfacial binding. Small-area devices achieved a champion PCE of 27.8%, with a certified maximum power point tracking (MPPT) efficiency of 27.3%. Perovskite modules with areas of 20.6 and 625 square centimeters reached PCEs of 24.4 and 22.5%, respectively. Small-area devices retained more than 98.6% of their initial PCE after 1752 hours of continuous MPPT at 85°C in air, and the 625-square-centimeter module maintained 96.9% of its initial PCE after 5900 hours of outdoor operation.
title_zh: n 型聚合物层可实现高效、可扩展且热稳定的钙钛矿太阳能模块
